chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Notification states:
At any point in time, notifications will have one of the three following states:

1. Unseen

These are notifications that the learner has not clicked on. The number of unseen notifications is shown in a red bubble on the top of the Bell icon. When the learner clicks on the Notification icon and opens the pop-up window, all of the unseen notifications are changed to the seen state, and the red bubble disappears.

2. Unread

Notifications not seen by the learner are considered unread and displayed with a white background. Learners can mark all the notifications as read by clicking the action Mark all as read on the Notifications page.

3. Read

Notifications that the learner has clicked on are called read notifications. These notifications are displayed with a grey background. Learners can mark all the notifications as read by clicking the action Mark all as read on the Notifications page.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Tags:
Tags are attributes that you can apply to all modules, files, questions, polls, and evaluation parameters (mission and coaching sessions). Tags help admins with filtering, organizing, and searching for content (from Manage Tags) as well as reporting of content (from Tag Analytics). Learners can also filter search results using tags.

Note: Tags applied to evaluation parameters will not appear in global search results on the learning site. For example, the tag “acme” is added to a mission’s evaluation parameter. When users search with “acme” on the learning site, the corresponding mission would not appear in the search results.

To learn about how to create and manage tags, see Create and manage Tags.

This article provides information on applying tags to:

- New modules
- Existing modules
- Apply Tags in bulk

1. To apply tags to a new module, click Apply tags on the Create screen when creating the module. An example of applying tags in the quick update module:
2. To apply a tag from the Apply Tags screen, select available tags from the different sections or select a tag from the Suggested Tags section. Note : Tag suggestions are based on recently created and frequently used tags. You can search for an existing tag by typing its name in the search bar.
3. To create a new tag, click Create new Tag .
4. If you create a new tag, select the Category from the drop-down and click the checkbox to create the tag. For more information on creating and managing tags, see Create and manage tags .
5. Click Apply Tags . You can also click Apply More Tags to add more tags. Note :

- You can apply up to 1000 tags to a module.
- Tags are not case-sensitive.

Note:

- You can apply tags to files, media, questions, and polls.

Tip: You can also create new tags. See Step 4 in the Apply tags to a new course or quick update module section for more information.

9. Click Add.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Platform communication requirements:
Mindtickle uses secure HTTPS and real-time communication to send updates between the platform and the browser. Some platform operations, such as file uploads, CSV upload validation, formatting checks, row-level processing status, and completion responses, use secure WebSocket connections.

Asynchronous tasks also use the same WebSocket-based real-time communication channel to send progress updates and completion status to the browser. This includes bulk operations such as archive, mirror, and move in Programs and Content Center.

The System feedback, which displays notifications on the site, relies on the same real-time communication channel to show the latest updates.

If WebSocket communication is blocked or intercepted by a firewall, proxy, or SSL inspection tool, the browser may not receive real-time progress or completion updates. As a result, the page may remain stuck on Processing... or continue to show an in-progress state, even if the operation has completed on the server.

Work with your IT or network security team to allow the following connections:

| Requirement | Details |
| --- | --- |
| Allowlist Mindtickle domains | https://*.mindtickle.com and wss://*.mindtickle.com |
| WebSocket communication | Allow WebSocket Secure (wss://) communication over TCP port 443. |
| WebSocket upgrade requests | Allow WebSocket upgrade requests over HTTPS. |
| Persistent connections | Allow persistent, long-lived TCP connections to Mindtickle domains on TCP port 443. |
| SSL inspection | Disable SSL inspection for *.mindtickle.com. SSL inspection can interrupt WebSocket upgrade handshakes and real-time communication. |
| Streaming responses | Do not buffer text/event-stream responses. |
| Transfer encoding | Support chunked transfer encoding. |
| Idle timeout | Configure network timeout limits so long-running upload, validation, streaming, or processing operations are not terminated prematurely. |
| Custom or white-label domains | If your organization uses a custom or white-label Mindtickle domain, apply the same rules to that domain. |

Note: These requirements are platform-wide and are separate from feature-specific allowlist requirements, such as AI Roleplay connectivity requirements.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Learners > Access the report:
You can open a learner’s overall report from several analytics views across the platform:

From series reports

- On the Series reports page, click the name of the series for which you want to view the learner’s performance.
- Go to the Learners tab and scroll to click the learner’s name.
- The Details tab of the learner’s overall report opens, filtered for the selected series.

From manager and group reports

- On the Manager reports or Group reports page, click the name of the manager or group the learner belongs to.
- Click the learner’s name. In the preview panel on the right, click View overall report .
- The Overview tab of the learner’s overall report opens.

From the Readiness Index (RI)

- In Readiness Index > click an RI group > Reports tab > User distribution table, click the learner’s name to open their Scorecard tab in the overall report.
- In Readiness Index > click an RI group > Correlate tab > Learner scatter chart , click the learner’s name in the bubble chart to open their Scorecard tab in the overall report.

To learn more, see Readiness Index scorecard for admins.

The Overview tab contains a summary of the learner’s profile, engagement data, and certifications.

- Basic details: Includes name, contact information, assigned initiatives, and general engagement stats.
- Engagement trends: Displays learner activity over the past 12 months. Hover over data points for more detail. Note: The engagement trends chart can be filtered by module status (Modules invited, Modules started, Modules completed). Click on the chart legend to enable or disable each category.

- Certifications: Lists modules with certification, current status, and score or % score earned.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Learners > Details:
The Details tab displays the learner’s performance across all assigned modules.

Filters

Use the following filters to narrow down the module data:

- Modules assigned during: Filter by assignment date range.
- Series: Filter by the series the module belongs to.
- Module type: Filter by module type such as course, assessment, or quest.
- More filters: Use Public series data and Module relevance (multi-select) filters for further customization.

Overview charts

The top section displays:

- Modules assigned
- % Completion
- % Score

Note: These charts allow filtering based on completion status and score range. Use the legend to toggle each category.

Report table columns

This table includes the following columns:

- Module name
- % Completion
- % Score
- Certificate earned
- Invited on

You can sort the table by any column using the sort icon. By default, modules are sorted alphabetically.

Available time columns

Use the dropdown in the Invited on column to display additional columns:

- Due date
- Started on
- Completed on

These time-based columns are also included in the exported report.

Additional actions

- Export report: Click the export icon, enter your email, and click Submit to receive the report by email.
- Access module report: Click the more icon beside a module to view the learner’s report card (learner's module report) .

Learn more about performance metrics and analytics terms and definitions.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Course and quick update:
This article focuses on how to record your screen in a course or quick update.

To learn more about course and quick update modules, refer to the following articles:

- Create a course
- Create a quick update

1. From a course or quick update, click Add learning objects.

2. In the Add learning objects panel, select Screen recording under Build content.

3. Grant the microphone access from the browser by clicking the Click here option.

Note: If the microphone access is already provided, you will land directly in the microphone settings mentioned in Step 5.

4. The following microphone settings appear:

- Option to choose microphone device
- Microphone audio level feedback
- Set recording countdown

Modify these settings if needed and click Done to proceed to the recording screen.

5. Click the Start recording button placed at the bottom of the window. Allow screen share on the pop-up window that appears.

6. The recording starts following the countdown. You can view the microphone feedback and the length of the recording, in minutes and seconds.

7. Once the recording is complete, stop it by clicking Stop Recording. This will initiate the uploading and processing of the recording. A draft will be created once the recording is saved.

8. Choose to preview the draft and save it as a final video or record multiple drafts. Save one of the drafts as the final video.

If you want to replace a saved video, click Replace, to roll back to the recorded drafts state. Choose from existing drafts or click Create new draft to record a new video and Save as final video.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Content Provider > Deployment:
To deploy the Skillsoft - Mindtickle integration, your organization needs to hold a production instance of both Mindtickle and Skillsoft. Before you begin, ensure that the following decisions are made by the Skillsoft administrator to initiate deployment.

1. The frequency at which content should be synced to Mindtickle. For example: every 6 hours, every 12 hours, etc. The frequency should be based on how often the content is updated in Skillsoft.
2. Communicate the Skillsoft CustomerId, EndPoint, and SharedSecret values to the Mindtickle Admin.

Once you have finalized these decisions, the Mindtickle Administrator uses the Skillsoft Open Learning Services Architecture (OLSA) protocol to pull newly created and updated content from Skillsoft to Mindtickle.

Note: If the content in a published Module is updated or the content is deleted from Mindtickle, the Mindtickle Admin sends an email to the content creator to initiate syncing it to Skillsoft.

After the integration is complete, the Skillsoft Library will be visible in your Mindtickle Admin Site.

Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) for more information on the Skillsoft - Mindtickle integration and deployment.

Once you finish the editing, click Save at the upper-right corner of the screen. On the pop-up that appears, click Confirm.

Note: This pop-up is applicable only for default templates and does not appear while editing custom templates.

button that appears. Make your changes and click to save or to discard the changes.

For non-UID enabled sites, if users with duplicate email addresses from SFDC gain access to Mindtickle via Connected apps, multiple individuals could potentially log in to the same Mindtickle account, posing a risk of data or security breaches. It is recommended that UID is enabled for your learning site to ensure this feature works as intended.Tip: You can identify whether a site is UID-enabled through the Add users to the platform flow. To use it for authentication, the email ID must be configured as the Username too.]
2. For customers without a UID, only the SFDC email is presently mapped to the Mindtickle email for authentication and user creation. In scenarios where customers possess duplicate emails, it's crucial to restrict access to authorized users by filtering profiles within the connected app. For more information, see step 11 in this section.

12. [Additional steps for UID-enabled sites] If your learning site is UID-enabled, you must add a custom attribute to ensure Salesforce SSO works as intended. The custom attribute, unique to each user in Salesforce, serves as a distinctive value that is then integrated into Mindtickle as an identifier specific to that user.

To add a custom attribute, follow the steps mentioned below:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Single Sign-On (SSO) > Steps to be performed in Mindtickle:
1. Set up the SSO configuration details. You can enter the details manually, or use the Upload provider meta file option to upload the metadata file, which auto-populates the details. On the Salesforce page, click Upload identity provider meta file to upload the metadata file saved on your system.
2. Once the file is uploaded successfully, the Redirect URL , Post URL , and Certificate fields are automatically populated. Click Activate SSO .
3. Click Activate SSO . A green check mark on the SSO tab indicates that the SSO is activated successfully. Your learners should now be able to sign in with Veeva on their Mindtickle learning site.
4. Click Edit configuration to edit the SSO configuration details. Once you’ve added the new details, click Update SSO .
5. Click Update SSO .
6. To deactivate the SSO, click Deactivate SSO .
7. Click Deactivate SSO in the pop-up. The green check mark disappears from the SSO tab. This indicates that the SSO is successfully deactivated (or not activated yet).

Yes. The reporting API allows you to extract raw, granular data from the Mindtickle platform. You can ingest this data into Business Intelligence (BI) tools — such as Tableau, PowerBI, or Microsoft Excel — to build tailored visualizations and reports.

The LearnerModulePerformances table is the primary table used for reporting within the Mindtickle reporting API. It captures the performance data of a learner within a specific module that is part of a specific series.

The granularity of each row in this table is defined as: Learner × Module × Series.

While this table contains performance metrics, it may not include deep learner attributes. To access specific user data points — such as profile fields and KScore — you can join the LearnerModulePerformances table with the Users table using the unique User ID.

The LearnerModulePerformances table primarily provides high-level, generic performance metrics for learners across the modules they have been invited to. It does not contain granular, module-specific engagement data or detailed interaction metrics.

The following specific metrics are not available in this table:

- Coaching sessions: Reviewer name, session number, and parameter scores.
- Missions: Reviewer name and parameter scores.
- Assessments: Responses to individual questions.
- Courses: Engagement metrics for specific files or videos.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Mindtickle APIs > Reporting APIs:
To enable Reporting API access for a specific user email address on your Mindtickle instance, follow these steps:

1. Verify admin access: Ensure the user holds an admin role and has access to the Mindtickle admin site. Note: Only users with the following roles are considered admins: Site Owner, Enablement Admin, Content Expert, and IT Admin.
2. Request access: If the user meets the criteria above, contact Mindtickle Support to enable Reporting API access for their account.

Once enabled, the user can use their email address to import data into Business Intelligence (BI) tools, such as Tableau, PowerBI, and Microsoft Excel.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > SCORM Content:
Interactive training courses created using e-Learning authoring tools can be accessed using Mindtickle. This article explains best practices for publishing SCORM packages created using Articulate Storyline 360 on Mindtickle. Learn more about best practices for Articulate Storyline 2 & 3, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate 9 and Camtasia.

Note:

- If you are facing issues with videos in your SCORM content not autoplaying due to the policy update in Chrome 66 , follow the workaround suggested by Articulate .
- Mindtickle recommends using HTML5 output format in your SCORM packages for compatibility on both web and mobile.
- We highly recommend limiting your SCORM package size to less than 500 MB. To learn more, see SCORM content on Mindtickle .
- If you have existing content in Flash-only output, you need to republish it to HTML5.
- Mindtickle only hosts the SCORM content on its platform. Testing the SCORM files is outside the scope of Mindtickle support. The Mindtickle support team provides the findings based on primary evidence shared by the customer. Before raising a support ticket, it is recommended to go through the help articles related to the best practices for admins.
- Mindtickle support determines the need to test the SCORM files in exceptional situations, on a case-to-case basis and provides recommendations, only if the customer shares the raw SCORM files and other related data. Once shared, Mindtickle support will assist the customer in advisory capability.

Interactive training courses created using e-Learning authoring tools can be accessed using Mindtickle. This article explains best practices for publishing SCORM packages created using Articulate Rise on Mindtickle. Learn more about best practices on Articulate Storyline 360, Articulate Storyline 2 & 3, Adobe Captivate 9, and Camtasia.

Note:

- If you are facing issues with videos in your SCORM content not auto-playing due to the policy update in Chrome 66 , follow the workaround suggested by Articulate .
- Mindtickle recommends using HTML5 output format in your SCORM packages for compatibility on both web and mobile.
- We highly recommend limiting your SCORM package size to less than 500 MB. To learn more, see SCORM content on Mindtickle .
- If you have existing content in Flash-only output, you need to republish it to HTML5.
- Mindtickle only hosts the SCORM content on its platform. Testing the SCORM files is outside the scope of Mindtickle support. The Mindtickle support team provides the findings based on primary evidence shared by the customer. Before raising a support ticket, it is recommended to go through the help articles related to the best practices for admins.
- Mindtickle support determines the need to test the SCORM files in exceptional situations, on a case-to-case basis and provides recommendations, only if the customer shares the raw SCORM files and other related data. Once shared, Mindtickle support will assist the customer in advisory capability.

Follow these recommended steps before you publish your SCORM content to Mindtickle.

1. Open your project in Articulate Rise.

2. Click Settings on the upper right corner of the header menu.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > SCORM Content > SCORM 1.2:
To configure settings for SCORM 1.2 content packages,

1. Under Status Representation, select Incomplete to Complete.

2. Choose the Success/Completion Criteria based on how you want to mark the course completed/successful in Mindtickle.

a. Select User Access if you want to mark the course completed/successful if the learner has only accessed it, but may or may not have viewed the content.

b. Select Slide views and /or quiz if you want to mark the course completed /successful based on the number of slides the learner has viewed. If you choose this option, ensure that the Quiz checkbox is not selected. Enter the percentage (%) of slides viewed or the number of slides after which you want to mark the course successful or complete.

c. If your course contains a quiz, select Quiz and choose any option from the drop-down list based on your preference. If you choose this option, ensure that the Slide views checkbox is not selected.

3. Under the Data to Report section, choose how you want Mindtickle to track the Quiz Score (based on Percentage or Points) and select Interaction Data.

4. Under the LMS Advanced Settings, select the Send Data On Every Slide.

5. Click OK to save your settings.

6. Go to the Publish to Mindtickle section to enable the appropriate settings before you publish your SCORM package to Mindtickle.

This article explains the steps to update the content in a course or quick update.

1. On the admin site, navigate to the series that contains the module which you want to update.

2. Click Edit from the options on the left.

3. Update the content or make the desired changes to your module.

4. Once done, click the Update button to sync the changes in the module.

To learn more, see Which changes to a published module, will or will not trigger a module update?

5. Choose one of the following options depending on the state of the Learners’ progress in the Module in the Push these changes for drop-down list:

- only to those who will be invited hereafterNote: The progress of already invited Learners won't be affected.
- only those who have NOT started the [Module Type]Note: The progress of the Learners who have already started, and the progress of the Learners who have already completed the Module won't be affected.
- only those who have NOT started or NOT completed the [Module Type]Note: The progress of the Learners who have already completed the Module won't be affected.
- all, including those who have completed the [Module Type]Note:

- The progress of all the Learners irrespective of their state of completion will be affected.
- The Learning Content that has changed will be incomplete.
- The Learning Content that has not changed will still be complete if the Learner has completed it before.
- The Learner will have to redo/reattempt the Learning Content that was changed.

The following image is an example of a course module.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup:
Automation rules enable you to automate user management, role assignment and revocation, content assignment, and asset recommendation tasks otherwise carried out manually. From the Automation rules tab, you can:

- Use Mindtickle conditions to create role and user-based rules within Mindtickle.
- Use Salesforce conditions to create opportunity-based rules in Salesforce.

These rules are created by applying conditions on modules, groups, profile fields, roles, or opportunity fields and defining actions that are taken for learners who meet the conditions. Using this feature, admins can create automated learning paths for learners. Through integration with external applications such as Salesforce, the rules automate personalized content recommendations to sales reps based on the specific stage of the sales cycle. This helps bring the relevant deal-winning content, assets, and resources into the rep’s workflow. Thus, ensuring that sales reps deliver the right content to prospects at the right time. This enables the admins to automate repetitive actions that usually need human intervention. It also helps save time and reduces the manual effort and error margin by omitting repetitive manual actions.

Your learning site must meet the following prerequisites to enable it for your learning site:

- Asset Hub must be enabled on your learning site.
- Salesforce Opportunity Integration must be configured on your learning site.
- The most recent version of the Mindtickle app in SFDC must be installed.

For more information, contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

Note: There may be a delay between activating an automation rule and the execution of the specified action. This delay may arise due to any of the following reasons:

This delay may arise due to any of the following reasons:

- A lag between the creation and activation of the rule.
- The values of the attributes in the rule are changed. For example, if an existing rule is configured as: If the Learner department = Customer Success, assign user to the series Customer Onboarding Best Practices. Suppose the admin updates a learner’s department from Product Marketing to Customer Success. In that case, there may be a lag between the admin updating the learner’s profile field value and the learner getting assigned to the series Customer Onboarding Best Practices.

While the automation suite is designed to process rules promptly, several factors, including system load, network conditions, rule complexity, dependencies on external systems, and queue size, can influence the timing of the action. We recommend considering this potential delay when setting up and relying on automation rules for critical tasks or time-sensitive actions. If you have specific timing requirements, we encourage you to plan accordingly to ensure the desired outcomes are achieved within your expected timeframe.

- Access automation rules
- Filter automation rules

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Access automation rules:
1. On the admin site homepage, click Account and select Automation suite . The Automation suite page is displayed.A list of all automation rules applicable to your learning site is displayed under the Automation Rules tab. In case there are no rules created, then this page will be blank. If rules are created and still not displayed on this page, contact Mindtickle Support.Note:
  - All rules applicable to your learning site (except SFDC Opportunity rules, time-based rules, and other highly complex rules created on the backend) are visible on the Automation rules tab.
  - SFDC - Opportunity-based rules are visible in the list only if Automation Suite 2.0 is enabled on your learning site and at least one such rule is created. For more information on Automation Suite 2.0, see the introduction section of this article.
  - User-based rules created using Mindtickle conditions, for example, Status on module , Score on module , are denoted by the relevant icon in the list. For example, in the screenshot below, the first rule in the list is created using the Status on module condition, and the module is a Course. So, it is denoted by the icon. Similarly, a profile-based rule is denoted by the icon and a role-based rule is denoted by the icon. Opportunity-based rules created using Salesforce conditions, for example, SFDC - Opportunity , are denoted by the icon.
  - If a rule is invalid, the Invalid rule icon appears against it in the Conditions column. Hover over the icon for more details. A rule becomes invalid if one or more entities (modules, groups, series, profile fields, roles, or opportunity fields) in the rule condition are archived or deleted. If all entities in the rule condition are archived or deleted, No conditions and the Invalid rule icon are displayed instead of the rule in the Conditions column. You can update the rule conditions in an invalid rule and activate it later. For more information, see Edit a Rule . Once the rule conditions are updated and the rule is no longer invalid, you can choose to Activate it based on your use case. If more than one condition is added to the rule, by default, the first condition is visible. To view all conditions, hover over View all conditions . All conditions added to the rule are displayed in the pop-up that appears.
  - If a rule is deleted:
    - The actions triggered by the rule in the past are not undone. The details for all past actions are available in system logs .
    - The actions specified in the rule are not triggered moving forward.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Filter automation rules:
- Rule status To filter rules based on their status, click the dropdown and select one of the three values:
  - Active
  - Inactive
  - Invalid
- Rule application period Use this option to filter rules applied during a specific time period. A rule is applied successfully if all conditions specified in the rule are qualified. To filter rules based on their application period, click the dropdown and select one of the following values:
  - Last 15 days
  - Last 15 to 30 days
  - Last 30 to 60 days
  - Last 60 to 90 days
  - Beyond 90 days
  - Never Note : Once the filter is applied, the rules that are displayed are the ones that have been last applied to a learner within the specified rule application period.
- Condition on
  - Modules
  - Profile fields
  - Groups
  - Roles You can use this filter only for Mindtickle rules. Note : It is currently not possible to filter Salesforce rules based on Condition on . For example, you cannot run a filter query in which the value for Condition on is set to Value proposition . To filter rules based on the condition set on modules, groups, roles, or profile fields, select the option from the Condition on dropdown and select the value from the corresponding list. Alternatively, you can search for a module, group, or profile field by entering its value in the corresponding field. Click Apply to apply the filter. Note : The filter dropdowns are enabled and display filter values only if at least one rule exists for the corresponding option. For example, if no role-based rule exists on the platform, the corresponding filter dropdown is disabled and does not display any filter values.
- Action on
  - Modules
  - Series
  - Groups
  - Roles You can use this filter only for Mindtickle rules. Note : It is currently not possible to filter Salesforce rules based on Action on . For example, you cannot run a filter query in which the value for Action on is set to Recommend specific assets . To filter rules based on the action set on modules, series, roles, or groups, select the option from the Action on dropdown and select the value from the corresponding list. Alternatively, you can search for a module, series, or group by entering its value in the corresponding field. Click Apply to apply the filter. Note : When using the Condition on or Action on filters, you can filter rules based on the module, series, group, role, or profile field. You can search for the module/group/series/role and apply the filters. This helps in searching for rules that have a particular module/group/role/profile field in the rule Condition and/or a particular module/series/role/group in the rule Action .
- Created by To filter rules based on creators, click the dropdown and select the creator’s name from the list. Alternatively, search for a creator by entering the name in the search field.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > View rule insights:
The Automation rules tab provides detailed insights about each automation rule created for your organization. This includes data about when and how many times the rule was last applied effectively.

Note: A rule is said to be applied successfully if all conditions specified in the rule are met.

Using these insights, you can evaluate the behavior of a rule, its performance over a particular period of time, and whether it is yielding the desired outcome. Based on the findings, you can update the rule or its associated entities or delete it if it is no longer required. Thus, you can ensure the rules are managed and contribute effectively to your content distribution strategy.

This section further explains the various performance metrics available for automation rules and how to view them.

- Rules applied to at least one learner within the last 90 days or beyond 90 days View the insights icon against the rule in the Rule insights column.
  - - This icon represents the rule is applied at least once in the last 90 days
  - - This icon represents the rule is applied at least once beyond the last 90 days
  - - This icon represents the rule is not applied yet

Tip: Hover over the Legend icon to know what each icon represents.

- Last applied date and time This is the date and time when all conditions of the rule were last met, and the rule was applied. Hover over the insights icon under Rule insights to view the rule’s last applied date and time.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > View rule insights:
- Last applied date and time This is the date and time when all conditions of the rule were last met, and the rule was applied. Hover over the insights icon under Rule insights to view the rule’s last applied date and time.

Note: The timestamp ‘last applied on’ conveys the last time a rule was evaluated. The evaluation may or may not result in an action. Audit log entries for automation rules are created only when a rule is evaluated and the rule action is triggered.

For example, if a rule is created as follows: if profile field Role = Information Developer, add user to group Documentation. The learner with the role Information Developer is added to Documentation on Dec 11 2023. Later, the admin manually removes the learner from Documentation on Dec 12, 2023. Suppose the learner’s role is updated from Information Developer to Customer Success Manager at 10 AM on Dec 13, 2023. When the rule evaluates the condition on Dec 13, 2023, the system tries to remove the learner from the group Documentation. However, the learner is not a part of the group Documentation (since the learner was already manually removed by the admin on Dec 12, 2023). In this case, the rule insight is displayed as ‘Last applied on 10 AM Dec 13, 2023’, but no audit log entry is created as a rule action was not triggered (only the rule condition was evaluated).

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Edit automation rules invitation email template:
On the Automation rules tab, the Edit invite template option in the upper-right corner allows you to directly access and customize the Automation suite module & series invitation email template, which is available in Account Settings > Email invite template.

This email template is used for bulk module and series invitations in Automation suite.

Note:

- The Automation rule invitation email template is triggered if:
  - a user is invited to more than one module or series from all possible automation links and rules in a 5-minute window. This is done so that a learner does not receive too many individual module and/or series invitation emails.
  - The module invitation email and mobile notifications settings are enabled at the series level.
- The template is not used for single invitations. If a user is invited to a single module or series, the invitation template defined in the respective module or series’ settings is used for invitations.

For more information about the template and when it is applied, see Email Template for the Automation Suite Module and Series Invitations.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > FAQs:
All rules applicable to your Learning Site (with the exception of SFDC Opportunity rules and time-based rules) are visible on the Automation Rules interface. The conditions within a rule are made with any of the two type of operators, the AND operator and the OR operator.

Existing rules that contain the OR operator are split into two separate rules in the Automation Rules interface. Each individual split rule assumes the properties of the original rule. In such cases, when a Site Owner tries to edit the properties (name or description) of one of the split rules, the properties of other linked rule(s) also change. Contact MindTickle Support to change the properties of split rules separately.

1. Time-based backend rules - Rules that cause actions to be executed only after a certain period of time, based on a profile field value.
2. SFDC Opportunity rules- Rules created specifically for the SFDC Opportunity integration.

4. Rules that are based on multiple Module IDs.

All other rules applicable to your Learning Site are visible in the Automation Rules interface. Learn more about Automation Rules and contact MindTickle support for any queries.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Account Settings > Hall of Fame:
A leaderboard is a scoreboard displaying names and scores of learners. The leaderboard in Mindtickle is called Hall of Fame. The Hall of Fame leaderboard displays the score, badge, and ranking of the learners who participated in a module. It shows how the learners and their peers performed in the module.

Note:

- Hall of Fame is available only for the course, quick-update, and quest modules.
- To hide learner's details, such as names and scoring data, disable the Hall of Fame for the respective course , quick-update , or quest . Additionally, it is recommended that you disable Segmented Leaderboard and Peers on the learning site. For more information, contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Account Settings > Segmented leaderboard:
Segmented leaderboard is an alternative to the traditional Hall of Fame leaderboard. It allows you to segment or break up the Hall of Fame leaderboard based on certain conditions into categories so that the leaderboard is relevant to learners. It is designed to be GDPR-compliant by allowing learners to opt in or out of sharing their scoring data.

Note:

- You must be a site owner to configure the segmented leaderboard.
- Segmented leaderboard is available on both web and the Mindtickle mobile app. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) to enable this feature for your learning site.

You can configure the following segmented leaderboard settings:

- Profile fields : Profile field values by which you want to segment the leaderboard. For example, if you configure the leaderboard with the Department and Job Title profile fields, your learners can filter or drill down the leaderboard by:
  - Department , to see the leaderboard for all peers in their department.
  - Job Title , to see the leaderboard for all peers who hold the same job title within the same department.
- Default opt in/out : The default opt in/out setting for segmented leaderboard for all learners, whether Opted In or Opted Out . Any changes you make to this apply immediately to all learners. You can also configure some exceptions to this as described later in the article.
- Allow opt in/out : Allow learners to manually opt in or opt out of the leaderboard, so they can choose whether to show their score, badge, and ranking to peers.

Perform the following steps to enable and configure a segmented leaderboard from Account settings:

- Profile fields : Profile field values by which you want to segment the leaderboard. For example, if you configure the leaderboard with the Department and Job Title profile fields, your learners can filter or drill down the leaderboard by:
  - Department , to see the leaderboard for all peers in their department.
  - Job Title , to see the leaderboard for all peers who hold the same job title within the same department.
- Default opt in/out : The default opt in/out setting for segmented leaderboard for all learners, whether Opted In or Opted Out . Any changes you make to this apply immediately to all learners. You can also configure some exceptions to this as described later in the article.
- Allow opt in/out : Allow learners to manually opt in or opt out of the leaderboard, so they can choose whether to show their score, badge, and ranking to peers.

Perform the following steps to enable and configure a segmented leaderboard from Account settings:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync:
Mindtickle allows users to be imported from Human Resource Management Systems such as Workday and BambooHR. This article contains two sections that explain the procedure to integrate Workday with Mindtickle.

- Steps to be performed in Workday
- Steps to be performed in Mindtickle

The following is a graphical representation of the Mindtickle - Workday integration process.

Prerequisite: Ensure you have the Learner Profile Fields in Mindtickle listed. These fields should be mapped to the columns of the Report created later during the integration.

Note:

- The default synchronization cadence for data exchange between Mindtickle and Workday is every 12 hours. To update the cadence, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
- The platform's timezone is UTC. For example, if you add a user to WorkDay on 16.10.2024 at 11 PM PST, the user is added to the Mindtickle platform on October 17 because of the timezone difference.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App:
The progress of the Learner is synced to the MindTickle server and is reflected on the portal once they connect back to a network. The sync time may vary based on two factors:

- The number of content objects that need to be synced.
- The bandwidth of the network the Learner is connected to.

Note: In case the app crashes due to loss of network connectivity, the Learner's Progress will be impacted based on the type of data they were consuming at that point of time:

- If the content is a PPT then the Learner will have to go through the PPT again.
- If the content is a video, it will resume from where it stopped.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Mindtickle APIs > Reporting APIs > URL components > 3. Query Options > Logical operators:
The following logical operators are supported by the Mindtickle Reporting API:

| Operator type | Value | Condition | Example |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Equals | eq | TRUE if the left operand is equal to the right operand. | $filter=Title eq 'Manager' |
| Not Equals | ne | TRUE if the left operand is not equal to the right operand. | $filter=Title ne 'Manager' |
| Greater Than | gt | TRUE if the left operand is greater than the right operand. | $filter=Total gt '100' |
| Greater Than or Equal | ge | TRUE if the left operand is greater than or equal to the right operand. | $filter=Total ge '100' |
| Less Than | lt | TRUE if the left operand is less than the right operand. | $filter=Total lt '100' |
| Less Than or Equal | le | TRUE if the left operand is less than or equal to the right operand. | $filter=Total le '100' |
| Logical And | and | TRUE if both operands evaluate to true. | $filter=Title eq 'Manager' and Total eq '100' |
| Logical Or | or | TRUE if either operand evaluates to true. | $filter=Title eq 'Manager' or Total eq '100' |

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT:
This article explains how to enroll in an event or a session. It also explains how to self-check in to a session.

A session is a one-time event that is conducted by an instructor at a scheduled date and time. An event is a collection of multiple sessions. Admins can configure individual sessions or full-day/multi-day events comprising multiple sessions across multiple days. You can view and enroll in all events and sessions available inside the Instructor-Led Training (ILT) Module you are invited to.

Note:

- You must enroll in an event or a session prior to the start date and time. You cannot enroll for live or past events or sessions. To enroll or unenroll after the start date and time, contact your admin.
- If enrollment lock is enabled for an event or session, you must enroll before the enrollment lock date and time. Once the enrollment lock date and time pass, you can no longer enroll or unenroll. To enroll or unenroll after the enrollment lock date, contact your admin.

chunks.title: Enroll in an ILT event or session

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT > Enroll in an event or a session:
1. Click Enroll in the ILT invitation email. Alternatively, log in to your learning site and click View on the ILT Module assigned to you.
2. The ILT Overview section provides a quick overview of the events or sessions you are invited to. Tip: To navigate to the series Modules page, click the series name in the top left corner. The page lists all (live, upcoming, and past) events and sessions of the ILT module. Use the available filters to filter the list based on your requirements. Use the Search field to find a specific event or session.
3. For events, click Event breakdown to view more information about the event and sessions in it.
4. Click Detail to learn more about the event or individual sessions. The Session Detail page lists the session name, duration, date, start and end time, timezone, and session type. The Event Detail page lists the following information:
  1. Event name, duration, start and end date, timezone, enrollment type (Event level or individual session level).
  2. Number of sessions in the event
  3. List of sessions, session name, duration, date, start and end time, timezone, and session type ( Classroom , Online , or Hybrid ).
5. Click Enroll on the session or event card. If the enrollment for the event is set at the event level, you must enroll for the complete event. Enrolling for the event will automatically enroll you for all the sessions in the event. If it is set at the session level, you can choose to enroll in individual sessions of the event. For individual sessions, clicking Enroll enrolls you for that session. Note :
  1. Based on the settings configured by your admin, you can enroll for multiple events or individual sessions at a time or enroll for only one session.
  2. If the settings are configured to allow enrollment for only one session, and you miss a session you had enrolled for, you can enroll in a future session. This is possible only if your attendance for the missed session is marked as Did not attend . If your attendance is marked as Unmarked or Attended , you cannot enroll in a subsequent session. Contact your admin for more details.
  3. If you miss attending an enrolled session and then enroll for a subsequent session, the enrollment status of the previous session remains unchanged. You are still marked as Enrolled for the previous session, which impacts your overall attendance. In such cases, if required, the admin can unenroll you from the previous session.
  4. Sessions or events that have already occurred will not have an Enroll button. You cannot enroll in an event or session once it has started.
  5. When you enroll for an event or a session, you receive an enrollment email. The event enrollment email contains a list of all the sessions in the event. Additionally, the following actions occur automatically:
    1. The sessions (individual or within events) are added to your synced calendar.
    2. If the session details, such as type, time, or location are changed, a new invite with the updated details is created on the calendar, and the old invite is deleted.
    3. If the session is canceled, the invite is deleted from your calendar.
    4. To receive automatic updates on the calendar, you must set calendar permissions accordingly.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT > Enroll in an event or a session:
- For Google calendar, in Settings > General > Events from Gmail , ensure the Show events automatically created by Gmail in my calendar checkbox is checked.
- For Outlook calendar, in Settings > Events from email , ensure the calendar event options are configured as follows. Note : Although the settings in Outlook help, they are not a definite measure of enabling/disabling events sync from mail. In most cases, the events are synced if the correct .ics file is sent, irrespective of these settings. Caution: This update applies only to ILT sessions that are scheduled and conducted post the auto-sync feature is enabled on your site. You may or may not see conflicting meeting invites on the calendar for sessions scheduled before the feature is enabled. It is recommended that you keep a close watch on your calendar for sessions scheduled before the feature is enabled. For enrollments done before the auto-sync feature is enabled on the site:
- If you have downloaded the session .ics file and created a calendar event and the session time, type, or location is updated (updation done post feature enablement date), you will see a duplicate event on the calendar for that session.
- If you have downloaded the session .ics file and created a calendar event and the session is canceled (cancelation done post feature enablement date), the calendar event will not be automatically deleted. For enrollments done after the auto-sync feature is enabled on the site:
- A calendar event for that session is automatically created on your work calendar.
- If the session details, such as time, type, or location are changed, a new event with the updated details is created on the calendar, and the old event is deleted.
- If the session is canceled, the event is deleted from your calendar. See below image for reference.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT > Enroll in an event or a session:
- If your admin has enabled enrollment limit and enrollment lock, the enrollment limit and lock details are displayed next to the Enroll button.
- If enrollment limit and enrollment lock is disabled, you can enroll at any time.
- If your admin has set up a video conference meeting for the session, the Location section displays meeting details such as the meeting URL, meeting number, and meeting password.
- If your admin has set up a classroom session, the Location section displays the physical location of the meeting.
- The Enroll button is disabled if the enrollment lock date and time has passed. Contact your admin to enroll for this session.

6. For more information on self-check-in, see Check-in to mark your attendance.

7. To unenroll from the event or session, click Unenroll.

Note: The Unenroll button is disabled if the enrollment lock date and time has passed. Contact your admin to unenroll from this session.

8. If the seats are full and a waiting list is available, click the Join waiting list button to add yourself to the waiting list.

Note: If event enrollment is configured at the event level, joining the waitlist automatically adds you to the waiting list of each session in the event. If event enrollment is configured at the individual session level, you can choose to join the waiting list for each session individually.

On the pop-up, click Join waitlist.

Your status is set to Waitlisted.

If you are on the waitlist for a session and do not receive a confirmed enrollment, you can join another session after the waitlisted session ends. Once the waitlisted session ends, the Enroll option becomes available again, allowing you to select and enroll in another available session.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT > Enroll in an event or a session:
Once the waitlisted session ends, the Enroll option becomes available again, allowing you to select and enroll in another available session.

Note: If you are on the waitlist for a session and do not receive a confirmed enrollment, you can join another session after the waitlisted session ends. Once the waitlisted session ends, the Enroll option becomes available again, allowing you to select and enroll in another available session.

If auto-enrollmet is enabled, you are automatically enrolled for the sessions in the event (if event-level enrollment is set) if an enrolled learner unenrolls. You receive an email notification confirming your enrollment.

Click Leave waitlist to leave the waitlist.

Note:

- Once you leave the waitlist in this event, you will be removed from the waitlist of all sessions in this event.
- The Join waiting List button is disabled if the enrollment lock date and time has passed. In such cases, contact your admin to join the waiting list.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT > Check-in to mark your attendance:
The Self check in option is available only at the session level if your admin has configured it for the session.

You will be able to self check-in to the session from the web or mobile app only during the check-in period . For more information on how to self check-in from the mobile app (using the check-in code or by scanning the QR code), see Self check-in to mark your attendance.

The Session Instructor or Facilitator will share the 6-digit-code with you before the Session check-in time via different mediums, such as email, SMS, to chat message. Enter the provided code and click Check-In.

Note: The Admin can still update your attendance. The attendance status marked by the Admin overrides your setting.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT > Watch the session recording:
If your admin has uploaded the session recording for a session that you have enrolled for, you can access it from the session details page and watch it later. This enables you to go through the session content even if you have not attended it. You can also download the recordings and use them for future reference.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > ILT > Watch the session recording:
1. Click recording preview. The file appears in a media player.
2. Click the Play icon to start playing it. Note :
  - If you are watching the recording for the first time, you cannot skip it or fast-forward it.
  - If you pause the recording, exit the player, and return to watch it later, the watch progress on the video is retained.
3. Click 1x to increase or decrease the playback speed. Choose from the available options. By default, the playback speed is set to 1x .
4. Click 360p to update the video resolution. Choose from the available options. By default, the video resolution is set to 360p .
5. Click the Download icon to download the video. The video opens in a new tab of your browser. Click More Options and select Download . The video is downloaded to your system.
6. Click the Full Screen icon to view the video in Full Screen mode.
7. Once you have completed watching at least 95% of the video, the recording viewed status is updated on the session. Click the updated status to watch the recording again. Note : For learners who have not attended the session , the recording viewed status is updated only if you watch at least 95% of the video without skipping it or fast-forwarding it. This rule does not apply to learners who have attended the session. Learners who have attended the session or have watched the video once can skip it or fast-forward through it.
8. Once you are done watching the complete recording, you receive a session completion email notifying that you have completed watching the recording and your session completion status is marked as Complete .
9. If the admin replaces the recording, you receive a recording modified email notifying that the session recording is modified. Your progress on the session is reset, and the new recording becomes available against the same session. If the admin deletes the recording, the session recording is deleted, and your progress on the session is reset.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync:
Mindtickle allows users to be imported from Human Resource Management Systems (HRMS) such as Workday and BambooHR. This article contains two sections that explain the procedure to integrate BambooHR with Mindtickle.

- Steps to be performed in BambooHR
- Steps to be performed in Mindtickle

Prerequisite: Ensure you have set up the learner profile fields in Mindtickle. These fields will be mapped to the columns of the Report created later during the integration.

This is a graphical representation of the Mindtickle - BambooHR integration process.

Note:

- The default synchronization cadence for data exchange between Mindtickle and BambooHR is every 12 hours. To update the cadence, contact your customer success manager (CSM).
- The platform's timezone is UTC. For example, if you add a user to BambooHR on 16.10.2024 at 11 PM PST, the user is added to the Mindtickle platform on October 17 because of the timezone difference.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync > Steps to be performed in BambooHR > Create a custom report:
1. On the BambooHR home page, click the Reports tab on the header menu. Click the Add Report button.2. On the Add a New Report page that opens, enter Report Name and choose the fields you want to add to the report. Click Save.Note: Check if the Status column is present to ensure that the removal of inactive employees can be automated in Mindtickle. Also ensure that the field for Manager email address is included in the report.3. To remove or add fields in the report, click the edit icon on the upper right corner of the screen and click Save.

4. Retrieve the Report ID from the URL of your report. For example if the URL of your custom report is https://abc.bamboohr.com/reports/report.php?id=123, then the ID is 123. Save the ID on any available text editor on your machine. This will be used further in the Mindtickle Integrations interface.

Learn more about how to create a custom report in BambooHR.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync > Steps to be performed in BambooHR > Create a custom access level:
5. On the BambooHR home page, click the Settings icon on the upper right corner of the screen.

6. On the Settings page that opens, navigate to Access Levels. Click the create new icon next to Levels and click Custom Access Level.

7. In the Basic Info section, enter Mindtickle Integration Access as the Access Level Name.

8. In the What this Access Level Can Do section, grant appropriate access if required, else click Next Step.

9. In the What this Access Level Can See section, under See About other Employees, select the columns that were used to create the report earlier. Click Save and Finish.

Note: Ensure you have selected all relevant columns under the What this Access Level Can See section before you proceed.

Learn more about how to create custom access levels in BambooHR.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync > Steps to be performed in Mindtickle:
This section lists the steps that should be performed in Mindtickle to complete the integration.

1. On the admin site homepage, click Account on the left navigation bar.
2. Select Settings from the drop-down menu.
3. On the Settings page, click the Security & integrations tab.
4. Scroll down to the User Sync section.
5. Select BambooHR from the drop-down list under the HRMS tab.
6. Paste the API Key copied in step 17 in the previous section. Enter the BambooHR sub-domain of your organization in the Sub-Domain field. Paste the report number copied in step 4 in the Report No. field. Click Submit . Note : If the URL for your BambooHR is abc.bamboohr.com then enter abc in the sub-domain field.
7. If you want to change the values in any of the fields, click Edit, enter the new values, and click Submit .
8. If you want to switch to an HRMS other than BambooHR, click Disable and select the desired HRMS from the drop-down list. Once you have performed the steps mentioned above, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM), who will then engage our Professional Services team to take the next steps and complete the procedure of configuring the integration.

- Training
- Assets
- Call AI
- Analytics
- Sign in customization
- Language
- Security & integrations

- Learning Site Homepage
- Roles
- Leaderboard
- Language
- Security and Integrations
- Email Templates

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Course and quick update > Text answer:
Text answer is similar to Word guess. Here, the learner has to enter the answer manually.

- Instructions on how to enter the answer options
- Text box to add answer option
- Text box to define the percentage accuracy of the answer. It computes the percentage match to the correct option in terms of spelling and case of the characters. For example, if accuracy is defined as 100%, the learner must enter the exact word or phrase as mentioned by the admin. If the accuracy is 70%, a minor difference in the answer entered by the learner is accepted.
- Include Other Acceptable Answers option enables the learner to provide alternate answers. For example, USA or US can be an alternate answer for the United States of America.Note:
- To include multiple acceptable answers use a comma separator.
- The Text answer learning object is enabled with accuracy check by default. To request Text answer allowing options for answers with and without accuracy, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

Learn more about how to create questions in a Course or Quick update.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Get Started with Mindtickle > Introduction > Modules with limited support on the mobile app > Mission:
Voice-over slideshow and video roleplay mission types are available for online access on the Mindtickle mobile app. You can access your saved drafts in the offline mode, but you cannot submit your mission.Screen capture, email, and task evaluation mission types are not supported on the Mindtickle mobile app for learners.Note:

- If an admin uploads a presentation to the voice-over slideshow mission, it will not be accessible in offline mode.
- Insights, in-video comments, keyword analysis, review guidance, and transcriptions are supported only in online mode on the Mindtickle mobile app.
- Learners can access mission drafts offline if they are recorded on the same mobile device.
- Reviewers can access only cached missions offline. Newly created missions can only be accessed online.

Note: The Mindtickle (iOS) app supports reviews only in the web view.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Account Settings:
The Sign in customization page allows site owners to customize the elements of the learning site sign in page (login page) as per the organization branding guidelines.

You can access it from the admin site sidebar by navigating to Account > Settings > Sign in customization.

On this page, you can customize various elements of the learning site sign in page.

You can customize the following:

Logo image. Appears on the sign in page and the learning site header (top-right corner).

Learning site name. Appears on the sign in page and the learning site header (top-right corner).

Cover image. Appears only on the sign in page.

Welcome message for your learners. Appears only on the sign in page.

Social media links. Appears only on the sign in page.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Account Settings > Social media links:
You can configure your organization’s social media links on the sign in page to personalize the learner’s learning experience. Through these links, learners can access the organization’s social media accounts/profiles/channels/pages and stay updated about the latest news and events. Adding social media links not only allows you to introduce the organization to the learners in a broader way, but also helps you increase your brand reach and awareness.

To add social media links to your learning site:

1. Click the Edit icon against the social media icons.
2. On the Add Social Links page, enter the links to your organization’s respective social media pages. Once the link is configured for a social media profile, its corresponding icon appears as a colored icon. All other icons appear greyed out. Note : The link must be entered in the form of a valid URL. For example, http://youtube.com or https://youtube.com or www.youtube.com or http://www.youtube.com or https://www.youtube.com .
3. To test a URL, click Test against it. The link opens in a new tab.
4. Once confirmed that the URL is correct, click Save . Once the link is configured for a social media profile, its corresponding icon appears as a colored icon in the edit section of the learning site homepage. All other icons appear greyed out. Note : Only the social media links that you configure are visible to the learners on the sign in page of your learning site.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync:
Mindtickle allows users to be imported from Human Resource Management Systems such as Workday and BambooHR. For example, SAP SuccessFactors, UltiPro, and ADP can directly load their employee data into an SFTP server hosted by Mindtickle.

This article explains how to sync users onto the Mindtickle platform using SFTP.

Prerequisite: Ensure you have the Learner Profile Fields in Mindtickle listed. These fields should be mapped to the columns headers of the file uploaded to the SFTP server during the integration.

Note:

- We recommend having the Profile Fields in Mindtickle listed before you proceed with the integration. These fields should be mapped to the columns headers of the file uploaded to the SFTP server during the integration.
- Please reach out to your Customer Success Manager if you would like to update or change your existing system.

To initiate User sync using SFTP, you will need the following details:

- Hostname/ URL - sftp.storage.mindtickle.com Note : If your learning site is based in the US, then please use the following URL: sftp-us.storage.mindtickle.com
- Port ID - 22
- IP address (if required) - 13.251.2.65

The following sections explain how to initiate User sync on Mindtickle using SFTP.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync > Establish connection:
1. On the admin site homepage, hover over the Account icon on the left navigation bar, and click Settings.

The Settings page is displayed.

1. Click the Security & Integrations tab, navigate to the User Sync section, and click the SFTP tab.

The Username field is populated by default.Note: You will need this username at a later stage while setting up the connection of the SFTP server with your HRMS.

1. Create an SSH key pair with the Username above and save the public key. Enter this SSH Public Key in the field provided and click Save.

1. Once you have saved the SSH Public Key, the message ‘Your SSH Key Recorded’ is displayed.

Note: If you want to change the SSH Public Key, contact Mindtickle support.

1. If you want to enable PGP encryption on the data, select the PGP Encryption on data check box, click Generate Key and then Download Key. A file with the PGP Encryption Key is downloaded to your local machine.

Note: If PGP Encryption on data is checked, Mindtickle will assume that all the data getting loaded to the SFTP server with your Username is encrypted. Unencrypted data will no longer be processed by Mindtickle.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Roles and Permissions:
In the admin site sidebar, click Users → Roles to access the Roles page, which lists predefined roles and their corresponding permissions on the Mindtickle platform. From this page, site owners can grant users access to various roles and view users who are already granted access to a particular role.

The page lists all default and custom roles available for your Mindtickle instance and the permissions for each role.

In the Permissions given column, hover over the listed permissions to view the entire list of permissions assigned/given to the role.

In the Users column, the user profile icons provide a preview of users who are assigned the role. Click thePlus button against a role to assign the role to more users.

For information on how to assign roles to users from the Roles tab, see Assign roles and permissions in Mindtickle.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Course and quick update:
This article explains the best practices for embedding a mission in a course or quick update.

Learn more about Best Practices for Mission.

Permissions: Admin creating the course should have Collaborator permissions for the series that contains the mission to be embedded.

Series: A mission should preferably be in a different Series from the Course or Quick-Update. This will avoid confusion if you are sending Full Invites to the Learner for that Series.

Note:

- We do not recommend moving the original Mission from one Series to another. In case you want to move the original Mission, you will have to re-embed the Mission in the Course or Quick-Update.
- Once learners reach an embedded Mission within the Course or Quick-Update, they gain access to the Series where the original Mission exists and see it under their Assigned Series , Explore by Series widget, and What’s New in Assigned widget.

Certificates: The Course Certificate should be turned Off. The Learner will continue to receive the Mission certificate. This will avoid confusion for the Learner, where the user could receive two certificates.

Sequential Locking: The Mission to be embedded should not be in a Sequentially locked Series.

Email Customization: The Course completion email should be customized for the Course containing the Embedded Mission, to let the learner know that the points from the Mission will get added post the review.

Invitations: Invite the Learner only to the Course. Embedded Mission invites are automated.

Notifications: Emails & notifications should be Off for Invitations and Reminders in the original Mission.

Reviewers: We recommend setting Managers as Reviewers for the Mission.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Data Sync and Reporting API:
This article explains how to import data using the Microsoft Power BI tool.

For information on the data limits for various formats and querying methods, see Odata Best Practices in Reporting API.

Prerequisite: Contact Mindtickle Support to enable your email address to import the Mindtickle data into your BI tools. This email address must have access to the Admin Site. Once enabled, the same email address can be used to import data into Tableau, Excel, and PowerBI.

1. Open the Power BI tool on your device. Click Get Data on the Home ribbon.

2. Click OData Feed.

3. On the OData feed dialog box, select the Basic radio button and enter https://admin.mindtickle.com/Odata.svc in the field provided for URL. Click OK.Note: If your learning site is based in the US, then please use the following URL: https://admin.prod-us.mindtickle.com/Odata.svc.

Note: This is a generic URL to access OData from Mindtickle.

4. On the screen that appears, click the Basic tab. Enter your Mindtickle Admin Username and Password for authentication. Click Connect.

5. The left pane of the Navigator window displays the data structure divided into multiple tables. Know more about the tables that can be accessed using the Reporting API. To learn more about the attributes in these tables see the Reporting API- Metadata sheet.

6. Select the names of the table(s) you want to view or find a specific table using the search bar. The data within the tables will be displayed on the right pane. Click Load.

7. The Load window displays the progress of the import.

8. Once the import is completed, the tables and their elements are visible in the Fields Pane on the right side of the screen. You can use the Visualizations pane to create visuals and reports using the data.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup:
Profile Management in Mindtickle allows the site owner to create or delete profile fields and relationships based on the organization’s requirement for gathering user information. They are used to store information about a user accessing the platform. The site owner can view, add, delete, and control the profile fields and relationships using the interface.

A Profile Field stores additional information about a user such as designation, region, or job role. This information is used to apply filters in user management or analytics.Note: There is no limit on the number of profile fields that can be created for a learning site.

A Relationship such as a Manager, Reviewer, Mentor, or Department Head identifies how users are related to each other. These relationships are used to set up review workflows and hierarchy for Roll-Up reports.

This article explains how you can access Profile fields (Users > Profile fields)on your admin site.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Manage Profile Fields and Relationships > Change input type:
A profile field can have three input types - Date input, Text input, and Dropdown.

- Date input - allows learners to enter a date in the profile field.
- Text input - allows learners to enter text in this profile field
- Dropdown - allows learners to select from a list of values provided

You can change the input type for the profile field from Date input to Dropdown or Text input from the profile field Settings.

It has the following implications:

- Changing to Text Input will lead to retaining the data that was captured previously, however, the date format will not be enforced when capturing a new value in this profile field. The field will change to the normal text field.
- Changing to a Dropdown type will lead to retaining the data that was captured previously, however, when the admin or learner tries to update the value against this profile field, they would be forced to choose from the values configured in the dropdown.
- The system will prompt the admin to review any date-based rules set up on the profile field and recommend deactivating the rule before taking this action. The date-based rules can be reactivated post completion of the activity.

You cannot change the input type for the profile field from Dropdown or Text input to Date input.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Profile field type conversion behavior > Manage learner controls:
Based on your preference, you can change the settings to make the profile field or relationship Visible, Editable, and/or Mandatory by clicking the checkboxes under Learner controls as applicable.

The profile fields that you create appear on a user’s profile. Based on your preferences, you can choose to make the profile fields Visible, Editable, or Mandatory for the learners.

1. Select the Visible checkbox if you want it to be visible on the user’s profile.

2. Select the Editable checkbox if you want to allow users to edit the information for the profile field.

3. Select the Mandatory checkbox if users are required to provide the information for the field during the first login.

The following are the default learner control settings:

1. When all 3 learner controls are unselected:
  1. If you select Mandatory , the other 2 controls, Visible and Editable are also selected.
  2. If you unselect Mandatory , the other 2 controls, Visible and Editable remain selected.
  3. If you select only Editable , Visible is also selected.
  4. If you unselect Editable , Visible remains selected, only Editable is unselected.
  5. If you select only Visible , only Visible is selected.
  6. If you unselect Visible , only Visible is unselected.
2. When all 3 learner controls are selected:
  1. If you unselect Visible , all learner controls ( Visible , Editable , and Mandatory ) are unselected.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Profile field type conversion behavior > Manage learner controls > Considerations for learner controls:
- If a profile field or relationship is mandatory, it is imperative that it is also visible and editable for the learners, for example, Name . However, a field that is not mandatory can still be set as visible and editable for the learners, for example, Job title .
- If it is optional and editable, it is imperative that it is also visible to the learners, for example, Region .
- You can set up a profile field that is visible to the learners but not editable, for example, the Joining date .

Note:

- On mobile, date-type profile fields are non-editable. However, they can be made visible based on the learner controls defined for the field.
- Making the profile fields visible will enable the learners to filter by them in the Peers section on the learning site.
- Shortkeys are unique identifiers for every profile field or relationship that are used by Mindtickle for user sync .

Coaching Sessions helps Managers conduct coaching on an ongoing basis and provides data-driven insights for each Learner’s performance. The Coaching Sessions creation workflow consists of four main tabs.

Build - The Build tab allows you to add basic attributes to the Coaching Sessions, enter evaluation parameters, and manage review preferences.

Settings - The Settings tab allows you to enable general settings and email communications for the Learner and Reviewer.

Publish - The Publish tab prompts you to complete all To-Do’s and then publish the Coaching Session.

Invite & Track - The Invite & Track tab allows you to invite new Learners, appoint Reviewers, and list the Learners and Reviewers already invited to the Coaching Sessions Module and also displays their activity.

This article further explains the initial steps of creating a new Coaching Session followed by steps to rename, discard, get URL, and apply tags to a Coaching Session. You can also watch the Coaching Sessions Overview Walkthrough.

Note:

- Coaching Sessions cannot be created in a Public Series.
- You can award a certificate to the Learners for meeting certain score criteria.

1. From the Content tab of the admin site home page, click Create New. Select Module to create a coaching session from scratch or select Use a template to create a coaching session using an existing template. For more information on how to create a module using a template, see Create a module using a module template.

1. From the admin site home page, click Training > Modules > Create modules.

Alternatively, you can create a Coaching session from within a series by clicking Training > Series > select the required series > Create module.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Reviewer Appointment > Appointment Method:
There are three ways in which you can appoint a reviewer to a Coaching Sessions module.

- Manually appoint Reviewer for each Learner during or after invitation - For this option, you can appoint reviewers for learners individually from the Invite and Track tab. Note : When you enable the Allow direct Manager’s access to this Coaching Session option, the reviewer's setting is automatically changed to 5 reviewers with Appoint Reviewer manually for each Learner during or after invitation option.
- Appoint Manager as Reviewers - For this option, click the Select Manager Field drop-down list and select a manager field. Note : The manager fields displayed in the drop-down list are those created in Profile Management .
- Appoint a common Reviewer for all Learners - For this option, click the Select the Common Reviewer drop-down and select a reviewer.
