Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Reviewer Appointment > Review Cadence:
If the Reviewer Frequency is selected as Multiple, you can set the desired interval between two consecutive sessions. The cadence cannot be changed after the Coaching Session is published. The three ways you can set intervals are

- Ad-hoc Sessions - Select this option if you want to allow the reviewer to decide the interval between two sessions. Select the number of Expected Sessions Per Month the reviewer must conduct with the learner. You can select up to 10 sessions per month. For example, you created the Coaching Session on 25th January and the reviewer opens the invite on 28th January and decides to schedule the sessions. The reviewer is then expected to conduct and review two sessions within 30 days from 28th January.
- Once Monthly - Select this option if you want the reviewer to conduct one session every month. Select the Monthly Start Date from which the system will assume the duration of one month. For example, if the Monthly Start Date is set to 16, the reviewer is expected to complete one session between the 16th of the current month to 16th of the following month.
- Once in several weeks - Select this option if you want the reviewer to conduct once in the number of weeks set. Select the Number of Weeks that the system will assume as one session in the set number of weeks. You can select the Number of Week s between 1 and 52. For example, if the Number of Weeks is set to 5, the reviewer is expected to conduct one session every five weeks.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Overall Reviewing Preferences:
Enable the Reviewer can edit the review after submission toggle switch if you want to allow the reviewer to make any changes to the review once it is submitted. This option is disabled by default.

When disabled the reviewer will not be able to edit a submitted review. They will only be able to view and re-open the review. This will create a new review session where the reviewer can further schedule and review the session with the learner.

Enable the Allow Reviewers to give overall written feedback toggle switch if you want the reviewer to provide any written feedback about the learner’s performance on the field. This option is enabled by default.

Enable the Allow Reviewers to log session time with Learner toggle switch if you want the reviewer to log the time for which the session is conducted. If enabled, this becomes a mandatory field for the reviewer while reviewing the Coaching Session.

You can watch the Appointing Reviewers in Coaching Sessions Walkthrough video.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Email communication > Emails for the learner:
Learners receive the following emails:

- Invited: The learners receive this email when the Learners Self-Review is enabled.
- First self review not submitted: The learners receive this email as a reminder if the learner has not started the self-review within the set number of days. This reminder is applicable only for coaching sessions where self-review is enabled and review not started. Click + Add Reminder and add the number of days you want to send the reminder.Note: Invited and First self review not submitted emails are sent only if learners self-review is enabled. Otherwise, both these emails are disabled.

- Review scheduled: The learners receive this email when the reviewer schedules a coaching session with the learner.
- Review scheduled: The learner receives this email when the learner schedules a review coaching session with the reviewer. Note: The reviewer and learner receive an email once the session is scheduled. The session invitation is added to the calendar of the reviewer and learner only if they are using Google/Outlook email clients and calendar and the admin uses the default session scheduled email template.
- Review submitted: The learners receive this email when the reviewer submits the review.

- Review Assigned: The reviewer receives this email when a coaching session is assigned for review.
- First Session not Scheduled/Reviewed: The reviewer receives this email as a reminder if the reviewer has not scheduled or started the review within the set number of days. This reminder is applicable only for sessions that have not yet started. Click + Add Reminder and add the number of days you want to send the reminder.
- Review Scheduled: The reviewer receives this email when the reviewer schedules a review coaching session with the learner.
- Review Scheduled: The reviewer receives this email when the learner schedules a coaching session with the reviewer. Note: The reviewer and learner receive an email once the session is scheduled. The session invitation is added to the calendar of the reviewer and learner only if they are using Google/Outlook email clients and calendar and the admin uses the default session scheduled email template.
- Recurring reminders : The learner receives this email as a notification of pending self-review for Multiple type of coaching sessions. These reminders are sent based on the Review cadence set by the admin under Learners self-review .
- Recurring reminders: The reviewers receive this email as a notification of pending reviews for multiple review types of coaching sessions. These reminders are sent based on the Review cadence set by the admin under Reviewer appointment . For new coaching sessions, the Recurring reminders option is set to the Recurring Reminder email template by default. For existing coaching sessions, the Recurring reminders option is set to None by default. However, admins can select the Recurring reminders email template from the drop-down list and republish the coaching sessions to send Recurring reminders emails to the reviewers. Note:
  - In a single day, for the same module, the reviewer will receive 1 email for all the pending reviews. Example: For module "ABC," if reviewer John is appointed as reviewer for 5 learners and the review for all 5 learners is pending, then John will receive one email for all 5 learners in a single day.
  - The reviewer will receive different reminder emails for different modules.
  - If the reviewer takes no action even after receiving 5 consecutive reminder emails, the reviewer will not get any further recurring reminders.
  - The Recurring reminders are sent even if a session is scheduled, unscheduled, or in progress.
  - These Recurring reminders are only sent through email.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Preview:
After creating the Coaching Sessions and completing any To-Do's, click the Preview button to view the end-user experience. The preview mode helps you guide the Learner and Reviewer on what actions to take. It will also help you visualize the end-user experience so that you can improve the content if needed. For example, update the description, or naming of files.

Click Learner or Reviewer depending on the user experience you wish to view. You can preview the Coaching Session irrespective of the state of the Coaching Session. For example, you can preview a Coaching Session even after it is published. However, the preview mode will always show the stated of the Coaching Session as “Unscheduled” for Learners and the “Schedule” button for Reviewers.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Publish:
To publish a Coaching Session, make sure you have completed all the To-Dos.

1. Choose the Learners you want to invite to the Coaching Sessions. Click the drop-down list to select the available options.

- Invite All Learners of this Series - invites Learners who are invited to at least one Module in the Series.
- Invite Fully invited Learners of this Series - invites Learners who are invited to all Modules in the Series.
- Invite Select Learners from this Series - allows you to select from the list of Learners invited to the Series.

2. Select the Also notify the Learners via email checkbox if you want the Learners to receive an email notification inviting them to the Coaching Sessions. Click Confirm Publish.

3. If you want to publish without inviting any Learners, click the Don’t invite anyone radio button and click Confirm Publish now.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Enter evaluation parameters > Add parameters:
1. Click the Add parameter button to create a new evaluation parameter.

2. Enter an appropriate name for the parameter in the Enter parameter name field provided.

3. Select the Parameter type from the drop-down list. There are three types of parameters that you can choose from.

- Rating scale: allows the reviewer to assign a rating value to the learner based on a scale.
- Multiple choice: allows the reviewer to pick one of the multiple options provided.
- Text input: allows the reviewer to enter text feedback.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Enter evaluation parameters > Add parameters > Rating scale:
For Rating scale parameter type, select values from the drop-down lists for Min, Max, and Score.

- Min - You can choose between 0 and 1 as the minimum value on the Rating Scale.
- Max - You can choose any number in the range of 2 to 10 as the maximum value on the Rating scale.

- Score - You can choose a score from the drop-down list for the Rating scale.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Enter evaluation parameters > Add parameters > Multiple choice parameter type:
For Multiple choice parameter type, two options (Yes and No) are provided by default. Click the + Add Option button to add more options, enter the appropriate names for each option and select the corresponding Score from the drop-down list.

A Multiple choice parameter type should have at least two options for the reviewer to choose from.

Click the delete icon on the extreme right to delete an option.

If you want to set a Multiple choice parameter as a non-scoring parameter, set the score to 0. The outcome selected by the reviewer will be captured but no score will be assigned to it.Note: Irrespective of the score, reviewer(s) can choose only one correct option from the multiple options provided.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Guidance for reviewer > Evaluation parameter configuration:
Select an Evaluation parameter to view more options, such as duplicate , move , and delete .

Parameter configuration

The Parameter configuration pane contains the following parts Reviewers can comment, Mandatory to respond, Allow reviewer to choose 'Not applicable', Tags on evaluation parameter, and Reviewers can recommend a module.

- Reviewers can comment: If you want reviewers to add comments for the evaluation parameter, enable the Reviewers can comment toggle switch.
- Mandatory to respond: A newly created evaluation parameter is set as mandatory by default. To make the evaluation parameter non-mandatory or optional, disable the Mandatory to respond toggle switch.
- Allow reviewer to choose 'Not applicable': If you want to allow a reviewer to make the evaluation parameter ‘Not Applicable’ during review for a particular learner, enable the Allow reviewer to choose ‘Not Applicable’ toggle switch.
- Tags on Evaluation parameters: Apply relevant tags to the Evaluation parameter. Click icon to select from the available tags or create new ones .
- Label the rating scale: This option is used for Rating scale parameters. You can enable the toggle to label the rating scale levels with appropriate labels for each level. Eg: If the rating is Min: 0 and Max: 3.

Then you can rate each level as:

0= Entry level

1= Beginner

2= Intermediate

3= Proficient

- Reviewers can recommend a module: Click the Add module button if you want to assign published module(s) that allow learner(s) to undergo remediation in their area of improvement.

Duplicate

Click the Duplicate icon to copy an evaluation parameter. The newly copied parameter is added to the end of the list of parameters within that section.

Move

Delete

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Bulk-update evaluation parameters:
You can duplicate, delete, and/or modify settings of the evaluation parameters within a Coaching Sessions Module in bulk.

1. Select the check box for the evaluation parameters you want to bulk update.
2. A quick access toolbar appears at the bottom of the screen. Click Apply tags , Change settings , Duplicate , Remove all tags, or Delete based on your preference.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > FAQs > Switch to another admin site:
This section explains how to switch to the admin site of a learning site that you have access to and belongs to the same organization within the Mindtickle platform.

1. On the admin site home page, click the profile icon in the upper-right corner and then click Switch learning site.

1. The Switch learning site pop-up appears. Based on your role, it lists all the learning sites within the Mindtickle organization that you have access to.

Note: If the learning site that you want to access is not listed, it means that the learning site belongs to a different organization within the platform. In this case, perform the steps listed in the next section to sign in to the learning site that is in a different organization. For more help, contact Mindtickle Support.

1. Click the name of the learning site whose admin site you want to switch to. You will be redirected to the admin site of the selected learning site.

This section explains how to switch to an admin site belonging to a different organization within the Mindtickle platform. Note that you must have access to the learning site in that organization.

For more help, contact Mindtickle Support.

1. On the admin site home page, click the profile icon in the upper-right corner and then click Switch learning site.

1. The Switch learning site pop-up appears. If a learning site that you have access to is not listed, it means that it belongs to a different organization in Mindtickle. In this case, click the Sign in to a different learning site option to manually sign in to that learning site.

1. On the page that appears, enter the URL of the learning site and click Continue.

1. You are redirected to the learning site sign-in page. Once you sign in successfully, you are redirected back to the admin site.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Coaching Sessions > Learners overview:
The Learners tab displays all invited learners, the number of reviewers yet to be appointed, and the numbers of scheduled, unscheduled, and closed sessions. Click the numbers to view the table filtered by each criterion, as required.

The table lists the names of all learners invited to the coaching session, the reviewers assigned to them, the number of sessions, the date the session was last reviewed, and the date the next session is scheduled.

Note: The last self-reviewed column is displayed only if the Learners self-review is enabled.

You can find a specific learner using the search bar. You can also find a learner by searching for the Reviewer assigned to that learner.

Reviewers unappointed and Last self-reviewed denote the status of the coaching session.

Click the menu icon to the right of each row to view the following actions you can take for every Learner.

- View review
- View profile
- Remove learner

To take bulk actions, such as Replace reviewer, Add reviewer, and Close coaching sessions, select the learners and click the appropriate buttons in the quick access pane at the bottom of the window. Click the menu button on the right pane for more options, such as Remove learner and Remove reviewers.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Collaboration App Notifications > Prerequisites:
Before starting the integration, ensure the following requirements are met:

- Enable the integration: Contact Mindtickle Support to enable the Slack integration for your Mindtickle instance. Note : This is required only for enabling Mindtickle notifications in Slack, and not for the Seller Copilot.
- Admin permissions: The user performing the setup must hold:
  - Slack admin rights in the workspace.
  - IT admin and site owner roles in Mindtickle. (See Roles and permissions ).

Note: Once the integration is complete, the user's site owner role can be revoked. However, if the user is deactivated in Slack or their admin permissions are removed, the integration will be disabled.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Collaboration App Notifications > Set up Mindtickle in your Slack workspace:
Follow these steps to install and connect the Mindtickle Slack app.

1. Find the App: Open Slack and click Apps on the left panel.
2. Search: On the Browse App Directory page, enter "Mindtickle" in the search bar.
3. Install: Click Add . Note: If you are redirected to the Slack App Directory in your browser, follow these steps:
  - Select Mindtickle from the search results.
  - Click Add to Slack .
4. Authorize: Click Allow to grant Mindtickle the necessary permissions to access your workspace.
5. Open Slack: Once installed, click Open Slack . The Mindtickle bot will now be visible in your Apps list.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Collaboration App Notifications > Connect your Mindtickle site:
Once the app is installed, you must map your Mindtickle learning site to the Slack workspace.

1. Go to the Messages tab of the Mindtickle app in Slack.
2. Enter the connection command: @mindtickle connect [your-domain] Example: If your site URL is university.mindtickle.com , type: @mindtickle connect university.mindtickle.com
3. Upon success, you will receive a confirmation message.

Note: If the admin sets up the app on the organization’s official Slack account, it is automatically installed for all users. Individual users do not need to install the app themselves.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Collaboration App Notifications > Sync Slack users to Mindtickle:
To ensure your users are recognized by the system (for both Mindtickle notifications and Seller Copilot), you must perform a user sync.

1. Enter the sync command: @mindtickle user-sync [site-prefix] Example: If your site is university.mindtickle.com , type: @mindtickle user-sync university

Important notes on syncing:

- After this initial manual sync, Mindtickle will automatically sync users every 12 hours .
- [ Applicable only for the Mindtickle notifications feature ] Contact Mindtickle Support to turn on Slack integration to ensure that your learners and managers receive notifications in their Slack workspace.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Collaboration App Notifications > Customize the bot name:
To align with your organization's internal branding or enablement initiatives, you can customize the name of the Mindtickle bot within Slack (e.g., renaming it to "Sales Coach" or "Enablement Bot").

Note: This step is optional. While you can change the bot's display name, Slack does not currently allow you to customize the bot's profile picture; it will retain the standard Mindtickle "M" logo.

1. Log in to Slack using your admin credentials.
2. Access the app configuration page: The quickest way is to click this direct link to open the Mindtickle App Configuration tab . Alternatively, navigate manually within Slack:
  - Navigate to the Apps section on the left sidebar and click the Mindtickle app.
  - Click the bot name located below the main search bar.
  - In the menu that appears, click Configuration . This will open the Mindtickle Slack app page in a new browser tab.
3. On the configuration page, scroll to the Bot User section and click Edit .
4. Enter your preferred name in the text field and click Save changes .

Important updates to commands

- Once the name is changed, you must address the bot mentions using the new name . Example: If you renamed the bot to "Nirvana", the connection command becomes @nirvana connect [domain.mindtickle.com] . Where domain is your learning site name.
- Please allow approximately one hour after saving for the new bot name and commands to become fully active in your workspace.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Overview:
A public series can be viewed and accessed by learners at any time. By default, it is visible to and accessible to all learners in the All series tab on the Series page.

For more information on when to create a public series, see When to create which type of series?

A public series can also be scoped for specific learners only. To learn more, see Scoped public series.

Note:

- All Modules except coaching sessions can be a part of a public series.
- You can allow learners to view module relevance for a public series without subscribing to it. To enable it for your learning site, contact Mindtickle Support .

Learners can Subscribe to a specific public series to receive updates and reminders. If a learner subscribes to a Public series, the series moves under the Subscribed series section for that particular learner. The learner may or may not choose to complete the series since the learner chose to subscribe to the public series and wasn’t assigned the public series by the admin.

A learner can unsubscribe from a public series that they have subscribed. For more information, see Learning site overview.

Note:

- Public series or modules from public series are not added to the learner’s assigned module count.
- If a learner starts a module within a public series to which they are not assigned, it stays in the Public series section.
- If an admin fully invites a learner to a public series, then the series moves under Assigned series for that particular learner.
- If an admin invites a learner to select modules from a Public series, then the series stays under the Public series section for that particular learner.

chunks.body:
A public series can be viewed and accessed by learners at any time. By default, it is visible to and accessible to all learners in the All series tab on the Series page.

For more information on when to create a public series, see When to create which type of series?

A public series can also be scoped for specific learners only. To learn more, see Scoped public series.

Note:

- All Modules except coaching sessions can be a part of a public series.
- You can allow learners to view module relevance for a public series without subscribing to it. To enable it for your learning site, contact Mindtickle Support .

Learners can Subscribe to a specific public series to receive updates and reminders. If a learner subscribes to a Public series, the series moves under the Subscribed series section for that particular learner. The learner may or may not choose to complete the series since the learner chose to subscribe to the public series and wasn’t assigned the public series by the admin.

A learner can unsubscribe from a public series that they have subscribed. For more information, see Learning site overview.

Note:

- Public series or modules from public series are not added to the learner’s assigned module count.
- If a learner starts a module within a public series to which they are not assigned, it stays in the Public series section.
- If an admin fully invites a learner to a public series, then the series moves under Assigned series for that particular learner.
- If an admin invites a learner to select modules from a Public series, then the series stays under the Public series section for that particular learner.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup:
Rules in Profile Management allow you to automate recurring tasks pertaining to User Management. You can create a Rule based on Keywords, Text Conditions (Regular expressions) or Multiple Conditions.

Regex helps you to find one or more text matches using a specific search pattern. This article explains the best practices you can follow while using basic and advanced Regex.

Note: Regex is vast and can be used resourcefully to obtain the right results. This article only provides a high-level idea of how Regex can be used.

Once you create Rules using Text Conditions, you can validate the accuracy of the conditions you have entered using the Sample text field.

Enter values in the Sample text field. Press the enter key to separate values to be tested. Next to all values that meet the Regex condition, a checkmark appears. Next to all values that do not qualify, a cross mark appears.

During the process, if the values entered in Regex change, the checkmarks and crosses next to the values also change.

Contact Mindtickle Support to know more about creating rules using Regular Expressions.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Basic Expressions:
- Use anchors ^ or $ to define the start and end of the pattern, respectively.
- Use the vertical bar or single pipe | on your keyboard to add the OR condition.

| Expression | Definition | Example | Matched Pattern (refer above image) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ^ | Start of string | ^Sr.* | Sr. ManagerSr. MgrSr. Development Manager |
| $ | End of string | .*Manager$ | Sr. ManagerSenior ManagerSr. Development Manager |
| | | Applies OR condition | ^Sr.*|^Senior.* | Sr. ManagerSr. MgrSenior ManagerSr. Development Manager |

chunks.title: Best Practices for Creating Rules Using Text Conditions

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup > Advanced Expressions:
- Use parentheses i.e. () to define the scope of the pattern.
- Use quantifiers such as * , ? , + and {} to define how often a preceding element is allowed to occur in a text.
- Use the wildcard . to match any character in the string.

| Expression | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| . | Any single character |
| * | Zero or more |
| + | One or more |
| ? | Zero or one |

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Setup > Site Setup:
Rules in Profile fields reduce the administrative effort for a site owner by automating recurring tasks pertaining to User Management. Once created, these rules actively monitor changes in user profiles and trigger actions in real-time.

These rules can be used to add or remove users from groups based on the values of their profile fields. You can also link (or unlink) users belonging to a particular group to an associated series.

Note: For more information, see linking a group to a series.

The rules are triggered when the value of a user profile field is updated regardless of the method (Adding users individually, bulk-upload, or User Sync) used to update them.

The Rule management feature in Mindtickle allows the site owner to view, create, edit, activate/deactivate, and delete rules from the Profile fields page.

For more information, see Create a new rule and Manage rules.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Custom reports (old) > Create custom reports:
The custom reports feature lets you create personalized reports to track learner performance across your organization using predefined metrics. This article walks you through the steps to create a new custom report.

For information about self-serve reports, see Overview of self-serve reports.

Note: This feature is available only to users with the Can create custom reports permission. By default, this permission is enabled for site owners. Users with this permission have access to all platform data, regardless of the series or groups they have access to.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Custom reports (old) > Create custom reports > Customize the report:
The selected report template includes three main sections:

1. Report layout
2. Filter data for report
3. Report preview

I. Report layout

This section allows you to select which components to include in your report:

- Report summary: Displays a summary banner at the top of the report. Click the eye icon to hide it.
- Chart - 1 and Chart - 2: Visual representations of report data. Click the eye icon to hide either or both charts. Click Customize to change the chart type (Bar or Column), then click Save .
- Report table: Displays data in a tabular format. Click Customize to configure the table's layout.

Customize the report table as follows:

- Add or remove columns: Click an available column to add it. Click the X next to a selected column to remove it. You can also rename columns as needed. Some columns include tooltips explaining how their values are calculated.
- Format columns: Configure settings like data ranges for performance checkpoints and column color options for percentage metrics.
- Advanced options: Choose a column to sort by and set the sort order (ascending or descending). Click Apply changes to save the customizations.

II. Filter data for report

This section allows you to apply filters based on content and users.

- Select values from available drop-downs based on your needs.
- To define a date range, select Custom time from the Modules assigned during drop-down.

In the popup window, select the start and end dates, then click Apply.

Note: You can enter a start date up to one year in the past.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Custom reports (old) > Share custom reports:
You can share custom reports that you’ve created with individuals in your organization. Depending on the user’s role and your sharing preference, you can either share the full report or a scoped version.

A full report can be shared with any role that has the Can view custom reports permission. By default, this permission is assigned to enablement admins, site owners, and managers.

A scoped report can be shared only with managers. It displays data for learners who directly report to the manager receiving the report.

Note: Scoping is only applicable to first-level managers and does not apply to senior managers.

1. In the admin site sidebar, click Analytics > My analytics > Custom created > Custom reports .
2. Open the custom report you want to share.
3. Click Share in the upper-right corner of the report.

You can share the report in two ways:

- Share via email
- Share via Mindtickle platform

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Custom reports (old) > Share custom reports > Share via email:
You can send a custom report to individual users or multiple users in bulk.

Note: Reports are best optimized for viewing in Gmail.

Add Recipients

1. On the Share via email screen, select the users you want to share the report with. Use the search bar or apply filters like roles and profile fields to find users. Only users added to the Mindtickle platform are shown.
2. If sharing with a manager, choose between a full report or a scoped report . For all other roles, only the full report option is available. Click Next .

Note: You cannot change the report scope after it has been shared. To modify the scope, delete the shared report and re-share it with the updated setting.

Add CC

On the Add CC tab:

- Click Add CC to add up to 10 users per recipient.
- Click Add common CC to apply the same set of CC recipients (up to 10 users) for all report recipients.

Note: Adding a common CC will override any individual CCs already added.

Email options

You can choose to either send the report immediately or schedule it for a later time.

A. Send now

This option queues the report in email jobs for immediate processing.

- Enter the job name, subject, and message.
- Select Send report in email body to embed the report.
- Select Add as attachment to attach the report in one or more formats (.xls, .xlsx, .pdf, .csv, .doc).
- Click Send .

B. Schedule mail

This option lets you schedule the report delivery.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Tags:
Tags are attributes that you can apply to all modules, files, questions, polls, and evaluation parameters (mission and coaching sessions). Tags help admins with filtering, organizing, and searching for content (from Manage Tags) as well as reporting of content (from Tag analytics). Learners can also filter search results using tags. Tags that serve a similar purpose can be grouped together into categories. For example, tags set relative to the capabilities defined by your organization, such as Closing, Negotiation, Presentation, and Prospecting, can be grouped in the tag category, Competency.

This article explains how you can access, create, apply, and manage tags and tag categories.

Note:

- Only site owners can create and manage tags and tag categories.
- Only site owners, enablement admins, and content experts can apply tags.
- Tags applied to evaluation parameters will not appear in global search results on the learning site. For example, the tag “acme” is added to a mission’s evaluation parameter. When users search with “acme” on the learning site, the corresponding mission would not appear in the search results.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Tags > Access Tags and Tag categories > Create Tags:
Only a site owner can create tags and tag categories. As a site owner, you can create tags by using either the Create button or the Add tag button in a category.

To create a tag:

1. Click the Create button and select Tag .
2. In the Create tag pop-up that appears, enter the following information and then click Create (n) tags :
  - Tag : Enter a name for the tag. The default character limit for a tag is set to 40. Note : To increase the character limit, contact your Customer Success Manager. However, to ensure a good user experience, it is recommended that you create tags with up to 40 characters only.
  - Tag category : Select the category in which the tag should be created.
  - Click +Add another to create additional tags. Click to delete the tag. Note :
  - There is no limit on the number of tags you can create using this option.
  - You cannot create more than one tag with the same name.
  - Tags are not case sensitive. Alternatively, click the Create tag button in a category and repeat Step 2 listed above.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Tags > Access Tags and Tag categories > Apply and manage Tags:
1. Click More options to perform the following actions on the tag:
  - Apply to : Apply the tag to modules, files, questions, polls, or evaluation parameters (mission and coaching sessions). You can also search for modules, files, questions, polls, and evaluation parameters from the search bar and apply filters based on series and module type to refine your search.
  - Rename : Change the tag name.
  - Move to : Move the tag from one category to another.
  - Delete : Delete the tag. Note : This will permanently delete the tag.
2. Select one or more tags using the checkboxes to perform the following actions in bulk from the quick access panel at the bottom of the page:
  - Apply to : Apply the tags to one or more modules, files, questions, polls, and evaluation parameters.
  - Move to : Move the tags to a tag category.
  - Delete : Warns you about the number of places the tags will be removed from and removes them.
3. Clicking a number in any of the columns of a category displays the tag details panel on the right. This shows information on which modules, files, questions, polls, or evaluation parameters the tag is applied. Note : When you click a number in the columns for modules, files, questions, polls, or evaluation parameters, you can see only the content that you have access to (in a published or draft state). For example, when you click a number in the Modules applied to column, you can see only the modules that you have access to. If you click a tag that is applied to 10 modules and you have access to only 4 of them, you will see only 4 modules in the tag details panel. If you click another tag that is applied to 7 modules and you don’t have access to all of them, then you will not see any modules in the tag details panel. You can perform the following actions in the tag details panel:
  - You can search or filter the data based on series and modules.
  - Click Apply to more to apply the tag to more modules, files, questions, polls, or evaluation parameters.
  - To remove a tag from a particular content, hover your mouse on the content name and click Remove tag . For example, if you click a number in the Modules applied to column, you can remove the tag from one or more Modules using the Remove tag option.

Tags that serve a similar purpose can be grouped together into categories. By default, Mindtickle provides four tag categories - Competency, Competition, Product Line, and Uncategorized. The Competency category includes the following default tags:

- Only an admin with site owner permissions can create tag categories.

This widget lists all the coaching sessions assigned to you in the last 30 days.

The widget thumbnail displays up to 3 coaching sessions. If more than 3 coaching sessions are assigned in the last 30 days, you will see a Show all option on the top right corner. Click the Show all option to view all the coaching sessions assigned in the last 30 days.

You can review or schedule a session from the Recently assigned widget.

Review session

Click the Review option to start reviewing a coaching session. For more information, see Review Coaching Sessions.

Schedule session

Click the Schedule session icon to schedule a session with the learner.

On the Schedule session page displayed, set the Next session date, Next session time, and time zone as appropriate. Enter an Agenda of the session (optional) in the field provided. Select the Notify me 30 minutes before this session check box to set a reminder for yourself. Click Schedule.

Note: You can easily browse through the comprehensive list or search for specific locations (by city, country, or timezone name), making it effortless to find and select the desired time zone.

The system displays a session-scheduled message.

The reviewer and the learner receive an email notification and a calendar invite.

Note: The reviewer and the learner receive the calendar invite along with email only if:

- The learner and reviewer are using Google/Outlook email client and calendar.
- The admin has set the coaching session with the default Session scheduled template.

You can also schedule a session with the learner while reviewing a session. For more information, see Schedule coaching sessions with the learner.

A reviewer is appointed to a coaching session to provide feedback to the learner. This article explains how reviewers can schedule coaching sessions assigned to them.

While it is not mandatory to schedule a coaching session with the learner before you start reviewing the session, we do recommend that you inform the learner that you have begun the review. You can also schedule a separate meeting with the learner using your organization's calendar and directly start reviewing the coaching session during the meeting.

1. Click the View session button on the email notification you receive about being appointed as a reviewer.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Reference:
The adherence in coaching sessions analytics indicates whether the reviewer has reviewed the expected number of sessions in the set duration.

Adherence establishes consistency of coaching session activity between a manager and sales rep. This metric is calculated differently based on the cadence cycle set by the admin. Cadence cycle can be tracked on a weekly or a monthly cycle. Standard week definition is from Monday to Sunday, while the month definition is from first day to the last day of the respective month.

- Ongoing coaching sessions: For an ongoing coaching session, the adherence metric is considered till the day of analysis. It’s a running average across all the cadence cycles considered since the day of reviewer appointment. Adherence rewards consistent coaching behavior and helps avoid skewness where a reviewer performs coaching in patches (not regular).
- Closed coaching sessions: For a closed coaching session, the adherence metric is considered till the closing day of the coaching session. The activities of reviewer appointment and the day of adherence analysis are expected to happen mid-week. Therefore, the starting and closing cycles for adherence are computed on a pro rata basis while the rest of the completed cycles are considered in full. The weightage of each cycle considered is determined by the number of days in that cycle.

The article explains how the adherence is calculated with an example, along with the adherence calculation for all three review cadence scenarios.

- When review cadence is set to ad hoc sessions
- When review cadence is set to once monthly
- When review cadence is set to once in several weeks

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Reference > Explained: Adherence computation for a weekly cycle:
1. Let’s consider the adherence cycle as once in a week. That is, the user is expected to complete one coaching session in a week.
2. The day of reviewer assignment is considered the day of the start of the adherence cycle. For example, April 4 2024.
3. From the day of assigning a reviewer, we initiate cycle runs based on the configured cadence.
  - For the first cycle, derive effective cycle length (prorated). In this case, it is the upcoming Sunday of the week when the reviewer was appointed minus the day of week when the reviewer was appointed. Example: If the reviewer is appointed on Thursday, the cycle length would be 4, considering the days as Thursday, Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. So the prorated cycle length is 4/7 = 0.5714.
  - Calculate the prorated expected sessions for the first week: 1 session per week * pro rata factor = 0.5714.
  - Let's say the user did not complete any session in the first cycle. Calculate prorated completed sessions for the week: 0 (completed sessions) * pro-rata factor = 0
4. The last cycle here is considered as the Day when the adherence report was accessed. For example, April 17 2024.
  - On the day when you are accessing the adherence report, calculate the effective cycle length that has happened since Monday. Example: If you are accessing this report on Wednesday of the next to next week, then the effective cycle length = 3. So the prorated cycle length is 3/7 = 0.4285.
  - Calculate the prorated expected sessions for the first week: 1 session per week * pro rata factor = 0.4285.
  - Let’s say the user completed 1 session in the last cycle. Calculate prorated completed sessions for the last cycle: 1 (completed sessions) * pro rata factor = 0.4285.
5. All the completed weeks — between when users assigned to coaching sessions and when the report was accessed — are given full attribution. Here the week of April 8 - April 14 is marked complete.
  - Let’s say the user completed 1 session in the week. Since the cycle is marked complete, the pro rata factor is 1 (or 100%).
  - Expected sessions for the week = 1
  - Completed sessions for the week = 1
6. If a user analyzes the report on April 17, there will be three cycles considered:
  - April 4 - April 7
  - April 8 - April 14
  - April 15 - April 17
7. On April 17, the session adherence is calculated by adding the completed sessions across all cycles vs. the expected session across all sessions.
  - Total completed sessions = 0 + 1 + 0.4285 = 1.4285
  - Total expected sessions = 0.5714 + 1 + 0.4285 = 1.99
  - Adherence = 71.7%

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Reference > Review cadence = Ad hoc sessions:
Adherence = Sum of the completed sessions / Sum of the expected sessions x 100

For the above example, it is calculated as:

4.551 / 15.092 x 100 = 30.15%

Where:

- Sum of the completed sessions: 0.55 + 0 + 2 + 0 + 0 + 0 + 2 + 0 = 4.551
- Sum of the expected sessions: 1.092 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 0 = 15.092

Note:

1. The cycle start date for the first cycle is from the first time when the reviewer is assigned to the learner.
2. The cycle end date is the last day of the month. For the 2nd cycle onwards, the start date of the cycle is the 1st day of the month.
3. If the report is analyzed for an ongoing coaching session, then the last cycle is calculated pro-rata considered the day of the analysis.
4. In the above example, the assumption is that the reviewer has only one learner appointed to him/her. For more learners, adherence is calculated by taking an average of individual adherence.
5. The adherence for the entire cycle period will remain the same.

The integration between Mediafly and Mindtickle enables published content items from Mindtickle to be accessed on the Mediafly platform. Mindtickle Series, containing Modules, are stored as folders on the Mediafly platform. Published Modules in these Series are stored as URL assets within the corresponding folder on the Mediafly platform. These URL assets assume all capabilities of Mediafly assets.

Analytics of all content integrated with Mediafly is maintained within Mindtickle. You can view insights of content items synced with Mediafly by clicking the Analytics tab on your Mindtickle home page.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Set Up and Content Management > Deployment:
To deploy the Mediafly - Mindtickle integration, your organization needs to hold a production instance of both Mindtickle and Mediafly. Before you begin, ensure that you have made a decision on the following items.

1. Name of the root folder to be created in Mediafly.

2. If you are an existing customer, confirm if sync is required for historical data on Mindtickle. You can choose to include only certain Modules from the historical data. A list of Modules to be excluded needs to be provided to the Mindtickle Admin.

3. On an ongoing basis, you can either select a specific set of Series you want to sync with Mediafly or allow auto-sync of all Series. Contact your Customer Success Manager or to learn more about selective Series sync.

Once you have finalized these decisions, the Mediafly support team performs the following steps to initiate the deployment.

1. Create root folder in Mediafly for all content being synced from Mindtickle.

2. Create the admin account (with all permissions) in Mediafly.

3. Inform the Mindtickle Admin about the access token required to identify the Mediafly production instance of the customer.

4. Notify the Mindtickle Admin and the customer about the completion of these actions and communicate the access token and credentials.

Our team will then help you take the following actions to complete the deployment.

1. Run a bulk migration for historic data (for existing customers) and confirm that the sync is successful.

2. Configure the webhooks for real-time ongoing sync.

3. Inform the customer (Mindtickle Admin) and Mediafly administrator about the completion of these actions along with details of deployed configuration.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > FAQs:
You can upload a SCORM package to a Mindtickle course or quick update preserving its animated features. However, Mindtickle does not allow you to convert a SCORM package into a document with its animated features intact. Uploading a Microsoft PowerPoint presentation using the Upload Content option does not keep the animations in the presentation intact.

Note: We highly recommend limiting your SCORM package size to less than 500 MB. For more information, see SCORM Content on Mindtickle.

Following are the ways to replicate your animated SCORM package or MS PowerPoint presentation in Mindtickle:

1. Create a rich text document: You can paste content from documents like Doc, PPT, Excel, PDF, or online content like blogs and web pages preserving most formatting.

2. Record a voiceover slideshow: You can break your SCORM package into slides and record a voiceover for each slide.

3. Embed the MS PowerPoint presentation: You can either paste the link from YouTube/SlideShare/Prezi/SurveyMonkey/Highspot pitch URL or paste embed iframe code from Vimeo/Wistia/Google Slides and others.

Note: When you embed a file in Mindtickle, it automatically updates when the source file changes.

Other ways to create content in Mindtickle are:

- Record your screen
- Record a video

If your Salesforce user sync token has expired in the Mindtickle platform, follow the steps below to refresh the token and re-enable user sync or reverse sync for users in your organization with Mindtickle.

Note:

- You will need the Salesforce credentials to set up user sync with Mindtickle.
- This does not apply to Call AI and DSR Salesforce integrations.

For more information on resetting the Salesforce user token for DSR and Call AI, see:

- What should I do if my Salesforce User Sync token has expired in the DSR?
- What should I do if my Salesforce user sync token has expired in Call AI?

1. On the admin site homepage, hover over theAccount icon on the left navigation bar, and click Settings. The Settings page is displayed.
2. Click the Security & integrations tab, scroll down to the User Sync section, clear the checkboxes selected under the Salesforce tab, and select them again.
3. Click Save and then click Connect
4. On the displayed screen, enter your Salesforce admin credentials to log in.
5. On the displayed pop-up, click Allow.

The Connected Apps OAuth Usage screen is displayed.

6. After logging into Salesforce, in the left navigation panel, click Apps > Connected Apps > Connected Apps OAuth Usage.

7. Under the Connected App column, click the Install button on Mindtickle Salesforce OAuth.

8. On the displayed pop-up screen, click Install.

The Mindtickle Salesforce OAuth app is now installed on the Salesforce instance.

The Salesforce User Sync token will now be renewed and the User Sync/Reverse Sync of your Users will be enabled.

There are four stages in the journey of a User on the Mindtickle platform.

User Sync: You can add, update, and delete Users in Mindtickle from a user management system such as Salesforce, Veeva, BambooHR, Workday or using SFTP.

Note: All Users that are added to Mindtickle are assigned the Role of a Learner by default. Learn more about Roles and Permissions in Mindtickle.

Profile Management: Identify which User attributes you want to map to Learner Profile Fields in Mindtickle. You can store information about Users accessing Mindtickle using Profile Management.

Group Automation: Rules can be applied to assign Users automatically to a Group or set of Groups based on various filter conditions.

Note: Contact Mindtickle Support to enable Rules for your organization.

Series Linking: Users added to Groups that are linked to Series are auto-assigned to the Series and the Modules within.

Note: Mindtickle also allows you to invite Users to Series and/or Modules even if they are not part of a Group.

The engagement and performance metrics of Users can be tracked in Mindtickle Analytics or using Reporting API.

The Mindtickle integration with LinkedIn Learning consists of two parts:

1. Content integration: Fetch the relevant LinkedIn Learning content to add as learning objects into the Mindtickle platform. This helps admins select courses relevant to the learners.

2. Reporting integration: Fetch LinkedIn Learning xAstePI statements to update the learner’s progress and completion status on Mindtickle. This helps admins get accurate data on the progress of the learners who are taking the LinkedIn Learning course.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Content Provider > Prerequisites:
If you are a new user of LinkedIn Learning on Mindtickle:

- You can enable LinkedIn Learning integration with Mindtickle for your organizations only if you have a licensed LinkedIn Learning instance.
- The LinkedIn Learning content is available only to users who are licensed learners on the LinkedIn Learning platform.
- Mindtickle highly recommends having SSO enabled for your LinkedIn Learning instance.
- It is mandatory to complete both LinkedIn Learning content integration and reporting integration .

Note: If you are an existing user of LinkedIn Learning on Mindtickle, you only need to set up the reporting integration as you would have already established the content integration.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Content Provider > Benefits of integration:
- Learners can access the LinkedIn Learning content through Mindtickle along with the Mindtickle content. Note :
  - Once the LinkedIn Learning integration is set up successfully, the initial synchronization is scheduled to occur 24 hours later. Access to the syndicated content in Mindtickle is available after this synchronization.
  - Subsequent synchronizations occur every 24 hours thereafter. Only new and updated content is fetched in the subsequent syncs.
- Through this integration, admins can track the learners' progress on the content created on Mindtickle along with the content added from LinkedIn Learning to Mindtickle.

Fetch LinkedIn Learning content in Courses and Quick updates:

Integration with LinkedIn Learning enables admins to select courses from LinkedIn Learning relevant to the learners on the Mindtickle platform. Once the integration is complete, new content from LinkedIn Learning is automatically synced with Mindtickle . The integration also updates or deletes existing courses.

Get accurate reporting data on learner’s progress:

The reporting integration with LinkedIn Learning provides the admin with the actual progress and completion status of the learner who takes the course. Once the learner starts consuming the course on LinkedIn Learning, Mindtickle receives the progress data for the learner through LinkedIn Learning xAPI statements.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > Content Provider > How the integration works:
For content configuration:

1. In LinkedIn Learning, admins create a LinkedIn Learning REST API application for Mindtickle.

2. In Mindtickle, enter the details of the LinkedIn Learning REST API application to set up the content sync from LinkedIn Learning to Mindtickle.

3. Once the integration is complete, admins can add the LinkedIn Learning content as learning objects in the Courses and Quick updates.

For reporting configuration:

Note: It is mandatory to complete the content configuration to proceed with the reporting configuration.

1. In Mindtickle, download the xAPI credentials required on the LinkedIn Learning platform.

2. Add the xAPI credentials to set up the reporting configuration in LinkedIn Learning.

3. Once the reporting configuration is complete, Mindtickle receives the LinkedIn Learning xAPI statements of the learners’ course completion status.

1. Log in to LinkedIn Learning using your administrator credentials.

2. Click Go to Admin at the upper-right corner of the screen to view the Admin interface.

3. Click your profile image at the upper-right corner of the screen and go to Integrate.

4. Go to the Configure reporting integrations tab from the left panel and click Configure xAPI.

5. Click Add integration.

6. Enter the appropriate values in the Integration name and set the User Type as either the username or the email address. To enter values in Client ID, Client Secret, OAuth Server Url, and Tenant Server Url, refer to the xapi_credentials.txt file. Click Enable.

Note:

- The User Type value for LinkedIn Learning should match the User Type value in Mindtickle.
- If the User Type value does not match, the learner's percentage completion and score will not be updated on Mindtickle.

For more information on User Types, see the Add xAPI integration table in LinkedIn Learning xAPI Administration Guide.

Note:

- The User Type options are ID, Username, and Email.
- Mindtickle recommends using the same User Type option configured on the Mindtickle platform. For example, in Mindtickle if the user type is your email ID, in LinkedIn select the User Type as Email.

Once enabled, the xAPI Connection is visible in the Connections list.

You can enable or disable the xAPI connection using the Status toggle switch. Enable the xAPI connection to receive the correct learner progress.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Course and quick update:
This article explains how the steps to upload Syndicated Content from LinkedIn Learning in a course or quick update.

This option is visible only if you have set up the Mindtickle-LinkedIn Learning integration.

Note:

- Syndicated content is supported on the web only.
- Once the LinkedIn Learning integration is set up successfully, the initial synchronization is scheduled to occur 24 hours later. Access to the syndicated content in Mindtickle is available after this synchronization.
- Subsequent synchronizations occur every 24 hours thereafter. Only new and updated content is fetched in the subsequent syncs.
- The Mindtickle integration with LinkedIn Learning consists of Content integration to add learning objects into the Mindtickle platform and Reporting integration to update the learner’s progress and completion status on Mindtickle.

To learn more about a course or quick update, refer to the following articles:

- Create a course
- Create a quick update

1. From a course or quick update, click the Add learning objects button on the Build tab.

2. In the Add learning objects drawer, select Syndicated content under Build content.

3. On the screen that appears, select the LinkedIn Learning content of your choice. Alternatively, you can search for content using the search bar or filter the list of LinkedIn Learning content based on Topic, Skill, Level, and Language. Click Confirm.

5. The LinkedIn Learning content is added to the Mindtickle Course or Quick update. Click the Go to Course button.

The course opens a new browser tab on the LinkedIn Learning page.

Note: Changes to the LinkedIn Learning course automatically display in Mindtickle and do not affect the learner's progress.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Course and quick update > Consuming the LinkedIn Learning course:
On the learning site, learners must navigate to the learning object and click Go to Course to consume the LinkedIn Learning content.

Note: Learners must sign in to LinkedIn Learning before starting the course.

The LinkedIn Learning course diaplays in the new browser tab.

Once the learner goes through the LinkedIn Learning course, Mindtickle receives the xAPI statements related to the learner’s completion status.

The learner’s completion status updates the score on the learning object on Mindtickle.

Note: Mindtickle does not reset or recalculate the score if learners reattempt the LinkedIn Learning course.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Course and quick update > Scoring and completion:
The completion status of learners taking the course from LinkedIn Learning is available near real time on the Mindtickle platform. Mindtickle receives the learner’s completion status via xAPI statements.

Note:

- For chapter quizzes and exams on LinkedIn Learning, Mindtickle does not display the chapter quiz or exam score on the Mindtickle platform.
- LinkedIn sends the xAPI statements for courses only and not individual videos. In Mindtickle, the admin can track the accurate course completion and the learner's progress only for the LinkedIn Learning courses.
- The score on Mindtickle only reflects the completion status of the LinkedIn Learning course.
- LinkedIn Learning generates the xAPI statements at regular intervals.
- LinkedIn Learning sends the xAPI statement for each learner only once.
- If the learners complete the course before the Mindtickle and LinkedIn Learning integration, Mindtickle does not receive the xAPI statements and cannot mark the learner’s completion and scores. In such cases, the admin needs to manually mark the learner’s completion from the admin site and link to mark the completed article.

Example of scoring and course completion logic

If the learner partially consumes the LinkedIn Learning course, then on Mindtickle, the score is updated as per the partial completion.

For example, if there are 10 chapters in the LinkedIn Learning course and the learner completes only 5 chapters, Mindtickle's score is updated as 50/100 since the completion status is 50%.

Below is the image of the partial completion of the LinkedIn Learning course.

Below is the image of the score in Mindtickle updated as per the partial course completion on LinkedIn.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Tags:
The Tags dashboard provides comprehensive insights into tags applied to modules and content items, including files, questions, polls, and evaluation parameters.

Important notes:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Tags > Access the Tags dashboard:
In the admin site sidebar, click Analytics > Training > Dashboards > Tags to open the Tags dashboard.

The tags dashboard includes four tabs. The Overview tab is displayed by default.

- Overview tab: Provides a high-level summary of tag usage across content.
- Tag details tab: Displays performance and engagement data associated with specific tags.
- Segment heatmap tab: Offers a visual representation of tag data by learner segments.
- Learner heatmap tab: Shows tag-level data by individual learners.

For Tags dashboard roles and permissions, see Roles and permissions in Mindtickle. By default, only site owners and enablement admins have access to this dashboard. To grant access to other roles, contact Mindtickle Support.

The Tag details tab in the Tags dashboard provides a tabular view of performance and engagement metrics for all tags applied to modules or content items within modules on your learning site.

If needed, you can bookmark the table view by clicking Bookmark in the upper-right corner of the screen.

Filters

Use filters to refine which tag metrics are shown in the table:

- Time applied: Filter tags based on when they were applied.
- Series: Select one or more series to view tags relevant to them.
- Tag category: Filter tags based on their category.
- Learner fields: Filter based on learner profile fields such as role or department.
- More filters: Filter based on module type.

To find a specific tag, use the Search bar at the top of the table.

Export data

To export the visible data from the table:

1. Click Download as .
2. Select the preferred file format.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Tags > Segment heatmap:
The Segment heatmap tab in the Tags dashboard displays aggregated tag performance data based on different segment types such as groups, region, department, and location. This view helps you compare the engagement and performance of tags across segments.

Note: Segment types are based on the profile fields configured in Profile management for your learning site.

You can view the heatmap using the following performance metrics:

- % Score
- % Completion

Hover over any cell in the heatmap to see detailed metrics for that tag and segment.

You can bookmark the segment heatmap view by clicking Bookmark in the upper-right corner of the screen.

Filters

To customize the segment heatmap:

1. Click the Segment type drop-down to choose the segment you want to view. Groups is selected by default.
2. Apply filters to refine tag data:
  - Time applied: Filter tags based on when they were applied.
  - Series: Select one or more series to view related tags.
  - Tag category: Filter tags based on category.
  - More filters: Filter learners based on module type.
3. Select one or more values from the Series or Tag category drop-down menus and click Apply .

Note: You can select up to 60 filter values when applying filters to heatmaps.

Export data

To export the data shown in the segment heatmap:

1. Click Download as .
2. Select the preferred file format to download the data.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Tags:
Tags can be applied to modules as well as to files, questions, and polls within modules on your learning site. However, for performance and engagement data shown in the Overview Learner Heatmap, and Segment Heatmap tabs of the Tags dashboard, the count of tags applied to content items such as files, questions, and polls within modules is aggregated up to the module level.

For example, if a tag like “Competition” is applied to 3 content items out of 5 inside a course (C1) and is also applied to a quick update (QU1), then the total count of the tag in the Tags dashboard is 2, since it is applied to 2 modules.

For the Nature of content graph in the Overview tab of the dashboard, each tag is counted individually. You can apply filters using the “Tags applied to” drop-down to view tags applied either to modules or to individual content items within modules.

Learn more about the performance metrics in Analytics – terms and definitions.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Mission:
A Mission allows you to create virtual role-play exercises simulating a variety of sales/customer interaction scenarios as part of your enablement programs. Using Missions, Learners are able to practice and hone their skills in a safe and controlled environment. As Admins, you can crowdsource content, capture best practices, document videos, and standardize processes.There are five steps to setting up and executing a Mission:

1. The Enablement Admin creates the Mission, invites the Learners to participate, and appoints the Reviewers to review and Score the Mission submissions.
2. Learner submits the Mission.
3. Reviewer Reviews and Scores the Mission submission.
4. Learners receive feedback.
5. The Enablement Admin gets actionable insights of all Mission submissions.

Note: You can also award the Learners with a certificate on passing the Mission.

The Mission creation workflow consists of four main tabs:

Build - The Build tab allows you to add scenario details to the Mission, enter Evaluation Parameters, set cut-off Score, and manage Review Preferences.

Settings - The Settings tab allows you to manage General Settings and email communications for Learners and Reviewers.

Publish - The Publish tab prompts you to complete any remaining To-Do’s, invite Learners, and publish the Mission. It also allows you to track the version changes in the Mission.

Invite & Track - The Invite & Track tab allows you to invite new Learners to participate in the Mission and appoint Reviewers to the Learners. You can use Invite & Track to manage Learners and Reviewers, track their activity and follow up with them.

Learn more about how to Create a Mission.

This article explains how to create a mission.

1. From the admin site home page, click Training > Modules > Create modules.

Alternatively, you can create a mission from within a series by clicking Training > Series > select the required series > Create module.

Or click Training > Series > Create > Module. Select Use a template to create a mission using an existing template. For more information on how to create a module using a template, see Create a module using a module template.

2. On the Add modules pop-up, hover over the Mission tile and click Create mission.

3. Enter your mission name and select the series in which you want to place it. If you don't want to place it in an existing series, create a new series by clicking the Create a New Series link. Then, click Next.

Note: To learn about the character limit for mission attributes, refer to the Character limits of Series and Module attributes article.

4. Select the mission type of your choice.

Voiceover Slideshow

The voiceover slideshow mission type allows learners to record a voice narration of a PowerPoint presentation. Scenarios where learners must conduct a presentation work well for this mission type.

Video Roleplay

The video roleplay mission type allows learners to record their responses to a given scenario using their computer/web camera or mobile camera.

Email and Task Evaluation

The email and task evaluation mission type allow learners to give a written response to a given scenario. For example, assess how a learner replies to a prospect's email, answers a technical question, or what they observed during a job shadow. Alternatively, you can use this mission type to capture a ride-along report or account plan that is uploaded by the learner.

You can configure the Thumbnail, Show transcription to Reviewer and Learner, and Top Submissions under the General Settings.

Note: The Submission’s transcription option is not available in the Email and Task Evaluation Mission.

Thumbnail

1. Click Edit to change the Thumbnail image of the Mission.

2. A pop-up window Select a Thumbnail appears which contains a list of images to choose from.

3. You can select an image from the list or upload a custom image by clicking Upload Custom Thumbnail. Click Confirm.

Note: You can also delete thumbnail images from the list that you no longer need by clicking the delete icon. Once a thumbnail image is deleted from the list, it cannot be retrieved.

4. You can rename the thumbnail name by hovering over the thumbnail name and clicking on the pencil icon under the Custom option.

5. Click Done.

Show transcription to Reviewer and Learner

Submission’s Transcription is an Artificial Intelligence-powered system that transcribes the recorded audio and performs a keyword analysis based on the Learner’s submission.

Enable the toggle switch if you want the Learner’s submission to be transcribed and the transcription to be visible to the Reviewer and Learner.

Reviewers will then be able to review the Learners’ submissions based on the use of the keywords defined in the Reviewer Guidance.

Note: Submission’s Transcription recognizes all accents but the quality of the transcript produced is best for an American accent. For other accents, the quality of the transcript may be affected.

To learn more about the Review process, refer to Review Mission Submissions using In-Video Comments, Insights, Keyword Analysis, and Transcriptions.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Mission > Due Date & Email:
You can configure the Due Date and Email settings for both Learners and Reviewers under this section.

The due date for the Learner is applicable for their first submission. If the Learner is required to submit this Mission more than once, the due date will not be applicable for the 2nd submission onwards. The Learner may be required to do a 2nd submission in either of the below ways depending on how the Mission is configured.

- If the Learners previous submission was reset by the Admin.
- If the Learner fails the Mission and they automatically get a re-attempt assigned (or redo).
- The Reviewer manually asks the Learner to re-attempt the Mission.

The due date for the Reviewers is also applicable for reviewing the Learner’s first submission in the Mission. If for any reason mentioned above, the Learner is required to submit the Mission more than once, the Reviewer due date will not be applicable for reviewing further submissions.

Due Date for the learner

Click the toggle switch to Enable or Disable the Due Date. If enabled, specify the specific date or the number of days after invitation for the Due Date.

Note: The number of days after an invitation can be set in the range of 1 to 120 days.

Also, select what happens after the Due Date.

- Nothing happens. Learner can still complete the Mission.
- Mission freezes. Learner can’t progress any further.

Emails for the Learner

- Invited

- Automatically sent on the invitation
- Click View to view and edit the email template if needed

- Did Not Start

- Select the appropriate option for When to Send
  - Number of days after the invitation
  - Specific date
- Click +Add Reminder to add multiple reminders if needed

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Mission > Preview > Reviewer:
Click Reviewer to preview the Mission as a Reviewer. It displays the following attributes:

- Scenario
- Model Pitch (if enabled)
- Attachments (if uploaded)
- Certificate Cut-off or Passing Cut-off
- Due Date
- Target Length Range
- Learner’s Mission Submission
- Insights (location only)
- Transcriptions (location only)
- Evaluation Parameters and Guidance Description (if enabled)
- In-Video Comments (if enabled)
- Submit Review

To make any changes to the above attributes, click the Exit Preview button to exit the Reviewer preview mode.

You can also preview all the previous versions of the Mission in both the preview modes.

Note: Only the changes that trigger a module update will be captured in the versions.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Mission > Publish:
To publish a Mission, make sure you have completed all the To-Dos.

1. Choose the Learners you want to invite to the Mission. Click the drop-down list to select the available options.

- Invite All Learners of this Series - invites Learners who are invited to at least one Module in the Series.
- Invite Fully invited Learners of this Series - invites Learners who are invited to all Modules in the Series.
- Invite Select Learners from this Series - allows you to select from the list of Learners invited to the Series.

2. Select the Also notify the Learners via email checkbox if you want the Learners to receive an email notification inviting them to the Mission. Click Confirm Publish.

3. If you want to publish without inviting any Learners, click the Don’t invite anyone radio button and click Confirm Publish.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Mission > Pre-publish warnings:
For Copilot reviewer missions, guidance is key in determining how the Copilot evaluates the learner’s response and generates consistent scoring. Thus, you should provide clear and interpretable references for the Copilot reviewer.

With a pre-publish warning, the Copilot reviews the Evaluation parameters and generates a list of warnings under the Publish tab. These warnings highlight areas of the Evaluation parameters that need attention. Resolving the warnings ensures that the Copilot reviewer receives the necessary guidance for a thorough and effective review.

When you click the parameter number, you are navigated to the Evaluation parameters screen for that specific parameter, where you can make appropriate corrections.

Note: You can publish the mission by considering or ignoring the pre-publish warnings provided.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Mission:
The Invite & Track tab in the mission creation workflow allows you to invite Learners and appoint reviewers to a mission. You can also track the progress made by the learners and reviewers already invited to the mission under this tab.

Note: If you invited learners while publishing on the Publish tab, the list of those Learners will be displayed here.

This article explains how to invite learners to a mission from the Invite & Track tab.

Click Invite Learners, and select if you want to invite the Learner To Series or To Mission only.

- To Series - Inviting a Learner to an entire Series that the Mission is part of, assigns all the Modules in that Series to the Learner. If a new Module is published in that Series, the Learner is automatically invited to that Module.
- To Mission only - Inviting a Learner to this particular mission, assigns only the mission.

Invite learner to series

Invite learner to mission only

You can choose one of three options to invite Learners to the Series or Mission.

- Individual Learners - allows you to invite individual Learners who are added to the MindTickle platform.
- Learner Groups - allows you to invite Groups of Learners.
- Upload new list - allows you to invite multiple Learners (and also assign Reviewers) in bulk by uploading a list.

This article further explains each option in detail.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Mission > Add scenario details:
- Click Mission type if you want to change the type of the Mission. Note: This setting cannot be changed once the Mission is published.
- Roleplay type : You can choose from the following two options:
- Solo: When you create a mission using the One-way method, you do not get an interactive conversation with an AI avatar; learners can only record their submission..
- Roleplay with copilot : Select this option for creating an interactive mission roleplay with copilot assistance. For more information on how to create the mission, see Create interactive video roleplay mission .
- Add a Description of the Mission. You can format the description using the text editor provided. Click Attach supporting file to add files that you want the Learners to refer to before they start the Mission. You can either drag and drop the files or click to browse the files you want to upload. You will be directed based on the option you select. Follow the appropriate steps to add the supporting file.
- Set the expected Target Length Range of a Learner's submission. This is the expected length of the Learner’s video submission.
- Upload the Model Submission . A Model submission is a best-practice pitch that serves as a benchmark for the scenario. Reviewers/Copilot reviewers can evaluate the learners based on the Model submission. Learners can download the Model submission as a reference to practice and submit their best attempt. Note : The supported file formats for upload are .flv , .mp4 , .avi , .wmv , .mov , .mkv , .m4v , .mpg , .mpeg , .vob , .webm , .pdf , .docx , .doc .
- Enable the Model submission option if you want the learners to see the uploaded Model submission. By default, this option is disabled.
