chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Add users to the platform > Add multiple users via CSV:
1. On the Users page, click New users/groups > Upload list of users.
2. On the Add new users - upload CSV screen that appears, click Download sample. If you already have the .csv file, go to the next step.
3. In the .csv file that is downloaded to your local machine, enter values for each user’s profile fields.Note:
  - To view the list of supported timezones, click click here in the pop-up and enter the timezone IDs as required in the CSV file.
  - The profile fields in the downloaded file are the same as the ones configured in Profile fields.For example, the screenshot below depicts the profile fields configured in the Profile fields page.The screenshot below depicts the downloaded sample CSV file containing the same profile fields.
  - For the date type profile fields, you must enter the date in the format set for the profile field. If the format of the entered value does not match the format set for the profile field, the system displays an error message and prompts you to update the data and re-upload the file.
  - Before you upload the file, verify if the profile fields in the file match the fields configured in the Profile fields page. Also ensure, that you have considered the important points for CSV operations.
  - When adding multiple users via a CSV file, ensure that you use double quotes ( “” ) for values separated by commas in the different columns. Otherwise, the system displays an error. For example, in the Manager column, if you enter Aaron, Adam . The Manager name splits into Aaron and Adam during file upload, and the system displays an error. Instead, enter “Aaron, Adam” to process the CSV file without errors.
4. Click Upload and select the .csv file from its location.Note: If the fields in the Profile fields page and the sample file do not match, an error is triggered and the upload fails.
5. A list of all users from the .csv file is displayed. Click Add users.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Individual and bulk user actions > Actions on an individual user:
This section explains the actions you can perform on an individual user.

Click the More options icon button to see the actions available depending on the user's current status (Active, Deactivated, or Not signed up).

You can perform the following actions on an individual user:

- View profile: Opens the user’s profile.
- Edit profile: Allows you to edit the user’s profile on the same page.
- Impersonate user: Allows you to sign in as the selected user to the learning site to troubleshoot issues. To learn more, see Impersonate user.
- Go to user analytics: (applicable only for Active users) Opens the user’s Analytics page and shows their engagement and performance data.
- Add to groups: Add the user to one or more Groups. If the selected user was deactivated, then they are also restored during this action.
- Invite to series: Invite the user to one or more Series. If the selected user was deactivated, then they are also restored during this action.
- Remove from groups: Remove the user from one or more Groups. If a Group is linked to one or more Series, you are asked to confirm whether you want to remove the user only from the Group or from both the Group and the linked series.
- Restore: (applicable only for Deactivated users)The user is restored to their state prior to deactivation. If the user was Active before deactivation, they are restored to Active. If the user was Not signed up before deactivation, they are restored to Not signed up. The user is added to the platform with their previously-assigned roles, permissions, content, and groups. The analytics data (performance and engagement metrics) of the user is also restored. No emails are sent to the user on this change.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Individual and bulk user actions > Actions on multiple users:
This section explains the actions you can perform on multiple users in bulk. You perform these bulk actions using the quick-access toolbar that appears at the bottom of the screen when you select one or more users.

At any time, you can use the X (Clear all selected users) button in the lower-right corner to unselect all the users you had selected.

Note: The bulk actions listed in this section are visible for all users irrespective of their status, but you can only perform applicable actions that depend on the selected users’ status. For example, you want to restore and deactivate some users, and you select 2 Deactivated, 3 Active, and 4 Not Signed Up users, you will see all the actions in the quick-access toolbar. However, you can perform the Restore users action only for Deactivated users, and the Deactivate users action only for Active and Not signed up users.

You can perform the following actions on one or more users:

- Add to groups: Add users to one or more groups. During this action, users are also restored if they were deactivated.
- Invite to series: Invite users to one or more series. During this action, users are also restored if they were deactivated.
- Export selected users: To export the data of selected users in a report format. For more information, see “selected users” in export user data.Note:
- When you select one or more users, the Export report button will not be available in the upper-right corner, next to the Reset filters button. This is because the Export report button is used to export the data of all or filtered users.
- The last active session in the export report will reflect the user impersonation session as well.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Export user data:
- User ID: A unique number that is generated internally to the platform.
- Name: The names of users.
- Username: The email address used for authenticating the user while logging into the platform.
- Status: User’s current status: Active, Not Signed Up, or Deactivated.
- Added on platform (GMT): The date and time (in GMT timezone) on which they were added on the platform.
- Deactivated on (GMT): The date and time (in GMT timezone) on which they were deactivated on the platform. The value is available only if the user’s current status is Deactivated. The field is blank for user’s whose current status is Active or Not signed up.
- Last active on (GMT): The date and time (in GMT timezone) on which they were last active on the platform. The value is available only for users who have logged on to the platform atleast once. The value is N/A for users that have not logged in to the platform yet. For example for a user who is activated but the current status is Not signed up, the value is N/A.
- Group list: The Groups that they belong to. The value in the field is available as a comma-separated list of all groups the user is added to.
- Roles: The roles assigned to them. The value in the field is available as a comma-separated list of all roles the user is assigned to.
- Timezone: The learner’s timezone (based on the configuration done by the admin or the learner). This field may be blank or may include data per the list of supported timezones.
- Profile field/relationship field details: Apart from the default user details mentioned above, the report may also include details about the profile fields or relationships configured on the learning site. Each column in the report corresponds to a unique profile field or relationship. For example, the report attached to this article (scroll to the end of the page and download the attachment) includes columns about the user’s Job Title, Location, Region, Division, Department, Hire Date, Manager, Buddy, and Common Ground Buddy, as these are the profile fields and relationships configured on the learning site. For more information on profile fields, see Profile fields.
- UserID (Decimal): A unique number generated in Analytics or OData Reporting API reports.Note: The data in the UserID (Decimal) column is rendered in the correct (text) format in Google Sheets and Numbers (MacBook) applications. It is rendered in the exponential format in Microsoft Excel. To render the data in the text format in Microsoft Excel, follow the steps mentioned below:
  - Download the report.
  - Open Microsoft Excel.
  - Go to File > Import.
  - On the pop-up, select CSV file and click Import.
  - Select the downloaded report and click Get Data.
  - On the Text Import Wizard - Step 1 of 3, select Delimited and click Next.
  - On the Text Import Wizard - Step 2 of 3, select Comma and click Next.
  - On the Text Import Wizard - Step 3 of 3, select the UserID (Decimal) column, select Text, and click Finish.
  - Click Import.Note: Profile field and relationship details columns may vary depending on the profile fields and relationships configured on the learning site. All columns except profile field and relationship details columns are static and are always included in each report.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > FAQs:
Deactivated Users

From the Users page, you can deactivate Active and Not Signed Up users. Once deactivated, the user will remain on the platform, but in a deactivated state. They will not have access to any of the platform capabilities, such as Content, Analytics, and Users and Groups management.

Restore or Reactivate Users

From the Users page, you can restore or reactivate the deactivated users or add them back on the platform.

The user is restored to their state prior to deactivation. If the user was Active before deactivation, they are restored to Active. If the user was Not Signed Up before deactivation, they are restored to Not Signed Up.

The user is added to the platform with their previously-assigned Roles, Permissions, Content, and Groups. The analytics data (performance and engagement metrics) of the user is also restored. No emails are sent to the user on this change. When the user is added back or restored, they can continue working through the assigned Modules as long as the content has not changed.

Note: When you restore a deactivated user, their ILT enrollment and attendance data is restored only for the sessions where their attendance was marked — either “Attended” or “Did Not Attend”. No data is restored for the past sessions where the attendance was not marked (“Unmarked”) and for any future sessions where the user was enrolled. The ILT data is restored only if the user was deactivated after Nov 13 2020. No data is restored if the user was deactivated before Nov 13 2020.

This article explains how learners can change their learning site password.

1. Click the profile icon in the upper-right corner and then select My Profile and analytics from the drop-down.

2. On your profile page, click Change password.

3. On the Change password pop-up, enter the current and new passwords and click Save changes.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Submission:
When attempting a Video Roleplay Mission you are expected to either Upload Video or Record Video for your Submission.

In the above example, you have to upload/record a video to introduce a new product, state its value proposition, and lay the groundwork for another call. You are delivering this pitch to the Head of Sales Enablement.

To upload a video, tap Record Submission to browse the video from your mobile device or record a video.

Tap Upload to browse the video from your mobile device or tap Camera to record a video.

If you are recording a Mission for the first time, the app will ask for your permission to access your mobile’s microphone and camera, tap Allow.

You can now begin recording by tapping the Record icon.

When you start recording, the length of the recording (in MM: SS format) is displayed on the screen.

To stop the recording, tap the Record icon again.

Tap Save draft to save the recording as a draft or tap Submit to submit it for review. Alternatively, tap Discard & Record Again to delete the recording and start a new recording.

Preview your recording. If you are not satisfied with it, record a fresh voice-over by clicking Record New. All voice-over recordings are saved as drafts.

The Drafts section can store multiple drafts of your recording attempts. We recommend that you compare and preview all your attempts and choose the best one as your final Submission.

Note: All your recording attempts stored within the drafts section are visible only to you.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Submission:
When attempting a Voice-Over Slideshow Mission you are expected to record your Submission on a presentation.

The Admin may provide a standard presentation for you to record your submission on. This presentation cannot be altered.

Alternatively, you may be asked to create a presentation, upload it, and record your Submission on it.

In the above example, you have to upload a presentation and record your first sales pitch based on each point covered in the presentation. You will deliver this pitch to a Purchase Officer.

Tap Record Your Submission.

If you are recording a Mission for the first time, the app will ask for your permission to access your mobile’s microphone, tap Allow.

Tap Add Slide to upload a pdf to start recording your Mission.

You can now begin recording by tapping the Record icon.

When you start recording, the length of the recording (in MM: SS format) is displayed on the screen.

To stop the recording, tap the Record icon again.

Tap Save draft to save the recording as a draft or tap Submit to submit it for review. Alternatively, tap Discard & Record Again to delete the recording and start a new recording.

Preview your recording. If you are not satisfied with it, record a fresh voice-over by clicking Record New. All voice-over recordings are saved as drafts.

The Drafts section can store multiple drafts of your recording attempts. We recommend that you compare and preview all your attempts and choose the best one as your final Submission.

Note: All your recording attempts stored within the drafts section are visible only to you.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Submission > Insights > Articulation Insight:
The Articulation Insight measures how closely you have met the guidelines set by the Admin for this Mission.

Submission Length states if the submission length is short, appropriate, or long based on the set target length range.

Speech Pace shows how your delivery compares with the average range for speaking rate. The Speech Pace insight helps you understand if the pace at which you have delivered the submission is slow, appropriate, or fast.

Filler Words insight highlights phrases or sounds that mark a pause or hesitation in your pitch or presentation. This insight identifies filler words you have used and lists the number of times each word is repeated.

This article explains how Reviewers can schedule Coaching Sessions assigned to them using the MindTickle Mobile App. A Reviewer is appointed to a Coaching Session to provide feedback to the Learner. Learn how to schedule Coaching Sessions using the web interface or watch the Scheduling Coaching Sessions using the Mobile App video tutorial.

While it is not mandatory to schedule a Coaching Session with the Learner before you start reviewing the session, we do recommend that you make the Learner aware that you have begun the review.

1. Tap the View Session button on the email notification you receive about being appointed as a Reviewer. Alternatively, sign in to the mobile app as a Reviewer and see the required Coaching Session from the Coaching dashboard.2. Tap Schedule on the Coaching Session that you have been appointed Reviewer.

3. On the page that opens, set the Next Session date, Start time, and End time as appropriate. To conduct a day-long session, tap the All day check box. Tap Schedule.

The Learner will receive notifications about the scheduled Session.

4. To reschedule, open the Session and tap the previously scheduled time and date.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Mobile app:
This article explains how reviewers can review Coaching Sessions assigned to them using the MindTickle mobile app. You can schedule Coaching Sessions with your learner before you start reviewing.

Note: If you plan to review the session without scheduling it, ensure that the learner is made aware of it.

1. Tap the View Session button on the email notification you receive about being appointed as a reviewer. Alternatively, sign in to the mobile app as a reviewer and select the required Coaching Session from the Coaching dashboard.

2. Tap the supported files (if any) to your device to get an idea about the purpose of the session before you start reviewing.

3. You can also filter the review forms based on the section. From the Select section to review drop-down, select the required section, and tap Apply. This option is visible only if sections were added to coaching sessions by the admin.

4. Evaluate the learner based on the parameters provided. Parameters marked with an asterisk are mandatory, and you will have to evaluate the learner based on these before submitting the review.

Note: If admins have enabled Learners Self Review, reviewers can tap the Learners (self review) tab to view the learner's self review score.

5. Tap Enter session time with learner to log the duration for which you conducted the session.Note: This option is visible and mandatory only if the admin enabled it while creating the Coaching Session.

7. Tap Upload supporting file to add the file you want learners to refer to.

8. At any point during the review, if you wish to reset the feedback, tap Reset Parameters.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App:
This article explains the steps you can follow to take a Challenge using the Mindtickle Mobile App.

A Challenge is a set of Questions delivered to you as part of a Quest that you are invited to. A Quest is a Module that contains Questions developed on a given topic or concept. A few Questions are selected periodically and delivered to you in the form of Challenges.

Note:

- Quests are currently supported in both iOS and Android operating systems of the Mobile App.
- Quests are not available in offline mode.
- Quests are available in all the languages supported on the MindTickle mobile app. See Language Support in MindTickle and Which languages does the Mindtickle Mobile App support? for more information.

Learn how to take a Challenge using the web interface.

1. Tap the notification you receive on your mobile app to be directed to the Challenge.

2. Alternatively, you can take the Challenge from the home screen of your Mindtickle mobile app. Tap the Quest tile. You can see the description of the Quest. Tap Go to Quest.

Note: To see the complete explanation of the Quest, tap the description.

Note: Regardless of whether you have answered correctly or not, the Question will be delivered to you again in a few days.

6. Read the Explanation (if enabled by the Admin while creating the Quest) and go through the supporting information, if any. The Points you earned and the number of days after which the Question will be repeated for you are also shown.Note: Challenges are scheduled such that they will not be delivered on the weekend. Challenges are only delivered between Monday at 00:00 and Friday at 23:59 in your time zone.

- Quests are available in all the languages supported on the MindTickle mobile app. See Language Support in MindTickle and Which languages does the Mindtickle Mobile App support? for more information.

Learn how to take a Challenge using the web interface.

1. Tap the notification you receive on your mobile app to be directed to the Challenge.

2. Alternatively, you can take the Challenge from the home screen of your Mindtickle mobile app. Tap the Quest tile. You can see the description of the Quest. Tap Go to Quest.

Note: To see the complete explanation of the Quest, tap the description.

Note: Regardless of whether you have answered correctly or not, the Question will be delivered to you again in a few days.

6. Read the Explanation (if enabled by the Admin while creating the Quest) and go through the supporting information, if any. The Points you earned and the number of days after which the Question will be repeated for you are also shown.Note: Challenges are scheduled such that they will not be delivered on the weekend. Challenges are only delivered between Monday at 00:00 and Friday at 23:59 in your time zone.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Integrations > User Sync > Implementation effort and cost:
This integration requires engaging our Professional Services team for the implementation. Please contact your Customer Success Manager, who will then engage our Professional Services team. Professional Services can assist you with consultation, implementation, deployment, and testing of the integration.

Note: Engaging Professional Services is a paid service engagement.

The time taken to implement the integration depends on the size of your organization and other complexities. Professional Services evaluates their engagement effort after discussing the scope and requirements with you.

Follow these steps to sync your Entra ID users with the Mindtickle platform.

1. Contact Mindtickle Support to enable Entra ID user provisioning with Mindtickle’s Tools.svc.

Note:

- If Entra ID user provisioning is disabled in Mindtickle, the system rejects all requests from Entra ID.
- When you enable user provisioning in Tools.svc , the Entra ID's retry mechanism determines whether failed requests become successful.

2. Sign in to the Microsoft Entra admin center using your credentials.

3. On the left navigation panel, click Enterprise apps and select + New application on the displayed page.

4. In the Browse Microsoft Entra Gallery screen, enter Mindtickle in the search bar and select it from the displayed results.

5. On the displayed pop-up, click Create.

The application screen opens.

6. Click the Provisioning tab.

The Overview (Preview) screen is displayed.

7. Click the Provisioning tab on the left pane.

8. Select Automatic in the Provisioning Mode drop-down.

9. Under the Admin Credentials section, in the Tenant URL field, enter https://admin.mindtickle.com/scim.Note: If your learning site is based in the US, enter https://scim.prod-us.mindtickle.com/scim in the Tenant URL field. To confirm which region your learning site is based in, contact Mindtickle Support.10. In the Secret Token field, enter the secret token provided by the Mindtickle team.

- Apart from the 29 fields supported by Mindtickle, you can also customize the list of fields to add custom and standard fields. To learn more, refer to the How to add custom fields in the Entra ID article.
- If an attribute's value is removed or set to blank, Entra ID does not notify Mindtickle about the change. Only the original value of this attribute is retained in Mindtickle.

20. Contact Mindtickle Support to register the fields that you mapped in Microsoft Entra ID for your learning site before you enable provisioning.

Note: Configuring an attribute mapping in Microsoft Entra ID does not automatically register the field in Mindtickle. The Mindtickle Support must register each mapped standard, custom, or relationship field for your learning site.

If a mapped field is not registered, user sync requests can fail with a PATCH request's path not valid error, even when the Microsoft Entra ID mapping is configured correctly.

21. After the Mindtickle Support team confirms that the mapped fields are registered, return to the Provisioning section of your application.

22. Scroll down to the Settings section, set the toggle switch for Provisioning Status to On.

23. Select Scope as Sync only assigned users and groups.

24. Click Save.

The sync for your Entra ID users is now complete.

This article explains how to download and sign in to the Mindtickle mobile app.

For an overview of the features and functionalities of the app, see Mindtickle mobile app overview. For information on the mobile app requirements, see Supported browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

1. First, you need to download and install the Mindtickle mobile app on your mobile device (phone or tablet). You can download the app directly from the Apple App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android), depending on your mobile OS.
2. Open the app once it’s installed. It opens with the onboarding tour that provides a brief introduction to the app. Click Skip to skip the tour.

1. On the first page, enter your Learning Site URL and then click go in the keypad. For example, productmarketing.mindtickle.com. Use the Don’t know your learning site URL? option when you cannot remember your learning site URL. On the next screen, enter your Mindtickle email address. Then, you are directly taken to the sign-in screen. Note: You cannot use this option if there are multiple learning sites linked to your email address. In this case, you must enter a particular learning site’s URL to proceed with signing in. Please contact your admin in case you forgot the learning site URL.

This article explains all about your series in the Mindtickle app for iOS and Android.

When you open the Mindtickle app, you land on the Home tab. Tap the Series tab to view your assigned, subscribed, and public series. On the series home page, tap the tabs at the top to switch between Assigned, Subscribed, and Public series. For more information on public series, see Access Public Series.

The series page also displays the average rating for each (public, subscribed, and assigned) series.

Note:

- The average rating for a series is visible under the series name only if your admin has enabled the feature for your Learning Site and for that particular series.To view the number of user ratings on a series, tap on the series.
- If your admin has enabled the series ratings feature for a particular series, but it has not received any user ratings yet, only a dash (—) next to the star will be visible under the series name.
- If your admin has disabled the series ratings feature for a particular series, its series rating will not be visible, and learners will not be able to rate the series.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Access Public Series:
Public series are series that anyone in your organization can access. You can access public series from the Public tab on the Series page. This tab displays:

- All public series
- Scoped public series (if learner falls under the scope)
- Your subscribed public series
- Your self-initiated public series

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Series details page > Overview tab:
The Overview tab serves as an introduction to the series and its content, and provides a holistic overview and clarity. The overview page highlights important content in the series in a contextual way to provide a more intuitive and relevant learning experience.

The Overview page lists the series details on the overview page header, including:

- The series thumbnail.
- The series name and its type, i.e., if it is assigned, public, or a subscribed series.
- The series description. Click See more to view the entire description.
- The series rating and your rating for the series.

Note: The Overview tab is available only if your admin configures and enables the overview page for this series. If it’s enabled, this will be your default tab. If it’s not enabled, the Modules tab becomes the default.

The Overview tab displays content in the form of various widgets configured by your admin. For example, text widgets provide textual information, video widgets let you view videos, and certain widgets have important links. There are also four widgets that help you get to the important modules right from the landing page: Continue, Required, Trending, and Urgent widgets.Note: The Custom HTML/CSS widget may not always render and work properly on the Mindtickle app, due to an inherent limitation. We recommend to check and verify the widget on the mobile app yourself after adding it to make sure it works as you intended. If it's not working properly, we recommend removing it from the series overview page.

For more information on the widgets, see Create and edit pages using the Page Builder.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Series details page > Certifications tab:
On the Certifications tab, you can view, earn, and share series certifications. Earning a series-level certification proves your achievement of a common objective standard defined by your organization. Sharing it socially helps you showcase your skills and present yourself as a skilled professional. To get certified on a series:

- You must have access to the series.
- Certification must be added to the series by your admin.
- The certification must be active.
- You must fulfill the specified certification criteria completely.
- You must be eligible for the certification. If you have already met the certification criteria in the past (before activating the certification), you will not be automatically awarded the certificate.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Series details page > Certifications tab > Earn Series Certifications:
To earn a series certification:

1. Navigate to a series and tap the Certifications tab.
2. Tap the certification you are interested in. The following details are displayed:
  1. Certification description: A brief overview of the certification.
  2. Certificate sample: A sample of the certificate awarded to you upon successfully completing the certification criteria.
  3. Certification criteria: The certification criteria you must complete to earn the certification.
  4. Validity: The duration for which the certification will be valid.
3. Complete the certification criteria as specified. Upon successful completion, three actions occur automatically:
  1. You receive the certificate in an email.
  2. The certification tile on the Certifications tab is updated. The status of the certification is updated to Awarded and the certificate award date and validity are displayed. In case the certificate is not visible immediately, use pull to refresh to reload the page.
  3. The certificate is available for downloading as an image and sharing directly on LinkedIn. For more information, see Download and Share Certificates.Note:
    - Once you earn the certification and the certification is valid, you are not re-evaluated, even if the certification criteria changes.
    - If the certification criteria is updated, it only applies to learners who have not already earned the certificate and learners eligible for recertification.
    - If your admin deactivates the certification after you are certified, your certification is still retained and is not impacted in any way.
    - If your admin deletes the certification after you are certified, the certification is automatically revoked from you.

This article explains how to change your password using the Mindtickle mobile app. This is the password that you use for signing in to the Mindtickle platform, either on the web or using the mobile app.

Note:

- The option to change password is available only if you have signed in to the app using your username (email address). The option is not available if you have signed in through single sign-on (SSO) or an account activation link.
- If your organization uses SSO, changing the password for your mobile app does not impact your SSO password. You will still be able to sign in to the mobile app using your SSO credentials.

For an overview of the features and functionalities of the app, see Mindtickle mobile app overview.

1. On the mobile app, tap More on the tab bar at the bottom.

1. Tap Profile under more options.

1. On the profile page, click Settings.

1. On the Settings page, click Change password.Note: The Change password option is available only if you have signed in to the app using your username (email address). The option is not available if you have signed in through single sign-on (SSO) or an account activation link.
2. Enter the appropriate values in the fields for old password, new password, and confirm password. Now you can use your new password to sign in.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups:
A group is a set of users filtered and categorized based on their profile fields, such as location, department, or date of hiring. Site owners and enablement admins can create groups from the Users tab on the admin site. Having users segregated into Groups enables Managers to view and drill-down the reports in Analytics. Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Introduction:
The Groups page displays a list of all groups accessible to users based on their roles and permissions. Users with the Site owners, Group managers, and enablement admins roles can create, rename, and delete a Group, and also view the analytics for a group.

For each group, the Groups page displays the Group name (Groups), the number of users in it (Users), the name of the User who created it (Created by), and the date on which it was created (Created on). The Groups heading displays the total number of Groups that you have access to in parentheses.

Click the name of the group to view the group’s page, where you can add or remove members from the group, add and manage group collaborators, invite group members to one or more series, and link or unlink the group from series. To learn more, see the Groups page overview.

Filter groups: By default, Groups lists all the groups in the platform, subject to roles and permissions of the user accessing this page. Click the All groups button to filter the fgroups to display All groups or only those Groups created by you (Created by me).

Search groups: You can search for Groups using the search bar that is available next to the All groups button.

Note: The search query requires a minimum of three characters to run a search across groups. Any user with the “Group analytics” permission can browse, filter, sort, or search groups but cannot create, rename, or delete a group.

Sort Groups: You can sort the groups' information by the columns using the sort buttons in the column names. To learn more, see the Sort groups information.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Sort groups Information:
You can sort the group's information by the Group name, Users, Created By, and Created On columns.

This section explains how to sort the groups information:

1. For the column by which you want to sort the groups information, hover over the column name to display the sort buttons.As shown in the above screenshot:

- The Up and Down sort buttons appear next to the column name.
- The default sort is applied to the groups column (in alphabetical order).
- The dark-gray arrow indicates the order in which the currently active sort is applied.

2. Click the Up and Down sort buttons depending on the order in which you want to sort the column.

The Up button sorts information in the following way:

- groups: The group names, alphabetically
- Users: The number of users in groups, highest to lowest
- Created by: Names of the users who created the groups, alphabetically
- Created on: The group creation dates, latest to oldest

The Down button reverses the sort order that was set using the Up button.

3. To reset the sort to the default, click the same button again. This resets the sort to show information by the Groups column in alphabetical order.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > FAQs:
- When you remove learners, you can re-invite them to the module . Once re-invited, their data and progress are restored, and they can continue working on the assigned modules as long as the content has not changed.
- Removed learners do not appear in analytics.
- In an ILT module, when you re-invite a removed learner, their enrollment and attendance data is restored only for the sessions where their attendance was marked — either “Attended” or “Did not attend.” No data is restored for the past sessions where the attendance was not marked (“Unmarked”) and for any future sessions where the learner was enrolled. The ILT data is restored only if the learner was removed after Nov 13, 2020. No data will be restored if the learner is removed before November 13, 2020.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series:
When you create a blank series, you can design a readiness program from scratch to suit your organization's needs and requirements. You can add your learning content to it and structure it accordingly.To create a blank series:

1. On the admin site homepage, click Training on the left navigation panel and select Series.

The Series page is displayed.

2. Click the Create button and select Series from the drop-down menu to create a series from scratch.

Alternatively, you can create a series using pre-configured series templates from the Mindtickle Marketplace. Click Use a template. For more information, see Create a series using a series template.

The Create a new series pop-up is displayed.

4. In the Name your series, enter an appropriate name for the series. This field is mandatory.

5. Click Description for learners and enter a description for the series. You can mention the series’ goals, objectives, and relevance.

Note: To generate a series description using Copilot, click Generate new description.

6. Click Add to category to add the series to an appropriate category. You can choose from the available options or create a new category.

To create a new category, enter the name of the category and click Create “category name*”.

Categorizing series helps you organize your learning content and find it easily later. For more information on organizing, renaming, and deleting categories, see Series categories.Note: Categories are not visible to learners on the learning site.

7. Click Next

The Series Outline section is displayed.

8. Click Start from scratch to build a series from scratch.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Create sections > Create a section from the module listing page:
1. Navigate to the Modules tab in a series. If it’s a blank series, click Add a section . Otherwise, hover over a specific position in the series structure and add sections on the fly. The section is added at the selected position. This eliminates the manual overhead to modify and reorganize the series structure after adding modules or sections. Note : When sections are expanded, on hovering, both options, Add a module here and Add a section here , are available.
  - When sections are collapsed, only the Add a section here option is available.
  - If you add modules and then create a (first) section, all modules are automatically moved to the new section.
  - If the series contains only modules, you can add the first section at the top and then at any other position in the structure.
  - The Expand / Collapse option for sections is not available for series that exceed 100 modules.
  - It is recommended that a series should ideally consist of no more than 50 modules. This is to maintain optimal page performance and ensure learners are not overwhelmed by a large amount of learning content.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Modify series structure:
You can rename and delete sections, re-order sections, and reorder modules within a section or between different sections from the Modify series structure pane. You can access the pane from the modules listing page. The Modify series structure option is not available if no modules or sections are present in the series. It becomes available once you click Add a section on the modules listing page.

Click Modify series structure to perform the following actions:

- Rename a section: Click the pencil icon to change the name of the section.
- Delete sections : Click the Delete icon to delete the section. The module in the deleted section moves to the previous section in the sequence. If no other sections are present in the series, the module remains sectionless in the series.
- Re-order module within a section : Drag and drop the module within a section to rearrange them.

- Re-order module between different sections : Drag and drop a module into the section from another section. Note : When moving a module from one section to another, ensure the destination section is in expanded view within the Modify series Structure view pane.
- Rearrange sections : Drag and drop sections in the structure to rearrange their order.
- Delete all sections : Click Delete all sections to delete all the sections in the series. Deleting all the sections does not affect the module in the series.

As an enablement admin, you may need to reorganize enablement programs frequently. Reorganizing programs sometimes involves moving a module from one series to another. In some cases, it becomes necessary to move multiple modules together from one series to another.

Note:

- A module is moved to the destination series in the same state it was in, in the source series.
- After a module is moved, learners can access it only from the destination series.
- When you move a module from an assigned series to a public series , the learners’ completion and performance data becomes unavailable within Module reports in Mindtickle analytics . To access this data, contact Mindtickle Support . To restore and access the data from Mindtickle analytics, ensure that the learners who were invited to the module in the assigned series must access the module in the public series.
- When copying modules from a sequentially unlocked series without sections to a new or existing series, the copied modules are added to the end of the series. The module order of the source series is retained.

This article explains how you can:

- Move a single module to another series
- Move multiple modules to another series

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Move a single module to another series:
1. Navigate to the series from which you want to move the module.
2. Click the More options icon against the module you want to move and select Move to.
3. In the Move module pop-up, select the Destination series (and Section if applicable) into which you want to move the module. Note : If the destination series does not exist, click Search series , enter a name for the new series, and click Create a new series *name of new series* . The new series is created and the module is moved to it when you click Move .
4. Click Next .
5. Select the Notify these learners about the changes by email check box if you want to notify the learners in the source series about the move. After the module is moved, these learners will be able to access it only from the destination series. Click Next .
6. Choose which category of learners from the destination series should be invited to the moved module. Select the Notify learners via email check box if you want to notify the learners about the change. Note : • By default, the category of learners invited to at least one module in the destination series is selected. • Learners who have independently subscribed to the public series are automatically invited to the newly published module. The changes are pushed to learners invited by the admin.
7. Click Move . You can track the status of the action in Notifications . For more information, see System feedback Overview . Once the module is moved successfully, a confirmation message is displayed on the screen.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Move multiple modules to another series:
1. Navigate to the series from which you want to move the modules.
2. Select the modules you want to move. Note :
  - You can select up to 50 modules to move at once.
  - When moving multiple modules, it is recommended that you perform the action in batches of 50 modules each. Ensure that the subsequent batch is scheduled for moving at a sufficient time interval (at least 10 minutes) from the previous batch. If you plan to move a large number of modules by successively selecting 50 modules in batches of 3 or more, notify Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM). Taking these measures ensures that the platform’s performance is not impacted and is well monitored.
3. Click Move in the bulk action options displayed at the bottom of the screen.
4. Follow steps 3 to 7 of the move a single module to another series process.

Once the modules are moved successfully, a confirmation message is displayed on the screen.

Taking these measures ensures that the platform’s performance is not impacted and is well monitored.
3. Click Move in the bulk action options displayed at the bottom of the screen.
4. Follow steps 3 to 7 of the move a single module to another series process.

Once the modules are moved successfully, a confirmation message is displayed on the screen.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Module score and KScore:
Module score and points: You earn points in Mindtickle based on the completion of modules. The total number of points you earn in a module is your score for the module.

The points for each module are configured by your admin.

KScore: Knowledge score, also called KScore, helps you measure your progress as a learner. Every 100 points you score in any module earns you one knowledge score.

The knowledge score is the floor value after dividing your module score by 100.

| Score | KScore |
| --- | --- |
| 500/100 = 5.00 | 5 |
| 540/100 = 5.40 | 5 |
| 550/100 = 5.50 | 5 |
| 560/100 = 5.60 | 5 |
| 599/100 = 5.99 | 5 |
| 600/100 = 6.00 | 6 |

KScore for missions: For missions, the KScore is calculated by normalizing the module score out of 500 points.

For example, there are five evaluation parameters in a mission, each worth 500 points. A learner gets a score of 2000 out of 2500 points. When this module score is normalized, it equals to 400 out of 500 points. Therefore, the learner's module score will increase by 400 points and the KScore by 4 points. The following table elaborates this example:

| Actual score out of 2500 | Normalized score out of 500 | KScore Contribution |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2000 | 400 | 4 |
| 2350 | 470 | 4 |
| 2500 | 500 | 5 |

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Check your module score and KScore:
To check your module score:

1. In the navigation bar, click the profile icon in the top-right corner, and select My profile and analytics .

1. On the profile page that appears, your KScore and Module score is displayed under the All completed modules and All assigned series section.

- All completed modules: Shows the score you have earned for each of your completed Modules. You can sort the list to display all completed modules, modules where you earned a certificate, or an individual module.
- All assigned series: Shows the score you have earned for the completed modules for each of your assigned series. This section shows the number of completed modules in a series and the aggregate score you have earned for the completed modules.

To check your KScore:

- You can view your KScore in the top-right corner, next to the profile icon. Hover over it for the option to Compare with peers. The Recent achievements widget, in the right column, measures your progress and shows achievements you earned in the last 30 days.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Compare your KScore with peers:
To compare your KScore with your peers:

1. On the navigation bar, hover over the KScore icon in the top-right corner. The pop-up with your KScore and the Compare with peers button appears.

2. Click the Compare with peers button. The Leaderboard page is displayed. You can view the Kscore of your peers and the ranking of different learners in your company.

3. Your peers are listed based on their score rankings in descending order. By default, top-scorers are listed first. For more information on the peer's leaderboard, see Learning site overview.

To filter the Leaderboard page, click the Profile fields menu. The following options are available:

- Job title: The official job role of the learner.
- Department : The department of the learner.
- Location : The location of the learner.
- Region : The learner’s geographical region.
- Joining date : The learner's joining date.
- Transfer date : The date of transfer if the learner moved from another department.
- Leaving date : The date the learner left the company.
- Company name : The name of the learner's company.
- Designation : The learner’s designation in the company.

You can add multiple filters by clicking the Add new button.

4. Click Apply to sort the Leaderboard based on the filters.

The learners in the Leaderboard page are now displayed based on the selected filters.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups:
When a group is linked to a series, the series and its modules are automatically assigned to all the group members. You can configure the link such as:

- Only users added to the group in the future are invited to the series.
- OR
- Existing group members as well as users added to the group in the future are invited to the series.

Once linked, depending on your configuration, users are assigned to the linked series automatically. After a group is linked to a series, users also get invited to all modules of the series.

Unlinking a group from a series does not remove or uninvite the group members from the series — if necessary, you need to do this manually. After a group is unlinked from a series, any user added to the group will not get invited to the series automatically.

You can link (or unlink) a group and a series from the following places:

- From the Groups page
- From within a series

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > From the Groups page > While inviting the group to a series::
1. Sign in to the admin site.
2. On the left navigation bar, click Users and select Groups . The Groups page is displayed.
3. Click a group. The group details are displayed.
4. Click Invite group from the header and select To series to invite the group members to one or more series.
5. On the Invite group to series dialog box, perform the following:
6. Select one or more series that you want to link the group to. You can also search for a series by name.
7. When you select a series, the toggle switch in the Link to group column is on by default. If you do not want to link the group to the series, turn the toggle switch off.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > From the Groups page > From the series links tab:
1. To link the group to an individual series, turn the toggle switch ON for the series.
2. Select the series and click the Link now button to link the group to multiple series in bulk. Note : You can link up to 30 series in bulk at a time. If more than 30 series are selected, the Link Now button is disabled.
3. On the displayed pop-up, check the Invite all existing group members to the series to invite the existing group members to the series. If you invite them, members who were selectively invited to some modules are invited to the complete series. To invite only users added to the group in the future, leave the checkbox unchecked.
4. Click Link now . A confirmation message indicates that the linking has been completed successfully. Once linked, the toggle switch is turned ON . Note :
5. While linking, if you leave the Invite all existing group members to the series checkbox unchecked, existing members are not invited. After linking the series, you can click the Sync icon to invite existing group members to the series.
6. This option is also available while linking multiple series in bulk, and Invite all existing group members to the series was not chosen.
7. If you select the Invite all existing group members to the series checkbox, the Invited column displays a spinning sync icon to indicate that the existing group members are invited to the series. Based on your user selection, they are automatically invited to the linked series.
8. To unlink the group from an individual series, turn the toggle switch off for the series
9. To unlink the group from multiple series in bulk, select the series and click Unlink now . Note : You can unlink up to 30 series in bulk.
10. On the displayed pop-up, click Unlink now . Once unlinked, any users added to the group in the future will not automatically be invited to the unlinked series. A confirmation message displays on the screen, indicating the unlinking is done successfully. Once unlinked, the toggle switch is turned off . The Linked to <x> series status at the top is updated to display the number of linked series.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > From within a series:
You can manage linking/unlinking of groups visible on this page. You can also remove a linked group from the series from this page.

Note: A group might not be visible on this page if none of its members have been invited to this series.

1. On the series page, click Learners > View by groups . This displays the list of groups with at least one learner invited to the series.
2. In the Link status column, click the toggle switch to link the group to the series.
3. On the displayed pop-up, you can choose to invite:

- Only members added to the group in the future OR
- Future and existing group members

4. To invite future and existing members, select the Invite all existing group members to the series checkbox.

Note:

- Some learners from the group may be already invited to some but not all modules from the series. To invite them to the entire series, select the checkbox Invite all existing group members to the series .
- While linking, if you leave the Invite all existing group members to the series checkbox unchecked, existing members are not invited to the series. Post linking, you can click the Sync icon to invite existing group members to the series.

5. Click Link now.

A confirmation message is displayed on the screen once the group is successfully linked to the series. After linking, new users added to the group in the future are automatically assigned to the series and its modules.

Note: If the Invite all existing group members to the series checkbox is selected, then existing group members are also assigned to the series and its modules.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Communications > Notifications and Reminders:
This article explains how to set up email notifications and reminders on your admin site. To see a full list of email templates accessible across the learning site and across all the modules on the learning site, refer to the List of email templates article.

Once you have configured email templates for notifications and reminders, the next step is to determine which communications your learners should receive and how often should they receive them. The timing and templates used for notifications and reminders are set up at the series and module levels.

To learn more about the types of notifications learners receive, refer to the Learner notifications > Notification center article.

Note:

- Notification digest is enabled by default for your learning site; learners receive the notification digest email at a scheduled period based on the defined notification digest frequency. For more information, see Notification digest.
- Admins can also choose not to send notifications for modules that are marked as Optional or Unmarked for a learner. If applied, this setting is applicable to modules and series across the learning site. For more information, see Disable email notifications for optional or unmarked modules.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Communications > Notifications and Reminders > Series:
1. On the admin site homepage, click Training and select Series.
2. Click a series to open.
3. Click the Settings tab > Notifications tab.

On this tab, you can configure the following settings:

- Series invitation email and mobile notifications: Use the toggle switch to enable or disable the Series Invitation email and mobile notification which is sent when a Learner is invited directly to the Series.
- If this option is disabled, email invitations will not be sent when Learners are invited to the Series. If you enable it, choose the invitation email template from the drop-down list. If required, edit the invitation email template by clicking View then Edit template.
- Note: Changing this setting does not enable/disable the module invitation email, which is sent when a Learner is separately invited to any module within the series.
- Module invitation email and mobile notifications: A Module Invitation is sent when a Learner is invited to a Module directly. This is the master control to enable or disable all the Module invitations and mobile notifications from the Series settings.
- If this is disabled, no Module invitation is sent from any Module in this Series. If this is enabled, Module invitations will be sent based on individual Module settings.
- To learn more about how to disable individual module invitation emails, refer to the Modules section of this article.
- Reminder email and mobile notifications: Learner is reminded to complete the pending modules in a series. There are two ways this reminder is triggered.

- Automated reminders are set on the modules inside that series. The module reminder with the earliest reminder date takes precedence when the series reminder is sent.
- The admin sends a manual reminder.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Communications > Notifications and Reminders > Modules > Course:
1. On the Admin site homepage, click Training and select Series.
2. Click a series to open.
3. Click the course for which you want to update the settings.
4. If the course is in the Draft state, click the More options icon against it and select Edit.On the course module, click the Settings tab, and click the Due date and reminders tab.Under this tab, there are three sections: Due date for the learner, Emails for the learner, and Emails for the manager.

Due date for the learner

Enable or disable the completion due date. You can configure a universal course due date at the module level that applies to all learners invited to the course. Or, you can configure it at the individual learner or group level. This allows you to determine when each learner or learner group must complete the course. For more information on how to configure course due dates for individual learners or groups, see Edit due date.

To configure a universal completion due date for all learners invited to the module, specify the specific date or the number of days after invitation for the due date.

Note:

- The number of days after invitation can be set in the range of 1 to 730 days.
- If you change the course’s due date settings after it has been set for individual learners or groups, the system launches a pop-up notification. chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Communications > Notifications and Reminders > Modules > Course > Emails for the manager:
Send automated escalation emails to a learner’s manager if the module is incomplete for the learner even after the due date has passed. A course is considered incomplete for a learner if they have:

- Not started the course
- Started the course but not completed it

Note:

- The Emails for the manager option is available for a course only if a due date has been set on it.

Module incomplete

- Click + Add reminder.
- Choose Whom to send the email to. Select a manager from the Select a manager drop-down.Note: Manager fields can be configured in the learner’s user Profile. For more information, refer to Profile Management.
- Select the frequency at which the email should be sent from the Frequency drop-down and click . You can choose to send the email Daily, on every Alternate day, or Weekly. The default frequency is set to Daily.Note:
  - By default, the email will be sent at either 2 PM or 8 AM based on the manager’s timezone.
  - The frequency that you select will apply for all learners who have not completed the module and who report directly to the manager selected in the previous step.
  - If the module is multi-present, the escalation rule will apply to all learners that are invited to the module via all series in which the module is present. In this case, emails sent to the manager will receive details for learners from all series.
- Click View to view or edit the template. An email preview screen appears, which gives a sneak peek of how the email may appear to the recipient. Click Edit template to edit its contents. For more information, refer to Edit Template.
- Click the Delete icon to delete the rule.

Note:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Communications > Notifications and Reminders > Modules > Assessment:
1. Navigate to Assessment > Settings > Due date and emails.

Due date for the learner

Enable or disable the completion due date. You can configure a universal assessment due date at the module level that applies to all learners invited to the assessment. Or, you can configure it at the individual learner or group level. This allows you to determine when each learner or learner group must complete the assessment. For more information on how to configure assessment due dates for individual learners or groups, see Edit due date for learners.

Note:

- Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) or Mindtickle Support to enable this feature.
- This feature is also applicable for courses and quick updates.

To configure a universal completion due date for all learners invited to the module, you can select the following options:

- No. of days after invitation: The learner’s reminder is sent after a certain number of days after the invitation.
- Select a specific date: The learner’s reminder is sent on a specific date after the invitation.

If the Due date for the learner toggle is turned off on the assessment’s Settings page, then the Due date column will not be displayed in the Invite and track tab of the series.

If you select a specific date to send reminder emails to the learner, the bulk module reminders are disabled. For more information, see reminders.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Communications > Invite Learners > Individual learners:
Use this option to add one or more learners individually.

1. On the series page, click Invite Learners . From the drop-down menu, select Individual learners . A list of existing learners is displayed. You can find a specific learner using the search box. You can also filter learners by Profile Fields and Groups . If the learners are not listed, click Add new learners to manually add learners. The Add new learner(s) pop-up appears.
2. Enter the new user’s username and name and click Add 1 learner . Note :

- The user’s registered email address is their username.
- To add more new learners, click + Add another and repeat this step.

The new user is added to the platform. By default, the new user is selected as an invitee.

3. Click Invitation for (n) learners.

An invitation email is sent to the selected learners' registered email addresses.

1. Select whether group members can continue the module after the due date or whether the module freezes.

- Edit module relevance and Edit due date settings apply only to selected linked groups. The selected unlinked groups are not updated.

- Due dates are not supported for quests, competency assessments, AI roleplays, coaching, or ILT modules.

You can re-invite Learners only to the course, quick update, and assessment modules. This article explains the process of reinviting learners to these modules:

1. On the admin site, navigate to a series and then click the course, quick update, or assessment module to which you want to re-invite learners.

2. Select the learners you want to re-invite. Click Send email. The below image is an example of a course module.

3. On the pop-up that appears:

- Select the email template from the Select Template drop-down.
- In the From field, enter the name of the sender of the email.
- Enter the Subject of the email. An email subject is the first text Learners see after your sender name when an email reaches their inbox.
- Enter the main text in the body of the email. You can use different formatting options from the editor.

Once you have filled in all the information, click the Send Email button at the lower-right corner of the screen to send the email or Cancel to discard the action.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Roles and Permissions:
Each role in Mindtickle has a defined set of permissions associated with it. As a site owner, you can assign roles and permissions to both, new and existing, users in Mindtickle. Once you assign a role to a user, the permissions associated with that role are automatically assigned to that user. By assigning proper roles and permissions, you can regulate each user's access to the platform based on the type of activities they will be performing.

Before assigning roles and permissions, ensure that all site level preferences are set on the admin site.

Note: A Site Owner can assign multiple roles to the same user.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Communications > Notifications and Reminders:
The Send an announcement feature allows site owners and enablement admins to broadcast information to learners through Mindtickle.

This article further explains how to send announcements to learners.

1. On the admin home page, click the profile icon in the upper-right corner and then select Send an announcement.2. On the Send announcement dialog box, click Add recipients to select the learners or groups to whom you want to send an announcement.

3. On the Select recipients for announcement page, there are two tabs: Groups and Learners.

- On the Groups tab, select the groups you want to send the announcement. Use Search groups to find and select specific groups.

- On the Learners tab, select the learners to whom you want to send the announcement. You can use Search learners to find and select specific learners.
- By default, All groups is selected, and it displays learners from all the groups. You can click All groups to see a list of your groups and select a group to display its learners.

- Click Confirm to add the selected groups and learners as recipients.

4. Enter a Subject and Message for the announcement and click Send.

After you click send, the learners will receive notifications on:

- The learning site under Notifications . Learners can click the notification to view the announcement .
- The learners will receive an email notification.
- The learner will also receive the announcement notification on their Mindtickle mobile application . The learner can tap the notification to view the announcement.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Archive modules:
As an admin, you can archive a module that has already been published but is no longer relevant. You can even schedule the auto-archival of a module (Beta) for a later date in the future. Once a module is archived, it is no longer available to the learners. It is stored in the Archived modules folder on the left navigation panel of the admin home page and can only be accessed by the admin. This ensures that learners have access to only relevant content.

Note:

- Once a module is archived, learners can no longer access it. The following message is displayed when learners try to access an archived module:
- Archiving a multi-present module removes it from all the series it is available in and moves it to the Archived modules folder.
- It is possible to retrieve an archived module . However, learner data like progress and submissions associated with the archived module will be permanently lost. Learner records for the archived module are removed from learners' assignment or completion history and learner reports. However, you can access the analytics data for the archived modules at the individual module level. To view the analytics of the archived modules, apply the Archived filter in Module analytics or use the Reporting API .
- When you archive a module, the learners' module-level scores and points , as well as the overall Knowledge score (Kscore), are retained. Additionally, archived modules do not impact the Readiness Index (RI) in Analytics, which considers the module scores for RI calculations.
- You can view the analytics data for all archived module types except quests.
- If all modules within a series are archived and the series is deleted, the series-level analytics data is lost.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Archive modules > Archive an individual module:
To archive individual modules in a series:

1. On the admin site homepage, click Training on the left navigation pane and select Series.

The Series page is displayed.

2. Click on a series to open.

3. In the Modules tab of the series, click the More options icon of the module you want to archive.

4. Select Archive.

The Archive # published module pop-up is displayed.

5. Click the I understand and accept that once I archive these modules, the learner data and progress can't be restored checkbox.

The Archive button is enabled.

6. Click Archive.

You will receive a notification once the module is archived successfully.

7. To access it again, click Modules on the left navigation bar.

The Modules page is displayed.

8. Click the Archived tab to view the archived modules.

Analytics for archived modules are available at the individual module level. It cannot be accessed from series-level analytics. To view analytics of the archived module, apply the Archived filter in Module Analytics or use the Reporting API.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Archive modules > Archive multiple modules:
1. On the admin site homepage, click Training on the left navigation pane and select Series.

The Series page is displayed.

2. Click on a series to open.

3. In the Modules tab of the series, click the checkboxes of the modules you want to archive.

Note:

- You can select up to 50 modules to archive at once.
- When archiving multiple modules, it is recommended that you perform the action in batches of 50 modules each. Ensure that the subsequent batch is scheduled for archival at a sufficient time interval (at least 10 minutes) from the previous batch.
- If you plan to archive a large number of modules by successively selecting 50 modules in batches of 3 or more, notify Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
- Taking these measures ensures that the platform’s performance is not impacted and is well monitored.

4. Click Archive in the bulk action tray that appears at the bottom of the screen.

The Archive # published module pop-up is displayed.

5. Click the I understand and accept that once I archive these modules, the learner data and progress can't be restored checkbox.

The Archive button is enabled.

6. Click Archive.

Note:

- You can archive only published modules. If the selection is a combination of draft and published modules, by default, only the published modules are selected for archival.
- The option to archive multiple modules is enabled only after you accept the terms and conditions.

The System feedback icon displays the progress and completion status.

You can track the status of the action in System feedback. For more information, see System feedback overview.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series > Retrieve archived modules:
You can retrieve a module from the Archived page by creating a new copy. The copy will be treated as a new module. The learners’ progress and analytics data for the module are reset.

Note: You cannot retrieve multiple archived modules in bulk.

To retrieve an archived module:

1. Click Modules on the left navigation bar.

The Modules page is displayed.

2. Click the Archived tab to view the archived modules.

3. Click the More options icon on the module you want to retrieve and click the Copy as draft.

The Copy as draft pop-up screen is displayed.

3. In Module name, enter a name for the copied module. By default, the module's name has _copy suffixed to the name of the original module.

4. In Add to series, select a series to copy the module.

5. In Add to section, select the section in the series to add the module.

Note: If there are no sections in the series, this drop-down is not displayed.

6. Click Create copy.

The archived module is copied to the selected series in the Draft state.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups:
This article provides an overview of the Group to module linking feature in Automation links.

Using this feature, you can link a group to one or more modules, so the group members are automatically assigned to the linked modules. Once linked, all users added to the group in the future are also assigned to the linked modules automatically.

While linking to a module, you can also choose to perform the following:

- Invite existing users in the group to the module.
- Define module relevance for the users invited to the module.
- Set a due date for group members invited to the module.
- Remove users from the linked module when they are removed from the group.

You can also unlink the group from the linked modules.

This article further explains how you can view linked/unlinked modules, link or unlink a group with modules, perform mixed bulk operations, and view the performance and engagement data of the group in the linked modules.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > View linked/unlinked modules:
1. Sign in to the admin site .
2. On the left navigation bar, click Account and select Automation suite . By default, the Automation rules tab is displayed.
3. Click the Automation links tab.
4. On the Automation links page, in the Linked modules column, click the Add icon or the number for a group to view and manage its linked or unlinked modules. Note: The Add icon indicates no modules have been linked to the group yet. The number indicates the number of modules linked to the group.
5. The group panel that appears displays a list of linked and unlinked modules. If the module is already linked to the group, the toggle switch in the Link status column is turned on. To find a module, use the following options provided at the top to refine your search:

6. Turn the Show only linked modules toggle ON to show only the linked modules in the list. This option is useful when managing just the linked modules for a group.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Link to modules and invite group members > Link to an individual module:
To link a group to an individual module and invite the group members to the module:

1. Turn the toggle switch on in the Link status column. The following pop-up is displayed. Based on your requirement, select the options in the pop-up to perform the following additional actions:
  1. Define the module relevance to be set for the users invited to the module. By default, it shows the relevance per the module’s settings (for example, Unmarked in the screenshot above). You can set it to Required , Optional , or Unmarked .
  2. In the Set a due date drop-down, select the number of days learners have to complete the module after they are invited, and choose what happens when the due date passes. Note:
    - You cannot select a specific calendar date as the due date.

  3. The due date applies only to learners added to the group in the future. Existing group members keep their current due dates. For more information about setting due dates for group members, see Create a course .
  4. Select the Yes, invite existing group members to the module checkbox if you want to invite the existing group members to the module, with the module relevance selected in this pop-up. Note:

Unlinking a module from a group does not remove or uninvite the group's users from the module. After a module is unlinked from a group, any users added to the group in the future will not automatically be invited to the module.

You can unlink modules individually and in bulk.

Individually: You can unlink modules individually using the toggle switch in the Link status column.

To unlink the group from a module:

- Turn the toggle switch off for the module. If you unlink, any users added to the group in the future will not get invited to the module automatically.

Once unlinked, the toggle switch is turned off .

In Bulk: You can unlink multiple modules in bulk using the bulk action tray.

To unlink a group from one or more modules:

1. Select the modules and click the Unlink now button. Note : You can unlink up to 30 modules in bulk at a time. If more than 30 modules are selected, the Unlink now button is disabled.
2. In the confirmation prompt that appears, click Unlink now . Once unlinked, any users added to the group in the future will not be automatically invited to the unlinked modules.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Mixed bulk operations:
Automation links allow you to perform several operations simultaneously on multiple modules. For instance, for one of your groups, you want to link it to some modules, unlink it from others, and invite existing group members to the modules where they are not.

In this case, you can perform the following operations on multiple modules, as shown in the image below:

- Link now: This does not affect the existing links. Once you click Link now and the pop-up appears, the workflow is the same as linking to an individual module. Perform Steps 2-5 in the link to an individual module section.
- Unlink now: Unlinks only the linked modules that are selected.
- Invite existing users: This option will also set your selected module relevance in the Module relevance column.

Note: This option does not impact the links where existing users are already invited.

In the above example, you can simultaneously use the buttons from the bulk action tray to perform the three operations on the respective modules. Alternatively, you can use the options in the Link status column to perform each operation individually.
