chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Admin:
You can group similar calls in libraries to easily access best practices for a particular topic. For example, if you want all your best demo calls grouped for others to learn from, create a ‘Demo Calls’ library and crowdsource recordings by allowing users to add recordings to that library. You can also add a call to multiple libraries.

When sharing call libraries, you have two options to control access:

- Everyone (public) : This option allows all users to access the library without needing an invitation from admins. These libraries make sharing calls with all users easier for the admin.
- Selected users (scoped) : Only selected users and user groups can access the library. Admins must add users and user groups to these libraries.

Admins can invite individual users or link user groups to the library. When adding users individually, admins can select users from the user list. When linking user groups, users who are part of any related groups automatically get access to the library. Linked user groups automate user addition and removal based on their group membership.

Note: User groups can be created and managed via automation rules.

For backward compatibility, Call AI converts all existing libraries to scoped libraries. Admins can choose to convert them into public libraries as per their requirements.

Note: The old library workflow is being deprecated, and all users have transitioned to the new library workflow.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Admin > Create library > Share library access:
The Share access option is available only for scoped libraries (since public libraries are shared with everyone by default). Admins can share the library access by inviting individual users or user groups.

Click Share access and select Individual users or User groups.

For Individual users, the Share access to individual users pop-up displays the list of all the call participants.

Select the required users and click Share.

You can search for users by name and email ID in the Search users field.

For users already added to the call, the checkbox to select the user is disabled.

For User groups, the Share access to user groups pop-up displays the list of all the user groups.

Select the required user groups and click Share.

You can search for users by their name in the Search groups field.

The checkbox to select the user group is disabled for calls already shared with a user group.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Admin > Create:
1. On the Admin Site Homepage.

2. Click the Account Settings > Settings > Call AI> Themes.

3. On the Themes page, click the Add new theme button in the top-right corner.

4. On the pop-up that appears, fill in the following details:

- Theme Title : Add a title to showcase a proof point, essential topic or use case.
- Description : Add a description to convey information on what the theme is all about.
- Keywords of Theme : Add keywords or phrases relevant to the theme and help analyze the theme’s occurrence in calls.

For example, you can set the Theme Title to Pricing, the Description to List keywords that denote pricing discussed on calls, and Keywords to Ballpark Price, Discount, Budget, Charge, and Cost. See the pdf attached with the article for sample themes and keywords.

5. Click the Create button to proceed.

Once created, the theme appears on the Themes Setup page. Alternatively, you can find the theme using the search bar. You can view the following information for a theme:

- Name of the theme
- Number of recordings
- Number of keywords associated with the theme
- Date of creation of the theme
- Option to enable the theme as a key themes for voice of market analytics

Theme Name

Click a theme name to view its details. On the pop-up that appears, click Edit if you want to make changes in the theme title, description and keywords of the theme.

Number of Recordings

Click No. of Recordings for a theme to view a list of all the recordings associated with the theme.

Sort Recordings

To make the recording list more readable, you can sort them by:

- Newest First
- Oldest First
- Scorecard: High to Low
- Scorecard: Low to High

Filter Recordings

To view a specific list of recordings, you can apply the following filters to display only relevant recordings and hide the rest:

- Participant : Apply this filter to view call recordings of specific participants.
- Account : Apply this filter to gain insights on a specific account.
- Themes : Apply this filter to view recordings from a particular theme.
- Date : Apply this filter to view recordings from a specific timeline or a custom date range.
- More Filters : Apply filters using the CRM (Customer Relationship Management) objects. For example, use the Opportunity Probability filter to analyze calls that quantify the likelihood of winning an opportunity.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Admin > Key Themes for Voice of Market Analytics:
A key theme is a business-critical theme that helps managers derive insights by comparing its keywords’ mentions. For example, if the ‘Live Session’ keyword in the ‘Use Cases’ theme is mentioned often during calls with a prospect. It indicates that the prospect wants to develop a virtual Instructor-Led Training (ILT) program or outsource it.

This insight helps:

- Pitch the virtual training feature more efficiently and effectively
- Get to in-market prospects before the competitors
- Reach the prospects when it matters the most

It is advisable to select up to 3 key themes to make it easy for the managers to analyze and make faster product and sales decisions.

For example, you can choose MEDDIC (Metrics, Economic buyer, Decision criteria, Decision process, Identify pain and Champion) as a key theme. MEDDIC is the most renowned sales methodology for Enterprise B2B (Business-to-Business) sales.

It helps in:

- Increased revenue
- Accurate forecast
- Short sales cycle
- Fast deal assessment

To view the definition of key themes, hover over the Info icon.

To enable the key themes for the Voice of Market analytics:

- Decide up to 3 business-critical themes from the list and turn on their Toggle Switch .
- Click the Save changes button to proceed.

Site Owners and enablement admins can access manager analytics on the admin site.

In the admin site sidebar, click Analytics > Users and roles > Manager to open the manager reports listing page. The manager report page includes two main tabs:

- Hierarchy based reports : Analytics for managers defined in your Mindtickle hierarchy.
- Relationship field based reports : Analytics for managers defined through relationship fields.

The Hierarchy based reports tab is displayed by default.

Note: If hierarchy is not set up, only the Relationship field based reports tab will appear.

If relationship fields are also not set up, only site owners will be listed as managers, since they have all roles and permissions by default.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Managers > Introduction:
The Hierarchy-based reports tab offers performance and engagement analytics for managers included in the user hierarchy set up in Mindtickle. You can view data for all managers—those with teams and those without—and drill down into specific manager reports.

To use this feature, make sure you have set up a user-to-user hierarchy for your learning Site. Contact Mindtickle Support for assistance with the hierarchy setup.

The Hierarchy-based reports tab displays all hierarchical managers assigned to various series. It includes information such as:

- Manager level: The manager's position in the hierarchy.
- Number of learners: How many learners report to the manager.
- Scoring performance and % completion: Learners’ progress under each manager.

Use the following features to explore the data:

- Search by manager name: Locate a specific manager quickly.
- Manager level filter: Use the drop-down to filter by hierarchy level.
- Column sorting: Sort any column to customize the display.
- Export hierarchy: Email a CSV report of all managers shown.
- Export report : Export the report data in CSV format.

Click a manager’s name to access detailed analytics for their teams and all learners reporting directly or indirectly to them.

The report includes two tabs that present different views of learner performance.

Team's analytics

This tab provides a consolidated view of all teams reporting to the selected manager. It includes two tables:

- Teams: Managers who lead their own teams.
- Direct reports who don’t have teams: Individual contributors directly reporting to the selected manager.

To view the performance of direct reports without teams, scroll to the bottom of the report page. Their data appears only in the Individual’s analytics tab.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Managers > Team's analytics > 1. Overview:
The Overview tab shows the number of teams reporting to the selected manager, along with their average completion and score percentages.

It displays two tables:

- Teams: Managers with their own teams.
- Direct reports who don’t have teams: Individual contributors reporting directly to the selected manager. Their performance data appears only in the Individual’s analytics tab.

Each table includes key metrics in columns such as:

- Filtered learners
- % completion
- % score
- Modules overdue
- Total certifications

Hover over the information icon in the column headers for definitions of each metric.

The Filtered learners column shows the number of learners that match the applied filters.

Available actions

You can interact with the report table using the following actions:

- Sort: Click the Sort table by button to sort by any visible column.
- Search: Use the search box to find a specific manager by name.
- Customize metrics: Click the Customize columns button to select which metrics appear in the table. See the section below for details.
- Export: Export the report data in CSV format. For details, see this section .

Customize column metrics

To configure which column metrics appear in the report:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Managers > Team's analytics > 4. Series certifications:
The Series certifications tab provides analytics on certification data for all series assigned to team members. It offers visibility into the number of certificates awarded, assigned, and expired across all learners reporting to the selected manager.

Note: The Series certifications tab lists certificate details only if at least one learner in the series has been awarded the certificate or has an expired certificate. Certificates will not appear if no learners in the series meet these criteria.

Top stats

At the top of the tab, you’ll see the following summary metrics:

- Teams: Total number of teams (managers) reporting to the selected manager.
- Certificates assigned: Number of certificates assigned to learners across their assigned series.
- Awarded certificates: Number of certificates learners have earned by meeting certification criteria.
- Expired certificates: Number of certificates that are no longer valid.

Table data

The main table in this tab includes the following columns:

- Certification name: Name of the certificate configured in the respective series.
- Series: The associated series for each certificate.
- Certified: Number of learners currently holding a valid certificate.
- Expired: Number of learners whose certificates have expired.

Use the search bar to find a specific certificate and click any column header to sort the data.

Individual certificate data

Click on a certificate to open a detailed pop-up showing individual learner data across two tabs:

Certified tab:

- Learners: Names of learners with valid certificates.
- Certification date: Date when each learner was awarded the certificate.

You can sort columns or search by learner name. Up to 200 learners are shown; export is available for complete data.

- All learners: Includes learners reporting directly and indirectly to the manager.
- Only direct reports: Includes only learners who report directly to the manager.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Managers > Introduction:
Prerequisite: To view and use relationship field based reports, ensure that you have defined managers using relationship fields for your learning site. To learn more, contact Mindtickle Support.

The Relationship field based reports tab in Manager reports provides insights on managers defined through relationship fields. This tab displays all relationship field based managers assigned to the series. It includes data on:

- Number of learners: Learners reporting to the manager.
- % Score: Average score across assigned modules.
- % Completion: Completion rate of assigned modules.

You can sort by any column to customize the view. Use the Search by manager name field to find a specific manager. Click a manager’s name to see detailed analytics for their reporting learners.

The report includes two main tabs, offering different perspectives on learner performance.

Team members

This tab displays a report of all learners reporting to the selected manager.

Heatmap

This tab provides a visual overview of learner performance for a specific manager. You can view statistics either by learner vs. module or learner vs. series.

Click a learner’s name to open a side panel showing their engagement across all modules and access their overall report.

Series certifications

This tab provides analytics on certification data for all series assigned to team members. It offers visibility into the number of certificates awarded, assigned, and expired across all learners reporting to the selected manager.

Filters

You can filter the report to narrow down the data based on different criteria.

- Modules assigned during: Filter based on when modules were assigned.
- Series invited to: Filter based on the series learners were invited to.
- Learner fields and more filters: Apply filters by profile fields, manager, module type, group, and more.

The Relationship field based reports tab in Manager reports provides insights on managers defined through relationship fields. This tab displays all relationship field based managers assigned to the series. It includes data on:

- Number of learners: Learners reporting to the manager.
- % Score: Average score across assigned modules.
- % Completion: Completion rate of assigned modules.

You can sort by any column to customize the view. Use the Search by manager name field to find a specific manager. Click a manager’s name to see detailed analytics for their reporting learners.

The report includes two main tabs, offering different perspectives on learner performance.

Team members

This tab displays a report of all learners reporting to the selected manager.

Heatmap

This tab provides a visual overview of learner performance for a specific manager. You can view statistics either by learner vs. module or learner vs. series.

Click a learner’s name to open a side panel showing their engagement across all modules and access their overall report.

Series certifications

This tab provides analytics on certification data for all series assigned to team members. It offers visibility into the number of certificates awarded, assigned, and expired across all learners reporting to the selected manager.

Filters

You can filter the report to narrow down the data based on different criteria.

- Modules assigned during: Filter based on when modules were assigned.
- Series invited to: Filter based on the series learners were invited to.
- Learner fields and more filters: Apply filters by profile fields, manager, module type, group, and more.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Managers > 1. Team members:
The Team members tab in relationship field based reports displays performance data for all learners reporting to a specific manager.

This tab provides detailed metrics and tools to help managers track learner performance. The available options include:

- Filters: Apply various filters to customize the data shown.
- Data last updated on: Shows the last update time for the performance data.

The summary section below the filters displays high-level insights:

- Number of learners: Total learners reporting to the manager.
- % Participation: Percentage of modules started out of those assigned.
- % Completion: Aggregated module progress for all learners.
- % Score: Aggregated module score for all learners.

Search and table view

To find a specific learner, type their name in the search box and press Enter.

The data table includes the following columns:

- Learners
- Modules
- % Completion
- % Score
- Certifications

Table actions and insights

- Sort: Click the sort icon in any column header to sort in ascending or descending order.
- % Completion: Shows the learner’s total module progress.
- Module progress: Hover over the progress bar to see detailed stats. Colors represent progress levels—refer to the legend above the table.
- Modules overdue: Hover over the overdue icon to view the number of pending modules.
- % Score: Displays the learner’s average score. Use the dropdown in the column header to switch between percentage and absolute score. Scores are color-coded (red, orange, green) as per the legend above the table.
- Certifications: Shows certificates earned. For example, “80% (4/5)” means 4 out of 5 certificates earned, with 80% certification achieved.

Export report

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Managers > 2. Heatmap tab:
The Heatmap tab in relationship field based reports provides a comprehensive view of performance data for all learners reporting to a specific manager.

The heatmap tab includes two sub-tabs that present learner performance in different formats:

- Learner vs module: Displays metrics for learners across all modules assigned to them.
- Learner vs series: Displays metrics for learners across all series they are invited to.

Each sub-tab offers the same structure and features, with data specific to either modules or series. The remainder of this article explains features based on the Learner vs module view—these features are also applicable to the Learner vs series tab.

Available options

- Filters: Apply filters to narrow down the heatmap data. Note : You can select up to 60 filter values when applying filters to heatmaps.
- Data last updated on: Displays the last time the data was refreshed.
- Export report: Click the export icon to download the heatmap data in CSV format. The report will be sent to the email address provided in the export pop-up.

Heatmap metrics

Use the View by dropdown to choose the performance metric to display in the heatmap. Available options include:

- By % scores: Displays learners' aggregated scores across modules as percentages.
- By absolute scores: Displays the total score achieved by learners out of the maximum possible score across modules.
- By % completion: Displays learners' overall progress as a percentage across modules.

Additional filters for metrics

- Certifications: For score-based metrics, a certificate icon appears in the module column if the learner has earned a certificate.
- Overdues: For the % completion metric, an overdue icon appears in the module column if a learner has any pending modules.

Additional filters for metrics - Certifications: For score-based metrics, a certificate icon appears in the module column if the learner has earned a certificate. - Overdues: For the % completion metric, an overdue icon appears in the module column if a learner has any pending modules.

The first row in the heatmap shows aggregated values for each column, followed by individual learner data in the rows below.

Module filters and sorting

You can adjust which modules appear in the heatmap and how they’re sorted:

- Module selection filter: Use the No module selected dropdown to choose one or more modules to display in the heatmap.
- Module sort: Use the By recently active dropdown to sort modules by recent activity, or alphabetically (A–Z or Z–A).

Note: On the Learner vs series tab, these filters apply to series instead of modules.

Learner filters and sorting

You can also customize the list of learners shown in the heatmap:

- Learner selection filter: Use the No learners selected dropdown to choose which learners to include in the heatmap.
- Learner sort: Use the By highest score dropdown to sort learners by highest or lowest score, highest or lowest completion, or alphabetically (A–Z or Z–A).

Assessment pass and fail data

You can view pass and fail data specifically for assessment modules in the Learner vs module tab. This helps track learners who have passed or failed completed assessments.

- Applicability: This feature applies only to assessment modules.
- Icon display: If a learner has not completed the assessment, no pass/fail icon is shown.
- How to view: Use the Show pass/fail option in the View by dropdown while viewing by % score or % completion .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Managers > 3. Series certifications:
The Series certifications tab provides analytics on certification data for all series assigned to team members. It offers visibility into the number of certificates awarded, assigned, and expired across all learners reporting to the selected manager.

Note: The Series certifications tab lists certificate details only if at least one learner in the series has been awarded the certificate or has an expired certificate. Certificates will not appear if no learners in the series meet these criteria.

Top stats

At the top of the tab, you’ll see the following summary metrics:

- Certificates assigned: Number of certificates assigned to learners across their assigned series.
- Awarded certificates: Number of certificates learners have earned by meeting certification criteria.
- Expired certificates: Number of certificates that are no longer valid.

Table data

The main table in this tab includes the following columns:

- Certification name: Name of the certificate configured in the respective series.
- Series: The associated series for each certificate.
- Certified: Number of learners currently holding a valid certificate.
- Expired: Number of learners whose certificates have expired.

Use the search bar to find a specific certificate and click any column header to sort the data.

Individual certificate data

Click on a certificate to open a detailed pop-up showing individual learner data across two tabs:

Certified tab:

- Learners: Names of learners with valid certificates.
- Certification date: Date when each learner was awarded the certificate.

You can sort columns or search by learner name. Up to 200 learners are shown; export is available for complete data.

Expired tab:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics:
Team analytics in the Mindtickle learning site provides insights for managers into the performance and engagement of their learners across the platform.

Team analytics provides the following analytics reports:

- My analytics
  - Bookmarked
  - Shared with me
- Hierarchy reports
- Relationship based reports
- Call AI (Adoption, Conversation Stats, Call Score, Talk Track, and Voice of Market)
- Coaching
  - Reviewers
- Readiness Index

For details on the roles and permissions required to access Team analytics on the learning site, see this article.

Tip: In addition to the analytics and reports under Team analytics, managers can also access the Command Center from the learning site homepage. For details, see this article.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics > Access team analytics:
Managers can access their team’s report from the learning site as follows:

1. On the learning site homepage, click Team analytics in the left sidebar (navigation panel). The My analytics page → Bookmarked reports open as the landing page of Team Analytics. It lists all reports you have bookmarked for yourself.

1. Under My analytics page, click Shared with me to view reports and dashboards that others have shared with you.
2. Depending on whether you are a manager through hierarchy or only through relationship fields, the following manager reports are available in the Team analytics section of the sidebar:
  - Hierarchy based reports: If you are a hierarchical manager, then this report opens for you and displays hierarchy-based analytics of your team .
  - Relationship based reports: If you are not part of the learning site hierarchy and your direct reports are defined through relationship fields, then this report opens for you and displays relationship field based analytics.

1. Click My analytics → Call AI to access Call AI analytics reports: Adoption reports , Conversation Stats , Call Score , Talk Track , and Voice of Market .
2. Click Coaching → Reviewers to access the coaching sessions reviewer reports (or coaching reviewer reports). These reports provide provide reviewer analytics on coaching sessions, enabling efficient tracking and top-down visibility of coaching initiatives. For details, see this article.
3. Click Readiness Index to access the Readiness Index. The Readiness Index (RI) is a unified metric that, by quantifying the capabilities of sales reps, measures their readiness to achieve business outcomes. For details, see this article.

The Hierarchy reports report provides analytics for managers that are part of the hierarchy set up in Mindtickle. The report provides the performance and engagement data of your teams (managers reporting to you and their teams) and direct reports (individual contributors). You can drill-down to see anyone reporting to you directly or indirectly.

The report contains two tabs:

- Teams Analytics: This tab displays the rolled-up report of all teams reporting to the selected manager. Learn more about the Teams Analytics tab.
- Individual’s Analytics: This tab displays all Learners reporting directly or indirectly to the selected manager. You can select one of the following options in this view:
  - Only Direct Reports: Individuals reporting directly to the selected manager.
  - All Learners: All Learners reporting directly and indirectly to the selected manager.

Learn more about the Individual's Analytics tab.

The following image shows the Overview tab of the Teams Analytics report for Senior Manager Winston Morales. It lists all managers (of teams) and individual contributors who are reporting to Winston, in two tables:

- Teams: The first table lists managers who have a team of their own.
- Direct reports without teams: The second table lists Winston's direct reports who do not have a team of their own. In other words, they are individual contributors.

Direct reports without teams: Scroll down on the report page to view Winston's direct reports who do not have a team of their own. Their performance data is not provided in the Teams Analytics tab. Click the link to view their data in the Individual's Analytics tab.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics > Apply filters:
Filter the report based on the recency of the assigned Modules (Modules Assigned During), Series, Modules, and Learner Fields. Additional filters in More Filters allow you to include specific individuals based on their Group, Module Relevance, Module Type, and Assigned By, which allows you to select whether to consider Admin-assigned Series, self-assigned Series, or both. The filters are applied to the report data on the Teams Analytics and Individual’s Analytics tabs simultaneously.

Click View All Applied Filters to view all the applied filters’ values and remove specific filters, if needed. Click Reset Filters to reset all filters.

Note: You can select up to 60 filter values when applying filters to heatmaps.

In Team analytics → Relationship based reports, the Heatmap tab displays comprehensive heatmap reports of all Learners reporting to a particular manager. To learn about the Team Members tab in relationship field based reports, see Team analytics → Relationship based reports → Team Members Tab.

- Learner vs Module: Displays metrics of Learners across all Modules that they are assigned.
- Learner vs Series: Displays metrics of Learners across all Series that they are invited to.

- Filters: You can filter the report using various filters.Note: You can select up to 60 filter values when applying filters to heatmaps.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics:
The Bookmark functionality in Team analytics in your learning site provides you quick and easy access to specific reports that you as Senior Managers want to refer to in the future.

Using this functionality, you can bookmark reports for yourself. You can even bookmark a custom report that will save the selections that you make before bookmarking, such as applied filters, customized column metrics, and selected tabs.

Using the Bookmarked Reports option on the left panel, you can access all your bookmarked reports: whether bookmarked by yourself or bookmarked by others (Admin) for you.

This article explains:

- Bookmark any report: How to bookmark a report for yourself
- View bookmarked reports: How to access your bookmarked reports

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics > Bookmark any report:
This section explains how to bookmark a report for yourself so that you can refer to it anytime:

1. On the learning site homepage, click Team analytics in the sidebar. Reports are available to you depending on whether you are a Manager through organizational hierarchy or through relationship fields.

1. Open the Manager Analytics report (hierarchy reports or relationship based reports) that you want to bookmark, select the appropriate filters and customizations, and click Bookmark in the upper-right corner.
2. Click Bookmark this report for me in the pop-up.

1. Enter an appropriate name for the report and a note (of less than 100 characters) that will help you know the context of the report later. Then click Confirm. The report is bookmarked.
2. The Bookmark button updates to indicate the report is successfully bookmarked.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Learning content:
All content in Mindtickle is created and organized into series and modules. As a learner, you may be invited to participate in specific modules or an entire series. There may also be public Series you can access based on your needs.

Series: A series represents an enablement program, such as onboarding, product updates, and selling skills. A series is made up of various types of modules.

Module: A module is made up of learning activities and content within Mindtickle. Modules are organized within a Series. A module is always a part of a series.

Note: The modules that are available to you depend on your organization’s implementation of the Mindtickle platform.

For information on the types of modules, see Types of modules in Mindtickle.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Default and custom homepages:
The learning site homepage is made of various interactive widgets that provide personalized and contextual access to learning site content that is most relevant and important for you. Adaptive nature of widgets ensure that the most relevant content is easily highlighted and discoverable to boost adoption, engagement, and completion of the content.

In addition to the default homepage, you may have access to one or more custom homepages if configured by the admin. The default homepage is visible to all learners and, therefore, it is always available. Additionally, you may also see one or more custom homepages — only if your admin has configured a custom page to which you have access.

Your admin controls the visibility settings for each custom page so that only the relevant learners have access to the custom page and its content. If the admin has set the custom page's visibility to all learners, it will be visible to you. If the admin has set the page visibility by groups, it will be visible to you only if you are part of the group associated with the page. Through groups associated with the custom page, your admin has full control over which learners have access to the custom page. They can remove one or more learners' access as required.

Custom homepages provide targeted and relevant content as configured by the admin. Custom pages help a specific set of learners in discovering most relevant and important content in a straightforward way. Custom pages appear as tabs and in the order defined by the admin. You can see up to 5 custom pages.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Homepage widgets:
Your learning site homepages (default homepage and custom homepages) displays the following widgets based on the series and modules you have been invited to and your progress.

Important:

- You may not see all of the following widgets. A particular widget is visible to you only if your admin has added it to the homepage and you have access to the content configured in the widget.
- In addition to the 22 standard (general + series) widgets, 10 Asset Hub widgets and 2 Call AI widgets listed below are available only if you have purchased these products. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) for further information.

Here is a list of homepage widgets:

GENERAL WIDGETS

1. Text: Displays textual content and links. It can also include a linked button if configured by your admin.
2. Image: Displays content in the form of an image that provides context about the content linked in the button. The widget button may be linked to a URL link or to Mindtickle content (series, module, hub, or asset) — depending on how your admin configured the widget.
3. Video: Displayed video content. It may be an online video that is embedded or a video uploaded by the admin.
4. Featured resources: Links to useful internal and external files, folders, and videos collated by the admin.
5. Custom HTML and CSS: Displays content configured through HTML and CSS code.
6. Spotlight: Displays specific content or announcements that is noteworthy.
7. Recent achievements: Displays new certificates and badges earned by you and the increase in your knowledge score.
8. Overall progress: Your overall progress: completed modules vs. assigned modules.

SERIES WIDGETS

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Homepage widgets:
1. Featured themes: Displays various themes across your site. Each theme in the widget showcases thematically linked content. Themes are essentially tags applied to modules that can be across multiple series. The widget displays these tags as theme tiles.
2. Required: Modules that the admin has assigned to you, with module relevance set to "Required". These modules are mandatory for completion and are sorted by the most recently assigned first.
3. Urgent: Modules that are due soon for you or have recently turned overdue. A module will show up in this widget 15 days before the due date and 7 days past the due date; after that it's removed from the widget. Sorted by most urgent overdue first.
4. Showcased: Showcases (highlights) personalized and dynamic training content (series and modules). The series/modules are configured by your admin, either picked manually from a list or automatically based on filters.
5. Upcoming ILTs: You can view all of your live and upcoming instructor-led training (ILT) sessions directly on the homepage and take various actions. The widget acts like a calendar and provides a centralized view for your ILT sessions without having to locate them in series and modules.
6. Continue: Modules that you have started but not completed yet. Sorted by recently accessed first.
7. Trending: Most popular modules in the last 30 days, based on the number of times they were accessed by you. Sorted by modules with most views first.
8. Take action: Displays missions and assessments across all series that you have completed but failed (could not meet the passing criteria). The widget displays these modules only if reattempt is enabled by the admin and only for assigned modules, not public modules.The widget is displayed to you only if they have failed a mission or assessment and need to reattempt it. It lists the modules in this sort order: last completed module first. You can click on a module in the widget to go to the module and reattempt it.
9. Pinned series: All series pinned by you.
10. What’s new in public: Newly released or updated public series and modules. Sorted by recently-published first.
11. What’s new in assigned: Newly assigned or updated modules and series in the last 30 days. Sorted by recently-assigned first.Note: A newly-assigned series will be listed in this widget only if you are assigned at least 3 modules of the series or the complete series. In other cases, instead of the series, the widget will list the individual modules of the series.
12. Top-rated series: This widget displays the top 10 highly-rated Series in descending order of their average ratings. It also displays the average rating and the number of user ratings each Series has received.Note: Only those Series that have an average rating of 4 or more stars qualify as top-rated Series and are displayed in this widget.
13. Top-rated modules (beta): Displays the top 20 highly-rated modules (Course, Quick-Update and Assessment) in descending order of their average ratings. Only those modules with a minimum of 10 ratings qualify as top rated modules and are displayed in this widget. Note: Module rating and feedback is a beta feature. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) to enable it for your site.
14. Explore by series: Displays the last 10 public and assigned series. Sorted by recently accessed OR alphabetically if you haven't accessed any series.

- View sessions by status: all sessions or sessions where you are not enrolled, enrolled, or waitlisted.

Note: All sessions are shown in your current system timezone.

- Only the series assigned to the you
- Only your public series
- Specific series: one or more series selected by the admin

Depending on your admin’s configuration, the widget will be available anywhere at the center of the page or in the right sidebar. Further, you may see multiple ILT session widgets if your admin has configured more than one widgets.

The widget shows all live and upcoming sessions for you for the current month in a scrollable list. You can:

- View sessions by status: all sessions or sessions where you are not enrolled, enrolled, or waitlisted.

You can click on a session to view its details and take various actions (depending on your enrollment status), such as open the ILT module to which the session belongs, join the session or copy the link (for video conferencing sessions), enroll/unenroll from the session, and join/leave the waitlist.

Featured themes

The Featured themes widget displays a selection of themes across your site, with each theme showcasing thematically related content. Themes are tags applied to modules that can appear across multiple series. These tags are shown as theme tiles in the widget. You can view a maximum of 20 themes, arranged in the order configured by your admin. A theme will only appear if you have access to at least one module that has the theme tag applied. Access to a module is granted if it is assigned to you or is a public module.

Click on a theme to access the modules tagged with the theme. Clicking on a theme will take you to one of the following pages, depending on your admin’s configuration:

- Standalone series page: This page lists all series that contain at least module tagged with the selected theme. Click on any series to access the tagged modules. The page lists assigned series sorted by assigned date, followed by non-assigned series sorted by creation date.
- Standalone modules page: This page lists all modules tagged with the selected theme. The page lists assigned and self-started modules sorted by added date, followed by non-assigned and non-started modules sorted by name.

Continue

Displays all your Assigned or Public modules that are In Progress. Modules are sorted based on most recently accessed. This widget also displays the % completion of your assigned Modules. Click a Module to quickly resume your progress.

Displays Modules and Series assigned by the admin in the last 30 days. The Module and Series tiles display labels with the number of updates since it was assigned to you. Both Modules and Series are sorted by “most recently assigned first” sequence in this widget.

Note:

- A newly-assigned Series will be listed in this widget only if you are assigned at least 3 Modules of the Series or the complete Series. In other cases, instead of the Series, the widget will list the individual Modules of the Series.

Trending

Displays 20 Modules most accessed by all Learners across the platform. The widget considers Modules that Learners have access to, and are assigned by the Admin or subscribed by the Learner from Public Series.

Each view for a Module by the Learner is considered for the view count. For example, if the Learner views a particular Course five times, all five instances are counted in this Module’s view count. Modules are listed by the total number of views, in the order of most to least viewed.The modules listed in this widget can be completed, not completed, or public modules. Therefore, a module appearing in the Required widget may also appear in this widget if its views are higher.

Note: This widget does not include Coaching Sessions and ILTs.

Displays the last 10 Series you recently accessed.

Recent achievements

This is the first widget on the right. It displays your achievements in the last 30 days: new certificates and badges earned and the knowledge score gain.

Here’s what you can do in this widget:

1. Certificates and badges: Lists the certificates and badges you have earned in the last 30 days. Hover over the certificate for the option to download the certificate in a PNG format to your computer.

Overall progress

This widget displays your overall progress. The widget is displayed only when at least one module is assigned to you.

Learners can view the following types of module progress data using the dropdown menu in the widget:

- Assigned modules: Only modules and series that are assigned to you by the admin.
- Required modules: Showcasing the learner’s progress data on required modules will help drive completion rates on modules marked as required.
- All modules: Includes the following:
- Modules/series assigned to you by the admin
- Modules from subscribed public series
- Modules from self-initiated public series

By default, the widget displays your overall progress for the assigned modules. You can use the dropdown menu to view data for the required or all modules.

You can use the dropdown menu to view data for the required or all modules.

Note: If you would like to set required modules as the widget default (instead of assigned modules) for your learning site, please contact Mindtickle Support.

Click the drop-down and select All modules to check your overall progress that is based on a combination of your assigned modules, subscribed modules from public series, and self-initiated modules from public series.

Click the Complete or Incomplete links opens the Modules page. The Modules page has two tabs: All Modules and Assigned. Depending on which link you click in the widget, you are automatically redirected to the respective tab on the Modules page.

For example, if you select Assigned modules in the dropdown and click the Incomplete link, you are taken to the Modules page under Training. On the Modules page, the Assigned tab opens with the Status filter applied to list only those modules that are in progress and not started.

Note: If you open a completed mirrored module from the Overall progress widget, the system opens it from the assigned series. The navigation displays only the assigned series name.

In “You’re ranked in the percentile in your team”, you can view your rank within your team. It indicates how you compare with your peers.

The rank is a calculation of the percentile rank of users based on the following:

[All modules completed] / [Total number of modules available]

Note: The rank information will not be visible if it was hidden by your admin to comply with local jurisdiction rules.

Top-rated series

Displays the top-rated Series (public, assigned, subscribed and scoped public) in the descending order of their average Series rating. Only Series with an average rating of 4.0 stars or more qualify as top-rated Series and are displayed in this widget.

The widget also displays the average rating and the number of user ratings for each Series. The number of user ratings on a Series is equal to the number of Learners that have rated the Series.

This widget appears on a learner's homepage only if:

- The Admin has configured it for their learning site.
- The Learner has access to one or more Series whose average Series rating is 4.0 or higher.

- If multiple Series have the same average rating and the same number of user ratings, then such Series are arranged and displayed in alphabetical order.

Click on any Series on the widget to access it. From the Series page that appears, you can start exploring the content and rate it at any given point in time.

Top-rated modules

Displays the top rated modules (Course, Quick-Update, and Assessment) in the descending order of their average module rating.

For a module to display in the widget:

Knowledge Score, or KScore, is used to measure your progress. Every 100 points you score in any Module, earns you one Knowledge Score.

Your learning site always shows your total KScore in the navigation bar. You can see your KScore in the top-right corner, next to the profile icon.

You can also compare your KScore with your peers. To compare KScore, hover over the KScore icon, and then click the Compare it with peers link. This link is available only if Peers is enabled for your Learning Site.

To learn more, refer to Module Score and Knowledge Score (KScore) Overview.

Profile has the following options:

- My profile and analytics
- Sign out

My profile and analytics

The learner profile and analytics page has three tabs:

- Overview: Your profile information.
- Scorecard: Your Readiness Index (RI) scorecard analytics. Note: The Scorecard tab is displayed only if your admin has enabled scorecard analytics for learners.
- Settings : Configure your profile settings. Note : The Settings tab is available only if the following two conditions are met:
  - Notification digest is enabled for your learning site.
  - Your admin has configured notification digest settings such that you can choose your preferred digest frequency.

Overview

This tab displays your profile information.

On this tab, you can:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Profile:
Settings

From this tab, you can configure your profile settings such as set up the notification digest frequency.

Note: The Settings tab is available only if the following two conditions are met:

- Notification digest is enabled for your learning site.
- Your admin has configured notification digest settings such that you can choose your preferred digest frequency.

Set up notification digest frequency

A notification digest provides a high-level summary of a learner’s assigned content and learning progress during a specified time interval. For example, if the specified time interval is a week, the notification digest includes information about the series and modules the learner is invited to and the modules the learner has completed during the week. It also includes information about the modules that are still pending completion by the learner. It acts as a recap and is sent as an email to the learner’s registered email address at regular intervals. Thus providing a concise and organized overview of the information. The frequency of the notification digest can vary, ranging from weekly to biweekly or monthly.

Note: A notification digest is not a replacement for the individual email notifications sent to a learner. If enabled, it merely provides a quick summary of the learner’s assigned content and learning progress made during a specified time interval designed to enhance learner engagement.

If your admin has allowed learners to set up their preferred digest frequency, you can do so from this tab. To set up your preferred digest frequency:

- The digest is sent to your registered email address on Tuesday between 11 AM to 2 PM in your timezone (as per the timezone setup in your profile).
- If you have not configured the timezone in your profile, the digest is sent to your registered email address on Tuesday between 11 AM and 2 PM GMT.
- If (for any reason) the digest preparation for some learners is not completed by 2 PM, the system attempts to send the digest by no later than 5 PM.
- If the digest frequency is set to weekly , the digest is sent on Tuesday, considering your data from last week’s Monday to the current week’s Sunday.
- If the digest frequency is set to biweekly , the digest is sent on Tuesday, considering your data from Monday 2 weeks back to the current week’s Sunday.
- If the digest frequency is set to monthly, the digest is sent on the first Tuesday of the month, considering your data from the first Monday of the last month to the first Sunday of the current month.

Use this to sign out of the learning site.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series:
Bulk actions on modules in a series allow admins to perform various actions on multiple modules within a series. This helps admins and enablement program creators to create, structure, and launch global enablement programs easily.

In a series, you can now perform the following actions on multiple modules:

- Copy: Create independent (draft) copies of multiple modules in multiple series simultaneously.
- Mirror: Make the same modules available in multiple series simultaneously (multi-present). Mirroring is the same as making a module multi-present.
- Move: Move selected modules from one (source) series to another (destination) series.
- Archive: Archive published modules that are no longer relevant to the learners.
- Publish: Publish multiple modules in the series simultaneously.
- Invite learners: Invite learners to the selected modules.
- Schedule invitations: Schedule an invite for learners to the selected modules.
- Delete: Delete the selected modules.

You can also track the progress and view information for these actions in System feedback. To learn more, see System feedback overview.

For detailed information on each bulk action, see the following articles:

- Copy multiple modules
- Mirror multiple modules
- Move multiple modules
- Archive multiple modules
- Publish multiple modules
- Invite learners
- Schedule invitations
- Delete multiple modules

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Notifications:
The Notifications feature provides detailed information on the status and outcome of actions performed by you (admins). You can track the progress and view information for all your actions. It is beneficial for long-running actions for which progress visibility and tracking are very helpful.

Note: The Notifications feature is available only if the bulk module actions and bulk asset actions (assets) are enabled for your learning site.

Notifications keeps you continuously informed about an action’s progress and outcome. Because you can track an ongoing action anytime, you no longer need to stay on the page from where you performed the action.

When you perform an action, Notifications provides the following:

- Immediate acknowledgment that the action has started
- Continuous status of the action while it is in progress
- The outcome of the action when it completes

You can also view details of all the actions performed by you.

Note: Currently, the Notifications feature is available only for the following three bulk actions for modules and bulk asset actions for assets that you can perform on multiple Modules from within a Series or multiple assets within a hub.

Modules:

- Copy : Make multiple (draft) independent copies of Modules in multiple Series simultaneously.
- Mirror : Make the same Modules available in multiple Series simultaneously (multi-presence). Mirroring is the same as making a Module multi-present.
- Publish : Publish multiple Modules in a Series simultaneously.

Assets:

- Mirror: Make the same assets available in multiple hubs simultaneously.
- Move: Move the asset from one hub to another.
- Edit properties: Make edits to the properties of multiple assets in one go.
- Archive: Archive the selected assets if the assets reach their expiry date and are no longer needed.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Notifications > Tooltip > Actions in the tooltip:
The tooltip provides status and quick information on initiated and ongoing actions as follows:

- Initiated actions : This tooltip appears when you initiate an action. It provides you the option to cancel the action within 5 seconds. If you cancel the action, the countdown stops and asks for your confirmation to cancel the action. If you do not cancel it, the platform starts performing the action.
- In-progress actions : This tooltip appears when an action is in progress.

When you have performed multiple actions simultaneously, the tooltips for these are added one after the other.

All tooltips display the estimated time to complete an action. When an action is in progress, click Hide to hide the tooltip. The tooltip disappears as soon as an action completes.

You can view the detailed status of all actions (in progress and completed) in the Notifications drawer.

The Notifications drawer (panel) lists all actions you perform and maintains a history of them. The list is sorted in reverse-chronological order — the latest actions first. Each action shows the date and time when the action was performed and the estimated time to complete the action.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Series:
Within a series, you can perform bulk actions on modules, including publishing multiple draft modules. You can publish multiple modules in a series simultaneously.

Note:

- You can only publish the draft modules that have no pending to-dos.
- You can select draft modules from one series only.
- You cannot select draft modules from multiple series.

From a series, you can publish multiple modules simultaneously (bulk publish) as follows:

1. Sign in to the admin site.

2. On the left navigation panel, click Training and select Series.

The Series page is displayed.

3. Click the series with the Draft modules.

4. Select the checkboxes of the Draft modules you want to publish. If the series has sections, expand the section and select the modules individually.

5. Click Publish in the quick access panel that appears at the bottom.

The Publish # draft modules pop-up is displayed.

6. If there are modules with pending to-dos, complete the to-dos by clicking the Go to module button next to each module where it is displayed.

Once you complete its to-dos, you can publish the module from the module or the series pages.

The modules with no pending tasks are highlighted as No pending to-dos.

7. Click the Publish # modules with no to-dos button.

8. Choose the learners you want to invite to the modules. Click the drop-down list to select the available options.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Reference > About mirrored/multi-present modules:
Multi-present modules allow the same module to be available in multiple series simultaneously by mirroring it from one series to another. Any changes made to the original or mirrored module—except reminders—will be reflected across all its instances. Reminders can be configured separately for each module.

Note: Invitations for a multi-present module function the same as for a regular module. When a user completes a multi-present module in one series, their progress is automatically marked as Complete in all other instances—provided they are already invited or are invited in the future.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Analytics & Reporting > Reference > View analytics for a mirrored module:
1. In the admin site sidebar, click Analytics > Training > Modules to open the module reports listing page. This page displays all available module reports.
2. Use the search bar or apply filters to find the module that appears in multiple series. A multi-present module will appear multiple times in the list — once for each series in which it is included. The name of the module’s series is shown below the module name ( highlighted in blue ).
3. Click the module from the list. The module’s analytics page will open.
4. On the Learners tab, a Series filter appears specifically for multi-present modules. This filter lists all series in which the module is available through multi-presence.
5. In the Series filter drop-down, select one or more series to view analytics accordingly. You can choose to view analytics for a specific series or combined data across multiple series.

Note: If a learner is part of multiple selected series, they are listed only once in the module analytics data.

The same Series filter and functionality is also available in the Content tab of the module’s analytics page.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups:
In Mindtickle, a user’s account is created and associated with a username (email address). The username authenticates the user while logging into the platform, associates, stores all data and progress to the account, and receives various communications, such as notifications and reminders.

With the Replace username feature, admins can change a user’s username directly in the platform. When using this feature, the user’s data, state, and progress in the existing or previous account are retained and transferred to the new account associated with the new username.

If a username already exists, you cannot replace it. For example, if you want to replace the username James with an existing username Smith, the system will not let you. You should delete or rename the existing username, James, to a different username before replacing it.

For information on different scenarios for replacing a user’s username, including when a user has more than one active Mindtickle account, see Replace username FAQs.

Note:

- Replacing a user’s username does not delete the existing user.
- The user’s state is retained even after the username has been replaced. For example, if a user was in Deactivated state, they will continue to be in Deactivated state even after replacing their username.
- This action will replace the usernames on all the learning sites in an organization where users are present.

This feature is helpful when a Mindtickle user within your organization has an update to their username or ends up with two usernames for various reasons, such as changes to their name, division, or region.

Note:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > User Management > Users and Groups > Replace username manually:
You can replace an individual username or multiple usernames in bulk.

1. Click the checkboxes of one or more users whose usernames you want to replace.

Note:

- You can replace the usernames of up to 100 users at once.
- If the selected users include deactivated users, confirm whether to remove the deactivated users and proceed or proceed with them.

2. At the bottom of the screen, click the More icon and select Replace usernames.

The Replace username pop-up is displayed.

3. In New username, enter each user's new username. From now on, users should use their respective new usernames to log into Mindtickle and consume content.

4. Click the Show rows with errors only toggle to display only those user rows with an error.

Note:

- When you select multiple users for username replacement, the new username you enter for a user must not belong to any existing users. The User already exists error message is displayed.
- If an error is displayed, delete or update the username before replacing it. For example, if you want to replace James with an existing username, Smith. You should delete or rename the existing username, James, to a different username before replacing it.

5. Click the Replace # usernames button to proceed.

The following note is displayed:

- Once usernames are replaced, users will be signed out of all devices and asked to re-authenticate with their new usernames.
- This change may take some time to reflect on the platform.

6. Click Cancel to go back or click Replace to start replacing the usernames for the selected users.

This article explains how skipping content in a course or a quick update impacts a learner’s overall score.

Skipping content does not impact module completion but impacts the learner's score.

If a learner attempts content that is skippable, the score for that content is added to the overall score of the module.

If a learner skips learning content, they receive minimum points for opening the content. The following prompt alerts the learner that they are skipping the content:

However, if a learner skips a question or a poll, they receive 0 points. The following prompt alerts the learner that they are skipping the poll or question:

Note:

- If you have sequentially locked the content, learners can still skip the content. The learner’s progress is marked complete once they finish all the content.
- Learners receive minimum points for skipping learning content and 0 points for skipping polls and questions.
- Skip is not available for Embedded Mission content.

The Mindtickle mobile app sends various notifications to your phone to keep you up-to-date on content invitations, progress and reminders, and much more. You can view and respond to notifications from your phone's lock screen or through the Notification Centre (iOS) or Notification Drawer (Android).

The following type of notifications are displayed on your phone through the Mindtickle mobile app:

- New content (Series and module invitations)
- Content progress status and reminders
- Mission/Coaching Sessions review assigned
- Mission/Coaching Sessions review reminder
- Mission/Coaching Sessions review completed
- Coaching Sessions schedule (invitation)
- Coaching Sessions review approved/disapproved
- Announcements

Note: Notifications are displayed in the language you select for your learning site. To learn how to change the language settings, see How do I change my learning site language?

The notification from your mobile app displays the type of notification, module name, module type, and due date (if enabled by your admin).

Tap and hold a notification to expand it, see its description, and perform quick actions such as:

- Start Course or Quick-Update
- View Checklist, ILT, Coaching Sessions, or Assessment
- Record a Mission
- Go to Challenge for a Quest

Note: Actions displayed in an expanded view are different for each module.

Tap a notification to directly open the series or module in the Mindtickle mobile app.

On the Mindtickle app, you can view all of your notifications as follows:

Tap the bell icon in the upper-right corner to view all module and task related notifications on the app. The bell icon displays a badge with the total number of unread notifications. A notification is marked as read only when you tap on it.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started:
All content in Mindtickle is created and organized into series and modules. As a learner, you may be invited to participate in specific modules or an entire series. There may also be public series you can access based on your needs.

Series: A series represents an enablement program, such as onboarding, product updates, and selling skills. A series is made up of various types of modules.

Module: A module includes learning activities and content within Mindtickle. Modules are organized within a series. A module is always a part of a series.

Note: The available modules depend on your organization’s implementation of the Mindtickle platform.

The following are the types of modules in Mindtickle:

- Course: Used for in-depth training. Courses consist of multiple topics, a visual theme, and knowledge check questions and may include certification.
- Quick-update: Used to share important updates or announcements. It consists of bite-sized content and may include knowledge check questions to support your learning.
- Assessment: Used to assess your knowledge. It consists of multiple questions and may include certification.
- Checklist: Used to assign Tasks. Consists of a list of tasks that you need to complete on-the-job or offline.
- ILT (Instructor-led Training): Used for conducting classroom or webinar sessions. Classroom sessions are held in person, and webinar sessions are held virtually.
- Mission: Used to practice your skills based on various parameters decided by your manager or organization. Consists of roleplay exercises.
- Coaching sessions: Used to conduct coaching on an ongoing basis and provide data-driven insights for each Learner’s performance. Consists of coaching meetings with your manager or coach.
- Quest (Spaced reinforcement): Used to improve knowledge retention using an intelligent and adaptive system. Consists of short, personalized, and gamified challenges that are delivered to you automatically at spaced intervals.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App:
This article provides an overview of the Mindtickle mobile app. The mobile app is for learners and reviewers, who can access the Mindtickle platform via our app for iOS and Android.

In other words, the Mindtickle is supported on both types of mobile devices — phones and tablets — that are running on iOS and Android. For information on the mobile app requirements, see Supported browsers, devices, and screen sizes.

Note: Mindtickle supports mobile device management (MDM) for the Mindtickle app. However, we support only app installation and updates via MDM; we do not support any other MDM capabilities, such as auto-login.

The mobile app provides information in the following tabs:

- Home
- Series
- Assets
- Coaching
- Mission
- Call AI
- Performance
- Files
- Profile

Note: The following tabs are available to you only if you have purchased a license for the : Assets, Coaching, Mission, and Call AI.

Language support for the Mindtickle app:

- The language setting on the web does not affect language settings on the mobile for learners accessing the mobile app.
- While signing in to the mobile app, the mobile app will use the language set in the mobile device. The sign-in pages will display all information in your device language.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Home:
The Home tab displays your learning site homepage and it is made of various interactive widgets that provide personalized and contextual access to content that is most relevant and important for you. Adaptive nature of widgets ensure that the most relevant content is easily highlighted and discoverable to boost adoption, engagement, and completion of the content.

Here you can access your learning site homepages: the default homepage and custom homepages. The default homepage is visible to all learners and, therefore, it is always available. Additionally, you may also see one or more custom homepages — only if your admin has created a custom page to which you have access. Your admin defines the visibility of a custom homepage based on groups.

You can switch between your custom homepages in the following ways:

- Click the dropdown menu next to the page name and tap on any custom page from the More pages list.
- Use the arrow buttons to quickly switch between the pages.

Note: The above options to switch between pages appear only if you have access to at least one custom homepage. If you do not have access to any custom pages or the admin has not created custom pages, you will only see the default homepage.

Custom homepages provide targeted and relevant content as configured by the admin. Custom pages help a specific set of learners in discovering most relevant and important content in a straightforward way. You can view up to 5 custom pages.

Command center for managers

If the Command center for managers is enabled for your Mindtickle instance, it appears as a page at the end of the list. For details, see this article.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Home widgets > Trending:
Displays the 20 modules most accessed by all learners across the platform. The widget considers modules that learners have access to, and are assigned by the admin or subscribed by the learner from public series. Modules here are sorted by the "number of views" sequence in this widget.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Home widgets > Top-Rated Series:
Displays the top-rated series (public, assigned, subscribed, and scoped public) in the descending order of their average series rating. Only series with an average rating of 4.0 stars or more qualify as top-rated series and are displayed in this widget.

It also displays the average rating and the number of user ratings for each series. The number of user ratings on a series is equal to the number of learners that have rated the series.

This widget appears on a learner’s home page only if:

- The admin has enabled it for their learning site.
- The learner has access to one or more series whose average series rating is 4.0 or higher.

Note:

- If multiple series have the same average rating, then the series with a higher number of user ratings is displayed first.
- If multiple series have the same average rating and the same number of user ratings, then such series are arranged and displayed in alphabetical order.

Tap on any series in the widget to access it. From the series page that appears, you can start exploring the content and rate it.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Performance:
On the Performance tab, you can access your overall progress and performance data. It displays the following:

- Knowledge score (KScore) you achieve by completing admin-assigned or publicly available modules.
- Your overall progress for assigned modules under Module Participation Summary .

In “You’re ranked in the X percentile in your team”, you can view your rank within your team. It indicates how you compare with your peers.

The rank is a calculation of the percentile rank of users based on the following:

[All modules completed] / [Total number of modules available]

Note: The rank information will not be visible if it was hidden by your admin to comply with local jurisdiction rules.

Module Participation Summary

This section displays your overall progress and performance for assigned modules. You can view the following types of module progress data using the options at the top:

- All modules: Includes the following:
  - Modules/series assigned to you by the admin
  - Modules from subscribed public series
  - Modules from self-initiated public series
- Assigned modules: Only modules and series that are assigned to you by the admin.
- Required modules: Showcasing the learner’s progress data on required modules will help drive completion rates on modules marked as required.

Click the Complete or Incomplete links under each option to open the module listing page, which has two tabs: All and Assigned. For example, if you click the Incomplete link, you are taken to the module listing page, with the following filters applied automatically to display appropriate data:

- Completion Status: Displays only those modules that are in progress ( Active ) and not started ( Added ).
- Relevance: Displays only required modules.

You can view the appropriate data in each tab: All and Assigned.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Search:
From any page on the app, tap theSearch icon in the upper-right corner to search for series, modules, assets, and files.

As you start typing, the app displays the top two results from each section (Assets, Series, Modules, and Files). You must enter a minimum three characters for search to display auto-suggestions. To see all results on the search results page, tap the Search key on the keyboard.

For your search term, letters, special characters, file extensions, and emojis are supported. You can also search for text in another supported language. However, you may not get the best results for emojis because of emoji conversion incompatibility across devices.

For the entered search term, the search functionality looks for information in the names and descriptions. You can search for:

- Assets by asset name, description, and properties.
- Series by series name and description.
- Modules by module name and description. For Courses, you can also search for the module by the topic name.
- Files by file name.

The search result page shows results in five sections: Top Results, Assets, Series, Modules, and Files. Each section shows top results in descending order in terms of relevance, with most relevant results appearing first. Use the (filter) button to filter the results by one or more tags. On the Top Results section, tap on a section name or the "See all" link to see all results in that section. You can also click the name of any section at the top to view their results.

Search results also display the following information:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > User Sync:
Previously, when a user’s Okta email was changed or updated, we created a new user for the updated email in Mindtickle. This resulted in two users in Mindtickle belonging to the same Okta user. In this case, the Okta user would start syncing with the newly-created user in Mindtickle.

For example: Okta user a@abc.com is syncing with their corresponding Mindtickle account a@abc.com.

- Okta user a@abc.com changes to b@abc.com. Mindtickle creates a new user b@abc.com.
- Okta user b@abc.com starts syncing with b@abc.com in Mindtickle.
- The progression data from the Mindtickle user a@abc.com is not synced with Mindtickle user b@abc.com.

Now, our Okta integration will use the “Replace Email ID” functionality in the background to automatically update the email of the corresponding Mindtickle user whenever their email is updated in Okta. So that there will always be one Mindtickle user account for an Okta user.

However, there are scenarios where an Okta user already has two Mindtickle accounts; this is because earlier Mindtickle created a new user whenever an Okta user’s email was updated. In one particular scenario (described below), one of the Mindtickle accounts is permanently deleted. To understand better, consider the following scenarios:

Scenario A: One Okta + One Mindtickle account

In this scenario, whenever a user’s Okta email changes, their Mindtickle email is updated automatically. You need not take any action.

For example, Okta user a@abc.com changes to b@abc.com (for the first time). In this case, their corresponding Mindtickle account a@abc.com automatically changes to b@abc.com.

Scenario B: One Okta + Two Mindtickle accounts >> Okta email is updated again

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > User Sync:
In this scenario, a user’s Okta email had changed previously (that is, before the January 2021 release) so they already have two Mindtickle accounts:

User1: a@abc.com

User2: b@abc.com (syncing with Okta)

Now, after the January 2021 release, their Okta email changes again. In this case:

- If the Okta email is new: If the Okta email changes to c@abc.com, then we will simply change the email of User2 to c@abc.com. In this case no Mindtickle account will be deleted.
- If the Okta email is previously used: If the Okta email changes to a@abc.com (which it was previously), then we will change the email of User2 to a@abc.com. And the other account (User1) is deleted and all of its data and progress are purged; this is because we can’t keep two user accounts with the same email.

Note: For the deleted Mindtickle account, data cannot be retrieved because the account is permanently deleted.

Note: Mindtickle or Okta cannot track (and so, wouldn’t know) if multiple user accounts belong to the same user.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup:
As an admin, you can:

- Use Mindtickle conditions to create user or role-based rules within Mindtickle. You can create rules based on modules, groups, profile fields, or roles to automate either of the following processes:
  - Invite a user to a module or a series
  - Add a user to a group
  - Assign a role to a user
- Use Salesforce conditions to create opportunity-based rules in Salesforce (SFDC).

You can create SFDC opportunity-based rules based on the opportunity deal stage, industry, revenue, product fields, competition, or any available fields of the opportunity to automate asset recommendation to reps in the flow of work.

Notes:

- The feature to create opportunity-based rules is available only upon request. Contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM) for more details.
- You can create SFDC opportunity rules for all opportunity fields (standard and custom) configured in your Salesforce account. By default, rules can be created for the following opportunity attributes:
  - Account Industry, Account Number of Employees, Account Name, Description, Name, Owner Email, Stage, Type, Amount, Probability, Created At, Last Updated At.
- When configuring rules based on the learner’s role condition, you can create rules for standard and custom roles set up in your org.
- To add custom attributes and for more information on custom mapping of fields, contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

This article explains how to create, view, activate, deactivate, and delete rules. It also explains how to create a rule that is similar to an existing rule.

Note: This article explains the process of creating profile-based rules from the Automation Rules interface. For more information on how to create profile-based rules from the Profile Management interface, see Create a new rule in Profile fields.
