Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Content Center > Upload content:
Click Content Center in the left navigation bar to access the Content Center.

Initially, the Content Center is empty. Click the New button for options to upload files and folders.

The New button is always available in the Content Center header. It lets you add new content (files, folders, and embed links) using the following options:

1. Create new folders : Use the Create folder option to create a new folder on the Content Center homepage or within any existing folder to organize your content.
2. Upload files : Use the Add file option to upload one or more files from your computer or external storage providers such as Google Drive, OneDrive, Salesforce, Box, and Dropbox.
3. Upload folders : Use the Add folder option to upload one or more folders from your computer or external storage providers such as Google Drive, OneDrive, Salesforce, Box, and Dropbox.
4. Embed external content : Use the Embed link option to add externally hosted content (like YouTube videos or Google Docs) as learning objects using a link or embed code. You'll need to copy the shareable link or embed code from the source platform. You can embed the content inline using an iframe or set it to open in a new browser tab.

Continue reading for details on each of the four options.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Content Center > Upload content > D. Embed external content:
1. Get the embed code/link : Obtain the embed code or link from the source platform (like YouTube, Google Docs). Important : Mindtickle strongly recommends using the embed code if available, as it ensures more reliable embedding than a plain link.
2. Use it on Content Center : On Content Center, go to New > Embed link and paste the embed code or link to add the content. Click Embed once done.
  - Under Link settings , choose how the content opens for learners. The two options are mutually exclusive: you can select one, but not both.
    - Insert iframe tag : Embeds the content inline within Mindtickle. Use this option if the source link does not already contain iframe tags. This is the default behavior for embedded links.
    - Open in a new tab : Opens the link in a new browser tab instead of embedding it inline. Use this option for sites that block iframe embedding (such as LinkedIn, external LMS platforms, or secure dashboards), where inline embedding would otherwise show a "Refused to connect" error. This option is unavailable when Insert iframe tag is enabled or when the link is invalid.
  - Note : For a plain link that is not embeddable, select Open in a new tab . Such links cannot render within the file details page container, so opening them in a new tab ensures learners can access the content.
  - The Preview reflects your selection. For an iframe link, it shows the rendered content. For a link that opens in a new tab, it shows a placeholder screen with the destination URL, a Copy link option, and an Open button.
  - In the Name field, provide an appropriate name for the embed link.

Note:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Content Center > Upload content > D. Embed external content > Prerequisites for embedding:
The following prerequisites apply when you embed content inline using an iframe:

- Use embed code/link — not a regular URL : Only use the specific embed code or embed link provided by the platform. A regular web URL (e.g., https://docs.google.com/...) will not embed properly and may result in errors. Note : If you select Open in a new tab instead, a regular web URL is supported, as the content opens directly in a new tab rather than being embedded.
- Make the content publicly accessible : The content must be available to view without restrictions. For example, with Google Docs, Slides, or Sheets, you need to publish the content to the web: go to File → Share → Publish to web → Embed. This generates a proper embed code for use in Content Center. You can also adjust sharing settings to "Anyone with the link can view" if publishing isn't an option.

Tip: Refer to the host platform's help documentation for steps on generating embed codes or adjusting visibility settings.

Once uploaded, you can reuse the embedded content files across the Mindtickle platform — as assets and as learning objects in courses and quick updates.

The image below shows how embedded content is displayed when opened.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Content Center > Search, filters, and sort:
After adding files and folders to the Content Center, you can easily find content using search, filters, and sort options.

Filters

Filters include: Hubs, Series, Modules, File type, Created by, Tags, and Synced from. For example, use the Synced from filter to view files and folders synced from external sources like AEM, Google Shared Drive, and SharePoint.

Within Hubs, Series, and Modules filters, the "Hide files used in selected hubs/series/modules" toggle is available. Enabling this toggle inverts the filter logic to display Content Center files that are NOT currently used in the selected hubs/series/modules. This helps admins quickly identify unused files, helping them ensure all relevant files are utilized appropriately.

Sort

Sorting is available by the Name and Last modified columns. By default, files and folders are sorted by Last modified, with the most recent files and folders first.

Search

Use the search box to easily run a search across Content Center.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Content Center > Folder actions:
You can access folder actions in two ways:

- Click the More button next to the folder in the list view, or
- Click the More button in the header after opening the folder.

Note: You must have Manage Content permission to edit a folder. If you see the View only icon next to a folder, you do not have edit access. Site owners can manage the content of all files and folders in the Content Center by default.

You can take the following actions on a folder:

- Rename : Change the folder name.
- Get info : View the number of files and subfolders within the folder, parent hierarchy, folder creation date, creator name, last modified date, modifier name, and folder collaborators.

- Move : Shift the folder from one place to another within Content Center. Select the destination from the list of existing folders on the pop-up that appears or create a new folder. Note: While moving a folder, you cannot select a destination folder where you do not have the Manage Content permission. For more information, see Content Center Permission.
- Add Collaborators: Include an existing user or add a new user as a collaborator to the folder. When the collaborator is added to the folder, they have the Manage Content permission to all the files and subfolders within the folder.
- Manage Collaborators: Modify access of existing collaborators of the folder or provide access to all current and future users with Manage Content permission to the folder. For more information about the default collaborators in a folder, see Content Center Permission.
- Delete: Once deleted, you cannot undo the action. Delete or move all the files within before deleting the folder. You need the Manage Content permission to delete the folder.

- Rename : Change the name of the file. Note : Renaming a file in the Content Center changes the file's name in the learning object of a module. Additionally, please note that two files cannot have the same name in the Content Center.
- Download : Save the file to your local machine.
- Get info : View the file type, size, parent folder hierarchy, folder creation date, creator name, last modified date, modifier name, and file collaborators.
- Move : Shift a file from one place to another within the Content Center. Select the destination folder from the list or create a new folder on the pop-up that appears. Note : While moving a file, you cannot select a destination folder where you do not have the Manage Content permission. For more information, see Content Center Permission .
- Add collaborators : Include an existing user or add a new user as a collaborator to the file.
- Manage collaborators : Modify access of existing collaborators of the file or provide access to all current and future users with Manage Content permission to the file. For more information about the default collaborators in a folder, see Content Center Permission .
- Delete : Once deleted, you cannot undo the action. Remove the file from all the draft or published modules and assets before deleting it. You need the Manage Content permission to delete a file.
- Set as template : Designate the file as a template so that reps can personalize its content using variables (placeholders) when they create customized assets. Setting a file as a template is an explicit action: the file is treated as a template only when you choose this option, even if it already contains placeholder text. After you set the file as a template, you define each variable in the file (such as company name, contact name, or logo) and, where applicable, map it to a CRM field so that reps can auto-fill values from a deal. Note :

chunks.body:
- Rename : Change the name of the file. Note : Renaming a file in the Content Center changes the file's name in the learning object of a module. Additionally, please note that two files cannot have the same name in the Content Center.
- Download : Save the file to your local machine.
- Get info : View the file type, size, parent folder hierarchy, folder creation date, creator name, last modified date, modifier name, and file collaborators.
- Move : Shift a file from one place to another within the Content Center. Select the destination folder from the list or create a new folder on the pop-up that appears. Note : While moving a file, you cannot select a destination folder where you do not have the Manage Content permission. For more information, see Content Center Permission .
- Add collaborators : Include an existing user or add a new user as a collaborator to the file.
- Manage collaborators : Modify access of existing collaborators of the file or provide access to all current and future users with Manage Content permission to the file. For more information about the default collaborators in a folder, see Content Center Permission .
- Delete : Once deleted, you cannot undo the action. Remove the file from all the draft or published modules and assets before deleting it. You need the Manage Content permission to delete a file.
- Set as template : Designate the file as a template so that reps can personalize its content using variables (placeholders) when they create customized assets. Setting a file as a template is an explicit action: the file is treated as a template only when you choose this option, even if it already contains placeholder text. After you set the file as a template, you define each variable in the file (such as company name, contact name, or logo) and, where applicable, map it to a CRM field so that reps can auto-fill values from a deal. Note :
  - Set as template is currently available for PPT files only.
  - You need the Manage Content permission to set a file as a template.
  - For details on defining variables, mapping them to CRM fields, and how reps use templates, see this article .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Content Center > Notifications:
Click the Notifications bell icon to view details of ongoing and past actions you've performed on files and folders. This helps you track what changed, when, and where.

Action details

Click the Action details icon for any entry to view:

- Type of action (e.g., move, delete)
- Date and time of the action
- Number and names of affected files/folders

Content upload and bulk action tracking

The content upload process is asynchronous, and its progress appears in Notifications. As soon as you upload content, you’ll see the upload status in the pop-up in the upper-right corner. Click View all actions to view the list of all recent actions.

When you perform a bulk action (e.g., move, delete, upload), its status also appears in Notifications. This helps you monitor the progress and outcomes of large operations.

Note: You can cancel a bulk action within 5 seconds of starting it.

If a bulk action fails, click the Action details icon and select Failure reasons to troubleshoot.

Common reasons for failure include:

- Moving folders with identical names into the same location
- Deleting folders that contain files or subfolders
- Trying to delete a file that's used in modules or assets
- Insufficient permissions
- Conflicting actions by another admin at the same time

Reviewing these reasons can help you resolve issues before retrying the action.

Bulk upload progress

During bulk uploads, use the Notifications icon to track progress.

In the Action details panel, you'll see:

- All uploaded files
- Any failed uploads (click Show failed only to filter)
- You can also filter by failure type using the All failed items dropdown.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Content Center > Common failures and fixes:
| Failure message | Solution |
| --- | --- |
| Unsupported file format | This error is displayed because the file type is not supported. To resolve the error, upload the supported file. |
| File size limit exceeded | This error is displayed because the file exceeds maximum supported size. To resolve the error, resize and upload the file. |
| Corrupt file | The error is displayed because the file is corrupted. To resolve the error, check and upload the correct source file. |
| Selected file/folder not found | This error is displayed because the folder or file is deleted from the Content Center. Run a search to locate the file/folder or create a new file/folder location. To resolve the error, upload the folders to the new location. |
| Exceed 10 folder levels | This error is displayed because the folder structure limit of 10 sub-folders is breached. To resolve the error, configure the sub-folders to ensure you do not have more than 10 sub-folders and upload the folders. |
| You need permission to perform this action | This error is displayed because you do not have the Manage Content permission. To resolve the error, ensure the Manage Content permissions are correct and upload the file. |
| SCORM package error | This error is displayed due to an issue during SCORM package validation. To resolve this, send the error code to your SCORM package developer to correct the SCORM package. Once corrected, upload the SCORM package in .zip format. |
| File name exceeds 250 characters | This error is displayed because the file name exceeds 250 characters. To resolve the error, rename and upload the file and ensure the file name is within 250 characters. |
| Folder name exceeds 250 characters | This error is displayed because the folder name exceeds 250 characters. To resolve the error, rename and upload the folder to ensure the folder name is within 250 characters. |
| Invalid folder name | This error is displayed because of an invalid folder name. The folder name does not support the characters / and \. To resolve the error, enter a valid folder name and upload the folder. |
| Other | This error is displayed because you may have refreshed the admin site while the bulk upload was in progress. To resolve the error, upload the file and do not refresh the admin site until the upload is complete. |

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs > 1. External meetings:
- External meeting : Meetings must include at least one internal and one external participant. Additionally, the calendar of at least one internal participant must be integrated with Call AI. The host of the meeting can be an internal or external participant.
- Meetings hosted by external participants: Meetings where the host is an external participant and at least one other participant has their calendar integrated with Call AI.
- External meetings hosted by your organization : Meetings where the host is internal, at least one external participant is on the calendar invite list, and at least one internal participant has their calendar integrated with Call AI.
- External meetings hosted by a Call AI user : Meetings where the host is internal, has their calendar integrated with Call AI, and has at least one external participant on the calendar invite list.

2. Internal meetings

- Internal meetings : Meetings where all participants are internal, and at least one participant has a calendar integrated with Call AI.
- Internal meetings hosted by a Call AI user : Meetings where all participants are internal, and the host has their calendar integrated with Call AI.
- All meetings : All meetings are scheduled for a Call AI user with calendar integration, and the user is either invited as a participant or host the meeting.

Note:

1. Participant classification

- Internal participant: A participant whose email domain is listed as internal in the Call AI settings.
- External participant: A participant whose email domain is not listed as internal in the Call AI settings.

2. Meeting categorization based on invite acceptance status

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
Call AI records a meeting even if all participants are internal under the following conditions:

- If your Recording setting in Call AI is Internal or All , Call AI will record all internal meetings.
- If your Recording setting in Call AI is External Inbound or External Outbound :
  - Call recording does not depend on the participants who have joined the call but depends on the calendar invitee list. If you have invited any external user while creating the calendar invite, Call AI will record the meeting.
  - If you use multiple domain names or a different email address than the one registered with the Call AI platform, you will appear as an external user to Call AI. As a result, Call AI will record the meeting even if all participants are internal. Note: To add or register your internal email domains with the Call AI platform, please contact MindTickle Support.
  - If you change the email domain after scheduling a meeting, Call AI will not consider the new change. It will consider the email domain which was present before the change. Hence, Call AI will record the meeting even if all participants are internal.Note: If you change the calendar invite after scheduling a call, Call AI will consider the new change and record the meeting according to the new invite list.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
- If you have the calendar integration enabled but do not have a calendar entry for the meeting, please add a new entry in the calendar with a valid video conferencing URL . This new entry will add the meeting to the Call AI platform, and the bot will join the meeting.
  - If the Recording setting at your organization is “External Outbound or External Inbound,” you must have at least one external email address in your calendar entry.
  - If the Recording setting at your organization is “Internal,” you must have all internal email addresses in your calendar entry.
- If you do not have calendar integration enabled :
  - If you have a designated recording bot in your organization (you can check this with your Admin), you can directly add the bot onto the calendar as a meeting guest.
  - If you do not have a designated recording bot in your organization, you can use one of the techniques from the following section.

For both of the cases mentioned above:

- You have to make sure that you check the option to See guest list in the Google calendar settings so that the bot can read the invites from the calendar event.
- You can view at least two weeks of upcoming meetings under the Upcoming Meetings section, which Call AI will record. You can enable the recording for individual meetings from this section by using the Enable Recording toggle switch.

Note: You can enable the calendar integration and recording for a meeting only if you have a recorder role in Call AI. For more information, see Call AI Permissions.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
Call AI records a meeting even if all participants are internal under the following conditions:

- If your Recording setting in Call AI is Internal or All , Call AI will record all internal meetings.
- If your Recording setting in Call AI is External Inbound or External Outbound :
  - Call recording does not depend on the participants who have joined the call but depends on the calendar invitee list. If you have invited any external user while creating the calendar invite, Call AI will record the meeting.
  - If you use multiple domain names or a different email address than the one registered with the Call AI platform, you will appear as an external user to Call AI. As a result, Call AI will record the meeting even if all participants are internal. Note: To add or register your internal email domains with the Call AI platform, please contact MindTickle Support.
  - If you change the email domain after scheduling a meeting, Call AI will not consider the new change. It will consider the email domain which was present before the change. Hence, Call AI will record the meeting even if all participants are internal.Note: If you change the calendar invite after scheduling a call, Call AI will consider the new change and record the meeting according to the new invite list.

The bot may join a call late under the following conditions:

- You invited the bot or updated the calendar entry within ~5 minutes of the meeting’s start time. It takes ~2 minutes for Call AI to make the bot join your call. Hence, we recommend adding a bot or updating the meeting at least 5 minutes before the expected start time of the meeting.

- There can also be a situation where some internal processes take time to complete, which might have caused the bot to join late. If this happens frequently, please contact MindTickle Support .

If you have a recording license while using Zoom, you can click the Record button during a call. The bot is then automatically pulled into the call. Also, the meeting is fetched by Call AI only if there is a corresponding calendar entry when the Record button is pressed.

The bot joins the call with the same email address each time, causing the meeting to fail from Call AI’s end as Zoom will not allow the bot to join the call.
- If you have the calendar integration enabled but do not have a calendar entry for the meeting, please add a new entry in the calendar with a valid Zoom URL. This new entry will add the meeting to the Call AI platform, and the bot will join the meeting. Note:

- If you have a designated recording bot in your organization (you can check this with your Admin), you can directly add the bot onto the calendar as a meeting guest.
- If you do not have a designated recording bot in your organization, you can use one of the techniques from the following section.

For both of the cases mentioned above:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
You may see two bots in a call under the following conditions:

- If you have scheduled multiple meetings simultaneously with the same meeting ID , let’s say one ends at 10:00 AM, and another starts at 10:00 AM. In this case, the bot for the first meeting remains in the call and the bot for the second meeting also joins the call as it does not understand when the first meeting ends.
- If multiple tenants (users) who use Call AI are in the call , a bot for each user will join the call.
- Suppose you update a calendar invite ~2-4 minutes before a call. Call AI currently does not delete a meeting if it is about to start or is in the process of joining a call. If you make any changes to the Zoom link, Title, or Time within ~2-4 minutes before the expected start time, Call AI creates a new meeting. If you have made changes to the Title or Time, and the Zoom link remains the same, two bots will join the call, provided the new time comes within the current meeting time.

Note: You can enable the calendar integration and recording for a meeting only if you have a recorder role in Call AI. However, you can disable the recording for a meeting if you have a listener, recorder, or admin role. For more information, see Call AI Permissions.

chunks.title: I can't see the bot in the call. Why?

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
- There is no Zoom or Webex URL in the created calendar entry.
- You have not checked the option See guest list in the Google calendar setting. As a result, the bot cannot read the guests of the call.
- You start the meeting before the expected start time mentioned in the calendar invite. Bot usually joins the call within ~0 - 2 minutes before the expected start time of the meeting.
- In Zoom or Webex, users have two kinds of Meeting Rooms:
  - Permanent Meeting Room
    - If the host has enabled the setting to let other users join the meeting room before the host starts the meeting, the bot can also join with the same privileges as Call AI considers the meeting as started. If no participants join the call in the next 10 minutes (at least 1 participant should be present other than the bot), the meeting ends automatically .
    - If the host has not enabled the setting to let others join the meeting room before the host starts the meeting, the bot waits for 30 minutes for the meeting to start, and if it does not start within 30 minutes, the meeting ends automatically .
  - Temporary Meeting Room
    - In this case, if the host did not start the meeting and the bot is in waiting status for the first 30 minutes, the meeting ends automatically.
- The bot has not joined yet but will join the call late. It can happen under the following conditions:
  - You invited the bot or updated the calendar entry within ~5 minutes of the meeting start time. It takes ~2 minutes for Call AI to make the bot join a call. Hence, we recommend that you add a bot or update the meeting at least 5 minutes before the expected start time of the meeting.
  - There may be some issue within the Call AI platform that has caused the bot to restart, but this happened before you have joined the call. Hence, the bot will join the call after the restart process completes.
  - There can also be a situation where some internal processes take time to complete, which might have caused the bot to join late. If this happens frequently, please contact MindTickle Support .
- Suppose the Host or Organizer has kicked the bot out of a current session (happens only in Zoom). No other bots will join the session until you end and start a new meeting with the same URL (in the Personal Meeting Room).
- If a bot has been in a call for 5 hours , the meeting automatically ends in Call AI for that corresponding bot. For now, the maximum time set for which a bot can record a meeting is 5 hours. If any changes are required, please contact MindTickle Support .

chunks.title: I cannot see the transcription or What happens if I am unable to see the transcription?

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
- The wrong transcription happens under the following scenarios :
  - Currently, Call AI recognizes audio for transcriptions with US-English by default. If any other slang is detected, Call AI may not accurately identify it, and the transcription may appear different.
  - Call AI does not transcribe the basic filler words such as Umms, Errs.
  - If the voice is not audible or the voice is significantly low for the system to recognize, transcription may not appear or may be different.
  - If there are background noises along with your sound, which may cause barriers for the transcriptions to be processed completely, they may appear different.
  - If two users are speaking at the same time, transcription for both of them may appear to be together with both the speakers mentioned.
  - Call AI automatically detects the transcription language as per the settings of users participating in that call. If none of the participants have selected any language , they may view transcription in a default language set up by the Admin. If the Admin has not selected anything, then transcriptions would appear in US English. Note: The transcriptions are not translated but transliterated into different languages.
- Incorrect speaker transition happens under the following scenarios:
- The data Call AI gets from Zoom or Webex is used to identify the speaker transition events. If the user details shared between these products are incorrect, the data which Call AI shows will also be inaccurate.
- The data sent by these products depends on your background noise as well. If there is well detectable background noise, Call AI receives the speaker details with the same noise, and hence the speaker detection is affected. It is recommended to keep the background noises at a minimum for the speaker transition to function so that your video conferencing tools share the correct speaker details with Call AI.

Call AI is a Conversational Intelligence platform where you can access all your call recordings and develop your sales effectiveness and efficiency using system-driven insights. It serves as a virtual buddy to your sales conversations by recording, transcribing, and generating AI-based insights from your client and prospect calls.

Note: Call AI is a paid feature. For more information, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > User > Key Features > Integrations:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > User > Key Features > Integrations > Calendar Integration:
Once Call AI is integrated with your Google or Outlook calendar through a simple one-step process, the bot will automatically join your calls.

Once the bot joins the call, it will record, transcribe, and analyze the call and provide statistics and automated insights.

You can save, bookmark, or share these calls with peers through libraries set up by your admin.

For more information, see Call Recording Details.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
You can only share calls with a Call AI user from your Organization. If you want to share a call, you can use the following options:

- Normal User
  - You can use the Share button present inside a recording to share a call.
  - You can add the call to an existing library (only Admins can create a library) with shared access with the user with whom you want to share the recording.
- Admin
  - You can use the Share button present inside a recording or on the main dashboard next to the recording to share a call.
  - You can also create a Library , add the meeting to it and share it with any user. Only Admins have access to create or edit libraries.

- Admin

  - You can also create a Library , add the meeting to it and share it with any user. Only Admins have access to create or edit libraries.

Only Admins can create a Library, but all users can add a recording to a library. You can add a call to a library from the Meeting Recording Page using the Add To Library option.

- Following are the access permissions given to different users:
  - Normal User (Not a Manager) : You can access only your meetings (which you were a part of or invited to), and the meeting shared with you through the Share option or a shared library.
  - Manager : You can access all the meetings mentioned here and the meetings of your team members. If there are multiple team members, you can access all of their meetings. In case of more than two levels of hierarchy, you can access the recordings of only your reportees and not the teams reporting to them.
  - Admin (Manager or Non-Manager) : You can access all the meetings that are present on the Call AI platform.
- You can ask one of the participants of the meeting to share the call with you by using the Share button on the top right corner of the Recording View page.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Manager > Review Sales Conversations and Coach > Identify Overall Team’s Performance:
As managers, you can see key performance metrics and activity data to understand the on-call performance of your team. Use Key filters (including CRM data) to decipher actionable insights.

To drill down your analytics scope, use any of the following filters.

- Date range: By default, the last quarter will be selected as the date range. Click the date range to select another timeline or to select a custom date range.
- Theme: Click the Themes filter and select a specific theme as a part of the drop-down (you can even search) to analyze your data based on the themes selected. For example, select ‘Competitor’ or ‘Pricing’ as a theme to see the data analysis pertaining to keywords within these themes.
- Account Name: Click Account Name to gain insights for a specific account.
- More filters: Click More Filters to use your CRM objects as filters. For example, use the “Opportunity stage” filter to analyze data of calls made in the ‘Discovery’ phase.

For more information, see Call Analytics.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Manager:
This article explains the steps to sign in to Call AI and integrate your calendar as a Manager.

Note: Call AI is a paid feature. For more information, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

1. Depending on your role (listener or recorder), you receive the Sign Up email from your admin. Click the Sign in to Call AI button in the invitation email that you received from your Admin. By default, the manager has a listener role in Call AI.

2. You are redirected to your learning site.

3. Log in to your learning site. For more information, see Sign In to Mindtickle.

4. On the learning site, click Call AI in the left navigation panel to open the Call AI home page.

The Recordings page displays the onboarding workflow.

5. Click Get started to navigate to the Upcoming meetings page.

The Recordings page displays the list of available recordings.

To learn more, refer to Call AI Overview for Managers.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages:
The Page Builder feature allows admins to customize the default learning site homepage, as well as create and customize one or more additional custom homepages meant for specific sets of learners. This article provides an overview of the feature.

Using the Page Builder, you can customize the learning site homepage for web and mobile devices for a more personalized experience for your learners. You can customize the homepage according to your organization's strategy and needs to ensure that learners can quickly find what they need.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Features:
When you customize the learning site homepage using the Page Builder, the platform automatically provides a further personalized dashboard for each learner.

The Page Builder has the following capabilities:

- Add and configure widgets
- Hide or show, rearrange, and delete widgets
- Configure the dynamic widgets . Dynamic widgets are widgets that can be configured with the content of your choice, such as Spotlight , Showcased , Featured resources , and Featured themes .
- Customize for mobile devices: Using the Tablet view and Mobile view buttons at the bottom, you can show or hide widgets on mobile devices. Certain widgets are shown by default, while others are hidden by default, so check whether a widget is shown or hidden and change it as needed. Note: Any changes that you make and publish for mobile devices (phone and tablet) are immediately available on the Mindtickle app (for iOS and Android) automatically; you do not need to update your app. This also applies to the customized or white-labeled app (WLA) .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Overview and common actions > Available widgets:
1. Canvas (beta): Create a custom page section using the all-new Canvas.
2. Text: Create a text widget with options for a heading, links, and formatted text. Additionally, you can add a button to the widget and link it to Mindtickle content (series, module, hub, or asset) or any URL. You can copy and paste existing formatted text and images from elsewhere into the widget. You can add as many Text widgets on the homepage as you like.
3. Image: Add or upload an image with a description. You can add as many Image widgets on the homepage as you like.
4. Video: Embed any online video or upload one directly. You can add as many Video widgets on the homepage as you like.
5. Featured resources: Links to useful internal and external files, folders, and videos collated by the admin. For details, see Add dynamic widgets to learning site homepages .
6. Custom HTML and CSS: Add your own HTML and CSS code to create a custom widget. You can add as many Custom HTML and CSS widgets on the homepage as you like. Note: The Custom HTML and CSS widget may not always render and work properly on the Mindtickle app due to inherent limitations. We recommend that you check and verify the widget on the mobile app yourself after adding it to make sure it works as intended. If it is not working properly, we recommend hiding it from the mobile view.
7. Spotlight: Prominently highlight links to specific content or announcements. For details, see Add dynamic widgets to learning site homepages . Note: This widget needs to be customized with the content of your choice.
8. Overall progress: The learner's overall progress: completed modules vs. assigned modules.
9. Recent achievements: Displays new badges earned by learners and the increase in their knowledge score .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Overview and common actions > Available widgets:
1. Featured themes: Displays themes across your site, with each theme showcasing thematically related content. Themes are tags applied to modules, which can span multiple series, and they appear as theme tiles in the widget. For details, see Add dynamic widgets to learning site homepages .
2. Required: Modules that the admin has assigned to the learner , with module relevance set to "Required." These modules are mandatory for completion and are sorted by most recently assigned first.
3. Urgent: Modules that are due soon for the learner or have recently turned overdue. A module shows up in this widget from 15 days before the due date until 7 days past the due date, after which it is removed from the widget. Sorted by most urgent (most overdue) first.
4. Showcased: Showcase (highlight) personalized and dynamic training content (series and modules) to learners. You can select the series and modules for the widget in two ways: either from a list of all of your series and modules, or by configuring filters based on which series and modules are selected automatically. For details, see Add dynamic widgets to learning site homepages .
5. Upcoming ILTs: Add a calendar view where learners can manage upcoming ILT sessions. Learners can view all of their live and upcoming instructor-led training (ILT) sessions directly on the homepage and take various actions. The widget acts like a calendar and provides a centralized view of the learner's ILT sessions without having to locate them in series and modules.
6. Continue: Modules that the learner has started but not completed yet. Sorted by most recently accessed first.
7. Trending: The most popular modules in the last 30 days, based on the number of times they were accessed by learners. Sorted by modules with the most views first.
8. Take action: Displays missions and assessments across all series that the learner has completed but failed (could not meet the passing criteria). The widget displays these modules only if reattempt is enabled by the admin, and only for assigned modules, not public modules. The widget is displayed to a learner only if they have failed a mission or assessment and need to reattempt it. It lists the modules in this sort order: last completed module first. Learners can click a module in the widget to go to the module and reattempt it. You can add only one Take action widget on the homepage. The widget requires no configuration.
9. Pinned series: All series pinned by the learner.
10. What's new in public: Newly released or updated public series and modules, sorted by most recently published first. Updates are shown at the series level, even if only a single module within the series was updated.
11. What's new in assigned: Newly assigned or updated series and modules, sorted by most recently assigned first.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Overview and common actions > Customize homepage layout:
You can customize the homepage experience in terms of the layout and placement of widgets. You can group widgets in two ways to keep relevant widgets together:

- Group widget rows: Place widgets (up to 3) next to each other within a widget row. The row horizontally occupies the space of a single widget but can contain 3 widgets.
- Create sections: Vertically group multiple widgets or widget rows. Use this to keep related widgets and widget rows together in a section.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Overview and common actions > Customize homepage layout > Widget options:
You can perform the following actions on a widget:

- Add widgets: Click the ( Plus ) button to add one or more widgets. Note: Widgets added to the right column are available only for the web, not for mobile.
- Widget actions: Hover over a widget for the actions available to customize it. The actions available depend on the type of widget. You get one or more of the following actions:
  - Edit: Edit an already configured dynamic widget. Available only for these dynamic widgets: Spotlight and Featured resources .
  - Hide or show: Hide or show any widget.
  - Rearrange: Rearrange widgets vertically within their column using the up and down arrow buttons.
  - Delete: Delete any widget except the following default widgets: Recent achievements , Overall progress , and Explore by series . Important: Proceed with caution; this action cannot be undone.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Overview and common actions > Customize homepage layout > Widget row options:
You can perform the following actions on a widget row:

- Drag (vertically): Drag the row vertically across the canvas. This option is fast but the same as the Move option listed below. Use it to organize the order of rows on the page.
- Move (vertically): Use the up and down arrows to move the row vertically.
- Delete: Delete the row and all of its widgets (including their content and configuration) permanently from the page. If you delete a row from an active and published page, changes reflect to learners when you publish the page again. Important: Proceed with caution; this action cannot be undone.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Overview and common actions > Customize homepage layout > Section options:
You can perform the following actions on a section:

- Drag (vertically): Drag the section vertically across the canvas. This option is fast but the same as the Move option listed below. Use it to organize the order of rows on the page.
- Remove separator line: Remove the gray separator line that appears between two widget rows. Use this option to integrate the rows seamlessly.
- Move (vertically): Use the up and down arrows to move the section vertically.
- Delete: Delete the entire section (including the widget rows and the widgets in each row) permanently from the page. If you delete a section from an active and published page, changes reflect to learners when you publish the page again. Important: Proceed with caution; this action cannot be undone.
- Tooltip: Provides a quick overview of the sections feature.

For further information on the Page Builder for learning site homepages, see the following help articles:

- Create and manage custom homepages for the learning site
- Add and configure widgets for learning site homepages
- Add dynamic widgets to learning site homepages
- Best practices for the Page Builder for learning site homepages

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > Benefits of integration:
Call AI’s integration with Salesforce helps admins to leverage all of Call AI’s functionalities, such as

- Map Call AI recordings with Salesforce standard objects such as Contact, Opportunity, Account, and Lead.
- The fields under these objects are available as filters in Call AI.
- It helps managers and reps view and understand insights on the calls that happened at different sales cycle stages.
- Provides insights to sales and revenue leaders on the following:
  - Theme spoken
  - Call score
  - Questions asked during the call in chronological order
  - Any action items as a follow-up to the call. Call AI creates the list of action items using AI.
  - Talk %
  - Objections raised
  - Longest monologue
- Allows selection of fields to customize the custom object page layout

Note:

- SFDC integration is set up inside your Call AI interface. Contact Mindtickle Support to enable the setting.
- Call AI integration creates a custom object inside your SFDC environment.
- Only newly created SFDC custom objects would have the new structure.
- If you delete an SFDC object from your Salesforce instance, Call AI removes the mapping of that object with the call recordings on the platform. You can no longer filter recordings using that object. It ensures you always get the most accurate recording data on Call AI.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > How Salesforce CRM integration works? > 1-way SFDC Integration:
The 1-way SFDC integration allows Call AI to pull relevant SFDC data into Call AI and associate it with the corresponding recorded meetings. Call AI users can then use these filters to slice and dice the data and analyze it better.

Perform the following steps to enable the 1-way SFDC integration:

1. Log in to the Admin Site Homepage.

2. From the left panel, click Account >Settings> Call AI > Integrations.

3. Click Salesforce > Enable.

You can integrate Call AI with SFDC using an Application Programming Interface (API). Call AI uses an API to integrate with SFDC and requires you to sign in to your SFDC admin account.

4. On the displayed screen, enter your Salesforce admin credentials to log in.

Note: You must have a Salesforce admin account. Mindtickle strongly recommends using a dedicated Salesforce Integration User to perform this integration.

The integration user must have access to the following objects required for the integration:

| Object name | Field name | Access |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Account | All fields | ViewAll |
| Opportunity | All fields | ViewAll |
| Contact | All fields | ViewAll |
| Lead | All fields | ViewAll |
| User | All fields | ViewAll |
| AccountContactRole | All fields | ViewAll |
| OpportunityContactRole | All fields | ViewAll |

For more information on how to create an integration user and grant the required permissions, see Create an Integration User in SFDC.

5. On the displayed pop-up, click Allow.

6. After logging into Salesforce, in the left navigation panel, click Apps > Connected Apps > Connected Apps OAuth Usage.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > How Salesforce CRM integration works? > Configure Call AI Recording Custom Object within an Account/Opportunity:
To configure the Call AI Recording custom object for an Opportunity standard object, follow the steps mentioned below in your Salesforce instance:

Note: You can follow the same steps to configure Call AI Recording custom objects for other standard objects (Account, Lead, and Contact).

1. Click the Setup icon in the upper-right corner of the Opportunity object.
2. Click Edit Object from the dropdown that appears.
3. Navigate to the Object Manager tab and click Page Layout from the left panel.
4. Click the Page Layout Assignment button in the upper-right corner.
5. Navigate to your profile on the table that appears and select a layout to add a Call AI Recording custom object.
6. Click the Related Lists from the left panel and search Call AI Recording using Quick Find .
7. Select and re-order fields to display on the related list and click OK .
8. Drag and drop the Call AI Recording custom object to the Opportunity Sample section and click the Save button in the upper-left corner.

Once configured, you can view the Call AI Recording custom object in the lower-right section of the Opportunity object and the call data for the Opportunity.

Click View All to view a list of all the recorded calls for the opportunity.

Note: It takes approximately 3 - 4 hours for Call AI recordings to appear within SFDC.

On the page that appears, click the name of a recording to view its detailed Call Stats.

Call Stats provides you a complete overview of how your team performs in sales conversations and gives valuable insights into your team’s recording statistics. For more information, see Conversation Stats.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > Create Salesforce activity for the call recording:
In Salesforce, the Call AI data is pushed into Salesforce as part of the 2-way SFDC integration. From the custom object data, admins (if required) can create Salesforce activities from the call recording. These activities help admins generate reports to get insights into the sales rep’s activities and progress.

The process of creating the Salesforce activities is divided into 2 parts:

1. Add fields in the task object: Add the required fields to the task object in Salesforce. This includes fields such as who the task is assigned to, the subject of the task, the due date of the activity, comments, and other relevant details. It is essential to add Call AI as a task type to track the task.

2. Automate the task creation process: Admins can now create a flow to automate the task creation whenever a new record is created in the Call AI custom object. The flow ensures the task-type activity is automatically created whenever a call recording is complete. This process involves mapping details from the custom object to the fields in the task object. For example, the title of the call could be mapped to the subject of the task.

The automated flow within Salesforce picks the mapped values and creates a task-type activity for all new call recordings available in the Call AI custom object.
chunks.body:
In Salesforce, the Call AI data is pushed into Salesforce as part of the 2-way SFDC integration. From the custom object data, admins (if required) can create Salesforce activities from the call recording. These activities help admins generate reports to get insights into the sales rep’s activities and progress.

The process of creating the Salesforce activities is divided into 2 parts:

1. Add fields in the task object: Add the required fields to the task object in Salesforce. This includes fields such as who the task is assigned to, the subject of the task, the due date of the activity, comments, and other relevant details. It is essential to add Call AI as a task type to track the task.

2. Automate the task creation process: Admins can now create a flow to automate the task creation whenever a new record is created in the Call AI custom object. The flow ensures the task-type activity is automatically created whenever a call recording is complete. This process involves mapping details from the custom object to the fields in the task object. For example, the title of the call could be mapped to the subject of the task.

The automated flow within Salesforce picks the mapped values and creates a task-type activity for all new call recordings available in the Call AI custom object.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > How Salesforce Lightning dialer integration works?:
- Salesforce dialer records the call and sends the audio file to Call AI.
- Call AI processes the audio file and makes it available on your Call AI interface.
- Call AI generates useful insights, themes, transcripts, and statistics for the call recording. You can perform different actions such as send private messages, take notes, and share recordings with peers and customers. For more information, see Call Recording Details .

Note:

- Call AI imports only the dialer calls of users with a recorder role. For more information, see Call AI Permissions .
- Call AI displays the phone number of the prospect as the recording name.

- If the name and email address of a participant is not available in the Salesforce dialer recording, Call AI displays the dialer number as the participant’s name. You can edit the participant's name on the recording details page.
- If you delete a recorded call in the Salesforce dialer, the recording is retained in Call AI and can be accessed from the Recordings page. For more information on how to delete the recordings from the Call AI interface, see Delete a Call Recording .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > How Salesforce Lightning dialer integration works? > Recording a call with Salesforce dialer:
1. When you make a call using the Salesforce dialer, click the Record option to record your call. Note : The call recording is listed in Call AI only if you record the call in Salesforce.
2. Once your call ends, the recording appears in the recording list on the Call AI interface approximately within an hour. There might be a delay if there is an issue from Salesforce’s end. In that case, we recommend a wait time of up to 2 hours. You can use Call AI’s powerful and guided search to quickly search for a specific recording. For information about the insights available for a call recording, see Call Recording Details. Note :

- Call AI does not fetch recordings that are less than 10 seconds long.
- Call AI does not import incoming calls on your Salesforce dialer number.
- Call AI does not support Salesforce dialer call transfer and conference.
- Suppose a rep stops and starts recording multiple times during a call, Call AI retains only the first recording..
- Call AI does not capture shared screen in Salesforce dialer recordings.
- Call AI ignores recordings of non-Call AI users.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > How Salesforce Lightning dialer integration works? > Enable auto-recording in Salesforce dialer:
Automatically record calls in the Salesforce dialer using the auto-recordings option.

To enable auto-recording for the Salesforce dialer instance:

1. Click the Setup icon in the upper-right corner of the Account and click Setup .
2. From the left panel, click Feature Settings > Dialer > Recording and Consent .
3. On the Recording and Consent page, switch the Enable Default Recording toggle on.

To enable auto-recording for a particular user:

1. Click the Profile icon in the upper-right corner of the Account and select Settings .
2. From the left panel, click Dialer > Recording Settings.
3. On the Recordings Settings page, check the Record all calls by default checkbox.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages:
Using the Page Builder, you can create custom homepages for the learning site to provide unique, personalized pages to your learners. In addition to the default homepage on the learning site, admins can create and configure one or more additional homepages and set each page’s visibility to a set of learners based on groups or to all learners.

This article provides information on the following actions you can perform in the Page Builder to customize your homepages:

- Add widgets
- Add and configure widgets and the page layout:
  - Widget actions: Hide/show, rearrange, and delete widgets
  - Layout actions: Drag or move a widget row or section vertically. Delete a widget row or section; this will also delete the widgets within.
- Configure the dynamic widgets. Dynamic widgets are widgets that can be configured with the content of your choice. The following dynamic widgets are available: Spotlight , Showcased , Upcoming ILTs , Featured Resources , Featured Themes , and Trending .
- Hide Learner’s rank information ( Overall Progress widget) and Series titles ( Explore by Series widget)

For a detailed overview of the feature, see Page Builder for learning site homepages.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Add widgets:
Perform the following steps to add one or more widgets to the homepage:

1. In the admin site sidebar, click Account > Homepages . From this page, you can create and manage all learning site homepages.
2. Click the name of any homepage to open it in the Page Builder for editing. The Page Builder page opens and displays a replica of the learning site homepage . It displays a preview of the homepage with its existing configuration and sample data.

1. The Page Builder page appears. Using the Widgets panel, you can add a total of 21 unique widgets to your homepage. Important: In addition to the 21 standard widgets, two Call AI and five Asset Hub widgets listed below are available only if you have purchased these products. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) for further information.Widgets that are already added and cannot be added further are disabled and displayed in gray.For information on all available widgets, see Page Builder for learning site homepages.

1. To add a widget, drag-and-drop the widget on the canvas on the right where you want it. Depending on the widget you are adding, it can be added at the center (main space), or on the right-side column, or both. You can also add it above or below another widget. If adding at the center, you can also place it on either side of another widget. Tip: Before dropping the widget on the canvas, move it around to trigger a dotted blue bar with the + icon, which indicates areas/points where you can drop (add) the widget.

1. The widget is added to the homepage in your selected position.

Note: If it’s a dynamic widget that you are adding, you must configure it before it is added to the homepage.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Hide/show, rearrange, and delete widgets:
After a widget is added, you can hover over a widget for actions available to customize the widget. These actions depend on the type of the widget. This section explains how to hide or show, rearrange, and delete a widget.

Hide/Show: You can hide or show all widgets. Use this option to retain the widgets but hide them instead of deleting them.

- Hover over the widget and click the (Hide) icon to hide the widget. Publish the changes to hide the widget on the homepage for all learners.
- To show a hidden widget, hover over it and click the (Show) icon. Publish the changes to make the widget available on the homepage for all learners.

Rearrange: You can rearrange all widgets using the arrow buttons, vertically within their column. This helps you order and position the widgets as per your requirement.

- Hover over the widget and click the (Up Arrow) icon to move the widget one place up in the column. Publish the changes to reflect the widget’s new position on the homepage for all learners.
- Hover over the widget and click the (Down Arrow) icon to move the widget one place down in the column. Publish the changes to reflect the widget’s new position on the homepage for all learners.

Delete: You can delete any widget except the following default widgets: Achievements, Overall Progress, and Explore by Series. Use this option to permanently delete widgets.

- Hover over the widget, click the (More Options) icon and then select Delete to delete the widget. Publish the changes to delete the widget from the homepage for all learners.

The Page Builder feature allows admins to customize the default learning site homepage as well as create and customize one or more additional custom homepages meant for specific sets of learners. This article provides an overview of the feature.

This article provides information on configuring the dynamic widgets on your homepages using the Page Builder.

For a detailed overview of the feature, see Page Builder for learning site homepages.

You can configure the following dynamic widgets with the content of your choice:

- Spotlight
- Showcased
- Upcoming ILTs
- Featured resources
- Featured themes
- Trending

You are prompted to configure these widgets when you add them to the homepage for the first time. Later, you can edit the configured widgets to make further changes.

Note: Currently, only the dynamic widgets can be configured. The rest of the widgets cannot be configured as their content is derived from the platform.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Spotlight:
Spotlight is a dynamic widget that is used to prominently display and promote any initiative, announcement, series, or module to learners. Spotlight functions as a marketing or promotion banner. Banners are the individual slides that make up the Spotlight widget.

Note: You can add a maximum of 7 Spotlight widgets. Additionally, you can add up to 4 banners within each Spotlight.

The following are some example use cases where Spotlight is useful:

- Just before an SKO (Sales Kickoff), the enablement team can highlight the pre-SKO work that Learners need to do.
- To call out a specific program for Learners who have just joined the company as part of their onboarding.
- To highlight a new video from the CEO that everyone should view.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Spotlight > Content linking:
Content highlighted in Spotlight is linked and clickable. There are two primary ways to link to content:

- Widget link: This is defined through “Link to” field in the widget configuration. Using this field, you can link the widget to a series, module, hub, or an asset. Or, link it to an external website. Content linked with option can be accessed by either clicking the widget/banner or by clicking the CTA (call to action) button if it is added.
- Links in widget description: You can add links to the words in the description. Links added here are independent of the widget link. Adding links in the description is useful when you need to link to other relevant content in addition to the main widget link.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Spotlight > Configure spotlight:
When you add a new Spotlight widget, you are prompted to configure it. Perform the following steps to add and configure Spotlight:

1. In the admin site sidebar, click Account > Homepages. From this page, you can create and manage all learning site homepages.
2. On the Page Builder page that appears, edit the homepage to which you want to add the Spotlight widget.
3. Drag-and-drop the Spotlight widget from the left sidebar to where you want it place it on the right. You are prompted to configure the widget. It is recommended to put Spotlight at the top of the column because the widget is used to draw attention to essential content and resources.
4. In the New spotlight widget pop-up that opens, add one or more Spotlight banners (up to 4 banners per widget). Each banner is a slide, and multiple banners will display as a slideshow within the widget on the homepage. The first banner is added by default. Click Add banner to add more banners. If you add multiple banners, you can easily reorder them through drag-and-drop (collapse the banner list and then use drag-and-drop).

1. You need to configure the widget settings under two tabs, Banners and Settings, as discussed in the following steps. The Banners tab lets you add and configure each banner in the widget. The Settings tab lets you configure the widget size and appearance.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Spotlight > Configure spotlight:
1. On the Banners tab, provide the following information for each banner:
  - Background Image: Upload and select the image that will be the background of this banner. Ensure that the image is a .jpg or .png of 950 x 210px resolution/size so that it fits best.
    - Banner Overlay: Once you add the banner background image, you get the option to add an overlay over the image. Adding overlay can often increase the banner text readability.
  - Link to: Choose where to link each banner to. You can link it to a series, module, hub, or an asset. Or, link it to an external website. For linking to Mindtickle content (such as modules and assets), you can easily search and find the content you want to link. Note that it searches only in the content's name, such as the name of a module or asset.Use the Open in a new tab option if you want the linked content to open in a new tab for your learners.Note: If a learner has completed the series or module linked to a banner, then this particular banner will no longer be shown to the learner. Additionally, if a learner doesn’t have access to the linked content, the banner doesn’t show up for that learner.The linked entities (modules, assets, etc.) will work properly on the mobile app as well. However, the new settings (e.g. aspect ratio) are currently not supported on the mobile app.
  - Banner text: Enter the text or description for the banner. It can include a title or headline along with a description for the banner. You can use common formatting options (heading styles, bold/italic/underline, text color, font size, and more) and even add a link. For the link, ensure to provide the complete URL, for example https://drive.google.com/drive/search?q=actionitems.This link is clickable independent of the content linked in the widget through Banner URL. The banner will display up to three lines of description text. Learners can hover over the description to see the entire text.
  - Button text: Add a name here if you want to add a CTA (call to action) button on the widget that will direct Learners to the content linked in this banner (through Banner URL). Example names: View, Enroll, Explore, and Learn More.This is an optional field. Leave blank if you don’t want to add the button. Learners can still access linked content by clicking on the widget.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Spotlight > Configure spotlight:
1. On the Settings tab, you can customize widget size/appearance: widget height, widget aspect ratio, and the banner image fit. Changes made here will apply to all banner images in this widget. You can configure the following:
  - Widget height: Select Auto, Fixed, or Custom height for the widget.The Custom option lets you define minimum and maximum height. For the maximum height, enter "auto" to auto-adjust the image height.
  - Widget height: This option lets you set the width for the height defined in the previous setting. The default setting is Ultrawide (4:1 aspect ratio). Other options are: Widescreen (16:9), Landscape (5:4), Square (1:1), and Portrait (4:5).Note that the widget height option is not available if your height setting is set to Fixed.
  - Image fit: Select how the banner image fits within the widget layout. Available options are: Cover, Contain, and Stretch.
  - Show banners of completed modules: Lets you automatically show or hide banners based on users' progress in the linked series and modules. This lets you control whether to display banners if the user has completed the linked series and modules.By default, the setting is turned OFF for new Spotlight widgets. This means that the widget will hide the banners for the user who has completed the linked series and modules.Toggle the setting ON if you prefer to show banners of completed series and modules. For instance, you may want to keep completed banners visible for specific training paths for organizational purposes or to keep a consistent homepage structure for all learners.Note 1: Banners linked to a series will be hidden only when all modules in that series are completed by the learner, including for public series.Note 2: Please note the following on backward compatibility for your existing Spotlight widgets:For banners created/updated before the October release for Spotlight, the setting will be turned ON by default. Edit the widget to turn it OFF.For banners created/updated after the October release for Spotlight, the setting will be turned OFF by default. Edit the widget to turn it ON.
2. Click Add Spotlight to save the changes and add the widget to the homepage in your selected position.
3. Once done with all changes, click Publish to publish the changes on the homepage for all Learners.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Showcased:
Showcased is a dynamic widget that is used to showcase (highlight) personalized and dynamic training content (series and modules) to learners. It enhances the overall learning experience while simplifying content management for admins.You can add content (series/modules) to the widget either by selecting the series/modules from a list or by configuring filters based on which series/modules will be selected automatically.

Note: Whether you add only series, or only modules, or a mix of both, learners will see up to 20 series and/or modules in the widget and only those to which they have access.

You can add as many individual Showcased widgets to the homepage as you like.

Tip: You can also add this widget to the overview page for a series. For more information, see Create and edit pages using the Page Builder.

When you add a new Showcased widget, you are prompted to configure it. Perform the following steps to add and configure the widget:

1. In the admin site sidebar, click Account > Homepages. From this page, you can create and manage all learning site homepages.

1. On the Page Builder page that appears, edit the homepage to which you want to add the Showcased widget.
2. From the Widgets panel, drag-and-drop the Showcased widget on the canvas on the right where you want it. You can add the Showcased widget at the center as well as on the right-side column. You can add it above or below another widget. If adding at the center, you can also place it on either side of another widget.Tip: Before dropping the widget on the canvas, move it around to trigger a dotted blue bar with the + icon, which indicates areas/points where you can drop (add) the widget.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Showcased > Add from list:
Use this option to select series and modules from a list of all of your series and modules. This option lists all your series and modules separately, with filters and search to help you find specific series/modules.

1. For the Add from list option ( Step 3 ), under Select series and modules > Series , select one or more series from the list of all of your series. Use the filters and search to find specific series. Note: You can select as many series as you like, but learners will see only the first 20 series to which they have access.
2. Click the Module tab and select one or more modules to add to the widget. Use the filters and search to find specific modules. You can use the search bar to find a specific module.

- When adding mirrored modules, selecting a series automatically assigns that series to the module.
- After learners complete the module, the system displays the next modules from the same series, maintaining the module order for a seamless learning experience. For example, a module, Product 101 , exists in both the Acme Product Training and Acme Sales series. If an admin adds it to the widget from the Acme Sales series, learners who complete it are directed to the next module in the same series.

3. Click Next to continue, which takes you back to the Content tab (Step 3).Note: You can select as many modules as you like, but learners will see only the first 20 modules to which they have access.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Upcoming ILTs:
With the Upcoming ILTs widget, learners can easily view all of their live and upcoming instructor-led training (ILT) module sessions directly on the page and take various actions. The widget acts like a calendar and provides learners a centralized view for their ILT sessions without having to locate them in series and modules. It ensures that learners are fully aware of their schedule and makes it easy to join or enroll in sessions.

You can use the Upcoming ILTs widget on learning site homepages, series overview pages, and hub overview pages. The widget behaves the same way for learners on every page, but how you configure it depends on the page type:

- On a learning site homepage or hub overview page , you configure which series' ILT sessions the widget shows.
- On a series overview page , the widget automatically shows the ILT sessions for that specific series, so no series selection is required.

The steps below describe adding and configuring the widget on a learning site homepage. For details on adding the widget to a series overview page or hub overview page, see the "Add the widget to a series overview page or hub overview page" section.

Note:

- The widget displays only the independent sessions in the ILT module. It does not display ILT events and sessions that are part of an event.
- The widget is currently not supported on the Mindtickle app.
- As a best practice, enablement admins can utilize this widget to display specific series and promote particular ILT programs.

On a learning site homepage, you use the Page Builder to configure the widget to show ILT sessions from:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Upcoming ILTs > For hub/series overview pages:
You can also add the Upcoming ILTs widget when building a hub overview page or a series overview page. The learner experience is the same as on a homepage, but the configuration differs by page type.

Hub overview page

Configuring the widget on a hub overview page works the same way as on a homepage. When you add the widget, you are prompted to configure the Widget title, the Show ILT sessions from option, and the Max height, as described in the steps above for a homepage.

Series overview page

On a series overview page, the widget is scoped to that specific series, so it is added differently:

- The widget is added directly with default settings; no configuration pop-up appears. It automatically shows only the ILT sessions belonging to that series, so the Show ILT sessions from option is not shown.
- After adding the widget, you can edit it to change the Widget title and Max height . The Show ILT sessions from option is not available, because the series is detected automatically from the page.
- You can add only one Upcoming ILTs widget per series overview page.
- The widget is not available in the page builder for an archived series.
- If there are no upcoming ILT sessions for the series, the widget does not appear.

For learners, the widget behaves the same on all three page types: learners can view sessions by status (all sessions, or sessions where they are not enrolled, enrolled, or waitlisted), use the month selector to view future sessions for a particular month, and enroll in or unenroll from a session directly from the widget.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Featured resources:
Featured resources is a dynamic widget that is used to link to content and resources that can be internal (residing on Mindtickle) and external (e.g., YouTube videos). You can add as many Featured Resources widgets as you like. When you add a new Featured resources widget, you are prompted to configure it.

You can use the Featured resources widget on learning site homepages, series overview pages, and hub overview pages. The following steps provide information on how to add a Featured resources to a learning site homepage:

1. On the Page Builder page that appears, edit the homepage to which you want to add the Featured resources widget.
2. Drag-and-drop the Featured resources widget in the column on the right where you want it. You are prompted to configure the widget.

1. The New featured resources widget pop-up opens.
2. Add a title and text for the Info help icon for the widget. Then add one or more resources. For each resource, add the resource link and a name that is short and easy to understand. The links will appear as a list in the widget.For the resource link, you can link to a URL or Mindtickle content (series, module, hub, or asset). Use the search option to look for the Mindtickle content that you want to link to. Also, ensure to provide the complete URL, for example https://drive.google.com/drive/search?q=actionitems.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Page Builder for learning site homepages > Featured themes:
Featured themes is a dynamic widget that allows your Learners to explore content by themes. It displays various themes across your site. Each theme in the widget showcases thematically linked content. Themes are essentially tags applied to Modules that can be across multiple Series. The widget displays these tags as theme tiles.

Note: You can add a maximum of 5 Featured Themes widgets.

You can configure the widget to display the tagged modules in one of the following ways:

- Grouped by series: This is the default option. Take learners to a series to go to the tagged modules. Use this option if you want learners to first see the respective series in which the tagged modules reside.
- Directly as modules list: Take learners directly to the tagged modules. Use this option if you want learners to directly see the tagged modules, without having to see the series first where the modules reside.

Before adding this widget, you need to first apply tags to the Modules that you want to group together and ensure that all tags are also grouped in a single tag category. While configuring the widget, you can only select tags from a single tag category. You cannot select tags from across multiple categories.

Note: Ensure that the tag names are short and mobile-friendly for use on the Mindtickle mobile app.

For information about adding tags to Modules individually and in bulk, see:

- Apply Tags to Modules
- Create and Manage Tags
