chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > User Management > System and Audit Logs > Access and view audit logs:
1. On the admin site homepage, on the left navigation panel, click Account and select System logs . The System Logs page appears with two tabs - Audit Logs and Email Logs . Note :
  - If Audit Logs is disabled on your site, clicking on System logs takes you directly to Email logs . If enabled, both tabs are displayed, and Audit logs is selected by default.
  - Audit Logs record all actions performed during the last 365 days starting from the day the feature is deployed in Mindtickle (August 16, 2022). Past data is unavailable and cannot be retrieved in any way. The Audit logs tab displays the chronological list of events from the last 7 days as the filter Last 7 Days is applied by default. For more information about other available filters, see Filter Audit Logs . The events appear in descending order of their occurrence, hence the most recent event appears at the top of the list. Information about each log is displayed under the columns Events , Event details , Performed by , and Date and time .
  - Events Reports the action and its category. For example, User invited to the module . Other examples of action categories include user added to a group, user removed from a series, user invited to a module, and profile created.
  - Event details Describes the action and provides its details. For example, Jim Anderson is invited to Core Product Offerings Update . The corresponding module, series, user, group, and profile field icon is also displayed here, depending on the action. Refer to the following legend to identify the associated attribute type:
    - Series
    - Group
    - User
    - Profile Management
  - Performed by Reports if it was an admin action or a system-driven event. It also reports the corresponding admin and system details. Tip : Click Automation rule to navigate straight to the rule’s details page in Automation suite. The rule is clickable only if you have access to the Automation suite.
  - Date and time Reports the date and time on which the action was performed. Note :
    - The date and time are localized to your system’s (machine) timezone. For example, if you are viewing the audit logs while in the PST timezone, the date and time will be aligned with the PST timezone.
    - The action appears as a log in the list when the system processes it. For some actions, there may be a delay (approximately 1 hour) between when they occur, get processed, and appear in the log list.
2. To retrieve detailed information about an action, click its Event details . The Event details pop-up appears. It provides comprehensive information and a detailed context about the action in four sections:
  - Event description Provides detailed information about the action that was performed. For example, in the above screenshot, the Event description section also provides details about the series in which the module is present.
  - Performed by Provides information about the admin or system that performed the action and the date and time on which the action was performed.
  - Impacted users Provides information about the user impacted by the action. Note :
    - Each audit log is specific to an individual user. So, for example, if 100 users are added to the platform via CSV upload, 100 individual events are logged independently for each user.
    - If the action is such that no users are impacted, for example, a group is renamed , the message ‘No users were impacted in this event’ is displayed in this section.
  - Impacted attributes Depending on the action, this section provides details about the impacted groups, modules, series, or profile fields. It also provides details about attributes that were not impacted by the action, but were involved in its execution.
    - Example 1 The action is ‘The user Jim Anderson is invited to the course Core Product Offerings Update via a Group-Module link’. The Impacted attributes section in the Events details pop-up provides details about the module, series the module is present in, and group linked to the module. This information helps you understand through which group the user was invited to the module.
    - Example 2 The action is ‘The user Alex Fry is invited to the series 1:1 Coaching by the admin, Adam’. The Impacted attributes section in the Events details pop-up provides details about the modules the user was invited to when the action was triggered.

  - Events Reports the action and its category. For example, User invited to the module . Other examples of action categories include user added to a group, user removed from a series, user invited to a module, and profile created.
  - Event details Describes the action and provides its details. For example, Jim Anderson is invited to Core Product Offerings Update . The corresponding module, series, user, group, and profile field icon is also displayed here, depending on the action. Refer to the following legend to identify the associated attribute type:
    - Series
    - Group
    - User
    - Profile Management
  - Performed by Reports if it was an admin action or a system-driven event. It also reports the corresponding admin and system details. Tip : Click Automation rule to navigate straight to the rule’s details page in Automation suite. The rule is clickable only if you have access to the Automation suite.
  - Date and time Reports the date and time on which the action was performed. Note :
    - The date and time are localized to your system’s (machine) timezone. For example, if you are viewing the audit logs while in the PST timezone, the date and time will be aligned with the PST timezone.
    - The action appears as a log in the list when the system processes it. For some actions, there may be a delay (approximately 1 hour) between when they occur, get processed, and appear in the log list.
2. To retrieve detailed information about an action, click its Event details . The Event details pop-up appears. It provides comprehensive information and a detailed context about the action in four sections:
  - Event description Provides detailed information about the action that was performed. For example, in the above screenshot, the Event description section also provides details about the series in which the module is present.
  - Performed by Provides information about the admin or system that performed the action and the date and time on which the action was performed.
  - Impacted users Provides information about the user impacted by the action. Note :
    - Each audit log is specific to an individual user. So, for example, if 100 users are added to the platform via CSV upload, 100 individual events are logged independently for each user.
    - If the action is such that no users are impacted, for example, a group is renamed , the message ‘No users were impacted in this event’ is displayed in this section.
  - Impacted attributes Depending on the action, this section provides details about the impacted groups, modules, series, or profile fields. It also provides details about attributes that were not impacted by the action, but were involved in its execution.
    - Example 1 The action is ‘The user Jim Anderson is invited to the course Core Product Offerings Update via a Group-Module link’. The Impacted attributes section in the Events details pop-up provides details about the module, series the module is present in, and group linked to the module. This information helps you understand through which group the user was invited to the module.
    - Example 2 The action is ‘The user Alex Fry is invited to the series 1:1 Coaching by the admin, Adam’. The Impacted attributes section in the Events details pop-up provides details about the modules the user was invited to when the action was triggered.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > User Management > System and Audit Logs > Filter audit logs:
1. On the Audit Logs tab, in the All filters panel, click any dropdown based on how you want to filter the logs. Note : By default, the filter Last 7 days is applied, and the list is filtered to display audit logs from the last week. You can further filter the logs based on:
  - Timeline Scope the list to display the events from:
    - All (last 365 days)
    - Today
    - Yesterday
    - Last 7 days
    - Last 30 days
    - Custom date range
  - Action type Click:
    - Performed by users - to display a list of actions performed by an admin. The list of admins is displayed.
    - Performed by system - to display a list of actions performed by a system. The following options are considered as a system:
      - API
      - Automation rule
      - Group to module linking
      - Group to series linking
      - MT system
      - Profile-based rule
      - Readiness index cohort rule
      - User sync
      - Self sign up Note : All actions performed using custom solutions, for example, scripts, or tool settings, fall under the MT System (Mindtickle System) category.
    - Attributes Click:
      - Select users - to select users and filter the list by events performed on selected users.
      - Select groups - to select groups and filter the list by events performed on selected groups.
      - Select modules - to select modules and filter the list by events performed on selected modules.
      - Select series - to select a series and filter the list by events performed on the selected series.
    - Event type Click:
      - User events - to filter the list by an event performed on users. Select the event(s) from the following available options:
        - User added to the platform
        - User activated
        - User deactivated
        - User restored
        - User email updated
        - User display name updated
        - User profile updated
        - Username replaced
        - User timezone updated
        - User relationship updated
        - User role updated
        - User impersonated
      - Group events - to filter the list by an event performed on groups. Select the event(s) from the following available options:
        - Group created
        - Group updated
        - Group deleted
        - Group collaborators updated (added or removed)
        - User added to the group
        - User removed from the group
      - Module events - to filter the list by an event performed on modules. Select the event(s) from the following available options:
        - User invited to a module
        - User removed from a module
        - Module settings updated
        - Module archived
      - Series events - to filter the list by an event performed on series. Select the event(s) from the following available options:
        - User invited to a series
        - User removed from a series
        - User subscribed to a series
        - User unsubscribed from a series
      - Profile management events - to filter the list by an event performed on profile or relationship fields. Select the event(s) from the following available options:
        - Profile field created
        - Profile field updated
        - Profile field deleted
        - Relationship field created
        - Relationship field updated
        - Relationship field deleted
2. Once you have selected the filters, click Apply in the respective dropdown or simply click anywhere outside the dropdown. Alternatively, use the Search field in the dropdown to search for a particular attribute, select it, and click Apply . Note : The Search field is not available in the dropdowns present under Filter by event type . The filtered list of audit logs is displayed.
3. Click Reset to remove the applied filters. Clicking Reset removes all other filters and applies the default filter ( Last 7 days ) to the list.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle APIs > Reporting APIs:
Mindtickle’s reporting API supports pagination for all reporting API tables (routes). Using the pagination script, you can send successive API requests allowing you to fetch increased dataset in a single request.

Note: This feature is available for all customers by default.

This article provides an overview of client-side pagination with the skip and top options. It also provides a sample script to help you implement pagination at your side.

For information on pagination for the LearnerModulePerformanceIncremental (LMPI) table, see Pagination for the LMPI Table in Reporting API.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle APIs > Reporting APIs > How It Works:
Mindtickle’s reporting API supports client-side pagination with the skip and top options model to fetch the data in batches when the data is large and cannot be fetched in a single go. Here’s how it is implemented on the server-side: every time you run the script, the data is sorted based on the primary key and the script skips the records that are already fetched. When there are no records fetched already in the start, the skip will be “0” and the script will run until there are no records to be fetched.

However, the script does not fetch records inserted while it is running. Let’s say, you insert new records while the script is running and fetching the data. In this case, when you run the next query in the current script, these newly-added records are skipped. Only when you run the script the next time, the script fetches the skipped records so that, eventually, the data will be consistent and up-to-date.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle APIs > Reporting APIs > Best Practices:
Please ensure to make use of the following best practices:

- You do not need to use any sorting on top of pagination because sorting is provided within the pagination implementation.
- When you use the top option to fetch top records, the value should not be greater than 300,000 for the CourseObjects, QuickUpdateObjects, and AssessmentObjects tables. Similarly, the value should not be greater than 100,000 for the LearnerModulePerformances table.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle APIs > Reporting APIs > Sample Script:
```python
import io
import csv
import time
from datetime import datetime
import requests
from requests.auth import HTTPBasicAuth

table_name = "CourseObjects"
base_url = f"https://admin.mindtickle.com/Odata.svc/{table_name}"
username = 'username'
password = 'password'

def get_query_params(base_url, read_format, column_selection=None, filter_conditions=None, top=None, orderby_columns=None, skip=None):
    params_query = [f"$format={read_format}"]
    if column_selection != None and len(column_selection) > 0:
        params_query.append(f"""$select={",".join(column_selection)}""")
    if orderby_columns != None and len(orderby_columns) > 0:
        params_query.append(f"""$orderby={",".join(orderby_columns)}""")
    if filter_conditions != None and len(filter_conditions) > 0:
        params_query.append(f"""$filter={" and ".join(filter_conditions)}""")
    if top != None:
        params_query.append(f"""$top={top}""")
    if skip != None:
        params_query.append(f"""$skip={skip}""")

    return f"""{base_url}?{"&".join(params_query)}"""

def process_csv_records(records, file_name):
    """
    :param records: this is the data in string format
    :param file_name: a string name, which is assigned to the csv file
    :return: downloads the data(records) in the csv format with the name of csv file as file_name
    """
    reader = csv.reader(io.StringIO(records))
    rows = []

    for row in reader:
        rows.append(row)

    data = rows
    file = open(file_name, 'w+', newline='')

    with file:
        write = csv.writer(file)
        write.writerows(data)

if __name__ == '__main__':

    read_format = 'csv'

    ## top value can not be set more than 300000 for CourseObjects, QuickUpdateObjects, AssessmentObjects
    ## top value can not be set more than 100000 for LearnerModulePerformances
    top = 10000

    # you can define filter like ["StartTime ge '2021-01-01 00:00:00'", "StartTime le '2021-12-31 23:59:59'"], according to the fields expected in the particular route
    # if filter_conditions is None No filter is applied
    filter_conditions = None

    # you can select columns like ["UserId", "ModuleId", "SeriesId", "Score", "MaxScore"]
    # if column_selection is None all columns are selected
    column_selection = None

    # if orderby_columns is None, the data is ordered by the primary key if skip is not None
    orderby_columns = None

    skip = 0

    ## generate initial url
    url = get_query_params(base_url=base_url, read_format=read_format, column_selection=column_selection,
                           filter_conditions=filter_conditions, top=top, orderby_columns=orderby_columns, skip=skip)

    num_of_retries = 3

    def run(url):
        itr = 0
        total_rows = 0
        for i in range(0, num_of_retries):
            try:
                while True:
                    resp = requests.get(url, auth = HTTPBasicAuth(username, password))
                    if int(resp.headers.get('X-MTAPI-RecordCount')) == 0:
                        break
                    first_row_num = total_rows + 1
                    total_rows = total_rows + int(resp.headers.get('X-MTAPI-RecordCount'))
                    last_row_num = total_rows

                    # change the name of the file accordingly
                    file_name = table_name + str(datetime.now().strftime("_%Y_%m_%d_%H_%M_%S_")) + str(first_row_num) + '_to_' + str(last_row_num) + '.csv'
                    if read_format == 'csv':
                        process_csv_records(resp.content.decode('utf-8'), file_name)

                    ## generate next url
                    url = get_query_params(base_url=base_url, read_format=read_format, column_selection=column_selection,
                                           filter_conditions=filter_conditions, top=top, orderby_columns=orderby_columns,
                                           skip=total_rows)
                    itr = itr + 1
                    print(f"total rows after iteration {itr} =  {total_rows}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(e)
                if i < num_of_retries:
                    print("Sleeping for 60s will reattempt after that")
                    time.sleep(60)
        print("Finished Processing")

    run(url)
```

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics:
The Reports tab provides detailed reports related to Readiness Index (RI) in the following tabs:

- Competency categories/competencies: Provides data on the competencies you have configured for Readiness Index. For each competency, you can view its average score, any change in the score, and the competency benchmark score.
- Teams: Provides data on the managers and their teams (as configured in the user-to-user hierarchy ) in your organization. For each manager, you can view the total number of members in their team and the team’s average RI score.
- Modules: Provides data on the modules that have an impact on the competency score. For each module, you can view all competencies that the module is tagged with and the module score. Additionally, if you apply the “Competency” filter, the report displays a different set of relevant data: % contribution to competency, competency score of the module, and impact on overall competency score.
- User distribution: Provides data on the users (learners) in your organization. For each user, you can view their manager’s name and the RI score.

Note: Readiness Index (RI) data is not real-time. The data gets updated weekly — every Monday at 2 AM UTC. During the weekly data update, associated user hierarchies, competency performance data, and RI scores also get updated. For example, if there were any changes to your user hierarchies in the days between the last RI update and the upcoming update, the changes will reflect in RI after the next weekly update.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics > Access the reports:
You can access the Readiness Index (RI) reports in the Reports tab in one of the following ways:

- Directly: Click the Reports tab in Readiness Index to access the reports directly.
- Via Track and Correlate tabs: You can also access the reports through clickable actions in the charts of the Correlate and Track tabs.
  - Track tab: On this tab, you can access the reports in one of the following ways:
    - Click the Details button in the upper-right corner of a chart to open the respective report.
    - From Measure Readiness Index charts: Wherever chart data is clickable, you can click to open the respective report with applicable filters applied. For example, you can click the links in Top Insights, the bars in the User Distribution chart, and the buttons that are available when you click on a competency or competency category in the Competency chart.
  - Correlate tab: On the quadrant chart, click any of the bubbles. In the pop-up that opens, click the buttons (such as the View best performing learners , View underperforming learners , and View all learners buttons) to open the respective reports with applicable filters applied.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Team analytics > 1. Competency categories/competencies report:
This report provides data on the competencies you have configured for Readiness Index. For each competency, you can view its average score, any change in the score, and the competency benchmark score.

With this report, you can easily identify what are the key competencies within specific categories driving the benchmark and design your enablement plans accordingly. For example, using the Change in competency score column, you can pinpoint the influence competencies and their categories have on the overall score.

This report provides the following information:

- Competency name: Competencies selected by you in RI.
- Average competency score: Average of scores achieved by selected sales reps on a competency.
- Change in competency score: Any change in the competency score for the selected period, which is selected in the Show RI change from setting in the upper-right corner. If Last Month is selected, the latest month’s RI is compared to the last month’s RI. If Last Week is selected, the latest week’s RI is compared to the last week’s RI.
- Tag benchmark: Competency benchmark score.
- Benchmark score: Overall RI benchmark score.

You can apply various filters as well as sort the column data. Click the Export icon to export a detailed report of this report to an email address. The exported data is only for the team of the manager selected in the first filter.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started:
On the learning site homepage, you can access all series and modules available to you from the Training section in the navigation panel. Additionally, you can also access ILT sessions, global leaderboard, and files, and ILT sessions.

- Series: Displays your series in four dedicated tabs: All Series , Assigned , Subscribed , and Public . You can view various information for each series, such as their progress, ratings, and whether a series is pinned or subscribed by you. You can also search for a series using the Series Menu sidebar. For details, see the " Series homepage " section.
- Modules: Displays your modules in two tabs: All modules and Assigned modules. For details, see the " Modules homepage " section.
- ILT sessions: Lists your ILT sessions. For details, see this article .
- Global leaderboard: Displays a leaderboard based on the knowledge score of learners. It displays your team’s knowledge score performance and your rank within your team. For details, see the " Global leaderboard " section.
- Files: It is a library of all the files associated with series and modules you are assigned to or have completed. For details, see the " Files " section.

When you click on Training in the sidebar, it opens the Series page, which is the landing page for the Training section.

Series on mobile: You can also access your series on the Mindtickle mobile app (for iOS and Android). For more information, see Series on the mobile app.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Series homepage > Subscribed Series:
Displays all public and scoped public series you have subscribed to.

You can subscribe to a public series by clicking the Subscribe button on the series detail page. When you subscribe to a series, it is moved to the Subscribed tab and is denoted by the(bell) icon. On subscribing, you start receiving notifications for the series as it gets updated.

You can unsubscribe from a series from the series detail page — if you no longer want to receive any updates or reminders about it. When you unsubscribe from a series:

- It is moved back under the Public tab.
- Any modules (from that series) that are Completed or In Progress , retain their completion/progress states. This allows you to resume your progress when you re-subscribe to the same series or start any module from the series.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Explore and find your series > View series progress and other details:
Each listed series, represented as a folder, displays the following information to provide you with a quick overview:

1. Type of series: assigned or public.
2. Progress: Current status of the progress you have made on the series. Hover over the progress bar to view the number of modules completed out of the total.
3. Completion: Completed series are indicated by the checkmark.
4. Rating: The overall average rating for the series.
5. Pinned: The pin icon indicates the series is pinned by you or your admin.
6. Subscribed (for public series): The bell icon for a public series indicates that you have subscribed to the series.
7. Certification(s): The total number of active certifications available on the series and the number of certifications you have earned.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Explore and find your series > Series certifications:
Adding a certification to the series allows your admin to set standardized evaluation criteria for the modules in the series. It is used to assess your knowledge and skills on the learning path defined in the series. You can earn series-level certifications to prove your achievement of a common and standard objective defined by your organization.

A series with active certifications is denoted by the Available Certifications icon. Hover over the icon to view the number of active certifications available on the series.

If you have earned some or all certifications on a series, it is denoted by the Earned Certifications icon. Hover over it to view the total number of certifications and the number of certifications you have earned.

You can discover and earn certifications only on series you have access to. For each certification, you can access details such as:

- The certification criteria you must complete to earn the certification
- Any validity, expiry, and recertification details

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Series detail page:
On the series homepage, when you click on a series, it opens the series detail page. The page is divided into the following sections:

- the header,
- the Overview tab,
- the Modules tab, and
- the Certifications tab.
- the Leaderboard tab. Note : The Leaderboard tab is a beta release. For more information, see Mindtickle Series Leaderboards .

From the header, you can take various actions on the series. The Modules tab lists all modules added to the series. You can apply filters on the listed modules and search for a module. You can click a module to start it.

Let's now understand the Certifications tab.

The Certifications tab lists:

- Certifications available on the series (denoted by the blue label Available )
- Certifications that you have earned (denoted by the green label Completed )
- Certifications that are expiring (denoted by the amber label Expiring )
- Certifications that have expired (denoted by the red label Expired )

Click View details to check the certification details, such as the thumbnail image, name, award date, certification validity, and expiry date.

The Leaderboard tab ranks the learners of the series having points more than 0. It enhances learner engagement and gamification experience series/scope series level.

If your admin has enabled leaderboard, then the respective series details page also displays the Leaderboard tab.

For more information on how the leaderboard calculates rank, see Mindtickle Series Leaderboard.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Series detail page > Actions on the Series:
From the header of the series detail page, you can take the following actions:

- Hide series menu: click to hide the Series Menu sidebar. Click again to show it.
- Navigation: In the navigation breadcrumb, click the home icon to go back to the learning site homepage. Click “Series” to go back to the series homepage.
- Series rating: Click the stars to rate the series. If already rated, you'll see your rating. You can also modify your rating anytime you want.
- Pin the series: Click the Pin button to pin or unpin the series.
- Subscribe to the series (for public series): For a public series, the header also provides an option to subscribe to the series.
- View active certifications: If certifications are added to the series, the number of active series certifications is displayed in the header.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Series detail page > Actions on the overview page:
Note: The Overview tab is available only if your admin has configured and enabled one for this series. If it's enabled, it is your default tab; if it's not, the Modules tab becomes the default.

The Overview tab serves as an introduction to the series and its content, giving you a holistic overview and clarity. It highlights important content in the series in a contextual way for a more intuitive and relevant learning experience.

The Overview tab displays content as various widgets configured by your admin. For example, text widgets provide information, video widgets let you watch videos, and some widgets link to important content. Several series widgets also help you get to key modules and sessions right from the landing page, including the Continue, Required, Urgent, Trending, Take action, Showcased, and Upcoming ILTs widgets.

Page sections: If your admin has configured sections for the overview page, you see the page outline on the left or right side of the page, depending on the admin's configuration. You can click the sections in the outline to quickly navigate to them.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Series detail page > Actions on the modules:
For the modules listed on the series detail page, you can take the following actions:

- Filter and search: Filter the module list by type, completion status, relevance, and the tags associated with the modules. Use the search bar to find a particular module.
- Start the module: Click the module to start it.

Module thumbnails (tiles) also provide various types of information about the module, such as its relevance, type, name, description, progress status, and score and certification.

About module relevance: Use the Relevance filter to filter modules by Required (mandatory to complete), Optional (optional and may not need to be completed), or Unmarked (no module relevance is set). Module relevance is indicated by the "Required" and "Optional" labels on the module thumbnails. No label is shown for Unmarked modules.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Series detail page > Actions on Certifications:
For the certifications listed on the series detail page, you can take the following actions:

- View certification criteria : Check the criteria (on available certifications) you must complete to earn the certification. You can also check any validity, expiry, and recertification (if applicable) details and preview the sample certificate. Click View details on the certification thumbnail. The Certification Details panel appears and displays:
  - a sample of the certificate that will be awarded to you upon successful completion of the certification criteria
  - the certification criteria that you must complete to earn the certification
  - the certification validity
- Download earned certificates : Once you are certified, you are automatically awarded a certificate. You can download and share the certificate with your network to showcase your competence and expertise, enhance your credibility, and build your brand value. You can use it to showcase your competence and expertise on the subject matter. Click View Certificate on the certification thumbnail. The Certification Details panel appears and displays the certificate with award date and validity details. Click Download Certificate . The certificate opens as an image in a new browser tab. You can save it as an image (it is downloaded as a .png file) and share it socially. For more information, see Earn and manage series certifications .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Series detail page > Actions on the series leaderboard:
For the leaderboard listed on the series detail page, you can participate in the competitive series ranking at a global level. Check the criteria to be eligible in the leaderboard.

Learners can use the leaderboard of a series/scoped public series in the following ways:

- If you are part of a series, you can access and check the leaderboard.
- If you have a series score over zero, you can be part of the leaderboard and your rank is listed.
- If your admin invited you to the series, you can compare your rank among peers based on the given period.

1. Click Leaderboard on the series details page of your invited series/scoped public series, or subscribed series/scoped public series.

2.Filter this leaderboard based on when the learners were invited or subscribed to this series, when invited by the admin. The default time period is past 90 days. You have the following filters:

- Past 30 days.
- Past 90 days.
- Last month.
- All time.

3. Scroll down to view your latest rank and points among peers of the respective series.

The leaderboard determines the learner ranks by combining the learner’s absolute points earned for modules in the series and the timing of achieving the score, considering the day and time. For more information on how the leaderboard calculates rank, see Rank Determination.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Modules homepage:
Displays your modules in two tabs: All modules and Assigned modules.

For the modules listed under each tab, you can take the following actions:

- Filter and search: You can filter the module list by their type, completion status, relevance, and tags associated with the modules. Use the search bar to search for a particular module.
- Sort: Use the Sort option to order the modules listed under each tab. The selected order applies within whichever filters you have active, and the list re-orders immediately when you choose a different option. The following sort options are available:
  - Newly assigned: Lists the most recently assigned modules first. This is the default sort order.
  - Alphabetically: Lists modules in alphabetical order by name.
  - Recently accessed first: Lists the modules you accessed most recently first.
  - Due date soonest: Lists modules with the earliest due date first. Modules without a due date appear after all modules that have a due date.
- Start the module: You can click the module to start it.

Module thumbnails or tiles also provide various types of information on the module, such as the module relevance, type, name, description, progress status, and score and certification.

About module relevance: You can use the Relevance filter to filter modules by Required (mandatory to be completed), Optional (optional and may not need to be completed), or Unmarked (no Module Relevance is set). Module relevance is indicated with the “Required” (for Required) and “Optional” (for Optional) labels on the module thumbnails. No label is shown for the Unmarked modules.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Global leaderboard:
Available in the Training page sidebar, the global leaderboard displays a leaderboard based on the knowledge score of learners. It displays your team’s knowledge score performance and your rank within your team. You earn one knowledge score for every 100 points scored in any module. The global leaderboard helps learners measure their progress and compare it with their peers. A higher knowledge score would result in a higher rank.

It also displays your profile on the right to allow quick access to view and edit the profile. You can also click any of your peers (other learners) to view their profiles.

In the profile fields dropdown menu, you can apply one or more profile fields to view the leaderboard by a specific set of peers and also search for a profile field.

Note: The profile fields will be visible only if the admin has enabled them.

The global leaderboard applies default sorting to display learners (peers) in the order of top scorer first (high to low knowledge score, in the descending order).

Note: On standard learning sites, the global leaderboard is accessible to all users; for partner learning sites, it is visible exclusively to the same partner group.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started > Files:
Available in the Training page sidebar, Files is a library of all the files associated with series and modules you are assigned to or have completed. By default, all files are displayed, and accessible after completing the learning object associated with the file. Starred Files displays any files you have starred for quick access. Files can be filtered based upon the Series, Modules, File Type, or Tags.

For example, if you have an important call and want a refresher about the product features, you can quickly access the required content from the Assets section.

Note: The Assets library does not display Factopedia files (multimedia and handouts) added in a Course or Quick-Update.

The Starred files section consists of only those files which you have starred, whereas the All Files section consists of both starred and unstarred files. Both Starred and All Files can be filtered based on the Series and Module filter.

You can also filter the files by Tags that have been associated with the files.

The system locks the files of incomplete modules. When you click a locked file, the following pop-up is displayed.

You must complete the module to access the file.

You can open files part of learning objects (LOs) in modules without opening the module.

You can also view the files in multilingual series and modules in other languages, if translations are available.

Note: For a multilingual file, the system displays the file in the language last used to access it.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup > Overview of Automation suite:
Mindtickle’s Automation suite helps streamline processes, enhance productivity, and improve overall sales effectiveness. It enables you to automate repetitive and manual tasks associated with sales enablement. This includes activities such as role assignment and revocation, user management, content management, task assignment, and asset recommendation. Through integration with external applications such as Salesforce, Mindtickle’s Automation Suite provides personalized content recommendations to sales reps based on Salesforce opportunities. This helps bring the relevant deal-winning content, assets, and resources into the rep’s flow of work. Thus, ensuring that sales reps deliver the right content to prospects at the right time, engage with customers effectively, and personalize the customer experience at every stage of the buyer’s journey effectively.

Depending on your use case, you can define the qualification criteria just once and set up tasks that the system automatically performs. This ensures:

- Learners are assigned the right roles, permissions, and content at the right time.
- Reps receive just-in-time asset recommendations in SFDC.
- Admins spend less time on repetitive manual tasks.
- Faster processing and reduced turnaround time of multiple admin tasks.
- Reduced human errors and, thereby, improved efficiency.
- Minimum effort in maintaining a track record of actions that you need to perform.

Note: Automated asset recommendation in Salesforce using Automation Suite is available only upon request. Your learning site must meet the following prerequisites to enable it for your learning site:

- Asset Hub must be enabled on your learning site.
- Salesforce Opportunity Integration must be configured on your learning site.
- The most recent version of the Mindtickle app in SFDC must be installed.

For more information, contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup > Overview of Automation suite:
Mindtickle’s Automation Suite comprises Automation rules and Automation links.

From the Automation rules interface, you can:

- Use Mindtickle conditions to create user and role-based rules within Mindtickle.
- Use Salesforce conditions to create opportunity-based rules in Salesforce. Note :
  - Salesforce conditions-based rules can be created only if Automation Suite 2.0 is enabled for your learning site. For more information, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
  - You can create SFDC opportunity rules for all opportunity fields (standard and custom) configured in your Salesforce account. By default, rules can be created for the following opportunity attributes:
    - Account Industry, Account Number of Employees, Account Name, Description, Name, Owner Email, Stage, Type, Amount, Probability, Created At, Last Updated At.
  - To add custom attributes and for more information on custom mapping of fields, contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

Automation rules enable you to automate user management, content assignment, and asset recommendation tasks otherwise carried out manually.

The Automation links feature automates the task of series and module assignments for groups. It allows you to manage all your group to series and group to module linking from one place.

As an admin, you can link one or more series or modules to a group so that the group members are assigned to them automatically. Once linked, all users added to the group in the future will also be assigned the linked series or modules automatically. You can also unlink the series or modules linked with the group using Automation Links.

As an admin, you can use Automation Rules and Automation Links to automate tasks, such as:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup > Overview of Automation suite > Automation rules:
You can use automation rules to create module, group, profile, role, and opportunity-based rules. These rules are created by applying conditions on modules, groups, profile fields, or opportunities (in Salesforce) and defining actions for learners who meet the conditions.

Check out a few examples of tasks that can be automated using automation rules:

- Profile-based rule
  - If a learner’s job title is Customer Success Manager and the joining date is Jan 23, 2025, then add the learner to the CSM Training Feb’24 group.
  - You can create date-based rules for profile fields . When selecting dates for date-based rules, the Start date is included, and the End date is excluded. For more information on creating date-based rules for profile fields, see Create date-based rules .
  - For example, to add users who joined the organization between January 16, 2025, and January 31, 2025, to a specific group (America Sales), the End Date must be set to February 1, 2025. This ensures that all users who joined the organization until midnight of January 31, 2025, are automatically added to the America Sales group.

- Group-based rule If a learner is added to the group CSM Training Feb’22 , then invite the learner to the New Hire Onboarding series, which includes the following modules:
  - [Course] Company Policies
  - [Course] Platform Onboarding
  - [Course] Product Training
  - [Quick Update] Industry trends
  - [Assessment] Week 1 Checkpoint
- Module-based rules
  - If a learner’s completion status on the course Sales Enablement v/s Sales Readiness is Completed , then invite the learner to the assessment Know Your Industry .
  - If a learner’s score on the assessment Know Your Industry is less than 80%, then:
    - Invite the learner to the quick update What is the difference between Sales Enablement and Sales Readiness? AND
    - Add the learner to the group Industry Trends - Training Week 1 .
  - If a learner has received certification for the course Product Training , then invite the learner to the course Introduction to Product Marketing .
- Role-based rules
  - If a learner’s profile field Department is Sales US and designation is Manager , assign the role Manager to the learner.
  - If the learner’s profile field Designation is Site owner , assign the roles of Site owner and DSR Admin to the learner and invite the learner to the series DSR Admin Training .
  - If a learner’s profile field Department is Sales Enablement , assign the role Enablement admin to the learner.
- Opportunity-based rules
  - If the SFDC opportunity deal stage is Prospecting , then:
    - recommend (specific) assets: Introduction video , Brochures , Product Sheets , and Case Studies
    - recommend (criteria-based) assets:
      - Asset Type : PDF
      - Hubs : Hub name is ‘Prospecting Stage Hub Case Studies’ and ‘Prospecting Stage Whitepapers’
      - Attributes : Hubs tagged with the attributes ‘Customer Success Stories’

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup > Overview of Automation suite > Automation links:
With Automation Links, admins can automate series and module assignments for groups. Using this feature, you can link one or more series or modules to a group so that the existing group members are assigned to them automatically.

When you link a group to a series, existing users and users added to the group in the future are assigned to the series automatically.

While linking a group to a module, you can choose from the following options:

- Invite only users added to the group in the future Once linked, all users added to the group in the future are assigned the linked module automatically. For example, if you link the group APAC Sales to the quick update How to Sell , only learners added to the group post linking are automatically invited to the quick update How to Sell . Note : You can change this setting and invite the existing members by performing a Group sync .
- Invite existing users and users added to the group in the future Once linked, all existing users and users added to the group in the future are assigned the linked module automatically. For example, if you link the group APAC Sales to the quick update How to Sell , all existing learners and learners added to the group post linking are automatically invited to the quick update How to Sell .

For more information on how to effectively use automation links, see Automation links.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations:
This article explains how admins can integrate Call AI with the Cloudtalk dialer.

Important Note:

- Setup : To ensure the highest level of data integrity and security, this integration requires a compatibility verification step before enabling activation. As telephony providers frequently update their API standards, the Mindtickle engineering team performs a live connectivity check to ensure your instance is aligned with the latest protocols and maintains a secure, stable connection.
- Verification : Activation is not automatic; we must first verify API compatibility with your dialer version.
- Timeline : The Mindtickle team will analyze the requirements and communicate the time required to enable the integration.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > Benefits of Integration:
Call AI’s integration with Cloudtalk helps reps and managers to leverage all of Call AI’s functionalities, such as:

- Review meetings quickly (skip inactivity, speaker timeline, recording speed, search in the transcript)
- Understand latest market insights and make strategic decisions (voice of the market, refine search by word in the transcript)
- Maintain compliance (recording deletion)
- Learn from winning reps (setup role-based, best practices libraries)
- Collaborate on call recordings (add comments, view action items, share recording
- Coach on real customer interactions to help the team win more deals (use coaching forms on recordings, manager digest, call scores, CRM filters, automatic theme generation)
- Self-learn and stay up to date on field calls (extensive search, email alerts, open access of all recordings, listen to meetings on the go using the mobile app)

For more information about Call AI functionalities, see Call AI Overview.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > How the Integration Works?:
The integration works as follows:

1. Call AI fetches and processes the Cloudtalk recording and makes it available on your Call AI interface.

2. Call AI generates useful insights, themes, transcripts, and statistics for the call recording. You can perform different actions, such as sending private messages, taking notes, and sharing the recording with peers and customers. For more information, see Call Recording Details.

Note:

- As a recording name, Call AI displays the name and phone number of the registered Cloudtalk prospect. Call AI only displays the phone number if the prospect is not a registered user on Cloudtalk.
- If you delete a recorded call in Cloudtalk, the recording remains in Call AI. For more information about deleting such a recording from the Call AI interface, see Delete a Call Recording.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > Integrate Call AI with Cloudtalk > Obtain API Access Key ID and Access Key Secret from Cloudtalk:
1. Login to the Cloudtalk dashboard.

2. From the Cloudtalk dashboard, click Account > Settings > API Keys.Note: We recommend you create a new API key exclusively for Call AI and Cloudtalk integration.

3. Click the Add API Key button to generate a new API key. The new API key is added to the end of the API Keys list.

4. Click the Show option against the newly created API Key.

5. Verify the Created date and time to ensure it is the latest generated API key.

6. Copy the Access Key ID and Access Key Secret to the clipboard.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > Record a call using Cloudtalk:
Once you set appropriate permission, the reps can now record a Cloudtalk call:

1. You can place the Cloudtalk call from the browser link or a desktop app.For a detailed step-by-step process to place a Cloudtalk call, see Using Cloudtalk Phone.Note: Ensure you have enough credit to place a Cloudtalk call. For more information, see Using Cloudtalk Account Calling Credit.

2. Once a call is completed, the recording appears under Cloudtalk Dashboard > Statistics > Call history. Scroll to the Call history logs section.

3. The call recording is added to the recording list on the Call AI interface within an hour.

4. You can use Call AI’s powerful and guided search to look for a specific recording quickly. For more information about the insights available for a call recording, see Call Recording Details.

Note:

- Call AI only imports the dialer calls of users with a recorder role. For more information, see Call AI Permissions.
- Call AI does not fetch recordings with less than 10 seconds.
- Call AI does not import incoming calls on your Cloudtalk number.
- Call AI does not support Cloudtalk hold, call transfer and conference calls.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series:
As an admin, you can add certifications to a series created for learners in your organization. Certifications allow you to create a specific learning path within the series. The learners who complete the certification path earn a certificate.

For each series, you can set up certification criteria to evaluate the performance of the invited learners. Using this feature, you can add rules to evaluate automatically invited learners’ progress on the modules added in the series, award certifications to learners who fulfill the criteria, and trigger recertifications for eligible learners. You can configure the settings so the certificate is always valid or only for a certain period. You can define the recertification settings and criteria based on the certificate's validity. You can also configure certificate sharing to LinkedIn so that once learners complete the certification, they can add it to their LinkedIn profile directly from Mindtickle.

Note:

- Only admins with Manage series permissions can add series certifications. This permission is available to the site owner role by default.
- You can add up to 70 certifications to a series.

This article further explains how to:

- Add certification to a series
- Define certification criteria
- Select a certificate template
- Select an email template
- Define certificate validity
- Define recertification settings
- Configure certificate sharing to LinkedIn

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series > Add certification to a series:
To add certifications:

1. On the admin site homepage, click Training on the left navigation panel and select Series . The Series page is displayed.
2. Select the series to add a certificate
3. On the series page, click Settings > Certifications > Add certification to series . Note : If certifications are added, the Certifications tab lists all certificates that exist. To add a new certification, click Add certification .
4. The New certification panel appears. Enter the Certification name and Description . Adding a description is optional. However, it is recommended as a best practice. The name and description should ideally give a brief overview of the certification. This provides learners a quick preview of what learners will accomplish once they achieve the certification. Note : The character limit for the certification name is 100 characters.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series > Define certification criteria:
You can select conditions and define rules to automatically evaluate the learners’ performance on the modules added to the series. You can create rules based on the user’s group, the Status of module, and the Score of module.

- In Select condition, define the certification rule. You can add a maximum of 20 rule conditions. For more information on the different conditions, see Conditions and actions in automation rules .

The following conditions are available:

- Status on module : This condition is based on the learner’s module completion status . Since each module has different status types, the value changes based on module types. For example, the status values for a course are In Progress and Completed . But, for an assessment, the status values are In Progress , Passed , and Failed .
- Score on module : This condition is based on the learner's module score. For example, if the certification score is 80/100 for a module. Leaners’ should score 80 or above to be eligible for certification.
- Added to group : This condition automatically executes actions for a group. You can use this option to assign certifications to specific groups, ensuring only designated group members can see and earn the certification. You can add a maximum of 10 groups.

You can choose whether the condition should apply if all or at least one of the rule criteria is met. The following options are available:

- AND clause: The rule is applicable only if the learner meets all conditions in the rule.
- OR clause: The rule is applicable if the learner meets at least one of the rule conditions in the rule.
chunks.body:
You can select conditions and define rules to automatically evaluate the learners’ performance on the modules added to the series. You can create rules based on the user’s group, the Status of module, and the Score of module.

- In Select condition, define the certification rule. You can add a maximum of 20 rule conditions. For more information on the different conditions, see Conditions and actions in automation rules .

The following conditions are available:

- Status on module : This condition is based on the learner’s module completion status . Since each module has different status types, the value changes based on module types. For example, the status values for a course are In Progress and Completed . But, for an assessment, the status values are In Progress , Passed , and Failed .
- Score on module : This condition is based on the learner's module score. For example, if the certification score is 80/100 for a module. Leaners’ should score 80 or above to be eligible for certification.
- Added to group : This condition automatically executes actions for a group. You can use this option to assign certifications to specific groups, ensuring only designated group members can see and earn the certification. You can add a maximum of 10 groups.

You can choose whether the condition should apply if all or at least one of the rule criteria is met. The following options are available:

- AND clause: The rule is applicable only if the learner meets all conditions in the rule.
- OR clause: The rule is applicable if the learner meets at least one of the rule conditions in the rule.

chunks.title: Add series certifications

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series > Define certification criteria > Caveats:
- By default, the AND clause is selected. All conditions added to the rule must be met for it to be applicable. You can change it to the OR clause if required.
- You cannot use the Added to group condition with OR clauses. When selecting Added to group as the rule condition, all OR clauses in the rule change to AND clauses.
- When creating a series certificate, if you select Added to group as the certification criteria, learners will see only the certificate specific to their group on the learning site. For example, if a series has three certificates, one of which is configured for a specific group. Although the series has three certificates, learners from the specific group see only one certificate for that series on the learning site.
- You can create multiple certifications within the same series for different groups.
- If a module is moved or archived, a message highlights that the certification is inactive. To reactivate the certification, you should modify the Certification criteria .

The certification is awarded to learners if they meet the criteria.

For example, in the screenshot below, the certification criteria are:

Award certification if the learner’s:

- score on the course module Sales Enablement is equal to 100% AND
- The status on the assessment module Sales Enablement v/s Sales Readiness is Passed You can define the certification criteria by adding multiple modules in the same rule condition or combining multiple individual rule conditions. Note : Only modules that are part of the series can be added to the certification criteria. For more information, see Create a new rule , module score of a learner , and module status of a learner .

1. Click the Edit icon on the Email template to customize the emails sent to learners for series certificate completion.

The Select email template screen is displayed.

2. You can search for existing series email templates in the Search.Note: You can also disable the series certification email sent to learners by selecting None.

3. You can filter the displayed email templates using the following filter options:

- All categories: All email templates are displayed.
- Completion: The module completion email templates are displayed.
- Digest: The notification digest email templates are displayed.
- ILT Session Notification: The ILT session notification email templates are displayed.
- Invitation: The module invitation email templates are displayed.
- Module Update: The emails sent to learners when a module is updated and published are displayed.
- Others: The other category email templates are displayed.
- Reminder: The module reminder email templates are displayed.

The series certification email templates can also be filtered by usage, ascending, or descending alphabetical order.

Click Manage email templates on the learning site to view all available default email templates. For more information on the default email templates, see Account settings > Email templates.

4. Select a series certificate email template from the left pane to customize.

5. Click Edit template.

The selected series certification email template is displayed.

6. Click Save as copy to create a copy of the selected template.

Note: If you do not make a copy of the template, the default email template is modified. It is recommended to create a copy of a default email template before making changes.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series > Define certificate validity:
- In the Certificate Validity section dropdown, click the dropdown and select the certificate’s validity period. This is the duration of validity for the certification. The validity applies from the day the certificate is awarded to the learner. By default, it is Always Valid . You can change it to a different duration by selecting any of the following options:

- 3 months
- 6 months
- 9 months
- 12 months (1 year)
- 24 months (2 years)
- 36 months (3 years)
- 48 months (4 years)

Note:

- It is recommended to add an expiry date to the certification, so the validity of the certificate is maintained.
- Once the validity is over, the certificate expires. Learners can recertify on the series if recertification is enabled.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series > Define recertification settings:
- To enable recertification for learners in the series, turn the Recertification toggle ON .
- Recertification lets learners renew their series certificate within a defined renewal period. Learners must meet the original certification criteria again to earn the certificate. Select the recertification version
- In the Recertification version , select which module version learners must complete during recertification. The following options are available:
  - The version they were invited to: Learners recertify on the same module version they were originally invited to. This is the default option.
  - The latest version: Learners recertify on the latest available version of supported modules.

Use The latest version when learners must complete the most recent module content during recertification.Note: Only the course, quick update, checklist, and assessment modules support the latest version recertification.The recertification setting applies only after the learner’s series certificate expires. It does not affect active certifications that are already in progress.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series > Define recertification settings > Set the recertification period:
- In the Recertification period , specify when learners can renew their certificates. By default, learners can recertify from 15 days before the certificate expires to 30 days after . You can set the recertification period up to 1000 months after the certificate expires. For example, if recertification starts 15 days before the certificate expires and ends 30 days after, learners can reattempt the certification during this period.
  - If learners do not meet the recertification criteria before the recertification period ends, they are no longer eligible for recertification. If required, you can manually award the certification to learners. For more information, see How can I manually award or revoke series certifications?
  - If recertification is enabled for a certification, learners receive an email notification when the recertification period begins and ends.

Note:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series > Define recertification settings > Set the recertification period:
- Recertification on a series is disabled if the certification validity is Always valid .
- Learners must meet the original certification criteria to be eligible for recertification.
- The recertification version setting applies at the series certificate level.
- Different series certificates can have different recertification version settings.
- The selected recertification version applies to all supported modules in the series certificate.
- Admins cannot select a different recertification version for each module in the same series certificate.
- Recertification does not apply to modules such as quest, coaching, and instructor-led training (ILT) because these modules do not support version-based learner movement.
- Click Save and activate to save the certification and activate it immediately. If you click Save and activate , the certification is available for all learners and is automatically awarded to learners who meet the criteria. Alternatively, click Save to save the certification and activate it later. To discard the certification, click Cancel .
- The saved certification is added to the Certifications tab on the Settings page. The certificate appears in the Active or Inactive state, depending on your action in the previous step. If the certification is Active , learners who meet the criteria are automatically awarded the certificate. Learners receive an email notification (with the certificate attached) once the certification is awarded. Note :
  - If a learner has already met the certification criteria in the past (before the certification was activated), the certification is not awarded to that learner.
  - You can manually award a certificate to a learner. For more information, see How can I manually award or revoke series certifications?
  - Once a learner is awarded the certification and it is valid, they are not re-evaluated, even if the certification criteria change.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > User Management > Roles and Permissions:
With roles and permissions on the Mindtickle platform, you can regulate your users' access to the platform based on the type of activities they can perform. This ensures that each user can only access necessary and relevant feature capabilities and platform data. It also ensures that users do not have access to features that they don't need, minimizing the chances of errors and issues of users interfering with each other’s work.

For more information on the standard/default Mindtickle roles and their permissions, see Roles and permissions in Mindtickle.

In addition to the standard/default Mindtickle roles, you can create a custom role of your choice with the help of your Customer Success Manager (CSM). A custom role can have a variety of permissions across different features and functionalities on the platform. By assigning a combination of permissions to a custom role, they can get access to specific features and functionalities on the platform.

With a custom role, you can assign multiple permissions to a user to extend their access. For example, a user who has the manager role can also be assigned a content expert role by creating a new user who has all permissions of the manager and content expert roles. Similarly, a user that develops content may not need access to security settings. This user can exclusively be assigned the role of a content expert, restricting their access to only creating and editing content.

To guide you best in creating custom roles, this article lists example custom roles along with their recommended permissions. The custom roles described below are examples to illustrate how you might combine permissions. They are not predefined Mindtickle roles — you can create your own roles with any combination of permissions to suit your needs.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > User Management > Roles and Permissions > About limited/scoped access:
This section explains what is limited or scoped access for a permission.

You can provide scoped or limited access to a user by making them a collaborator, which grants them various collaborator-level permissions that you can also modify.

You can add collaborators on series, groups, assets (in Asset Hub), and files/folders (in Content Center). A collaborator can access only the specific series, groups, assets, and files/folders to which they are added as a collaborator. Moreover, they can only access the particular functionalities in each (series, groups, etc.) for which permissions are assigned. For example, if you add a collaborator to a series with only the Manage Series, Assign Content, and Series Reports permissions, they can only perform the following actions: manage the series, assign content, and view series analytics reports.

Note: A collaborator’s access to modules is governed through series. You cannot make someone a collaborator at a module level. When you make someone a collaborator on a series, they get access to all modules of the series.

- Content developer
- Third-party vendor

These roles are meant for using the overall platform, and not for a solution on the platform, such as Asset Hub. For each role, the table provides the following information:

- Specific permissions that you should assign to the role
- Level of access you should grant to the role for each permission

Help & Support > Help Center Home > User Management > Roles and Permissions > Example: Asset Hub custom roles:
This section provides information on the following example custom roles for Asset Hub — Mindtickle’s sales content management solution.

- Asset Hub Site Owner: Owner of the entire Asset Hub platform along with the licenses. Usually, it is the Enablement VP/Enablement Director in the organization.
- Asset Hub Site Owner (S): Owner of the standalone instance of Asset Hub without the core readiness capabilities. Usually, it is the Enablement VP/Enablement Director.
- Asset Hub Admin: Admins of Asset Hub who would create and manage the hubs and the rep experience. Usually, it is the VP of Product Marketing Manager (PMM) and Sales Enablement Manager.
- Asset Curator: SMEs, content developers, and content contributors in the organization. Usually, it is the content experts, PMMs, PMs, and Ops.

You need to assign a mix of Asset Hub, Content Center, platform, and analytics permissions to each role.

For each role, the table provides the following information:

- Specific permissions that you should assign to the role
- Level of access you should grant to the role for each permission

For each permission, the table also provides the technical name of the permission. For example, the “Manage Hubs” permission’s technical name is HUB_MANAGEMENT.

For a permission, a role can have one of the following levels of access:

Full = Universal and complete access Scoped = Limited or scoped access None = No access

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup:
Mindtickle allows you to create custom-branded certificates that you can award learners upon successful completion of series-level certifications.

This article explains how you can manage certificate templates by performing the following actions:

- Create a certificate template
- Edit a certificate template
- Activate a certificate template
- Duplicate a certificate template
- Deactivate a certificate template
- Delete a certificate template
- View certificate usage
- Filter certificate templates
- Sort certificate templates

Your role and assigned permissions determine your ability to manage certificate templates. You can manage the templates if:

- Your role is that of a site owner .
- Your role is other than that of a site owner, but your role has the MANAGE_CERTIFICATES permission. Note :
  - The MANAGE_CERTIFICATES permission is available to the site owner role by default.
  - To create a custom role for a user and grant them the required permissions, contact Mindtickle Support .

To manage certificate templates:

1. On the admin site home page, click Training and select certificate templates on the sidebar. The certificate templates page allows you to view and manage all existing certificate templates and their details. You can choose from the pre-built templates available by default, create a new template from scratch, or duplicate existing templates. You can also publish and activate, deactivate, filter, sort, and delete certificates. This article further explains how you can perform each of these actions from the certificate templates page.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup > Edit a certificate template:
You can edit an existing certificate template by changing its background image, updating its design layout, and changing the customizable elements on it. You can edit both active as well as inactive certificates.

To edit a certificate:

1. Click More options and select Edit . Alternatively, click anywhere on the certificate row. The certificate template canvas appears. Make the required changes. For more information, see Create a certificate template . The template is auto-saved and remains in the Draft state unless published. Note : When updating an active certificate, you can click Discard changes to undo the unsaved changes. This option is not available when editing a certificate that is in the Draft state. If the certificate has unpublished changes, it is indicated by a red dot on the Certificate templates page.
2. To publish the changes and activate the certificate, click Publish .

The certificate design is updated successfully, and the new design is available for use across all series certifications.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup > Deactivate a certificate template:
If you want to temporarily stop using a certificate template, you can deactivate it. You can deactivate only those certificates that are in the Draft state. You cannot deactivate a certificate if it is used in any series certification. If you try to deactivate a certificate that is used in any series certification, a pop-up displays on the screen with information about the certificate’s usage across series certifications.

To return to the Certificates templates page, click Okay, got it.

To deactivate a certificate:

1. Click More options and select Deactivate .
2. Click Deactivate in the pop-up.

A confirmation message appears once the certificate is deactivated successfully and the certificate’s status changes to Inactive.

Note: Deactivated certificates cannot be used for any of the series certifications.

You can delete a certificate template if it is no longer required.

1. Click More options and select Delete .

A confirmation message appears once the certificate is deleted successfully. It is no longer available for use in any series certifications.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > Site Setup > Filter certificate templates:
You can filter the certificate templates and narrow your search if you want to access a particular template. So, instead of searching through an extensive list. You can filter the templates by template status and template creator.

To apply a filter:

1. On the Certificates templates page, click the Status dropdown and select the value from the available options. You can select multiple values. Alternatively, click the Created by dropdown and select the value from the available options. You can select multiple values.
2. Click Apply . The list is displayed according to the applied filters.
3. Alternatively, enter the certificate's name in the Search field to quickly access the certificate template you are looking for.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin:
This article explains the hub overview page and how it helps admins provide an overview of what the hub is all about, the assets it contains, and the assets’ usability in the context of the learners or sales reps.

You can create and design the overview page for each hub displaying a specific message regarding the hub. It also highlights the assets within a hub and their relative applicability in deals with prospects and customers.

The hub overview page conveys the maximum capability of the hub and the assets available within, that reps can use to win deals. The feature allows you to logically group all available assets and govern the access control so that the reps are exposed only to the essential assets in the sales journey.

The hub overview page enables you to:

- Provide a clear context behind each hub and its associated assets.
- Create an immersive experience of the hub.
- Govern the access control of reps to only the assets they need in their sales journey.
- Help reps quickly identify the relevant and important assets during their pitch call with a prospect or customer.
- Set a preferential order of assets based on the relative applicability of a deal or business context.
- Communicate the changes and modifications to a hub seamlessly, allowing reps access to the latest and updated assets.

Note: Asset Hub is a paid feature, and the overview page is enabled by default for all customers who have purchased Asset Hub. For more information, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
