chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > FAQs > Access Mindtickle content from a third-party application:
When you access Mindtickle content from a CMS such as Seismic or Highspot, you are automatically redirected to the SSO provider’s login page.

While the SSO provider’s login page opens in a new tab, a transition page appears in the iframe (previous tab).

Note:

- The flow continues in the same tab and displays the transition screen if pop-ups are blocked on your site. To continue logging in, click Sign In to Mindtickle . You are then redirected to the SSO provider’s login page in a new tab.
- To ensure users are redirected to the SSO provider’s login page in a new tab during future login sessions, allow pop-ups on your browser. For more information, see how to allow pop-ups in Chrome , Safari , Firefox , and Edge .

Once you log in to the SSO provider (in the new tab), the following actions occur:

1. The tab closes automatically.
2. You are redirected back to the previous tab.
3. You are logged in to the Mindtickle site, and the Mindtickle content opens in the Seismic or Highspot iframe (in the previous tab).

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Setup > FAQs > Caveats:
- The flow of opening the SSO provider login page in a new tab applies to only the following:
  - Google SSO
  - SAML-based SSO (for example, Okta and Azure)
  - Salesforce SSO
- Other SSO flows, such as JWT, and OpenID, continue to work as is - the user is redirected to the SSO provider’s login page in the same tab.
- When logging in through SSO in the browser ( normal or private/incognito mode ), ensure the browser Allows all cookies . For example, see Google Chrome settings in the screenshot below.
- If the cookies are disabled on the browser, you will not be able to log in through SSO and receive the following error. In this case, when logging in through SSO in the browser’s private or incognito mode , ensure the browser’s third-party cookies are enabled. For example, see Google Chrome settings in the screenshot below.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Managers and Reviewers > Mobile app > Accessing the Coaching Rooms (reviewer dashboard) on mobile:
1. Sign in to the Mindtickle mobile app and tap the Coaching icon on the bottom navigation bar.

You will see one or more of the following tabs based on your role.

1. Coach others: This tab is displayed if you are a reviewer.
2. Self review: This tab is displayed if you are a learner, and self-review- enabled Coaching Sessions are assigned to you.
3. View coaching feedback: This tab is displayed if you are a learner and are invited to a Coaching Session with a reviewer assigned to you or if you have received feedback for the Coaching Sessions.

For more information on the Self review and View coaching feedback, see Coaching Rooms for Learners.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > Accessing the Coaching Rooms (learner dashboard) on mobile:
1. Sign in to the Mindtickle mobile app and tap the Coaching icon on the bottom navigation bar.

You will see one or more of the following tabs based on your role.

1. Coach others: This tab is displayed if you are a reviewer. For more information on the Coach others tab, see Coaching Rooms for Reviewers.
2. Self review: This tab is displayed if you are a learner, and self-review-enabled Coaching Sessions are assigned to you.
3. View coaching feedback: This tab is displayed if you are a learner and are invited to a Coaching Session with a reviewer assigned to you or if you have received feedback for the Coaching Sessions.

This tab is displayed if you are a learner and self-review-enabled Coaching Sessions are assigned to you. Here are all the details and actions you can perform from the Self review tab.

This dashboard is divided into three sections:

- Recently assigned
- Resume sessions
- View All Sessions

Note: The Recently assigned and Resume sessions widgets are displayed based on the data of your learning site. Example: If you do not have unfinished self-review Coaching Sessions in the last 30 days, then the Resume sessions widget is not displayed.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Mobile App > View coaching feedback > Upcoming Sessions:
This widget displays the upcoming Coaching Session for the next 30 days.

The widget thumbnail displays up to three Coaching Sessions in the order of occurrence. The recent upcoming session is displayed first, followed by the others.

If more than three upcoming Coaching Sessions are scheduled in the next 30 days, if more than two Coaching Sessions are assigned in the last 30 days, you will see an arrow icon. Tap the arrow icon to see all the upcoming Coaching Sessions in the next 30 days in the order of occurrence.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms:
Before you publish and share a room, you can decide if you want to remind contacts that a room was shared with them. You can configure automated reminder emails for your contacts.

Note: Updating room settings post-publishing remains an option. However, updating reminder settings post-publishing requires careful attention. Suppose reminders are turned off, the room is shared, and reminders are later turned on (in that sequence), then contacts do not receive reminder emails. However, subsequent room shares (after reminder settings are turned on) include reminder emails. So, all contacts with whom the room is shared henceforth receive reminder emails.

To turn the reminder emails on:

1. Navigate to the room, click Room settings, and then select Access options.
2. In the Access options screen, turn the Remind contacts who haven’t visited toggle ON .
3. Switch the Verify email with PIN toggle to ON if you want viewers to verify their identity using the 6-digit PIN sent to their email address.
4. Click Save Changes . Once this setting is enabled, 3 reminder emails spaced 3 days apart are sent to contacts who have not visited the room. The 3-day countdown begins once the contact is added to the room or the room link is shared with the contact. If the room link is shared with an additional contact, the 3-day countdown begins at the time the link was shared.

Here is a sample email reminder.

Note: Email reminders are not sent if:

- A contact has already visited a room.
- A contact has already received 3 reminder emails.
- A contact is removed from the room.
- The room has expired or is disabled or deleted.
- Reminders are disabled for that room.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms:
As a Digital Sales Room (DSR) admin, you can configure general settings per your organizational needs. This gives the users (admins and sales reps) the flexibility to use DSRs exactly how they want. It not only adds a personal touch for every user but also enables them to use DSRs to cater to their specific needs.

For more information on browser support, see Browsers supported for Digital Sales Rooms (DSR).

You can configure the following organization-level settings for DSRs:

- Company Profile
- Room Options
- Image Gallery
- Notifications *
- Integrations
- Permissions

*Available only if DSR is integrated with a CRM tool.

For more information on how to configure teams in DSRs, see How can I set up teams in DSRs?

Perform the following steps to configure the organization-level settings for DSRs:

1. On the admin site homepage, click Rooms and select Settings. Note: Access to DSRs is restricted if you use a browser set to private or incognito mode. In this case, open a new browser window, not in private mode, and try again. The Digital Sales Rooms Settings page appears.
2. From the left navigation panel, select an option based on the settings you want to configure. The respective tab opens.

This article further explains each setting in detail.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Company Profile:
The Company Profile section serves as a centralized hub for managing essential account details and permissions. It provides a snapshot of your organization’s vital information, such as the name, address, and contact details. Administrators or authorized users can also configure various permissions related to the organization's account from the Company Profile section.

Note: Any changes you make on this page are applicable only to Digital Sales Rooms and its features. The changes do not impact or get reflected in other parts of Mindtickle.

As an admin, you can manage the following account details from this page:

- Logo Upload or update your company logo. The logo appears in your account, rooms, and links.
- Organization Name Enter or update the name of your organization. This name is the official name associated with the account.
- Website Enter or confirm your website details. Clicking on your company logo in a room or a link directs visitors to this website.
- Address Enter your company’s physical location details.
- Phone number Enter your company’s primary contact number. This serves as a direct line of communication for inquiries and support.
- Email Domains Add any email domains used by your organization. Note :
  - If your account is integrated with a CRM and configured to automatically create contacts, the system does not create a contact if the email domain of the room visitor matches any of these specified domains. Additionally, the system does not log the activity of this contact to the CRM.
  - Basic account details such as organization name and email domains (with @mindtickle.com) are auto-populated during the sign-up process.

You can also manage the following settings from this page:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Company Profile:
- First-time admins (accessing the DSR tab on the admin site homepage for the first time) must click Yes on the Automatic content enrichment pop-up. Note : If you close the pop-up without selecting ( Yes / No ), the automatic contact enrichment feature remains disabled for your organization. Until you select a response on the pop-up, it reappears each time you access the DSR tab from the admin site homepage.
- Returning admins (who selected No on the pop-up) can toggle the setting from the Company Profile page. When you hover over the toggle switch, the pop-up displays the details of who made the most recent selection decision and when. Note :
  - This setting is configured at the organization level. If a DSR admin enables it, it is enabled for all users in the organization.
  - By default, the feature is disabled for new Mindtickle DSR customers (who opt for DSRs post the launch of this feature). For existing Mindtickle DSR customers, the setting will remain as is.
    - If it was disabled before the feature release, it will remain disabled.
    - If it was enabled before the feature release, it will remain enabled.
  - DSR admins can disable the feature at any time.
- Additionally, if your DSR account is integrated with a CRM, this feature ensures users have access to enriched CRM contact data, too. For users to receive enriched CRM contact data, ensure:
  - Your DSR account is integrated with a CRM. For more information, see Integrate Digital Sales Rooms with Salesforce , Integrate Digital Sales Rooms with Pipedrive , Integrate Digital Sales Rooms with Microsoft Dynamics 365 , or Integrate Digital Sales Rooms with HubSpot .
  - Enable the setting Create new contacts for unmatching emails while setting up the integration. See the reference image below .

From this tab, you can set up the colors, fonts, and default banner image for your room.

- Under COLORS , choose:
  - a primary color for the primary buttons
  - a secondary color for secondary buttons and links
  - a color for section header icons
- Under FONTS , choose the fonts that apply to headlines and regular text. Tip : Consult your Marketing team about the font and weight (normal, bold). Customer Success teams can also help you determine this if needed.
- Under BANNER IMAGE , set the default banner that is applied for all new rooms. If you create a room using a template, it will use the template banner image. Users can also customize the banner at the room level. To preview the room layout or change the default colors, font, and banner image options, click Customize . Alternatively, hover over the section (Colors, Fonts, or Banner Image) and click Edit . On the Customize Room page, update the room design options in the left navigation panel. Tip :
  - Switch the Autopick other colors to ON to have the system choose the secondary and icon colors for you. Once you complete making the changes, click Done on the top right corner of the page. You are redirected to the Room Options tab. Click Save changes to save the applied changes.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Options > Content Downloads:
Configure whether room visitors can download the content shared in rooms. If the Allow viewers to download content switch is ON, room visitors can download all content shared in rooms by default. Room owners can also change this setting at the content level. For more information, see Configure download option for content shared in DSRs.

Note: This setting applies only to rooms that users create after the Allow viewers to download content switch is ON and not to existing rooms.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Options > Privacy Policy:
Configure the privacy policy you would prefer to display to your rooms’ visitors. You can display Mindtickle’s privacy policy or your company’s privacy policy. By default, Mindtickle’s privacy policy is selected.

Click View to view Mindtickle’s privacy policy. It opens in a new tab in your browser.

To configure your preferred privacy policy:

1. Select Your privacy policy .
2. Enter your privacy policy name and URL.
3. Hover over the Help icon to preview the privacy policy name and how it appears in the consent prompt. Note : The privacy policy name in the preview is an example and does not change based on the value entered in the Privacy Policy Name field.
4. Click Save changes .

The updated privacy policy reflects in all the DSRs. Additionally, all visitors (in the EU region, see Geo-target Consent Request) to shared rooms receive an updated entry prompt, which includes the custom privacy policy.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Options > Privacy Policy > Geo-target Consent Request:
Mindtickle tracks DSR visitors and their information, such as active time on the website, time spent on each page of the documents, location data, and email address. Select room visitors (to shared rooms) from which region should receive an entry prompt with additional privacy information and a consent request.

By default, the selection is set to the EU region only. This means, all visitors to shared rooms in the EU region will receive an updated entry prompt with additional privacy information and a consent request. If you would like to show this prompt to all visitors regardless of location, select All geographies.

Click Preview to view the consent prompt and its appearance to room visitors.

Note:

- Room visitors may view the consent request based on their location and existing cookies.
- Admins can view the activity of room visitors in DSRs.
- Admins cannot customize the message displayed in the We value your privacy pop-up.

Click Continue to save the updates.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Options > Block email domains:
You can block specific email domains to restrict access to your DSRs.

By blocking access, you can ensure:

- Competitor exclusion By blocking competitors' email domains, you can ensure that sensitive information about deals, strategies, or internal processes does not fall into the wrong hands.
- Work email enforcement Organizations often prefer prospects use their official work emails rather than personal ones for professional tasks. This is to maintain professionalism, ensure proper communication tracking, and abide by company policies. With this feature, organizations can enforce the use of work email domains to access DSRs by blocking common personal email domains, such as gmail.com and yahoo.com .
- Unauthorized access alert Despite the precautions, there might be instances where unauthorized individuals attempt to access a DSR. With this feature, the system alerts the DSR owner and the collaborators whenever such an attempt is made. This allows you to monitor who is trying to access your DSRs and take necessary action, such as granting access if the attempt was legitimate or investigating further in case of suspicious activity.

To block email domains:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Options > Block email domains:
1. Navigate to the Block email domains section and enter the domains you wish to block. You can add domains manually (separated by a comma, enter, or space), click Add all personal email domains to select all available domains or choose from the list.
2. Click Save changes to confirm. The list of blocked email domains is updated. You may edit this list at any time. Note : To ensure access to DSRs is restricted for blocked email domains, enable the Require email to view setting in Room settings . For more information, see Configure default room settings: Access Options . When the Require email to view setting is enabled, users trying to access the DSR are prompted to enter their email address. If the entered email domain is on the blocked list, the user is denied access, and the DSR owner or collaborator is notified of the unauthorized access attempt. However, when the Require email to view setting is disabled, users can access the DSR without providing an email address. In this scenario, the Blocked email domains feature becomes non-functional as there are no email addresses to check against the blocked domains list.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Options > Section Headers:
Sections are strategic parts of a room under which users can structure sales content. By default, seven organization section headers are available. They allow admins to provide a list of recommended section header names when users are adding new sections in a room.

To edit the existing headers, click and update the details.

Note: Updates to existing section headers affect all existing rooms currently using them.

To add a new section header, click + Add Section Header. In the Add Section Header pop-up, enter the section header name. To add an icon, select from the available options or upload a new image and click Add.

Note: You can create section headers at the room level. However, using headers provided by default, helps provide consistency across multiple rooms and makes it easy to know which sections to include.

Section headers can be ordered in a meaningful way (such as how the sections should appear within a room or by what is most popular). To change the order of the section, select it and drag and drop it.

Note:

- The color of the section header icons is set in the Settings > Room Options section.
- If you want to upload custom icons, we recommend 64x64 for the size.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Options > Sales Actions:
Sales Actions allow you to create call-to-action buttons that can be easily added to rooms in a prominent location. These actions can provide next steps for buyers to advance the deal by including links such as a G2 review page or to sign up for your solution now. For actions that would be specific to an individual user (such as a link to a calendar tool) or links that would be used in just a single room (a link to review and sign a contract), users can create and edit Personal Sales Actions while building rooms.

If your users create links to their own calendar tool, you can remove the Schedule a Call button by toggling this off. This button allows visitors to alert a room owner that they are interested in a call and prompts the visitor to share their availability for a meeting with the room owner.

To add a new Sales Action, click Add More and enter the details (Target URL, Button Text, and Internal Description) for the action.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Image Gallery > Add banner images:
Banner images are used while creating Digital Sales Rooms or room templates. The banner reflects your company, target industry, or even your prospect or customer.

To add, edit, or delete a banner image from the image gallery:

1. On the Image Gallery tab, click Banner Images and click + Add Banner .
2. Select the image downloaded on your system and upload it. Crop the banner image as needed for display. The new image is added successfully to the Image Gallery . Note : The recommended dimensions are 1240 x 240 px.
3. Click the Edit icon on the image to edit it.
4. Click Upload New to upload a new image.
5. Select the new image from your system and upload it. Crop the banner image as needed for display. The existing image is successfully replaced with the new image. Note : Uploading a new image replaces the original image everywhere it is currently used.
6. Click the Delete icon to delete the image from the Image Gallery .
7. Click Delete in the pop-up that appears. The image is successfully deleted from the Image Gallery . Note : Deleting this image will remove it from the Image Gallery ; it will not remove the image from anywhere it is currently used.

Cover images are used as thumbnails for the content in rooms and room templates. Thumbnails can provide a visual preview of the content, helping to tell a story and set the context before the user engages with the full piece of content.

To add, edit, or delete cover thumbnail images from the image gallery, on the Image Gallery tab, click Cover Images and follow the same steps mentioned under the Add banner images section.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Notifications > Configure room visitor email notification settings:
Choose which name is displayed in the From name and Reply-to fields in system-generated emails sent to prospective buyers.

Select:

- User name | User email If the sales rep’s name should be displayed in the From and Reply-to fields. As the prospective buyer has a relationship with the sales rep, they are more likely to recognize and trust emails that come from a familiar and identifiable source, thus creating a sense of personal connection. Note : The From and Reply-to email is the same to ensure that recipients' replies go to the rep whose name is displayed in the email. The sender email is not changed.
- Admin | admin.mindtickle.com If Admin should be displayed in the From and Reply-to fields.

By default, room visitor email notifications come from Admin, and replies are sent to admin@mindtickle.com.

Under CRM, you can integrate DSRs with your HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, or Microsoft Dynamics 365 account to pull in sales data.

For more information, see:

- Integrate DSR with Salesforce
- Integrate DSR with HubSpot
- Integrate DSR with Pipedrive
- Integrate DSR with Microsoft Dynamics 365

Once connected, this is where you will see the status of prior sync events and be able to initiate a manual sync of the data if needed. You will also see the Configure option to determine which activities should be synced back into your CRM.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Permissions:
Define org-level permissions to manage and regulate your reps’ view and edit access to digital sales rooms. This ensures they have appropriate access to perform their job responsibilities, minimizes the risk of unauthorized access, and prevents the misuse of resources.

Based on your organization’s requirements, choose a permission set from the following:

|  | Edit | View |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Set I | All rooms | All rooms |
| Set II | My rooms | All rooms |
| Set III | My rooms | My rooms |

Note: My rooms are rooms where the rep is the owner or a collaborator.

For more information on how each permission set impacts the reps' access to digital sales rooms and the content within them, see Manage DSR access for reps.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms:
With a Digital Sales Room (DSR), you can create a collaborative, organized, and customized buying experience for your prospects. You can create rooms not just for your prospects, but also for:

- Internal training initiatives
- New employee onboarding
- Customer onboarding and account management
- Top-of-funnel marketing content
- Investment opportunities

For a video overview of Digital Sales Rooms for reps, see Digital Sales Rooms - For Reps.

This article further explains how you can:

- Create a room
- Preview, save, publish, and share a room

Note:

- It is possible to create a room without adding a deal.
- You can create only one room for a deal. However, editing a room (created by you and associated with other deals) and all its content and configurations is possible.
- When creating a new room, it is also possible to choose a deal that already has a room and edit the content within it. However, if the view and edit access under organization permissions are restricted to My Rooms, the deals associated with rooms owned by others (reps other than you) are unavailable for selection. For more information, see Manage DSR access for reps . Although this is possible, it is recommended that you make informed decisions and take the necessary precautions before doing so.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Create a room > Create a room using a room template:
To create a room using a room template:

1. Sign in to the learning site.
2. Click Rooms in the left navigation bar, and then select Templates Or In the Rooms page, click Browse templates. The Templates page is displayed.
3. On the Templates page, click Select on the template you want to use to create the room.
4. Follow steps 4 to 6 mentioned in Create a room from scratch . The room is created. Since it is built based on the content and room settings configured in the template, the room is an exact replica of the room template. You can edit the room configurations based on your preferences. While creating the room, configure the Room settings : Access options , Notifications , Layout , and Room thumbnail . While publishing the room, the Confirm room settings pop-up screen is displayed. For more information, see steps 7 and 8 mentioned in Create a room from scratch .
5. Click Create room link after selecting the necessary options. The room is published. From here, you can share it with your prospects, go back to editing the room, or go back to your rooms.

The room is displayed on the rooms listing page. For more information on the actions you can perform on a room from the Rooms page, see More actions on DSRs.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Create a room > Create a room from scratch:
1. Sign in to Mindtickle and navigate to the learning site.
2. On the learning site homepage, click Rooms in the left navigation panel, and then select Rooms . The Rooms page is displayed. If you have not created any rooms yet, the page is blank. If you have already created rooms, they are listed on this page. Note : By default, the Rooms filter is set to:
  - My Rooms for reps. This view displays all rooms in which the rep is an owner or a collaborator. To view other rooms, select All Rooms from the Rooms dropdown.
  - All Rooms for admins. This view displays all rooms that are created on your DSR instance.
3. Click Create room .
4. You are directed to the Create Sales Room page. If you have a connected CRM, you can search for a deal or company in the search bar and link it to your DSR. You can also create a room without selecting a deal or company. From the search field, you can access all the data that was pulled into DSR since the most recent auto-sync. If you just created an opportunity, you can perform a manual sync. For more information, see Integrate Digital Sales Rooms with Salesforce or Integrate Digital Sales Rooms with HubSpot . Note :
  - If the view and edit access under organization permissions are restricted to My Rooms , the deals associated with rooms owned by others (reps other than you) are not available for selection at this point. For more information, see Manage DSR access for reps .
  - It is recommended to integrate DSR with a CRM as it is important to ensure any data can be matched back into your CRM so you can see activities on opportunity/deal, contact, and company/account records as well as for analytics.
  - When a room is linked to a Company , its activities are recorded in the Account object in Salesforce.
  - If a room is linked to both a Deal and a Company , its activities are recorded in the Opportunity object in Salesforce.
5. To create a room without selecting a deal or company, click Skip .
6. Click + Create in the Deal field to create a new deal.
7. Enter the deal name, amount, and company name, and click Continue . You can also create a company and link it to the deal.
8. To add a company to the room, click + Create in the Company field. The Create company pop-up is displayed.
9. In the Company name field, enter the company’s name and select it. If it is a new company, click Add as new? The system creates the new company and links it to the deal. Note:
  - You can link multiple deals and rooms to a company.
  - You can create a room with just a company.
  - If a deal is associated with a company, the system auto-selects it in the Company field.
10. When selecting a deal or company, if the contacts are associated, the system automatically selects the room's contacts.If there are no contacts, you can add them in the Room Contacts field.
11. In the Room Contacts field, search for a contact to add to the room. Enter a domain name to display a list of users from a specific domain. For example, Mindtickle.com. To share the room with an entire domain, enter @<domain name> . For example, @Mindtickle.com. Note : Adding contacts to a room is optional. You can skip this step if you do not want to add contacts to the room. Room contacts are important if:
  - You want to lock down a room for specific visitors. For example, if only two people should have access to this room, you can add them as room contacts.
  - You want to track how many of your expected visitors have visited the room. For example, if you have 3 decision-makers who should enter the room if they are interested, add all 3 so you can track that 2/3 or 3/3 have visited. If you selected a deal synced from your CRM, some contacts may have been automatically added. You can add more by searching for their contact details. If you aren't synced to a CRM, you can add a contact from DSR. To add a new contact, enter the name in the search field and click Add as new? The Create contact pop-up appears with the email address or name you added in the previous step. Once you have entered the rest of the details, click Create Contact . The new contact is added to the deal.
12. Click Next Step . The room is created based on the room options configured by the admin. The next step is to add content to the room.

You can add content to the room in the following ways:

- Select a room template
  - Add room template content to rooms

Note: Reps can only add content and section headers from room templates, not room settings, sales actions, the welcome message, the banner image, or the room thumbnail image.

To add room template content to DSRs,

1. On the Create Sales Room page, click Add to room and select Add content from template.

1. In the Select template screen, click Select on a room template:

Note:

- Content can be added from both Organization Templates and Private Templates .
- If reps have already used a room template, it is highlighted as Previously used in the Select template screen.
- A template’s Select option is greyed out if all available content has already been added to the DSR.

1. Select new content to add from the room template in the following ways:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Create a room > Create a room from scratch > Upload content to the room:
- When uploading content from cloud storage options such as Google Drive, you can choose to upload content from the org-level account or your personal account. If your DSR admin has configured an org-level account, you can access the content stored on it without connecting to your personal Google Drive account. If multiple org-level Google Drive accounts are connected and you are granted access to them, the accounts are visible as a list. You can choose to connect your personal account on top of the org-level account to upload content in the DSR. If you have selected content from an account and then try to switch the account, the following warning is displayed: Clicking Change Account changes the account, and all your selected content is deselected.
- When uploading content from Asset Hub, you can also upload assets created by your marketing team from the Assets tab or your customized assets from the My assets tab. Note :
  - My assets is available only if it is enabled on your learning site. If enabled, the Assets and My assets tab appear on the Upload assets page. Else, the Share assets page displays only the assets created by the marketing team that you can upload to the DSR. For more information, see My assets or contact your admin.
  - The My assets tab displays all assets that you have customized and created. If you haven’t created any, the My assets tab is empty. For more information on how to create customized assets, see Create assets .
  - You cannot upload assets marked as Expired or Unshareable .
  - You can preview the Asset Hub content (PDF, PPT, Videos, images, audio, XLS sheets, audio, and Docs) added to a DSR without opening it.
- When uploading Zoom call recordings, note that:
  - Only files that are recorded to the cloud are available for upload. If you recorded a meeting on your local machine, you must upload it from your computer instead of from the Zoom integration.
  - When selecting a Zoom recording, the Recent tab displays up to 10 files. If you have more than 10 files, and you can't find your recording, try finding it on the All files tab.
  - The UI displays recordings from the past month only. To upload a recording from over a month ago, download it from Zoom, and then upload it from your local machine. Note : If you want to configure additional sources for users to upload content, click Configure options .
  - The Configure options option is not visible to sellers. You are redirected to Settings > Integrations > Cloud Storage . Turn the Allow Connection toggle ON for the option you want to enable the integration for. For more information, see Set Up Cloud Storage Integrations . Similarly, you can choose the Record audio, video, or capture a screen recording , Add a URL , Embed a link , or Add Text options to upload content to the room.

- Add a welcome message Provide a personal touch, welcoming a prospect to a room, thanking them for their time on a demo, or showing your excitement for next steps as they review content. This can be updated with a new message as you add more content along the sales cycle. For more information, see Create a Welcome Message .
- Add/update logo and banner image Show your brand next to that of your prospect or customer to visually show a partnership. Further enhance your brand, highlight an industry, or focus on your prospect/customer with a nice banner image across the top. For more information, see Add a Banner Image .
- Edit cover images Update the cover images for the content added to the room. Cover images can provide a visual preview of the content, helping to tell a story and set the context before the user engages with the full content piece. They make the content visually appealing and help users quickly identify and differentiate between various pieces. This significantly enhances the room’s overall experience and effectiveness. To add or update the cover thumbnail for a content piece:
  - Hover over the content and click Edit .
  - Select the cover image on the Edit content screen in the Cover image section
  - To choose a custom cover, click Select cover image . Choose an image from your gallery or upload a new one from your computer. Note : If you're an admin, you can manage the list of images from Image Gallery > Cover Images . For more information, see Set Up Digital Sales Rooms: Cover Images . The selected image will replace the existing cover image. For video files, you can even select a frame from the video. Click Select frame from video . Play the video and pause at the frame you want to use as a cover image. Click Select frame .
  - Click Done . The selected frame will replace the existing cover image. Note :
    - You can edit the cover image for four content types: video, audio, URL, and embedded content in all room or room template layouts. You cannot edit the cover image for image and text content types in any layout. You can edit the cover image for document content type only in the Tiles layout. For more information, see Configure default room settings: Layout .
    - When you edit the cover thumbnail image, it only affects the specific room or room template you are editing. However, if you edit and save a cover image in the room, cloning the room retains the updated cover image.
    - You can edit the cover thumbnail for five content types: video, document, audio, URL, and embedded content. However, you cannot edit it for two content types: text and image.
    - Content uploaded from Call AI or Asset Hub is treated as URL content, regardless of type. You can still select a cover image, but by default, the cover image from Asset Hub or Call AI is used.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Create a room > Create a room from scratch > Hide or unhide sections:
You can hide a section from room visitors in a sales room without deleting it. This is useful when you want to personalize a room for a specific deal stage, gradually reveal content to buyers, or keep internal or later-stage assets in the room without showing them to visitors immediately.

Note:

- You must have Edit access to the room to hide or unhide sections.
- You can hide or unhide only full sections, not individual content items within a section.
- Hidden sections remain visible to users who can edit the room.

Hide a section

To hide a section,

1. On the Edit Sales Room page, hover over a section you want to hide.
2. Click the More options icon, then select Hide . Tip: You can also hide a section from the left navigation pane by following the same steps.
3. Click Save . The section and its content are hidden from room visitors.

Unhide a section

To unhide a section,

1. On the Edit Sales Room page, hover over a section you want to unhide.
2. Click the More options icon, then select Unhide .
3. Click Save . The section is visible to room visitors again.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Preview, save, publish, and share a room > Save a room:
Once you have created the room, you can save it in the draft state before publishing it. You can take the room through multiple change iterations, save the most recent changes from each iteration, and continue building it later. This allows you to retain your progress and review the changes carefully before you publish the room.

Note:

- A room cannot be saved as a draft if content is not added to the room and the room name is blank.
- Draft rooms are not tracked. So data is not available for draft rooms under the Insights section.
- There is no CRM activity write-back for draft rooms. It is only applicable to published rooms.
- No emails are triggered for draft rooms.
- The external URL for draft rooms cannot be generated and is not available on the platform. If someone forges the external URL and tries to access the room, the following message is displayed:

You can save the room as a draft while creating it, previewing it, and editing it. To save the room:

1. Click Save Draft on the:
  1. Create Sales Room page while creating the room.
  2. Room Preview page while previewing the room.
  3. Edit Sales Room Draft page while editing the room.

A confirmation message is displayed on the screen once the room is successfully saved as a draft. You can continue editing the room or go ahead and publish it. You can access the draft room at a later stage as well.

To access a room later:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Preview, save, publish, and share a room > Publish a room:
You can publish a room while creating it or editing its draft. You can also edit a published room and republish it.

To publish a room while creating it or editing its draft:

1. Click Publish .
2. On the Confirm room settings panel, review the settings. If required, update them. Click Create Room Link . A confirmation message is displayed on the screen once the link is created successfully.
3. Copy the link or link and thumbnail and share it with your prospects and customers. Note : The Copy link & thumbnail and Copy link options appear when the room is published for the first time. If a room is edited and published again, you see the following options on the screen.
4. Click the Edit icon on the thumbnail to edit its preview.
5. On the Select room thumbnail panel, upload a new image or select an image from the pre-loaded gallery. The thumbnail is updated. For more information, see Share a Room - Tips and Sample Email Templates .

To republish a published room:

1. On the Edit Room page, click Save or Share . Clicking Save republishes the room and allows you to continue editing it on the Edit Room page. Clicking Share republishes the room and directs you to the Your room was edited successfully page, from where you can share the room using any of the three sharing options.
2. To proceed further, follow steps 3 to 6 of the Publish a room process.

The room is displayed on the rooms listing page. For more information on the actions you can perform on the room from the Rooms page, see More Actions on DSRs.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Preview, save, publish, and share a room > More actions on DSRs > Filter rooms:
You can filter the rooms and narrow down your search to probe into a particular DSR. So, instead of searching through an extensive list, you can directly access the room. You can filter DSRs by room status, teams, or room owner. You can also filter DSRs to display only your rooms or all rooms.

To filter rooms, click on any of the following filters and select the respective value from the drop-down menu.

- Rooms To display only your rooms or all rooms, click the dropdown and select an option:
  - All rooms
  - My rooms
  - Shared with me Note :
    - For admins, by default, the filter All Rooms is applied. For reps, by default, the filter My Rooms is applied.
    - If your admin has restricted the view access to My rooms , the All Rooms option is unavailable in the dropdown.
- Status To filter rooms based on their status, click the dropdown and select one of the three values:
  - Published
  - Draft
  - Disabled Note : By default, the filters Published and Draft are applied.
- Teams Using this filter, you can filter rooms based on the team assigned to them. If you have created teams, added users to them, and assigned a DSR to each team, you can filter for teams configured on your DSR instance. To filter the rooms based on teams, click the dropdown and select the teams. Note : By default, the filter All Teams is applied.
- Owner To filter rooms based on the owner, click the dropdown and select the owner’s name from the list. Alternatively, search for an owner by entering the name in the search field.
chunks.body:
You can filter the rooms and narrow down your search to probe into a particular DSR. So, instead of searching through an extensive list, you can directly access the room. You can filter DSRs by room status, teams, or room owner. You can also filter DSRs to display only your rooms or all rooms.

To filter rooms, click on any of the following filters and select the respective value from the drop-down menu.

- Rooms To display only your rooms or all rooms, click the dropdown and select an option:
  - All rooms
  - My rooms
  - Shared with me Note :
    - For admins, by default, the filter All Rooms is applied. For reps, by default, the filter My Rooms is applied.
    - If your admin has restricted the view access to My rooms , the All Rooms option is unavailable in the dropdown.
- Status To filter rooms based on their status, click the dropdown and select one of the three values:
  - Published
  - Draft
  - Disabled Note : By default, the filters Published and Draft are applied.
- Teams Using this filter, you can filter rooms based on the team assigned to them. If you have created teams, added users to them, and assigned a DSR to each team, you can filter for teams configured on your DSR instance. To filter the rooms based on teams, click the dropdown and select the teams. Note : By default, the filter All Teams is applied.
- Owner To filter rooms based on the owner, click the dropdown and select the owner’s name from the list. Alternatively, search for an owner by entering the name in the search field.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Preview, save, publish, and share a room > More actions on DSRs > Edit a room:
It is possible to edit a published or draft room that you own or are a collaborator on. You can update all of its content and configurations. When creating a new room, it is also possible to choose a deal that already has a room and edit the content within it. It is recommended that you take informed decisions and the necessary precautions before doing so.

To edit a room:

1. On the Rooms page, hover over a room and click the Edit icon. For a draft room, the icon is named Edit draft . Clicking the icon displays the Edit draft page. For a published room, the icon is labeled Edit room . Clicking the icon displays the Edit room page. Note : If your admin has restricted edit access to My rooms , the edit option is disabled for all rooms where you are not the owner or a collaborator.
2. Edit the room's contents as desired. For more information on how to proceed, see Preview, Save, Publish, and Share a Room .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Preview, save, publish, and share a room > More actions on DSRs > Copy the room section link:
To copy the link to a specific section in the room:

1. On the Rooms page, click the Edit icon on a DSR.
2. Click the More options icon next to a section header and click Copy link to section . The system copies the room section header’s link. You can also go to the room section you want to share, hover over the section name, and click the More options icon.
3. Click Copy link to section to copy the section’s link. Alternatively, you can also copy the room section’s link from the left navigation pane.
4. Share the copied link with the room visitors. The room visitors can use the link to open the DSR section directly. Note: If the Require email to view option is enabled in the room access settings , room visitors must enter their email address when accessing the shared section via the link.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Digital Sales Rooms > Preview, save, publish, and share a room > More actions on DSRs > Export visit data Insights:
1. On the Rooms page, hover over the row, click the More Options icon, and click Export Visits . Note : This option is available only for rooms that have had visitors. You are notified by a pop-up message on the screen that once the report is ready, an email will be sent to your (the user who requested it) email address. The email contains a link to download the report. Alternatively, on the Rooms page, click on a row.
2. On the Room Overview page that appears, click the More Options icon and click Export Visits . Note : This option is available only for rooms that have had visitors. You are notified by a pop-up message on the screen that once the report is ready, it is sent to your (the user who requested it) email address.
3. In the email that you receive, click Download CSV .
  1. The report is downloaded on your system in the .csv format. It includes the following details by default:
    - Contact Email : email address of the visitor. This value is blank for anonymous visitors.
    - Contact Name : name of the visitor. This value is blank for anonymous visitors.
    - Contact Phone : the visitor's phone number. This value is blank for anonymous visitors.
    - Contact Job Title : job title of the visitor. This value is blank for anonymous visitors.
    - Company : company of the visitor.
    - City : city of the visitor.
    - Country : country of the visitor.
    - Device : device the visitor used to visit the room (for example, Desktop, Mobile, iPhone, iPad).
    - Room Owner : owner of the room.
    - Content Name : name of the content viewed.
    - Content Visited At (UTC) : the date and time at which the content was viewed.
    - Time Spent (Seconds) : the time spent on the content in seconds.
    - Downloaded At (UTC) : the date and time at which the content was downloaded. Note :
      - If a visitor visits the room in separate sessions and accesses the same content in them, the separate visits are recorded as independent entries in the report.
      - If the visit is non-anonymous, the visitor’s Contact Email is reflected in the report. In some cases, however, the Contact Name , Contact Phone , and Contact Job Title fields may be blank.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms:
DSR insights provide valuable data about sales representatives' performance and progress in deals. This detailed information can help managers make informed decisions and provide targeted coaching to their teams.Tip: Statistics indicate that deals with a DSR have a win rate that is 30% higher than deals without a DSR associated with them. Encourage sales reps to create a DSR for every deal. This enables you to gather more data, such as finding your top users and understanding which users are getting the most engagement to replicate what's going well.

To view the insights,

On the admin site homepage, click Rooms and select Insights on the left navigation panel.

The Insights page is displayed.

The Insights tab has two tabs to analyze engagement: Rooms and Organization Usage. Additionally, insights can also be filtered by Teams (great for team leaders or breaking down content engagement), Room creators, and Date range.

This article further explains:

- Room Insights
- Organization Usage Insights

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Insights > Room Summary:
The top summary provides key details on room adoption and engagement, such as the total number of rooms created and the average number of visitors.

- Rooms created - compare this to what you would expect knowing how many deals or projects should have rooms during the time period.
- Avg # Items/Room - compare this to your best practices and how to showcase your product or service to see if users are following guidelines.
- Avg # Visitors/Room - Any number above 1.0 shows that on average, you have more than one visitor per room which means, bringing in additional stakeholders and providing value by keeping multiple people aligned.
- Avg # Visits/Room - Any number above 1.0 shows that your visitors are coming back to your room because they saw value in the content or have shared the room with others.
- Deals with Rooms - Use this as a baseline number to improve over time. If you are just syncing your CRM and getting started, it will show a low percentage of all deals, so aim for improvement each month/quarter/year.

- Avg # Items/Room - compare this to your best practices and how to showcase your product or service to see if users are following guidelines.
- Avg # Visitors/Room - Any number above 1.0 shows that on average, you have more than one visitor per room which means, bringing in additional stakeholders and providing value by keeping multiple people aligned.
- Avg # Visits/Room - Any number above 1.0 shows that your visitors are coming back to your room because they saw value in the content or have shared the room with others.
- Deals with Rooms - Use this as a baseline number to improve over time. If you are just syncing your CRM and getting started, it will show a low percentage of all deals, so aim for improvement each month/quarter/year.

The chart divides deals into two categories: deals with rooms (represented in red) and deals without rooms (represented in blue). They also give insights about when reps should create a room for a deal and what content impacts closed/won deals.Under % of Deals with Rooms, you can view the percentage of your opportunities that have rooms associated with them. chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Room Insights > Deals with Rooms:
- CRM opportunity : A deal must be associated with a CRM opportunity to appear on the chart. You can confirm this by seeing the CRM icon on the deal in the Select Deal step of the flow. Deals created directly in Mindtickle and not linked to a CRM opportunity will not appear on the chart. This is because the system uses CRM data to populate the chart.
- Deal owner : The sales rep must be the deal owner (CRM opportunity). The platform matches the CRM opportunity owner's ID with the user's Mindtickle account email address to determine the deal owner. If the system can't find a match, it will label the deal owner as 'Not a User,' and such deals will not appear on the chart. For example, from the screenshot below, the deal ‘Pizza Hut’ will not appear on the chart.
- Date range : For the deal to appear on the chart, the opportunity creation date must fall within the selected date range. For instance, if a deal is created outside the selected date range, it will not be included in the chart or the table on the list. You can select the date range from the Date range dropdown on the Insights page. Alternatively, click All Time to display the entire list and select the date range from the Date range dropdown. If your CRM is connected, DSR also attributes content ROI to the opportunities closed as won to show you which content is being used to drive deals forward. Note : The dollars are attributed to the entire deal.

7. On the displayed pop-up screen, click Install.

- Adoption of Modules - Contacts
- MT Modules Reports
- Adoption of Modules - Users

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Data Sync and Reporting API > Prerequisites:
1. Mindtickle strongly recommends using a dedicated Salesforce Integration User to perform this integration. The integration user must have access to the following permissions and objects required by the integration: Object nameAPI/Field nameAccessMT ModuleMindTickleDev__MTModule__cModifyAllMT Module UserMindTickleDev__MTModuleUser__cMT Module ContactMindTickleDev__MTModuleContact__cMT ConfigMindTickleDev__MTConfig__cContactIDViewAllEmailUserIDViewAllEmailUsername For more information on how to create an integration user and grant the required permissions, see Create an Integration User in SFDC .
2. You must have a Mindtickle admin account (at least an IT admin role ).

Mindtickle app will require the below permissions to provide a seamless experience with our integration.

- Access to basic information
- Access to manage your data
- Perform requests on your behalf at any time

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Data Sync and Reporting API > Set up the Mindtickle-Salesforce connection:
1. In the admin site sidebar, click Account > Settings > Security & integrations . On the Security and integrations page, scroll down to the User Sync section and then select the Salesforce tab.
2. Select the User and Contact checkboxes and click Save , and then click Connect .
3. On the displayed screen, enter your Salesforce admin credentials to log in.
4. On the displayed pop-up, click Allow.
5. After logging into Salesforce, in the left navigation panel, click Apps > Connected Apps > Connected Apps OAuth Usage . The Connected Apps OAuth Usage screen is displayed.
6. Under the Connected App column, click the Install button on Mindtickle Salesforce OAuth.
7. On the displayed pop-up screen, click Install.

The Mindtickle Salesforce OAuth app is now installed on the Salesforce instance.

The following table explains the permissions required in detail:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Data Sync and Reporting API > Install the app:
1. Go to the Mindtickle app listing on Salesforce AppExchange.

2. Click the Get It Now button on the listing.

- Click on login with Trailblazer .
- Login to your account via SFDC.

3. Select the SFDC environment (production or sandbox) and the account to install the package.

4. Review the details and confirm the installation.

5. The Salesforce administrator can decide whether to install the package for all users or only for administrators. For custom profiles with non-admin roles, select Install for All Users and install the package.Check the Grant third-party access box and continue.

Note:

- For custom profiles with non-admin roles, ensure the user's profiles have access to all the object and apex classes. For more information, see Grant users access to classes and objects .
- Installation might take some time to get completed. You will receive an email to confirm the successful installation.
- This integration is compatible with the latest version of the Mindtickle app installed from Salesforce AppExchange .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Data Sync and Reporting API > Sync modules:
Identify the modules that you wish to sync and send the list to your Customer Success Manager (CSM). The modules will be visible in your Salesforce instance only after they are synced.

Note:

- For Coaching Sessions, only the score for the last reviewed session is visible. For Missions having multiple reviewers, the average score of the last submission is displayed.
- With this integration, only module certification data becomes available in Salesforce (SFDC). It does not provide series certification data.

The following table lists the attribute API names, their labels, example values, and descriptions of the users and modules that are synced with Salesforce and their description.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > CRMs:
Mindtickle integration with Salesforce allows your learners (sales reps) to access Mindtickle modules from within an Opportunity page in Salesforce. The sales rep who owns the Opportunity record can access contextually relevant content depending upon the characteristics of the Opportunity.

Note:

- Mindtickle’s module and content recommendations are only available in Salesforce at the opportunity level, not at the contact or account levels.
- Mindtickle supports rule creation on all fields available in a Salesforce opportunity object. You can add rules based on other connected objects and create a custom or formula field in the Opportunity.

The admin site allows users to create shareable links to the Mindtickle series/modules/assets. These links can be embedded in Salesforce to help users navigate to specific training in Mindtickle. It works on mobile devices and requires an active internet connection.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > CRMs > Create Named Credentials:
1. Click thegear icon on the top-right corner and select Setup in Salesforce.

2. On the left panel, go to Security and click Named Credentials.

3. Click New Legacy.

4. The Label and Name must be Mindtickle (case sensitive).

5. URL should be ‘https://salesforce-events.mindtickle.com’.Note: For learning sites based in the US also, the above URL applies.

6. Select the certificate generated in the previous section.

7. Set the Identity Type as Named Principal.

8. Set the Authentication Protocol as JWT.

9. Set the Issuer and Named Principal Subject as Mindtickle (case sensitive).

10. Audiences must contain the company ID (cname) of your Mindtickle instance.

The company ID is displayed in the Security & integrations tab on the Settings page of your learning site.

11. Set the Token Validity for 1 hour.

12. Select the Mindtickle certificate as the JWT Signing Certificate. This must be the same certificate as the one selected in step 6.

Note: Do not change any other default attributes.

13. Click Save.

1. Click the gear icon in the upper-right corner and select Setup in Salesforce.
2. On the left panel, enter Process Automation in the search and select Process Automation > Flows from the results.
3. On the Flows screen, click New Flow
4. On the New Automation pop-up screen, click Record-Triggered Flow. On the Configure Start page, enter the following details:
5. From the Object drop-down, select Opportunity .
6. In the Configure Trigger , click the A record is created or updated radio button.
7. From the Condition Requirements drop-down, click None .
8. In Optimize the flow , click Actions and Related Records
9. Click Save.
10. On the left panel, click the + Add icon.
11. On the Add Element screen, enter MindTickleDev__MTOpportunityTriggerHandler and select it from the results. On the displayed screen, enter the following.
12. In the Label , enter a name for the trigger. For example, Opportunity.
13. The API Name field gets auto-populated. You can modify it if necessary.
14. In Description , enter a short description for the trigger.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > CRMs > Connect multiple learning sites to a Salesforce account:
You can connect multiple Mindtickle learning sites with your Salesforce account. This is beneficial if you have multiple learning instances and want to recommend modules to learners from different business organizations operating separate Mindtickle instances.

In this case, the notion of a parent learning site and child learning sites comes into play. The parent learning site is the one whose details are added under Named credentials on Salesforce, as outlined in the help article above (see Create Named Credentials). Child learning sites are Mindtickle instances added in the Linked Cnames parameter in the parent learning site. To establish connections between multiple instances of Mindtickle and Salesforce, it's necessary also to include the details of the child learning sites within the parent learning site settings.

Note: If the same admin user initiates the Mindtickle-SFDC connection for all learning sites, the synchronization could encounter issues. To ensure successful syncing of each learning site with the SFDC instance, it's important to have different individual user accounts conduct the connection process to avoid any errors.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > CRMs > Connect multiple learning sites to a Salesforce account > Add child LS details in parent LS:
1. In Salesforce, go to Tools > Edit Integrations > Common Settings and click Edit .
2. Add the child LSs to Linked Cnames .
3. Set the value for Enable Opportunity Sync to true .
4. Set the value for Enable SFDC Auth Certificate Upload to true. This ensures that your data is shared on the new package .
5. Ensure each child LS is authenticated on Salesforce.

Note:

- This feature is available only on request. To enable it, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
- You can connect up to 5 learning sites with a single Salesforce account.
- For child learning sites, there is no need to upload the Salesforce certificate in Mindtickle or add named credentials in Salesforce.
- The Salesforce admin must share the unique identifier attribute for all opportunities in all connected learning sites with Mindtickle.
- The unique identifiers are used while writing opportunity rules for separate learning instances to avoid conflicting rules and actions.
- Opportunity rules are written separately for all learning sites using the unique identifier as an additional condition. This ensures recommendations apply only to relevant opportunities.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Manage hub collaborators:
Mindtickle’s Asset Hub allows collaborators to work jointly on hubs. A user needs to be a part of the hub and be either a Site Owner or Enablement Admin, invited as a collaborator for a hub following the Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) mechanism that defines user privileges according to their roles. Mindtickle provides the option to invite only selected users, with appropriate permissions, as collaborators to limit the number of users that have edit access to the assets in that hub.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Archive or delete assets:
Mindtickle’s Asset Hub contains collaterals that help sales reps close the deal. Some of these collaterals need to be updated, and the previous outdated versions of these assets to be archived. Archiving an asset removes it from the sales rep’s view while keeping it in the archived state for future use. When an asset is no longer relevant or contains information that should not be available to even the hub collaborators, the customer can utilize the option to delete the archived asset from the Asset Hub. Once an asset is deleted from the Asset Hub, it is irretrievable.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Configuring consent and privacy policy of assets:
Mindtickle’s Asset Hub can track the engagement data, such as the time spent on the asset and the number of views, when an asset is shared externally. This kind of tracking requires consent from the asset recipients under various data privacy laws.

To help customers comply with international privacy laws, Mindtickle has the feature where customer admins can configure the consent mechanism and privacy policy to track the engagement data of customers and prospects on the shared assets. It also provides an option to mandate the customer’s or Mindtickle’s privacy policy to appear when requesting consent. The recipients have an opportunity to accept or decline the consent.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Stop the bot from joining the call:
Call AI users from customer organizations can disable the Call AI bot from automatically joining the meeting by toggling the record option for individual meetings.

Further, Mindtickle provides the functionality where Call AI sends an email to all the call participants 15 minutes before the meeting start time, informing them that the call will be recorded. Participants have the option to withdraw consent and stop the call recording. Participants can also ask the meeting host or co-host to remove the bot during a meeting.

- Privacy features in Call AI

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Disable call download:
Mindtickle offers security features for restricted sharing of call recordings to allow only limited access to the recording. For sharing a call externally, an email with the link for the recording is sent to the email address. Call AI users can customize the link settings to disable the call recording download.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Stop the bot from recording confidential meetings:
When discussing sensitive or confidential topics in meetings, hosts can move the Call AI bot to a waiting room in Zoom or a lobby in Webex to stop the recording. To remove a Call AI bot from a confidential meeting, select it from the participant’s list and add it to the waiting room or lobby. Hosts can admit the bot back to the meeting when necessary.

For the meetings where Call AI does not join but the recording is fetched through integrations with the video conferencing tool, the host can pause the recording using options provided by the video conferencing provider. This ensures privacy while maintaining the ability to record the rest of your meeting.

Although speech pace is merely indicative to help the reviewer, if the customer wants, they can disable this feature to avoid unwanted influencing factors.

If this indicative feature is not needed, the customers can disable it while building the Mission.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Enable or disable filler word usage in Mission:
AI assistance in Mission can detect filler words used by the sales reps during the sales pitch. The user might be doing an excellent job of explaining even with the filler words, and maybe the words are also helpful in some small talks or building relationships with the audience. Including these filler words along with the context might not even influence the effectiveness of the sales pitch. If the customer does not want the reviews to show the number of filler words used or what those were, customers can turn off this feature.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Best Practices and Use Cases > Security and Privacy > Enable or Disable editing Coaching Session review after submission:
Coaching Session reviews help learners improve their skills by providing constructive criticism and feedback. Mindtickle understands that reviews are essential to support the learner’s journey, so we provide the option to the admin to enable or disable editing of Coaching Session review after it has been submitted.

This feature enables reviewers to edit their review after submission and allows corrections to the already submitted review if required. After disabling this feature, reviewers can provide additional feedback in a new review session. Admins can configure this setting according to their requirements.

Mindtickle can enable the functionality again at the request of the customer.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
Call AI identifies the prospect's email id from the call recording and searches for this prospect in the Leads and Contacts of SFDC. Suppose a match is found with a contact. In that case, the system will check the corresponding Opportunity, Account that this contact belongs to, and the associate who had the call with that opportunity.

As admins, you can configure the fields from Contact, Lead, Opportunity, and Account objects that would act as filters for the reps, managers, and leadership to get to the right set of calls or insights. These fields are stored with respect to the calls.

Note: Some fields are temporary, and some are non-temporary. If you change the name of the Opportunity/Account in Salesforce, the corresponding calls in Call AI for the Account/Opportunity also reflect the change. However, if the stage of the opportunity is progressed to "T1”, and the call takes place at "T0", then the call stage is stored and is not updated.

chunks.title: How does Mindtickle use call recordings to map the recording insights back to respective opportunities in Salesforce (SFDC)?

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > FAQs:
When you make a call to sell products (e.g., P1 or P2, or P3), these are attributed to the contact via emails of invited participants. Thus, all the Opportunities connected to these contacts are linked.

If you are selling multiple products in the same call to all the contacts, then all contacts are linked. But if you have separate calls with selected contacts for different products, then the separate calls are linked to those Opportunities.

Note: When creating opportunities in SFDC, we recommend you add contacts diligently to segregate these common calls.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started:
As a learner, you can rate a module (course, quick update, and assessment) based on its overall value. Depending on your experience with its content, structure, and usefulness, you can rate a module on a scale of 1 to 5 stars. 1 is the lowest rating, and 5 is the highest. You can provide textual feedback on the module. This feedback is only visible to the enablement admins. Ratings and feedback help admins gather feedback on the modules without using external polls or surveys.

Note: Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) to enable it for your site. This feature is currently available only on the web and not on mobile.

When providing the ratings, consider the following parameters and ask the following questions:

- User engagement
  - Did I find the content engaging?
  - How likely am I to retake this module?
  - Would I be willing to take up more such programs?
  - Is this training format compatible with my learning style?
  - Could I easily navigate the module?
- Adoption
  - Did the module enable me to master the concept/process/product?
  - Do I feel more confident/comfortable with the concept/process/product than I was before I took this module?
  - Did I achieve a state in which I could train a peer on the process/product/concept?
  - Did this module help me develop professionally?
  - Was the content easy to understand, adaptable, and comprehensive?
- Content quality
  - Did this module meet my expectations?
  - How strongly would I recommend this content to a colleague in a similar role?
  - Was going through the content a valuable use of my time?
  - Can the content be applied to my work and daily responsibilities?
  - Will I be more effective in my work after going through this content?

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started:
- Was going through the content a valuable use of my time? - Can the content be applied to my work and daily responsibilities? - Will I be more effective in my work after going through this content?

Based on whether your answers to these questions lean more towards positive or negative feedback, you can rate the module accordingly.

The below example is for an course module.

You can rate the course once it is complete, either from the Course details page or the completion page.

1. To rate the course from the Course details page:

- Select the number of stars on a scale of 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).
- Click the Add feedback option, enter your feedback in the Tell us what do you think about this module text box, and click Save .

2. To rate the course from the course completion page:

- Select the number of stars on a scale of 1 (lowest) to 5 (highest).
- Enter your feedback in the Add your feedback/suggestions here text box and click Save .

A confirmation message displays that the rating is complete.

Your rating, the average rating, and the number of ratings for the course are adjusted and displayed on the module card.

3. To change your rating and feedback, navigate to the Course details page:

- Hover over the stars in Your rating and select the number of stars you wish to provide.
- Click View/edit and enter the required feedback.

The new average rating for the course is displayed on the module card.

chunks.title: Rate a module and provide feedback

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Get Started:
For information on rating a course, see the Navigating a course article.

For information on rating a quick update, see the Navigating a quick update article.

Note:

- You can only rate and provide feedback for the course, quick updates, and assessment modules.
- For a course or quick update, you can rate the module after completing 80% of the module.
- You can rate the entire module only after it has been completed.
- You can update your module rating multiple times. However, once you rate a module, you cannot unrate it or give it 0 stars. For example, if you give it 4 stars and later want to modify it, you can give it a minimum of 1 or 5 stars.
- It is not possible to give decimal ratings, such as 3.5 stars. However, the average rating for a module may be calculated as a decimal rating.
- If the rating feature is disabled after learners have rated it, then enabled again, the module's average rating will persist.
- At least 10 learners should rate an individual module for the average rating to be displayed on the module card on the learning site. If the module does not meet this minimum threshold, the rating is displayed as a hyphen on the module card. To customize the minimum learner count used to calculate the average rating, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
- The readiness experience dashboard allows you to access all your top-rated modules. For more information on top-rated modules, see Top rated modules .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Admin > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms:
Mindtickle’s Digital Sales Rooms (DSR) are persistent, real-time, virtual shared spaces built to enhance the buyer-seller interaction.

Each DSR acts as a one-stop shop for the sellers and buyers. Sellers can add all deal-related content to the DSR and buyers can access the DSR to view the content. Moreover, buyers and sellers can collaborate quickly and easily through mutual action plans and conversations. Through DSR, sellers get access to actionable insights, which can be used to identify gaps, make improved deal forecasts, and sell better and faster in the future. By delivering accurate deal-related content in a single shared space, reps can provide a customized experience to the buyer. For more information on different ways in which you can leverage DSRs, see Use cases for Digital Sales Rooms.

Note: Digital Sales Rooms is a paid feature. Moreover, Asset Hub, Mindtickle’s sales content management system, is a prerequisite for DSR. DSR can be enabled for your organization only if Asset Hub is already enabled. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) or Mindtickle Support to enable DSR for your organization.

This article further lists the key benefits and features of Digital Sales Rooms. For more information about the initial setup requirements of Digital Sales Rooms, see Set Up Digital Sales Rooms.
