Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports:
This article provides information on filters that are available in self-serve reports in Mindtickle analytics. It provides a list of all filters for quick reference and details on each filter, such as its use case and available filter values/options.

Filters help you further customize your configured report. For the metrics you have selected in the Configure panel, filters allow you to expand or narrow the scope of metrics data that you want to include in the report. Filters, along with metrics selected by you, help you create reports with only the most important and relevant data.

Filters are available at the top of the report when you are editing it:

The following is an overview of filter options and settings:

1. Default filters: All templates come with the following two filters applied by default. You can change their values to your liking.
  - Modules Assigned During: Past 30 days (default value)
  - Assigned By: Include admin assigned only (default value)
2. Add filters: Click the button to view all available filters, add one or more filters, and then select the filter values to apply the filters. Important: You must select a filter’s values/options to apply the filter. If no values are selected, the filter will not be retained when you save the report.
3. Reset filters: Click the button to reset filters to default. This will keep only the default filters with their default values.
4. View and remove applied filters: Click the button to view all of the applied filters. You can also remove any of your applied filters.

For information on how to apply filters, see Create self-serve reports. For an overview of self-serve reports, see Overview of self-serve reports in analytics.

For more information, see this article.* Important: For the Custom Time option, you can set the maximum date range to one year in the past from today. This is because self-serve reports provide data only for the series/modules that were assigned to learners during the past one year from the date of report creation. In other words, only for the series/modules to which learners were invited within the past year.
2. [Default filter] Assigned by: Select whether to include only either admin-assigned or self-assigned modules.Note: This is a default filter but can be removed if you don’t need it. Click the button in the filter section for the option to remove it. If you remove this filter, the report will display both admin-assigned and self-assigned modules.

1. Module Relevance: View data for learners by the Module Relevance (Optional, Required, or Unmarked) set in their assigned module. It considers only the modules with a defined Module Relevance.

1. Include only overdues: View data for learners by their overdue or non-overdue modules. It considers only the modules with a due date. A module becomes overdue after its due date has passed for the learner.Filter values: Yes or No. Select Yes if you want to include only the overdue modules; select No if you want to include only the modules that are not yet overdue. If you do not add this filter, the report considers both overdue and non-overdue modules.

1. Include only module certificates: View data for learners by assigned modules with module certification enabled or not. Certification is available for the following types of modules: Course, Mission, Coaching Sessions, and Assessment.Filter values: Yes or No. Select Yes if you want to include only the modules with certification enabled; select No if you want to include only the modules where certification is not enabled. If you do not add this filter, the report considers both kinds of modules.

1. Module types: View data for learners by the type of module they are assigned. Mindtickle provides 8 different types of modules.Filter values: Course, quick update, assessment, checklist, ILT, coaching sessions, mission (4 types of missions), and quest.
2. [Only for ILT templates] Enrollment status: View data for learners by their enrollment status in the ILT session. Filter values: Enrolled, not enrolled, waiting, enrolled but canceled, and waiting but canceled.The enrollment status can be one of the following:
  - Enrolled: Learner is enrolled for the session.
  - Not enrolled: Learner is not enrolled for the session.
  - Waiting: Learner is waitlisted for the session.
  - Enrolled but canceled: The session is canceled and the learner’s last status for the session was Enrolled.
  - Waiting but canceled: The session is canceled and the learner’s last status for the session was Waiting (waitlisted).
3. [Only for ILT templates] Attendance status: View data for learners by their attendance status in the ILT session. Filter values: Attended, not attended, and attendance not marked.The attendance status can be one of the following:
  - Attended: Learner has attended the session.
  - Not attended: Learner has not attended the session.
  - Attendance not marked: Learner’s attendance for the session is not marked. The learner may or may not have attended the session. For more information, see Manage sessions and learners' enrollment in ILT and ILT module analytics.
4. [Only for ILT templates] Session completion status: View data for learners by whether they completed the ILT session. The session completion status is based on the completion criteria configured in the session settings. A session is considered completed when all enrolled sessions have been completed AND the learner attended them all (or, if not attended, watched the session recording uploaded by the admin) and their attendance is marked "Yes". If the attendance is unmarked for any session, the session is considered as "In Progress".Filter values: Completed, not completed, and not applicable.
5. [Only for ILT templates] Session start date: View data for sessions based on the time period in which they were conducted, based on their start date.Filter values: Past 15 days, past 30 days, past 90 days, last month, last 3 months, last 6 months, and Custom Time *.Against a filter value, hover over theicon to view the exact date range. For Custom Time, you can make the custom date range dynamic. For more information, see this article. * Important: For the Custom Time option, you can set the maximum date range to one year in the past from today. This is because self-serve reports provide data only for the series/modules that were assigned to learners during the past one year from the date of report creation. In other words, only for the series/modules to which learners were invited within the past year.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Asset Hub:
This article explains how sales reps can view and track the Asset Hub activities relevant to the Salesforce Opportunity under the Opportunity’s Activity tab. This allows reps to track the activities within Salesforce and get all Asset Hub-related information within Salesforce.

Salesforce.com (SFDC) is a cloud-based CRM software solution to help marketing, sales, commerce, service, and IT teams work as one from anywhere and deliver exceptional customer experience.

The rep who owns the opportunity record can access Salesforce and track the activities similar to those available under the Interactions tab in Mindtickle. Managers can also visit the opportunity to monitor the progress of their sales reps on the opportunities.

Three types of activities are pushed from Asset Hub to identified Salesforce Opportunities:

- When an asset is shared, and the reps create the interaction
- When the contacts access the interaction
- When recipients or contacts share the interaction or asset with their peers

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Mindtickle Guide for Learners > Asset Hub > Benefits of activity writeback:
Integrating the Asset Hub activities into the Salesforce Opportunity can provide a number of benefits to the customers or prospects:

- Better monitoring : Pushing Asset Hub activities into the Salesforce Opportunity can provide valuable insights to sales reps, helping them monitor the deal's progress more effectively. For example, if the customer has viewed certain assets multiple times. Then, this may indicate a high level of interest or engagement, which could be used to guide the rep's communication and follow-up strategy.
- Enhanced reporting : Managers and admins can create reports in Salesforce on the activities performed across opportunities and derive business insights.
- Personalized experience : By having all relevant information about the customer's needs and preferences in one place, the sales reps can provide a more personalized and tailored experience, which can help build trust and rapport with the customer.
- Improved communication : Accessing all Asset Hub activities from within the Opportunity's Activity tab means that the sales team can communicate more effectively with the customer, addressing their concerns and needs in a timely and relevant manner.
- Efficient sales process : By streamlining the sales process and avoiding disjointed experiences across different systems, the customer can benefit from a more efficient and effective sales process, saving them time and hassle.
- Increased transparency : By having all relevant information captured in one place, the customer has increased transparency in the sales process, which helps build trust and confidence in the sales rep and the product or service being offered.

Overall, the integration and writeback of Asset Hub activities into Salesforce help improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the sales process and provides a more seamless and unified experience for reps.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin:
Authorizing your email address when sharing assets is a crucial step in ensuring the security of your organization's information. This article provides information how to authorize your work email address while sharing assets via email.

Note:

- Email address authorization is required only if — a) you want to share assets via your own work email address and b) Microsoft Office 365 is your email provider. It is not required if you share assets via admin@mindtickle.com .
- When authorizing your email address for sharing assets via email, you can only use your Microsoft login email address (UPN). Email aliases or alternate mailbox addresses are not supported.
- Sending asset sharing emails from personal email addresses is currently not supported for organizations using Microsoft Azure Government cloud (authenticated via login.microsoftonline.us ). Azure Government is a specialized sovereign cloud deployment, and support for it is currently unavailable due to a limitation with our email integration provider. Please contact Mindtickle Support for assistance.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin > Ways to authorize your email address:
Authorizing your work email address (email ID) involves providing approval or authorization to Mindtickle's Mindtickle-Email app for Microsoft Office 365, so that you can share assets via your work email address. This can be done either by the admin for the entire organization or individually by each user (rep) in the organization.

You can authorize your email for use with the Mindtickle-Email app for Microsoft Office 365 in one of the following ways:

Note: For either of the options, reps need to authorize their email address only the first time when sharing assets. Subsequently, they can share assets without requiring any authorization.

1. email
2. Mail.ReadWrite
3. Mail.Send
4. offline_access
5. openid

For users (reps)This section provides information on the steps that each rep needs to perform to approve the Mindtickle-Email app while sharing assets for the first time.

Important: Alternatively, the admin can pre-approve the Mindtickle-Email app by performing the following steps by signing in to the Mindtickle platform with their admin credentials. This removes all steps that the reps needs to perform. Instead, their email address is authorized immediately, without having to accept (approve) the Mindtickle-Email app. In other words, if the admin performs the following steps, they can take away this burden from all the reps who would otherwise need to perform them.

1. While sharing assets via email, on the Share assets via email page, enter your work email address through which you want to share assets. Then click Authorize . Note: Email address authorization is required only if — a) you want to share assets via your own work email address and b) Microsoft Office 365 is your email provider. It is not required if you share assets via admin@mindtickle.com .
2. In the new tab that opens, click Continue with Microsoft .
3. Sign in with your Microsoft account.
4. In the Permissions requested pop-up that appears, review the requested permissions by expanding each one. Then click Accept .
5. A toast notification appears, confirming that your email address is authorized successfully.
6. Now you can start sharing assets via your work email on Microsoft Office 365. Note: Once authorized, you will not be prompted to authorize your email in the future. Mindtickle's Asset Hub saves your email address and automatically populates it whenever you share assets via email in the future.

Configure the following consent settings in Microsoft Azure AD (Entra ID) admin center. For more information about the consent settings, see Microsoft documentation.

1. Sign in to the Microsoft Azure (Entra) admin center as a Privileged Role Administrator .
2. Browse to Identity > Applications > Enterprise applications > Consent and permissions > User consent settings .

Selected users will receive request expiration reminders: Enable or disable reminder email notifications to the reviewers when a request is about to expire. Consent request expires after (days): Specify how long requests stay valid.For details, see the Microsoft documentation.
5. Select Save to save your changes to the settings. It can take up to an hour for the workflow to become enabled.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin > Option 2: Users require admin approval > Instructions:
This section provides information on the steps that the rep and admin need to perform to approve the Mindtickle-Email app. Here is an overview of the major tasks covered in this section:

1. Rep sends approval request for the Mindtickle-Email app to the admin
2. Admin approves the app request
3. Rep authorizes their email and starts sharing assets via their work email address using Microsoft Office 365

Let's understand each in detail:

I. Rep requests app approval

For users (reps)Perform the following to start authorizing your email address. As part of the steps, you will request approval from your admin for the Mindtickle-Email app. You can complete your email authorization only after the app is approved.

1. While sharing assets via email, on the Share assets via email page, enter your work email address through which you want to share assets. Then click Authorize . Note: Email address authorization is required only if — a) you want to share assets via your own work email address and b) Microsoft Office 365 is your email provider. It is not required if you share assets via admin@mindtickle.com .
2. In the new tab that opens, click Continue with Microsoft .
3. Sign in with your Microsoft account.
4. The Approval required pop-up appears stating that you need approval from the admin. Enter the message in the Enter justification for requesting this app field and click Request approval .
5. The Request pending pop-up message appears, informing you that Microsoft has notified your admin about your request to access the app. On this pop-up, do not click Back to app . Instead, simply close the tab.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > How the integration works?:
1. Genesys records the call and sends the audio file to Call AI.

2. Call AI processes the audio file and makes it available on your Call AI interface.

3. Call AI generates valuable insights, themes, transcripts, and statistics for the call recording. You can perform different actions, such as send a private message, take notes, and share the recording with peers and customers. For more information, see Call Recording Details.

Note:

- Call AI only imports the dialer calls of users with a recorder role . For more information, see Call AI Permissions .
- Call AI displays the phone number of the prospect as the recording name.
- If a participant's name and email address is not available in the Genesys recording, Call AI displays the dialer number as the participant’s name. You can edit the participant's name on the recording details page.
- If you delete a recorded call in Genesys, the recording remains in Call AI. For more information about deleting such a recording from the Call AI interface, see Delete a Call Recording .
- Call AI only imports the dialer calls that are connected and more than 10 seconds long.

- If you delete a recorded call in Genesys, the recording remains in Call AI. For more information about deleting such a recording from the Call AI interface, see Delete a Call Recording .
- Call AI only imports the dialer calls that are connected and more than 10 seconds long.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > Wrap-up codes for calls:
When the Call AI and Genesys integration is complete, the Genesys instance creates a default wrap-up code. There are scenarios where you could not pick up the call, or the call is connected but accidentally canceled either during the call or before the call got connected. For such scenarios, if the wrap-up code is set as Missed Call, these calls are not pulled into Call AI.

To set a wrap-up code to a call

1. On Genesys Admin > Contact Center > Queues.

2. Select the call to assign the wrap-up code.

3. Click the Wrap-up Codes tab.

4. Click the Select new wrap-up codes drop-down list and select the required code. If the call is a missed call, select Missed calls.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > Integrations > Limitations:
The Genesys licenses are region specific. For example, if your organization is based in the US, the Genesys license is only for the US region. Only the calls made in the US are integrated with Call AI. If you have operations in multiple regions, for example, Asia-Pacific (APAC), you need to set up different tenants for those regions to integrate the calls in Call AI.

Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) or Mindtickle Support for more details.

The Meeting details contain the meeting name, tool type, and icon, such as Zoom or Google Meet, along with the meeting time. Click the meeting name to join the call from the Call AI platform.

- External participants

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Call AI > User > Search:
A search bar allows you to quickly find meetings by title without scrolling through the full list. The search updates results in real time, supports partial matches, and is case-insensitive. If no matching meetings are found, a No results found message is displayed.

Meeting selections are retained even when the search query changes or is cleared, allowing you to search, select meetings, and apply bulk actions (like enable/disable recording) across multiple search results in a single workflow. Use the De-select all option to clear all selected calls.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Series:
As an admin, you can smoothly create a module using one of Mindtickle’s preconfigured module templates. When you use a template, the entire module, along with its learning objects, questions and invite learners’ option, is copied onto your learning site, creating a brand new module. You can then customize this module to suit the needs and requirements of your organization and add it to your program for your learners.

The Mindtickle platform hosts templates created by Mindtickle and partner sites. See the Mindtickle marketplace to view the module templates.To create a module using a module template, follow the steps below:

1. From the Training tab of the admin site homepage, click Series.

2. On the Series page, click the Create button and select Template from the drop-down menu to visit the Marketplace.On the series page, click Create module in the series header or click Add modules in the Modules tab.

Note: The Add first module button is available only when there are no modules in the series.

From the Add modules pop-up that appears within the series, scroll down to Browse module templates and click the Next icon.

- You can add a course, quick-update, mission, assessment, coaching sessions, instructor-led training (ILT), checklist, or quest within your series. For more information on how to create each of these modules, refer to:
  - Create a course
  - Create a quick-update
  - Create a mission
  - Create an assessment
  - Create a coaching session
  - Create an ILT
  - Create a checklist
  - Create a quest

3. Scroll down to Browse module templates and click the Next icon.

The self-serve reports home page lists reports that you and other admins have created. This section provides an overview of the home page and the actions you can take.

The home page provides information related to the report’s properties, in the following columns:

- Report name: Name and description of the report that were added by the report creator.
- Report type: The self-serve report template that was selected for creating the report. The report templates are essentially the different types of self-serve reports available.
- Last updated on: Time and date when the report was last updated.
- Created by: Name of the admin user who created the report.
- Created on: Time and date when the report was created.
- Last updated by: Name of the admin user who last updated the report.

Additionally, you can take various actions on the home page, as discussed below.

Home page actions:

As annotated in the above screenshot, you can take the following actions on the home page:

1. Create new report: Click the button to create a new self-serve report.
2. Search and filter: Use the search bar to search for a particular report by name. Use the Created by filter to view all reports created by a particular admin.
3. Sort data: Sort the list of reports by a particular column using the sort button.
4. View all columns: Scroll horizontally towards left to view all report columns.
5. Report options: Click the ( More options ) button for options to edit the report for further changes and delete the report. Alternatively, you can also edit and delete any report from the report page.

- Created on: Time and date when the report was created.

You can edit self-serve reports created by you and other admins to make further changes to the report, such as add or remove metrics and filters, rename the report, update the report description.

Tip: If you want to make further edits but still keep the original report intact, you can instead make a copy of the report (duplicate the report) and make further changes to the copied version.

1. Open the report that you want to edit. You can open a report for editing in two ways from the self-serve home page:

  - From the list of reports, click the report that you want to edit. On the report page, click the button in the header to edit the report.
2. Once you’ve opened the report for editing, you can make all kinds of changes, similar to creating a new report. For more information, see Create self-serve reports.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Export report:
You can export self-serve reports (created by yourself and other admins) in a .csv format to an email address to share with someone in your organization.

1. On the self-serve reports home page, click the report that you want to export.
2. On the report page, click the button in the header.

1. In the pop-up appears, select one of the following options:
  - Export all metrics: Use this if you want to export the report with all available metrics that the report template provides. All applied filters are also considered in the exported report.
  - Export selected metrics. Use this if you want to export the report with only the metrics the report creator had selected while configuring the report. This option essentially allows you to export the report as it is configured and displayed on the page.

1. For the selected option in the previous step, enter the email address of the report recipient and click Done.Important: The report contains important confidential data. Please ensure that the entered email address is correct and belongs to the recipient within your organization, such as another admin or manager.
2. The report is sent through an email to the entered email address. In the email, the recipient can click the link (Download report button) to download the report in a .csv file. Note that the link will expire in 7 days from the time it was sent.

You can share a self-serve report with other admins and managers via email. You can also schedule the report for sending later. You can either schedule to send the report once or define a frequency or cadence at which the report to be emailed regularly.

Tip: If you want to share the self-serve reports through Mindtickle’s in-built sharing functionality, see the “Share report” section.

On the report page, use the Email report option to email the report right away or schedule it for sending it later. Once sent, you can view and manage emailed and scheduled reports under the Schedule’s details tab. This tab will be available only when you have emailed the report at least once.

Note: Emailed self-serve reports are logged in Email Logs.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Email report > Email and schedule the report:
1. On the self-serve reports home page, click the report that you want to email.
2. On the report page, click the Email report button in the header.
3. In the dropdown pop-up that appears, select one of the following options:
  - Email to admins: Use this option to email the report to other admins. The emailed report will appear exactly as configured by the report creator (either you or another admin), including all applied filters.
  - Email to managers: Use this option to email a personalized version of the report to managers. Each manager will only see data related to their direct reportees — meaning both individual contributors and team leads who report to the manager. All applied filters are preserved in the emailed report.
4. Let’s now understand how to email the report to admins. Click Email to admins in the previous step.Note: The following instructions are also applicable for emailing the report to managers — except that you need to select managers instead of admins.
5. Under Email report to admins > Select admins, select one or more admins as recipients with whom you want to share the report via email.Note: You can select up to 1000 recipients at a time. This limitation does not include recipients added as CC in the next step.To search for a particular admin, use the search bar. When you select an admin after running a search, your selection is retained when you clear the search results. Use the Profile field filter to view only a specific set of admins in the list. Use thebutton in the column header to sort the list in the ascending/descending order.Select admins individually or use the check box in the column header to select all admins at once. Click Next to continue.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Email report > Email and schedule the report:
1. Under Add CC, for each selected admin, you can add other admins as CC (carbon copy) recipients. Admins added as CC will also receive the same report by email.Click the + Add CC, select admin users in the dropdown menu, and then click Next.

1. Under Share details, first select whether you want to email the report immediately (send now) or schedule it for sending later (schedule email). Continue to the next steps for information on both options.

1. This step provides information on the Send now option using which you can email the report immediately.Provide the following email message details and then click Email:

- Schedule name: Provide a name that will help you identify this report later under the Schedule’s details tab after it is sent. Enter a descriptive name that provides the context of the email, with respect to the email/report content, purpose of the email, and the audience (recipients). Note: The schedule name is visible only to you and is not shared in the email.
- Subject: Email subject line.
- Message: Email message/body text to provide context to the recipients.
- Attachment format: Select whether you want to send the report in a CSV, XLS, or XLSX format.

All selected admins and their CC recipients will shortly receive the report in an email. You can now view details on the emailed report and track its status under the Schedule’s details tab. For more information, see the “Manage emailed and scheduled reports” section.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Email report > Email and schedule the report:
1. This step provides information on the Schedule email option using which you can schedule the email for sending later. You can either schedule to send the report once or define a frequency or cadence at which the report will be emailed regularly.Set up a schedule for the email and provide the email message details as follows:

- Email scheduling options: First, set the frequency: Once, Daily, Weekly, or Biweekly. Then, for the selected frequency, select the start and end dates, start time, and the time zone.If you selected Frequency = Once, the report will be emailed only once to the recipients. Use any of the other three options if you want to email the report at a regular cadence.

- Schedule name: Provide a name that will help you identify this report later under the Schedule’s details tab after it is scheduled. Enter a descriptive name that provides the context of the email, with respect to the email/report content, purpose of the email, and the audience (recipients). Note: The schedule name is visible only to you and is not shared in the email.
- Subject: Email subject line.
- Message: Email message/body text to provide context to the recipients.
- Attachment format: Select whether you want to send the report in a CSV, XLS, or XLSX format.

Click Email once done. All selected admins and their CC recipients will receive the report in an email at the scheduled date and time. Recipients can access reports from the email by downloading it from the link.You can now view details on the emailed report, track its status, and take certain actions (remove the schedule, update the recipients, and update email message details) under the Schedule’s details tab. For more information, see the “Manage emailed and scheduled reports” section.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Email report > Manage emailed and scheduled reports:
- Schedule name: The name you had provided while emailing the report. It provides the context for the sent or scheduled email so that you can easily identify it in the list and also understand what it was for, with respect to the email/report content, purpose of the email, and the audience (recipients). Note: The schedule name is visible only to you and is not shared in the email.
- Created date: Date when the report was emailed. For scheduled reports, this is the date when the schedule was set up.
- Frequency: “Immediate” for emails sent using the Send now option. “Once”, “Daily”, “Weekly”, or “Biweekly” for emails sent using the Schedule email option depending on the frequency selected while scheduling the report.
- Start date: For emails sent using the Send now option, this is the date when the email was sent because the email is sent immediately. For emails sent using the Schedule email option, this is the schedule start date, that is, the date when the first scheduled email was sent.
- Status: Current status of the email, whether sent (completed) or in progress (for scheduled emails). “Completed” for emails sent using the Send now . Similarly, the status will be “Completed” for emails scheduled using the Schedule email option if the schedule is over. If a schedule is in progress, the status column shows the date when the next scheduled email will be sent.

Manage reports

Click the More options button for available options for the emailed/scheduled report, depending on the following:

For reports with the Completed status, you can only view the details and cannot make any changes. These are the reports emailed using Send now.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Share report:
You can share the report with other admins and managers.

Using the Mindtickle platform’s built-in share functionality, you can share self-serve reports (created by yourself and other admins) with other admins and managers in your organization. Recipients can access reports shared with them from Analytics > Shared section in the sidebar.

Tip: If you want to share the self-serve reports by email, see the “Email report” section.

1. On the self-serve reports home page, click the report that you want to share.
2. On the report page, click the button in the header.

1. In the pop-up appears, select one of the following options:
  - Share with admins: Use this option to share the report with other admins. The shared report will appear exactly as configured by the report creator (either you or another admin), including all applied filters.
  - Share with managers: Use this option to share a personalized version of the report with managers. Each manager will only see data related to their direct reportees — meaning both individual contributors and team leads who report to the manager. All applied filters are preserved in the shared report.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Create:
You can create a copy of a self-serve report — that is, duplicate the report — when you want to keep the original report intact, so you can make further changes to the copied version of the report. This is helpful, for example, when you want to share the same report but with less (or more) data with a different set of stakeholders.

1. On the self-serve reports home page, click the report that you want to duplicate.
2. On the report page, click the button in the header.

1. The copied version of the report opens in edit mode, with the prefix “Copy of” added to the report name.

You can make all kinds of changes, similar to creating a new report. For more information, see Create self-serve reports. Once done with your changes, click Save to save the report. Or, click Discard to discard the copied report and not create the report.

Important: The copied version of the report remains in the draft mode until you save it. Therefore, you must save the report to successfully create a copy.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Self-serve reports > Report actions > Delete report:
You can permanently delete self-serve reports created by you and other admins if you no longer need them.

1. Open the report that you want to delete. You can open a report for deleting in two ways from the self-serve home page:
  - From the list of reports, click (More options) > Delete report for the report that you want to delete.
  - From the list of reports, click the report that you want to delete. On the report page, click the button in the header to delete the report.
2. In the confirmation pop-up that appears, click Delete to permanently delete the self-serve report.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin:
Mindtickle integration with Salesforce allows learners (sales reps) to track the Asset Hub activities relevant to the Salesforce opportunity under the Opportunity’s Activity tab. This article provides information on the settings that need to be configured by admins in order to allow reps to track the Asset Hub activities.

Note: Asset Hub is a paid feature. For more information, contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

chunks.title: Salesforce Opportunity integration for activity writeback [admin]

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin > Important info:
- The integration currently supports activity tracking only for email-based interactions (assets shared via email ), and not for link-based interactions (assets shared via link ).
- Contact identification and Opportunity linking : The system identifies contacts in Salesforce whose email addresses match those of recipients of the shared assets and pushes activities from email interactions to the corresponding Salesforce Opportunities. After identifying the contacts, the system locates any open Opportunities associated with these contacts, and pushes the relevant activities to those Opportunities. These activities will be visible to sales reps in the Activity tab.
- This integration does not support activity writeback to closed Opportunities .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin > Set up Mindtickle-Salesforce connection:
1. In the admin site sidebar, click Account > Settings > Security & integrations . On the Security and integrations page, scroll down to the User Sync section and then select the Salesforce tab.
2. Select the User and Contact checkboxes and click Save , and then click Connect .
3. On the displayed screen, enter your Salesforce admin credentials to log in.
4. On the displayed pop-up, click Allow.
5. After logging into Salesforce, in the left navigation panel, click Apps > Connected Apps > Connected Apps OAuth Usage . The Connected Apps OAuth Usage screen is displayed.
6. Under the Connected App column, click the Install button on Mindtickle Salesforce OAuth.
7. On the displayed pop-up screen, click Install. The Mindtickle Salesforce OAuth app is now installed on the Salesforce instance.

Note:

- Mindtickle requires the above Salesforce permissions for seamless integration.
- At the company level, a set of flags is available to enable or disable activity writeback across the entire environment. Additionally, there are three separate sets of flags to control writeback for each specific activity type. The company-level flags act as a high-level switch to turn activity writeback on or off for the entire environment, while the activity-specific flags provide customers with the flexibility to selectively track and log particular activities in Salesforce. To enable or disable these flags, contact Mindtickle Support or your CSM. For more information on tracking activity writeback, see View and track Asset Hub activities in Salesforce Opportunities (reps) .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Create an assessment:
To create an assessment:

1. Sign in to the admin site.
2. On the left navigation bar, click Training and select Series .

The Series page is displayed.

1. Click on a series to add the assessment.

The Modules tab of the series is displayed.

1. Click on Add module.

1. On the Add module pop-up, click Assessment.

Tip:

- Click Browse module templates to browse pre-designed templates and create an assessment using an existing template. For more information on creating a module using a template, see Create a module using a module template .
- Click Create with AI assistance to create assessments with Mindtickle Copilot. For more information, see Mindtickle Copilot for creating assessments .

1. On the Create new assessment pop-up, in Assessment name, enter an appropriate name for the assessment.
2. In Description, enter a brief description of the assessment’s objectives and value.
3. [Skip this step if you have started creating the assessment from within a series.] In the Select a series dropdown, choose a series for the assessment. You can choose from the list of existing series or create a new series using the Create a new series link.
4. Click Apply Tags to associate tags with this assessment.
5. In the Apply Tags pop-up, choose tags from the list of available categories. If you are a site owner, you can create a new tag relevant to your assessment. For more information, see Create/Manage tags and tag categories.

Applying tags like Competency and Product Line lets learners discover content quickly and helps admins analyze learner patterns efficiently. For more information, see Apply tags to modules.Note: If Tags are not enabled for your site, contact Mindtickle Support.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Create an assessment > Assessment sections:
- Assessment header From this section, you can:
  - Rename the assessment module Click the dropdown against the assessment name and click Rename . Enter a new name for the assessment and click Save . Note : You can also update the assessment name from the assessment Settings . For more information, see Configure assessment settings: General .
  - Get the assessment URL Click the More options icon and click Get module URL . The URL is copied to the clipboard, and a confirmation message displays to indicate the same.
  - View the assessment's overall rating If you have enabled module rating and feedback on the assessment, learners can rate it on a scale of 1 to 5 (1 being the lowest and 5 being the highest) and provide textual feedback. The average rating of the assessment is displayed in the header. For more information on how to enable module rating, see Configure assessment settings > General > Allow rating and feedback . Note :
    - The Overall rating of the assessment displays on the Assessment details page after at least 10 learners have rated it.
    - Module rating and feedback are beta features. Please contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) to enable it for your site.
    - The assessment’s overall rating is visible in the header only if module rating is enabled for the assessment.
  - Add/remove tags from the assessment To add a tag to the assessment, in the Tags on module section, click the Add icon and follow the process mentioned in Step 9 of Add an assessment section. To remove a tag from the assessment, click the Delete icon on the tag.
  - Access the To-do list Click the To-do icon to access the list of tasks you must complete before publishing the assessment. Clicking on a task from the list displays the tab on which the action should be performed to complete the task.
  - Preview the assessment Click Preview to preview the assessment before publishing. This helps ensure you publish the assessment without any discrepancies.
- Assessment creation canvas From this section, you can:
  - Build the assessment
  - Configure assessment settings
  - Publish the assessment
  - Invite learners to the assessment

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Build the assessment > Question types in an assessment:
- Multiple choice question (MCQ) Has fixed options and provides immediate feedback to the learner.
- Multiple choice question (MCQ) with images If learners are expected to select an image answer from a list of options, use this instead of the multiple-choice question type.
- Match image with labels Use when learners are expected to match an object name with the object image.
- Match text labels Use when learners are expected to match a text option in one column with another (correct) text option in the second column.
- Text answer This question type is similar to Guess a Word . Here, the learner is expected to enter the answer manually.

From the Build tab, you can:

- Add individual questions
- Upload multiple questions in bulk
- Organize the questions within specific topics based on their related themes
- Rearrange the order of the topics
- Rearrange the order of the questions within the topics
- Move questions from one topic to another
- Merge topics
- Download the list of questions
- Delete questions from the assessment

This article further explains each of these actions in detail.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Build the assessment > Add topics to an assessment:
A topic refers to a specific subject or area of knowledge that is covered within the assessment. Each topic focuses on a specific subject or theme and contains a set of questions related to that particular topic. Topics can be used to assess different aspects of a subject, highlight specific learning objectives, or cover different modules or topics within a larger course or curriculum. You can list the topics in a logical order to guide the progression of the assessment. This enables you to create a balanced assessment that covers a range of important concepts or skills.

Note: You may start building the assessment by creating topics first and then adding questions to the topics or adding questions first and then assigning them to different topics. If you start by adding questions first and then creating topics, by default, all the existing questions are moved to the first topic you create. You may also build an assessment that consists of only questions and no topics.

To add a topic:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Build the assessment > Add topics to an assessment:
1. Click Add topic .
2. Enter a name for the topic and click Save . Note : The character limit for the topic name is 60 characters.
3. Hover over the topic and click the add sign to start adding questions to the topic.
4. To add the subsequent questions, repeat the previous step. Alternatively, click the Add question button.
5. To add more topics and questions to the assessment, repeat the steps mentioned above.
6. Drag and drop a topic to reorder the topic list. This determines the sequence in which they are presented to the learner while attempting the assessment.
7. Click the expand/collapse icon on a topic to expand or collapse the list of questions in that topic.
8. Drag and drop a question to move it from one topic to another.
9. Hover over a topic, click the More options icon on the topic, and select an option from the list to perform the following actions:
  1. Assign bulk score : Assign a score to all the questions in the topic. Select the score for the questions in the pop-up that appears, and click Yes, assign score . Note :
    - This action overwrites the assigned score for the selected questions.
    - You cannot assign a customized score to the questions.
  2. Merge with another topic : Merge the questions from the topic into another topic. From the dropdown in the pop-up that appears, select the topic you want to merge, and click Yes, merge . Note :
    - Once you merge a topic, it cannot be undone.
    - Merging to another topic may lead to different scores in some topics. If randomization is enabled on the assessment, this may impact the randomization settings.
  3. Rename : Rename the topic. Tip : You can also double-click the topic name to edit it.
  4. Duplicate : Create a copy of the topic. Tip : The new topic is created with the same name as the existing topic. Rename the new topic to avoid confusion.
  5. Delete : Delete the topic and the questions in it. In the pop-up that appears, acknowledge the warning by checking the checkbox, and click Yes, delete . You can choose to delete the entire topic and the questions, or delete only the topic but retain the questions.
10. Select multiple topics or questions to perform the following bulk actions:
  1. Move : Move the selected questions or topics to a new or existing topic.
  2. Assign score : Assign a score to the selected questions in bulk.
  3. Delete : Delete the selected questions or topics.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Build the assessment > Add individual questions:
To add individual questions:

1. On the Build tab of the assessment, click Add question.

1. On the Add question pop-up, select the question type.

1. In the below example, a multiple-choice question is selected. For more information on each question type, see Question types.Note:
  - Two answer option fields are generated by default for question types with multiple answer options.
  - The answer options are randomized automatically for each learner. This ensures the assessments are unbiased and reduces the likelihood of learners receiving the same assessments.
2. [ Optional ] To add tags to questions, in the Tags on question section, click the Tags icon and follow the process mentioned in Step 9 of the Add an assessment section.
3. To configure the question score, click the Question score dropdown and select the appropriate value. By default, the question score is set to 100.
4. Click Attach image or video (optional).

Tip: Adding an image or video provides learners context, reference, and additional details about the question.

To add an image or video, drag and drop the file or click Attach image or video (Optional) to view the upload options available, such as your computer or cloud storage options.

Note: The supported file formats are: .MOV, .MP4, .WEBM, .JPG, .JPEG, .GIF, and .PNG.

1. To add more questions to the assessment, repeat the steps mentioned above.

The Build tab displays the list of questions successfully added to the assessment.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Build the assessment > Bulk upload questions:
To upload questions in bulk, add them to a file and upload them to the assessment. There are three ways to do this. Refer to the following section for details on each method.

Note: This option allows you to upload only two question types: Multiple-choice questions (MCQs) and Text answers.

To ensure that you add the questions to the file in the correct format, use Mindtickle’s sample file. For more information, follow the steps below:

1. On the Build tab of the assessment, click the Bulk upload questions link.

Or

1. Click the Upload questions icon.

1. Click Add question and select Bulk upload questions from the Add question pop-up.
2. On the Add new questions pop-up, click Download sample . The sample file downloads to your system. Open it using Microsoft Excel. It contains two sheets: questions and instructions . Before you start filling in the worksheet, read the instructions carefully. Enter appropriate data in each field in the Questions sheet, save the file, and upload it.

Once the file is uploaded successfully, the Add new questions pop-up displays the list of questions added to the file.

1. Review each question by clicking the Edit icon against it.

1. Update the question if necessary and click Save changes.

1. To delete the question, click the Delete icon against it.
2. To change the questions and re-upload the file, click Reupload.
3. After finalizing all changes, click Upload (n) questions.

The Build tab displays the list of questions successfully added to the assessment.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Build the assessment > Duplicate a question:
To reuse a question or its format in the assessment, you can duplicate it. To duplicate a question:

1. Hover over the question, click the More options icon, and select Duplicate . An exact copy of the question is created and added to the list as a new question. Every part of the original question, including the text, attachments, question score, and answer options, is duplicated.
2. Update the question details if necessary. Note : Changes made to the copy of the original question do not affect the original question.

1. Hover over the question, click the More options icon, and select Duplicate . An exact copy of the question is created and added to the list as a new question. Every part of the original question, including the text, attachments, question score, and answer options, is duplicated.
2. Update the question details if necessary. Note : Changes made to the copy of the original question do not affect the original question.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Build the assessment > Delete a question:
If you do not want a particular question to be a part of the assessment, you can delete it. To delete a question:

1. Hover over a question, click the More options icon, and select Delete .

1. In the Delete question? pop-up, click Delete question . The question is removed from the assessment.
2. To delete multiple questions in bulk, select the checkboxes of the questions to remove and click Delete.

1. In the Delete (n) questions? pop-up, click Delete . The selected questions are removed from the assessment.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Thumbnail:
The thumbnail represents the assessment's goal and content. When you create an assessment, the system displays a default image from the image library as the series thumbnail.

You can change the thumbnail with an existing image in the gallery or upload a new image.

A checkmark on the thumbnail in the library indicates the current selection. The thumbnail file names are displayed below the preview images, making it easier to identify and select the thumbnails.

To change an assessment's thumbnail, hover over the thumbnail and click Change.

The Gallery pop-up is displayed. From the gallery, choose from previously uploaded images or upload a new image.

Uncheck the image from the gallery to reset the assessment's thumbnail to the default state.

Tip: Use the Search field to search for specific thumbnails quickly.

The supported file formats are .JPEG, .JPG, and .PNG. The supported file size is 540 x 360 px.

Note: The supported file formats are .jpeg, .jpg, and .png. The supported file size is 540 x 360 px.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Time limit:
Set a time limit for the assessment. The timer starts when the learner starts the assessment. It does not pause even if the learner leaves the assessment or logs out of the platform. The assessment is automatically submitted when the allotted time limit is elapsed.

1. To enable the time limit for an assessment, click the Time limit switch.

Note: By default, the time limit is set to 60 minutes.

2. In Time limit, enter the value in minutes.

Note:

- The time limit can be set between 1 to 360 minutes only.
- If the learner is attempting a non-timed assessment (the time limit is disabled) and navigates away from the assessment or logs out from the platform, the module's status is set to In progress. The status continues to remain In progress until the learner submits the assessment. The assessment is submitted only when the learner clicks Submit .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Reattempt:
Choose whether you would want learners to reattempt the assessment.

1. Click the Reattempt switch to enable this feature.

2. In Number of reattempts, set the number of re-attempts allowed for the assessment. You can set it between 1 and 10 or as No limit.

Note: Do not set the number of re-attempts to No limit, if you have set the Reveal questions and answers after submission setting to After all attempts are over, as it takes the learner in an infinite loop.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Reveal questions and answers after submission:
You can select whether to reveal the correct answers to learners after submitting the assessment.

1. Click the Reveal questions & answers after submission switch to enable this feature.

Note: This setting only reveals the correct answers to the learners. It does not provide any explanation.

2. Select whether you want the learners to view the correct answers. The following options are available.

- After each attempt - All correct answers: The system reveals the correct answers for all questions in the assessment after each attempt.
- After each attempt - Only those selected by learners: The system reveals the correct and incorrect answers in the learner’s submissions, without revealing all correct answers for the entire assessment.
- After all attempts are over - All correct answers: After the learner uses all reattempts, the system reveals the correct answers for all assessment questions in the assessment. Note:
  - If a learner passes the assessment, the system reveals the correct answers for all assessment questions
  - The After each attempt - Only those selected by learners option is available only on the web and not on the mobile app.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Scoring and certification:
Set the minimum percentage accepted for a passing score. You can select between 10 and 100 %.

The learner can pass the assessment only if they earn the passing score (or more). For example, if the assessment has a max score of 1000 points and the passing score is 80%, learners pass it only if they earn 800 points or more.

To set a minimum passing score for an assessment, click the Passing score drop-down and select a percentage.

You can also click the Edit icon and enter a custom passing score for the assessment.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Scoring and certification > Certificate:
Choose if you want the learners to be awarded a certificate when they pass an assessment. To pass an assessment, learners’ final score should be greater than or equal to the passing score.

1. To enable certification for assessments, click the Certificate switch.

2. In the Validity drop-down, select for how long the certificate is valid.

Note:

- The certification validity can be set to a maximum of 60 months.
- If the certification validity was originally set to 24 months and later updated to 12 months, the new change applies only to the learners who are yet to complete the assessment (irrespective of the module versions).
- The certificate is generated in the language set for the learning site.
- For more information, see Account settings > Language .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Scoring and certification > Recertification:
The Recertification option allows learners to renew their assessment certificates before they expire.

1. In the Recertification section, click the toggle to enable it.

2. In the Make recertification available to the learners option, select when learners are allowed to recertify themselves.

For example, if you select 15 days, learners can recertify themselves 15 days before their certificate expires.

3. In Set Reminders, select when to send recertification reminders to learners.

For example, if you select 120 minutes, recertification reminders are sent to learners 120 minutes before their certificate expires.

4. In the Recertification version, select the assessment version for recertification. The following options are available:

- The version they were invited to: Learners recertify themselves in the same version of the assessment they were invited to previously.
- The latest version: Learners recertify themselves in the latest version of the assessment.

For more information, see When are certificates achieved: Assessment.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > General > Scoring and certification > Wrong answer penalty:
Set an additional penalty on the learner’s total score for wrong answers. You can set it between the range of -5% to -50%.

For example, if you set the penalty as -10% and the learner selects an incorrect answer for a 100-point question, they miss the 100 points, and an additional 10 points (10%) will be deducted from the learner's total score.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Due date and emails:
From this tab, you can configure the assessment's due date, invitation, reminder, and completion settings. For more information, see Invitation and reminder settings.

Note:

- You can configure a universal assessment due date at the module level that applies to all learners invited to the assessment. Or, you can configure it at the individual learner or group level. This allows you to determine when each learner or learner group must complete the assessment. For more information on how to configure assessment due dates for individual learners or groups, see Edit due date for learners .
- If you change the assessment’s due date settings after it has been set for individual learners or groups, the system launches a pop-up notification. Confirm if you want to change the due date for all learners invited to the assessment or just for the selected ones. If you want to apply the change to all learners, proceed with the change, else, click Discard .

- When setting the due date, the time zone is set to the admin's system time zone. However, it automatically adjusts to the learner’s time zone and is displayed correctly on the learning site.

Note: Enabling question or answer option randomization in an assessment does not lead to a version upgrade of the assessment.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Randomization > Randomize questions > Randomization in assessments with topics:
If enabled, all topics within the assessment are listed. By default, the value set in the Number of questions to show dropdown is selected to All for each topic. This means each learner receives all questions within that topic in a unique sequence. Change the value in the dropdown based on your requirement. Showing only some questions within a topic can provide learners with a unique set, increasing the likelihood of a fairer assessment. For example, if the topic contains eleven questions, you may choose to have nine questions randomly shown to each learner. This provides a different experience for each learner.

Note:

- If the scores for all questions are not the same, all questions must be included to keep the possible points even for all learners. To ensure this, the only value available for selection in the dropdown is All . Alternatively, you can update the topic's questions to have the same score, then select the number of questions to show.

- Similarly, if a topic is merged, it may have questions with different scores. Ensure that the questions are updated to have the same score. In this case, the only value available for selection in the dropdown is All . Alternatively, you can update the questions in the topic to have the same score and then select the number of questions to show.
- If you want tag analytics data, you must select all questions for randomization. Otherwise, tags applied to individual questions are not considered.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Randomization > Randomize answers:
Answer options can be randomized for each learner. This means each learner receives a different sequence of answer options for each question. By default, the answer option randomization feature is disabled. To randomize answers, switch the Randomize answers toggle to On.

Note:

- This option is not recommended if the answer options in any of your questions have answers that refer specifically to correlating options, as it could change the correct answers. For example, the correct answer is both A and B, but the answer shuffle changes the correct options to C and D.
- Answer options are not randomised in assessment previews.

Once all assessment settings are configured, you can publish them. For more information, see Publish an assessment.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment:
An assessment is a great way to test or certify a learner’s skill and knowledge on a particular subject. Mindtickle’s assessment module offers a clean interface that helps the learner focus on the question and possible answers.

Using the assessment module you can engage learners by including a mix of different question types such as:

- Multiple choice question (MCQ)
- Multiple choice question (MCQ) with images
- Match image with labels
- Match text labels
- Text answer

For more information about each question type, see Question types in an assessment.

You can add and organize questions in an assessment within specific topics based on their related themes. Grouping questions within topics provides a more organized, focused, and effective assessment experience. It supports a better understanding of learning objectives and targeted analysis for improved training outcomes. Moreover, the questions and answer options can be randomized for each learner. If this feature is enabled, learners receive unique assessments with different questions and sequences of answer options. This ensures the assessments are unbiased and reduces the likelihood of learners receiving the same assessments.

Note: By default, the question and answer option randomization feature is disabled. For more information on how to enable them, see Configure assessment settings: Randomization.

To make an assessment more engaging, you can:

- Add and organize questions within specific topics
- Set a time limit on it
- Add tags to it
- Configure a passing score and wrong answer penalty
- Enable or disable assessment certification, recertification, and reattempt
- Configure randomization of questions and answers
- Allow learners to rate it (Beta)

For more information on how to create an assessment and make it more engaging, see Create an assessment and Configure assessment settings.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Republish the assessment:
You can edit and republish an assessment if necessary.

1. On the admin site, click Training and select Series.

2. Click on the series with the assessment module.

3. Click the series with the assessment module.

4. Click the Build tab

5. In the Push these changes for, the following options are available:

- Only those learners who are invited hereafter: Only learners invited in the future can view this version of the assessment.
- Only those learners who have not started the assessment : The learners who have not started and the learners invited in the future can see this version of the assessment.

6. To discard unpublished changes, click Discard changes.

Only unpublished changes from the current assessment version are discarded when you discard changes.

Note:

- Learners already invited to the assessment continue to view the version to which they were invited. They cannot view the updated assessment version.
- Admins can update the question text without triggering an update to the module or resetting the learners' progress for those who have already completed the module. These changes are directly pushed to all learners invited to the module.

The following assessment attributes are not a part of the version update and remain the same across all versions:

- Name
- Description
- Thumbnail
- Reveal questions and answers after submission
- Due date
- Reminders

The following assessment attributes are a part of the version update and changes across the assessment versions:

- Time limit
- Passing score
- Wrong answer penalty
- Randomization

7. Click Publish changes.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Assessment > Track learners’ progress on assessment > Edit due date:
This allows you to revise the assessment completion due date by assigning a specific due date for the learner. This determines when the learner must complete the module.

1. Clicking Edit due date launches a pop-up. In the pop-up, you can choose a specific date or select the number of days after the last configured due date. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) or Mindtickle Support to enable this feature.

Note:

- If the module's Due date for the learner toggle is disabled on the assessment’s Settings page, the Due date column is not displayed in the series’s Invite and track tab.
- If the due date is disabled at the module level but an individual due date is set for a learner, that learner must adhere to that individual due date.
- If the module-level due date is enabled but an individual learner’s due date is set to None , that learner has no specific deadline, and None is displayed in the learner’s Due date column of the Invite and track tab.

2. In Set a new due date for learners, select the type of due date to set for the learner. The following options are available:

- No. of days after invitation: The learner’s reminder is sent after a certain number of days after the invitation. For example, if a learner is invited on November 1 and the due date is set to three days after the invitation, the due date will be November 4.
- Select a specific date: The learner’s reminder is sent on a specific date after the invitation. For example, if the due date is set to a specific date, such as November 10, the learner must complete the course by that date.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync > Benefits of integration:
Integrating AEM to sync the content from AEM to Mindtickle automatically, improves the productivity and efficiency of enablement admins, as they would no longer need to update the content on the Mindtickle platform manually.

Features of the automated sync from AEM:

- Admins can designate specific folders to sync from AEM to Mindtickle.
- In AEM, on updating the content in the designated folders, automatically updates in Mindtickle.
- Admins configure the content metadata to sync in AEM. The metadata synced from AEM automatically gets pushed to the assets published in Mindtickle.

2. On the Security and Integrations tab, navigate to the Content Sync section. Select Adobe Experience Manager and click Add account.

3. On the Add account modal, enter the Account details information.

a) Enter the Account name. The account name must be unique. If the same account name already exists, an error message displays to add a unique account name.

b) Enter the Connection details.

- Enter the AEM instance URL . For example, if the AEM instance address is https://companyname.adobeaemcloud.com:8080, then the AEM instance URL is https://companyname.adobeaemcloud.com.
- Enter the Port number associated with the AEM instance. For example, if the AEM instance address is https://companyname.adobeaemcloud.com:8080, the port number is 8080. This field can be left empty if there is no associated port number.

c) To connect with the AEM instance, enter the Username and the Password, and click Connect.

Note: The Username and Password should match the username and password entered in the AEM instance.

4. Click Save and proceed.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync > Steps to integrate AEM with Mindtickle > Map folders and asset metadata > Map folders:
Enter the folder name and the nested folder in the AEM folder path. For information on entering the folder path, see How do I enter the AEM folder path.

The system does validation checks to ensure the folder path is valid in your AEM instance.

An error message displays if the validation fails. The error message mentions the folder path is not present in the corresponding AEM instance.

Note: When the first sync runs, the Content Center creates the AEM folder having the account name configured as per the Account details section.

2. Click Add another folder to add multiple folder paths.

Note:

- You can add a maximum of 50 folder paths.
- The folder path can have at most 9 levels of nested folders. Mindtickle does not sync content beyond 9 nested folders.
- You cannot configure the same folder path multiple times.
- You cannot configure a child folder for an already configured parent folder.

3. To delete the folder path, click the Delete icon.

4. To complete the mapping process without mapping the asset metadata, click Save and proceed.

Note: Mapping the asset metadata is optional.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync > Enable metadata update events in AEM:
Note: Reach out to your development team to help you set up the updates to the metadata events in AEM.

To enable metadata audit events in Adobe Experience Manager:

1. Login to https://experience.adobe.com/.

2. On the home page, click Experience Manager.

3. On Cloud Manager, click Launch.

4. Select the required environment.

5. In the Production environment, select the Repositories tab and click Access Repo Info.

6. In Repository Info for your environment, click Generate password. Use the Git command line, Username, and Password to clone the Adobe cloud manager repository to your local computer.

7. Create the below two files in the ui.config/src/main/content/jcr_root/apps/{projectName}/osgiconfig/config folder. Create the folder if the config folder does not exist in the osgiconfig folder.

a) File name - com.day.cq.dam.core.impl.event.DamEventAuditListener.cfg.json

Code

```
{}
```

b) File name - com.day.cq.dam.core.impl.DamEventRecorderImpl.cfg.json

Code

```
{  "eventrecorder.eventtypes": ["METADATA_UPDATED"],  "eventrecorder.enabled": true}
```

8. Commit these changes and push the code to the git repository of your environment.

9. Go to Adobe Cloud Manager. Select Pipeline. Click the three dot menu icon and click Run.

Note: There should be one non-production deployment pipeline.

10. Once the deployment is complete, go to the AEM instance and change the title of any file. Run the below cURL command to fetch metadata changes.

```
curl --location 'https://{AEM_INSTANCE_URL}/bin/querybuilder.json?path=%2Fhome%2Fusers&1_property=sling%3AresourceType&1_property.value=granite%2Factivitystreams%2Fcomponents%2Factivity&p.hits=full&p.nodedepth=2&2_property=verb&2_property.value=METADATA_UPDATED&property.and=true'
```

11. Make sure to have the permission jcr:read for the path /home/user.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync > Frequently asked questions (FAQ's):
How do I find the AEM instance URL?

The AEM instance URL is available from the browser bar. The image below highlights the AEM instance URL.

How do I enter the AEM folder path?

The path for the sub-folder (child folder) is available from the URL in the browser bar. In the below example, the AEM child folder path is the path after assets.html, that is, /content/dam/parent-folder/child-folder. Your folder path must start with /content/dam.

Note: Avoid configuring /content/dam as a folder path unless you want all your assets to sync from AEM to Mindtickle.

What are the different types of validation failures while mapping a folder?

The folder path is not available in AEM.

Configuring a child folder of an already configured folder.

Configure an already existing folder path again.

What can I do if I have more than 9 nested folders within the folder path configured to sync?

Instead of configuring the parent folder with more than 9 nested folders, configure its child folders so that none have more than 9 folders.

Alternatively, configure the parent folders in AEM so the configured folder does not have more than 9 nested folders.

Note: At a later point (after successfully activating the AEM connection), in the configured folders, if the admin breaches the limit of 9 nested folders and creates more nested folders, the content is not synced from the folder beyond 9-levels of the hierarchy.

What if I need more than 50 folder paths in the mapping?

Add another account with the remaining folders. Multiple AEM accounts can be created and connected.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync:
Note: Automated sync from Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) is a beta feature. Contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM) to enable it for your learning site.

The metadata sheet contains the properties of Mindtickle assets and attributes created for that learning site till that point in time. Admins can map the corresponding AEM properties. After filling the metadata sheet, admins must upload that file on Mindtickle.

When the automated sync job runs, based on the metadata mapping, it fetches the metadata properties from AEM and populates them in the Mindtickle assets. The mapped properties are in read-only format in the Mindtickle assets. To edit any mapped asset property within Mindtickle, in the metadata mapping sheet keep the asset property value blank and re-upload the .csv file.

Automated sync of metadata helps to improve the admin's efficiency as they do not have to update the asset properties in Mindtickle manually.

Note: Adding the metadata details is a one-time setup to map the asset data. However, editing the synced account details update the metadata details.

To add the metadata details:

1. In the admin site sidebar, click Account > Settings > Security & Integrations.

2. On the Security and Integrations tab, navigate to the Content Sync section. Select Adobe Experience Manager and click Add account.

3. On the Add account modal, enter the Account details and navigate to Map folders and asset metadata.

4. After entering the folder details, click the Map asset metadata toggle to enable the mapping of Mindtickle’s assets metadata to AEM. Then, click Download metadata.

The .csv file containing the metadata template, that is, the asset properties and asset attributes of your learning site gets downloaded to your local computer.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync > Map AEM asset tags:
To map the asset’s AEM tags in Mindtickle:

1. In Adobe Experience Manager, navigate to Tools > Assets > Metadata Schema Form Editor and select the metadata form relevant to the folder path configured for the account.

2. Click the Tags field to sync and click the Settings tab. Copy the value mentioned in the Map to property field.

3. Paste the Map to Property value in the Property/Attribute ID (AEM) column in the downloaded metadata sheet. The Property/Attribute ID (AEM) value is for the Mindtickle attributes mapped to AEM tags.

4. To map a particular AEM tag with a Mindtickle asset attribute, navigate to Adobe Experience Manager > Tools > General > Tagging. Select the tag to be mapped and copy the path from the URL.

5. Enter the path in the downloaded metadata sheet in the Property/Attribute Value (AEM) column. Enter the path in the format Tag Namespace:Tag Path.

For example, if the copied tag path is workflow/projects/wcm/launch, then workflow is the Tag Namespace. In the metadata sheet, enter workflow:projects/wcm/launch in the Property/Attribute Value (AEM) column.
