To map the asset’s AEM tags in Mindtickle:

1. In Adobe Experience Manager, navigate to Tools > Assets > Metadata Schema Form Editor and select the metadata form relevant to the folder path configured for the account.

2. Click the Tags field to sync and click the Settings tab. Copy the value mentioned in the Map to property field.

3. Paste the Map to Property value in the Property/Attribute ID (AEM) column in the downloaded metadata sheet. The Property/Attribute ID (AEM) value is for the Mindtickle attributes mapped to AEM tags.

4. To map a particular AEM tag with a Mindtickle asset attribute, navigate to Adobe Experience Manager > Tools > General > Tagging. Select the tag to be mapped and copy the path from the URL.

5. Enter the path in the downloaded metadata sheet in the Property/Attribute Value (AEM) column. Enter the path in the format Tag Namespace:Tag Path.

For example, if the copied tag path is workflow/projects/wcm/launch, then workflow is the Tag Namespace. In the metadata sheet, enter workflow:projects/wcm/launch in the Property/Attribute Value (AEM) column.

Note: Replace the first / (forward slash) from the left with a colon (:).

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync > Frequently asked questions (FAQs):
What happens if you do not map the asset properties?

The asset properties do not get synced from AEM. The admins can edit the corresponding asset properties in Mindtickle.

Can I create (add and delete) rows in the downloaded metadata file?

Mindtickle recommends not adding and deleting rows from the downloaded metadata .csv file. Only add the mapping for the required properties. Refrain from creating new rows in the downloaded metadata file. If you do not want to sync specific properties from AEM, leave the properties empty.

What happens if the mapping is incorrect?

When the mapping is incorrect, the data from AEM to Mindtickle does not sync. The property identifier names are case-sensitive. Do not add spaces in the property identifier name.

Can I update the mapping later?

Yes. You can upload the .csv file again to update the mapping. Once you update the mapping, it affects all the existing assets as per the changes made in the mapping. The mapped properties then display on the asset in Mindtickle. You can edit the unmapped properties of the asset in Mindtickle.

If you update the .csv sheet:

- For properties previously unmapped but now mapped - In Mindtickle, you cannot edit the property values. The values of the properties display in read-only format.
- For properties previously mapped but now unmapped - These properties are no longer updated via sync from AEM. You can edit the property values in Mindtickle.

If you disable the asset metadata sync, asset properties no longer sync. However, the values for asset properties remain intact. You can edit the asset properties in Mindtickle.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Integrations > Automated Sync > Frequently asked questions (FAQs):
You can edit the asset properties in Mindtickle.

Can Customized Asset Creation properties can be synced?

Yes. The metadata mapping sheet includes 4 rows to define customization options:

- allowMixAndMatch = TRUE → Users can mix and match slides from this asset when creating customized assets.
- allowMixAndMatch = FALSE → Users cannot mix and match slides from this asset.
- allowEditingContent = TRUE → Users can edit the asset content when creating customized assets, through Microsoft Office for the web (PowerPoint, Word, and Excel) or Google Workspace (Slides, Docs, and Sheets).
- allowEditingContent = FALSE → Users cannot edit the asset content.

Once this property is synced:

- It becomes read-only inside Mindtickle (as with other synced asset properties).
- Any changes to the properties must be made in the source (SharePoint or AEM).
- Synced values automatically populate for assets during creation or update; otherwise, the default is No .

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin > Bulk actions on assets:
As an admin, you can select multiple assets within a hub and perform certain actions on them. Thus allowing admins to:

- Utilize filters or manually choose the assets you want to update
- Select multiple assets at a time based on various filters
- Publish, move, mirror, archive, and edit properties for multiple assets in one go
- Reset the filters to remove the applied criteria and start a fresh selection process if you need to update another batch of assets.

In the admin site sidebar, click Assets > Hubs to open the page that lists all hubs. Select a hub to open the hub page, which lists all assets . You can apply multiple filters to list the assets you are looking for. Once applied, select the assets to perform the bulk actions. You can monitor your action’s progress and outcome using the Notifications option in the header. For more information, see Notifications overview.

You can perform the following bulk actions:

- Publish
- Mirror
- Move
- Edit properties
- Archive

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin > Bulk actions on assets > Publish:
From a hub, select one or more draft assets that you want to publish. You can also select all draft assets. Use the first filter (All) and select Draft to list only draft assets.

In the pop-up that appears, review the assets you are publishing.

Once you confirm to publish the assets, you can view and track the publishing action status the Notifications option in the header. For more information, see Notifications overview. It shows whether the publishing is successful or provides error and details in case of failure.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Asset Hub > Admin > Bulk actions on assets > Mirror:
Mirroring makes the same asset available in multiple hubs. Click Mirror and select a destination hub from the pop-up that appears. You can also add a hub to the list by clicking +Add another.

Note:

- When you mirror an asset in multiple hubs, its content and configuration replicate across all other instances.
- If the content or configuration of one instance changes, it automatically reflects across all other instances.
- When you remove an instance of the asset from a hub, it will no longer be visible to the users and will not be a part of the analytics for that hub.

You can also view these points on the tooltip, which appears on hovering What is Mirroring?

Once you select the destination hub, click Confirm at the lower-right corner to proceed.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Analytics & Reporting > Reference > Viewing data update frequency on the platform:
In Mindtickle Analytics reports and dashboards, you can view the latest and upcoming data update/refresh time (in your local time zone):

- Updated on : Time when the data was last updated. All current data in the reports and dashboards is based on this latest data update. All activity before this time is reflected in the data; some more recent activity may also appear, but everything up to this time is always included.
- Next refresh : Time before which the next data update will take place.

Note: The Updated on and Next refresh timestamps now also appear in new analytics experience reports, including advanced reports, custom reports, and out-of-the-box (OOTB) reports. Previously, these timestamps were available only in legacy analytics reports.

These timestamps, along with other date and time values in analytics reports, are displayed in your local time zone (based on your device's time zone setting). For more information, see Local time zone support in analytics reports.

The data update frequency for exported reports matches the frequency on the UI so that you get the same data whether viewing on the UI or in exported reports. The data update frequency is also available for the analytics reports and dashboards for managers under Team analytics on the learning site.

Note: For the assessment module reports, the data update frequency is different for certain widgets and reports. For details, see Assessment module analytics.

In addition to the analytics available on the platform, you can also access your Mindtickle analytics data through integration with Snowflake or with Mindtickle's reporting API. In both methods, you need to run queries to fetch data from the metadata tables. The data update frequency is defined at the table level; all tables have a different update frequency.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Key benefits:
- Streamlines sales processes. Integrating DSR with Microsoft Dynamics 365 allows for a seamless flow of data and information between the two systems. This streamlines the sales process, eliminating manual data entry and reducing the risk of errors. Sales teams can easily access customer data, track interactions, and manage leads, opportunities, and quotes within a unified platform.
- Enhances collaboration. DSRs provide collaborative features such as document sharing, real-time co-authoring, and virtual meeting capabilities. By integrating these capabilities with Microsoft Dynamics 365, sales teams can collaborate more effectively, both internally and with customers. They can work together on presentations, proposals, and contracts, facilitating faster decision-making and improving the overall customer experience.
- Improves customer engagement. DSRs offer interactive and immersive experiences for customers during the sales process. Integrating DSR with Microsoft Dynamics 365 enables a seamless transition from initial customer interactions to more personalized and engaging sales meetings. Sales representatives can share relevant content, showcase product demos, and tailor the sales pitch based on customer preferences, increasing customer engagement and satisfaction.
- Provides a centralized data management repository. Integrating DSR with Microsoft Dynamics 365 ensures that all sales-related data is stored in a centralized location. This allows for better data management, tracking, and reporting. Sales teams can easily access customer information, sales histories, and opportunity progress, providing them with a holistic view of the sales pipeline. Managers can generate comprehensive reports and gain insights into sales performance, enabling data-driven decision-making.
- Provides improved analytics and forecasting. With a DSR integration, sales teams can leverage the analytical capabilities of Microsoft Dynamics 365 to gain deeper insights into sales performance and customer behavior. By combining data from the DSR and CRM systems, sales managers can analyze sales trends, identify bottlenecks, and make data-driven decisions to optimize sales strategies. Accurate forecasting becomes easier, as sales teams can access real-time data and make informed predictions about future sales.
- Increases efficiency and productivity. Integrating DSR with Microsoft Dynamics 365 eliminates the need for manual data entry and reduces duplication of efforts. This saves time for sales representatives, allowing them to focus on selling activities rather than administrative tasks. Automation of sales processes, such as generating quotes or sending follow-up emails, further improves efficiency and productivity.
- Provides better sales visibility and accountability. By integrating DSR with Dynamics 365, sales managers gain greater visibility into the sales pipeline and individual sales reps' activities. They can track the progress of opportunities, monitor sales performance, and identify areas for improvement. This increased visibility promotes accountability among sales teams, ensuring that targets are met, and sales activities are aligned with the organization's goals.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Integrate Microsoft Dynamics 365 with DSR:
1. Navigate to Organization Settings > Integrations .
2. Click Connect next to Dynamics 365 to start the authentication process.
3. On the pop-up, enter your Dynamics 365 instance URL and click Connect . Note : An instance URL is the web address that allows you to access your specific instance of the Dynamics 365 application. The Microsoft Sign In page opens in a new tab of your browser. Enter your login credentials and sign in. Alternatively, if you have already signed in, select your account from this page to log in.
4. Once the integration is successfully set up, you are redirected to your DSR instance in the previous tab and the Configure Dynamics 365 data sync pop-up appears. You can configure the required DSR activities to be pushed back to Dynamics as an activity. Switch the respective toggle to ON or OFF based on your requirements. By default, all activities are toggled ON . Note :
  - To ensure these activities and contacts are created successfully:
    - Connect the Microsoft Dynamics account using credentials that have read and write permissions.
    - Ensure the task and contact objects in your Microsoft Dynamics account do not have any custom mandatory fields.
    - Users must select synced items from the CRM when creating a room (for example, selecting an opportunity that has been synced and adding synced contacts).
  - By default, these activities are added to synced opportunities, contacts, and/or accounts.
  - You can configure or update these settings anytime based on your requirements. For more information, see Push Data from DSR to Microsoft Dynamics 365 .
5. Upon successful integration setup, the Dynamics 365 section on the Integrations tab lists the most recent sync(s) along with the details, such as the number of users, accounts, contacts, and opportunities that were synced from your Microsoft Dynamics 365 account. The data is auto-synced periodically (every three hours). To perform a manual sync, click Sync . Note :
  - The initial data sync takes several hours, depending on how many records exist in the CRM. However, it is processed without any work on your part. Once the initial sync is complete, you receive an email notification, notifying you about the same. Future syncs only validate for changes to any records and take a few minutes.
  - The CRM contacts must have an email address to sync.
  - Opportunities do not require a primary contact.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Digital Sales Rooms > Push Data from DSR to Microsoft Dynamics:
In addition to pulling in data from Microsoft Dynamics, you can decide whether to push data into Microsoft Dynamics and create activities and contacts for key events. The activities created are associated with the opportunity, account, and contact, as appropriate.

Activities can be created when:

- a room is created, edited, and visited
- a new comment is posted under Conversations
- a mutual action plan task is marked as Completed

Contacts can be created when a room is visited by a contact not already in your CRM (will be associated with an Opportunity and Account, if available).

To enable Microsoft Dynamics 365 activity creation, when setting up a new sync, you are presented with the following options:

Tip: Enable Create new Contacts for unmatching emails to ensure a contact is created in Dynamics 365 automatically every time a new visitor visits a room. Furthermore, to enhance the contact information of customers visiting your DSR, enable the Allow automatic enrichment of contact data switch from the Company Profile page. Users receive enriched contact data that may include the customer’s first and last name, phone number, organization, job title, LinkedIn profile link, and profile image. For more information, see Set Up Digital Sales Rooms: Company Profile.

These options are configurable by account to ensure they match your CRM needs. Switch the respective toggle to ON or OFF based on your requirements.

To update these settings:

1. Click Configure . The Configure Microsoft Dynamics data sync pop-up appears. Make the necessary updates and click Close icon.

Once these settings are configured:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT):
Instructor-led training (ILT) in Mindtickle is a form of training that combines the benefits of Mindtickle's sales enablement platform with the expertise and guidance of an instructor or facilitator. ILT events and sessions in Mindtickle offer a structured learning environment where participants can engage in interactive training sessions, collaborate with peers, and receive real-time guidance from instructors.

Note: ILT is supported on the web and the Mindtickle app (iOS and Android). Offline mode is not available in the app.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Key Benefits:
- Multi-day Events An event is a collection of sessions designed to streamline administrative tasks for enablement admins. Admins can configure full-day/multi-day events comprising multiple sessions across multiple days for events such as sales onboarding programs, company/sales kick-off programs, and knowledge certification programs. Admins can perform bulk actions on sessions, such as configuring enrollment, reminder, and completion settings at the event level, with the ability to trickle down to individual sessions. This improves efficiency, ensures consistency, and enhances overall management and participant experience in multi-session events.
- Interactive Learning Environment ILT modules in Mindtickle provide an interactive learning environment where learners can actively engage with the content, instructors, and fellow learners. Through features like live sessions and challenges, participants can interact, collaborate, and learn from each other, fostering a sense of community and engagement.
- Virtual and In-Person Delivery ILT events and sessions can be conducted in both, virtual and in-person formats. It offers the flexibility to accommodate different training needs. Virtual ILTs allow participants to join from anywhere, eliminating geographical constraints and reducing travel costs. In-person ILTs provide face-to-face interaction and enable hands-on exercises and activities.
- Content Management Mindtickle's ILT feature allows instructors to upload and manage training materials, such as session recordings. These resources can be accessed by participants, ensuring consistent access to relevant content and reference materials.
- Learner Engagement ILTs in Mindtickle are designed to facilitate active learner engagement. Instructors can assess learners through live challenges to evaluate comprehension and reinforce learning objectives. This encourages interaction and collaboration among participants and instructors. It fosters a dynamic learning environment and enables real-time feedback and discussions.
- Structured Learning Experience ILTs offer a structured learning experience, providing a clear roadmap and sequence of topics. The events and sessions ensure that learners cover all the necessary content and activities in a logical and organized manner, reducing confusion and ensuring comprehensive learning.
- Reporting and Analytics Mindtickle provides robust reporting and analytics capabilities for ILT sessions. Instructors and administrators can generate reports on attendance, completion rates, learner performance, and overall training effectiveness. These insights enable data-driven decision-making and help assess the ROI of ILT programs.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Create an ILT module:
1. On the admin site homepage, click the Training icon and select Series . The Series page is displayed.
2. Click on a series. The Modules tab of the series is displayed.
3. Click Add module . The Add module screen is displayed. Tip : Click Browse module templates to browse pre-designed templates and create an ILT using an existing template. For more information on creating a module using a template, see Create a module using a module template .
4. On the Create new ILT pop-up, in Enter ILT name , enter a name for the ILT.
5. [ Skip this step if you have started creating the ILT from within a series.] In the Select a series dropdown, select the series in which you want to place the ILT. You can choose from the list of existing series, or create a new series using the Create a new series link.
6. In Enter description , enter the description for the ILT. The description helps set the context, objectives, and value of the ILT.
7. Click Edit to edit the ILT thumbnail.
8. Add a unique thumbnail to your ILT. Choose from a list of available options or upload a custom thumbnail. While creating and uploading a custom thumbnail image, follow the image size and format recommendations mentioned against the Upload custom thumbnail button. For more information, see How to update thumbnail image of a module? Note : You can also edit, update, or replace the ILT name, description, and thumbnail from the ILT Settings tab. For more information, see Configure ILT Settings .
9. Click Apply Tags to associate tags with the ILT.
10. On the Apply Tags pop-up, click the tags to select and click Apply Tags .
11. If you are a site owner, you can create a new tag relevant to your ILT.
12. Applying tags like Competency and Product Line enable learners to discover content easily and help admins analyze learner patterns efficiently. For more information, see Apply Tags to Modules . You can also add or remove tags from an ILT from the ILT header section. For more information, see ILT header . Note : If you do not have Tags enabled for your site, contact Mindtickle Support .
13. On the displayed Create new ILT screen, click Create . The ILT module is created successfully, and you are navigated to the draft state of the ILT.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Overview > What is a session?:
An ILT session in Mindtickle is a specific instance where learners gather together, physically or virtually, to engage in a guided learning experience facilitated by an instructor. It is typically conducted in a classroom-like setting or through a virtual platform (Zoom, Webex, MS Teams, etc.) and offers an opportunity for learners to receive real-time instruction, interact with the instructor and fellow learners, and engage in hands-on activities and discussions. Admins can also upload the session recording to the session. This enables enrolled learners to review the session content even if they have not attended it in real time.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Overview > What is an event?:
An event is a collection of multiple sessions. Admins can configure full-day/multi-day events comprising multiple sessions across multiple days. Examples include:

- Sales Onboarding Program : A series of sessions a new learner is expected to attend.
- Skills/Knowledge Orchestration Program : A series of sessions a learner can choose to attend based on their preference for week, timezone, and language.
- Company Level or Group Level Event : A series of sessions, some of which could be optional, the learner is expected to attend across several days.

Learners can view all available events and sessions inside an ILT module.

Note:

- An ILT module can comprise multi-day events and individual sessions.
- An event must have at least one session within it.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Overview > Enrollment in sessions and events:
Admins can configure enrollment settings such that learners can enroll for a complete event or individual sessions. If it is set to 'complete event', learners are automatically enrolled in all the sessions within the event when they enroll in the event. This is ideal for situations where learners are expected to attend all sessions within an event. If it is set to ‘individual session', learners can choose which sessions within the event they wish to enroll in. This is ideal for situations where specific sessions within an event may be optional.

Attendance in sessions and events

Learners’ attendance is captured at the individual session level. If a session allows for completion upon watching a recording, then watching the recording also counts towards session completion. The completion of the event as a whole is determined based on the percentage of sessions completed within that event. This can be set up in the event settings, where admins can specify the percentage of sessions that must be completed for the event to be considered complete.

This article further explains how to:

- Create an event
- Create sessions

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Create events:
To create an event:

1. Sign in to the admin site .
2. On the left navigation bar, click Training and select Series. The Series page is displayed.
3. Click on a series to add the ILT module The Modules tab of the series is displayed.
4. Click on the ILT module.
5. Click Create and select Event .
6. On the Create event screen, enter the event name and description and click Create event .

The event name and description reflect its goal, objectives, and relevance. Choose from various formatting options (add hyperlinks, underline text, add bulleted lists, etc.) to format the event description.Tip: Enhance the event experience by incorporating engaging supporting material, including welcome videos that set an exciting tone, insightful past-year reviews to reflect on our journey, and scheduled forecasts that add anticipation and depth to the overall program. These additions promise to elevate the interest and enrich the event's content. Click Attach supporting file to upload the content. Review the supported file types and sizes on the Upload attachment pop-up before uploading.

Note:

- The start and end dates and event format (classroom, online, or hybrid) are automatically derived from the sessions added to the event. For example, if the first session in the event is virtual and starts on Jan 1, 2024 at 10 AM and the last session is a classroom event and ends on Jan 10, 2024 at 5 PM, the event start and end date is automatically set to Jan 1, 2024 and Jan 10, 2024, respectively. Since the event has a mix of classroom and virtual sessions, the event format is set to ‘Hybrid’.
- There is no limit to the number of events created in an ILT module.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Create events > Enrollment:
1. Choose whether learners can enroll for the complete event or individual sessions. Complete event : When selected, learners who enroll for the event are automatically enrolled for all sessions in the event. This is useful for events where learners are expected to attend all sessions. However, the admin still has the ability to enroll learners for individual sessions if this setting is selected. Individual sessions : When selected, learners have the option to enroll for individual sessions within the event. This is useful for events where some sessions may be optional. Note :
  - This setting cannot be changed if at least one session within the event is published.
  - The event enrollment lock and limit settings are available only if event enrollment is set to Complete event .
2. Set the event enrollment lock date and time . You can choose to set the lock on a specific date and time or before a specific number of days before the event.
3. Set the enrollment limit for the event by defining the maximum number of learners allowed to enroll for the event. Setting an enrollment gives you the option to enable the waiting list for the event. Enabling the waiting list allows learners to join the waitlist for the event when maximum enrollment is reached. If the waiting list is enabled, you can choose to automatically enroll waiting list learners when a learner unenrolls from the event. Note :
  - The option to configure a waiting list for the event is available only if enrollment lock is enabled for the event.
  - When automatic enrollment is enabled, changing enrollment status manually is disabled.
4. Overriding condition : In some cases, a learner might not be able to attend one or more sessions within an event. Admins have the ability to override the event-level enrollment and unenroll or enroll a learner from individual sessions within the event. This overriding functionality is not available to learners and can only be performed by admins.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Create events > Completion:
The completion of an event is calculated based on the completion of the individual sessions within the event. Choose when an event should be marked as complete for the enrolled learners. You can set the completion criteria for the event as a whole, such as requiring learners to complete 100% of the sessions in the event, or allowing for some flexibility by requiring learners to complete a certain percentage of the sessions.

For more information on configuring session completion criteria, see Sessions: Completion criteria.

Note: The number of sessions are rounded off to the closest whole number.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > More actions on events > Cancel an event:
You can cancel only published, upcoming events. You cannot cancel live and completed events. Canceling an event cancels all sessions in it. To cancel an event:

1. Click More options and select Cancel .
2. In the Cancel event dialog box, enter the reason for cancellation and then click Yes, cancel . The instructors are notified by email about the cancellation. By default, Notify learners about the cancellation checkbox is checked. Keep it checked to automatically sync events with the instructor's and learner’s calendar. Note : When the event is canceled, the calendar invite is:
  - Deleted from the calendar (Google).
  - Struck out on the calendar (Microsoft Outlook).
3. On the Events and sessions tab, the canceled event shows the status as Canceled for the event and all sessions in it. Click Manage on the respective row to view the event/session information.
4. On returning to the Events and sessions tab, you will see that the canceled event is no longer visible. Note : When you cancel an event, the enrolled learners are not removed from the module. You can enroll these learners into another event from the Manage Enrollment across all events/sessions page or invite them to enroll themselves.

chunks.text: Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Create an individual session > Session details: - Score : Set the score to be awarded to the learners when they are marked as Attended in a session. To set a custom score, enter the number in the field. Use the Up or Down arrows to increase or decrease the score. If a learner is marked as Did Not Attend they are awarded zero points. By default, the learners get a full score. - Start date and Start time : Set the start date and time for the scheduled session. By default, the time is selected to the nearest half-hour to the time when you are creating the session. For example, if you create a session at 16:15, the start time selected by default will be 16:30. Note : For sessions within an event that has an enrollment lock date set, the session start date must not be before the event enrollment lock date. - End date and End time : Set the end time at which the scheduled session ends. By default, this is set to one hour after the Start Time . This cannot be set to a time earlier than the Start Time . Note : The length of the session is calculated from Start Time to End Time . For example, if the Start Time is June 15, 9:00 AM, and End Time is June 15, 5:00 PM, the ILT session length will be 8 hours. - Time zone : Set the time zone as per your requirement. You can easily browse through the comprehensive list or search for specific locations (by city, country, or timezone name), making it effortless to find and select the desired timezone. The scheduled time of your session automatically adjusts to changes due to daylight saving time. You can choose if you want the Session Time Zone for Learners to be displayed in the time zone selected by you while creating the session or the learners time zone (set in each learner’s profile field). For more information, see Session timezone for learners . Note : If your learners are geographically distributed or you are scheduling a session for a time zone you are unfamiliar with, we recommend using a time zone converter . - Classroom / Video conferencing details : Select either Video Conferencing or Classroom location from the drop-down list for the session type. By default, the Classroom location is selected. If you opt for a classroom session, enter the location where the session will be conducted in this field. If it is a video conference, enter the meeting or webinar URL. If Zoom, Webex, or MS Teams are enabled, you can add the respective VC tool's meeting to the session. With this integration, when learners attend the ILT session conducted over Zoom, Webex, or MS Teams their attendance is marked automatically. For more information, see ILT-Zoom Integration to Manage Meetings and Auto-Attendance , ILT-Webex Integration to Manage Meetings and Auto-Attendance , ILT-MS Teams Integration to Manage Meetings and Auto-Attendance . Note : - The option to generate a Zoom/Webex/MS Teams meetings from the session is available only when you schedule an individual session. It is not available when uploading sessions in bulk. - The webinar URL is included in an .ics file, which is used to import the invite to a calendar application. Mindtickle supports rich text formatting for URLs. However, certain versions of Outlook do not support rich text formatting and, hence, do not show the location URL as a clickable link. Such links, if included with rich text formatting, will look something like https://abc.xyz or look simply as dead unclickable text https://abc.xyz. To view URLs in the correct format, it is recommended to use Outlook (or other Calendar application) versions that support rich text formatting. - You can replace the webinar URL that appears in the Location field, with custom text, for example, The webinar link is provided in the description . - To enable this for your site, contact Mindtickle Support . - For webinars, you can add customized clickable text in the session description, for example, Click here to join the Webex meeting . On clicking, the user is redirected to the URL added in the session’s Location field. When the .ics file is used to add an event to any Calendar app, the clickable customized text appears before the session description in the email body of the .ics file. To enable this for your site, contact Mindtickle Support .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Instructors and facilitators:
1. Click + Add instructor . Provide the instructor’s name, email address, and a brief introduction. The instructor’s name and email address are required fields, while the Instructor description field is optional. Note :
  1. If the session is a video conferencing session, you can assign the instructor as the co-host for the meeting. For more information, depending on the video conferencing tool, see ILT-Zoom Integration to Manage Meetings and Auto-Attendance , ILT-Webex Integration to Manage Meetings and Auto-Attendance , or ILT-MS Teams Integration to Manage Meetings and Auto-Attendance .
  2. When creating a single session, there is no limit to the number of instructors that you can add.
  3. When uploading bulk sessions, you can add up to 6 instructors in each session.
2. The Notify Instructors via email checkbox is selected by default. This ensures the session details are shared with the instructor via email. Instructors receive updated emails when:
  1. The ILT module is published
  2. The session time or location is updated
  3. An instructor is added or removed
  4. In-session activity is updated
3. Once the session is created, it is automatically added to the instructor’s synced work calendar. If the session details, such as time, type, or location, are changed, the details are updated on the calendar and the old invite is deleted. If the session is canceled, the invite is deleted from the instructor’s calendar. Note :
  1. Currently, the auto-sync supports Google and Microsoft Outlook calendars. To receive automatic updates on the calendar:
    - Ensure module-level reminders are turned on. For more information, see Configure ILT Settings .
    - The learner must set calendar permissions accordingly.
  2. For sessions scheduled before the auto-sync feature is enabled on the site:
    - If the session is canceled, the invite is not canceled from the calendar even if this feature is enabled.
    - If the session details (time, type, or location) are updated, a new invite with the updated details is added to the calendar. The old invite is not automatically deleted from the calendar.

In case a facilitator is important and should be visible to the learner in session details, then you can add that facilitator as an instructor while creating the session.
  3. For more information on the difference between an instructor and a facilitator and their roles and responsibilities, see Who are instructors and facilitators in ILT sessions?

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Instructors and facilitators > Enrollment > Enrollment lock:
- Admins can change this setting if required.
- Enrollment lock cannot be set for past or live sessions.
- Enrollment lock date and time must be set between the current time and the session start date and time. It cannot be after the session’s end date and end time.
- When uploading sessions in bulk,
  - if the Enrollment Lock Date and Enrollment Lock TIme fields are blank, enrollment lock is not enabled for the session.
  - if the Enrollment Lock Date field is specified and the Enrollment Lock TIme is blank, enrollment lock is enabled, and the enrollment lock time is set to 00:00 on the enrollment lock date.
  - if the Enrollment Lock Date field is blank and the Enrollment Lock TIme is specified, the enrollment lock is disabled for the session.
  - if the enrollment lock date and time are entered incorrectly for a session, the Upload List operation fails and an error message is displayed. In such cases, rectify the details in the list and upload the list again.
- You can edit the enrollment lock date and time even after the lock date has passed.
- You can enroll or unenroll learners even after the enrollment lock date has passed.
- You can enroll or unenroll learners even after the session end date has passed. This allows you to manage learner attendance for past sessions.
- This feature does not affect:
  - Auto enrollments when marking attendance via auto-attendance through Zoom, Webex, or MS Teams.
  - Auto enrollments from the waitlist (after an enrolled learner is removed from the enrollment list post the enrollment lock date).

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Instructors and facilitators > Enrollment > Waiting list:
Enable a waiting list in a session so that when a session is full, learners are able to join the waiting list. This setting can only be enabled if a limit is set on the number of enrollments in a session. Switch the toggle to enable the waiting list. When enabled, the following settings become available:

- Automatically enroll waiting list learners when someone unenrolls
- Notify learners via email when they move from the waiting list to the enrollment list

Switch the toggles for the respective settings ON to enable them.

Note: If you have enabled the following settings, then, learners cannot be enrolled from the admin site; they must be enrolled from the learning site.

- Limit the number of enrollments on the session
- Enable waiting list
- Automatically enroll waiting list learners when someone unenrolls

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Instructors and facilitators > Attendance and completion > Session check-in:
The self check-in option enables learners to mark their attendance for a session. This avoids having the admin manually mark all learners’ attendance using the Upload Attendance option. Learners can mark attendance using a QR code or the equivalent 6-digit code (check-in code) anytime during the period configured by you. For classroom sessions, instructors can display the check-in code anywhere in the classroom and for webinars or virtual sessions, you can display the check-in code on the screen. Learners can scan the QR code using the Mindtickle app or enter the 6-digit code (on the web or app) to mark their attendance.

You can configure self check-in for all types of sessions, except for deleted and canceled sessions. This allows you to extend the self check-in period for a session if necessary. Self check-in is enabled by default only for the upcoming sessions and is disabled by default for the past (Session Over) and live sessions.

Note:

- The check-in code is generated after the session is created. You can share it with your learners via your preferred mode of communication.
- Only enrolled learners can mark their attendance using self check-in.
- To ensure you capture attendance of learners that stayed for an appropriate duration, we recommend displaying the check-in code either during or at the end of the session.
- The admin marking attendance takes precedence over learners marking attendance through self check-in. If a learner has marked their attendance, the admin can overwrite it by changing the attendance status.

To configure session check-in for the session:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Instructors and facilitators > Attendance and completion > Session check-in:
1. Switch the toggle ON to enable session check-in for learners.
2. Set the check-in validity period. The check-in window is open based on the check-in validity period. By default, learners can check in without time restrictions before and after the session. However, the admin can set a validity period for check-in by clicking on the Set the check-in validity period checkbox. Learners can self check-in by entering the check-in code or by scanning the QR code. Note : The code is always valid for check-in throughout the session duration. If selected, you configure the code’s validity for check-in to a maximum of 1 hour before the session and 24 hours after the session. If this is not selected, learners can check-in for the session without time restrictions.
3. Checking the Send email to instructors and Set email to facilitators checkboxes sends an automated email with the QR code to all session instructors and facilitators 24 hours up until the session begins.
4. In cases where you create a session that is happening within 24 hours, you cannot get the QR code using the Send email to instructors and Send email to facilitators options above. In such cases, you can immediately get the QR code using one of the following options available below the QR code:

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Instructors and facilitators > Attendance and completion > Completion criteria:
Choose when a session should be marked as complete for the enrolled learners. You can choose between the following two options:

- Learner attends session only - if selected, the session is marked as complete if learners attend the session.
- Learner attends session or watches session recordings - if selected, the session is marked as complete if learner attends the session or watches the session recording.

Note:

- By default, the completion criteria is selected as Learner attends session only .
- If the completion criteria is selected as Learner attends session or watches session recordings , the session is marked as complete if the learner attends the session or watches at least 95% of the recording.

With this option, you can enable learners to watch the recording and go through the session content if they have not attended it. For more details, see Upload recording.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Instructors and facilitators > Reminders:
Configure the invitation and reminder emails for the session.

Note: If reminders are configured at the event level, they are automatically available at the session level also. You can edit or delete the event level reminders or even add new reminders for individual sessions.

Emails and notifications are sent to the enrolled learners. Click + Add reminder and set how many number of days, hours, and minutes before the session the reminder should be sent. Repeat this process to set multiple reminders.

Click Create session.

Based on whether you created a session inside or outside the event, the session is added.

Note:

- The event start and end dates, time, and event format (classroom, online, or hybrid) are automatically derived from the sessions added to the event. For example, if the first session in the event is virtual and starts on Jan 1, 2024 at 10 AM and the last session is a classroom event and ends on Jan 10, 2024 at 5 PM, the event start and end date is automatically set to Jan 1, 2024 and Jan 10, 2024, respectively. Since the event has a mix of classroom and virtual sessions, the event format is set to ‘Hybrid’.
- If you have multiple sessions scheduled for the same time on the same day, they will appear in random order for learners.

Configure the ILT settings and publish the module before you invite learners to the ILT.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Upload bulk sessions:
To upload multiple sessions in bulk:

1. On the Upload sessions pop-up, click Download sample . The .xlsx file that is downloaded to your local machine, contains 3 sheets: NEW SESSIONS - New ILT Session , Instructions , and Drop Down Data . Tip : Go through the instructions before you add information for the new session. The New SESSION - New ILT Session sheet consists of fields for Session Name , Session Type , Session Description , Start Date , Start Time , End Date , End Time , Enrollment Lock Date , Enrollment Lock Time , Time Zone , Location/URL , Password (required for Webex for auto-attendance), Reminder before , Maximum Enrollments , Waiting List , Score , Notify Instructors via Email , and Instructor Details . Enter the data in each field and save it to your local machine. Note : If a Webex meeting is set up for the session, enter the password in the Password (required for Webex for Auto-attendance) field for the respective session. For non-Webex meetings, leave the field blank.
2. Click Upload File and upload the file in the .xslx format. Alternatively, drag and drop the file from your system onto this screen. The Upload sessions screen appears with the session details. Click Create sessions to complete the action or click Upload again to upload a new list.

The sessions are created successfully and are listed on the Sessions tab of the session creation canvas.

Configure the ILT settings and publish the module before you invite learners to the ILT. For more information on how to manage sessions and manage learners’ enrollment across sessions, see Manage Events, Sessions, and Learners’ Enrollment in ILT.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > More actions on sessions > Upload session recording:
Use this option to upload a session recording to the session. Once uploaded, the recording is available on the sessions page of your learning site to all learners who have enrolled for the session. A link to the recording is also included in the session recording emails sent to the admin, participants, and attendees. This provides access to the recorded content of a session, allowing participants to review or catch up on the material covered during the session. In some cases, it also enables learners to go through the session content even if they do not attend it.

For more information on emails specific to ILT session recordings, see ILT session recording emails.

Note:

- This option is available only for (published) live and past sessions. For more information on how to publish a session, see Publish .
- You can upload the session recording anytime after the session starts.
- You can upload only one recording to a session with a file size limit of 500 MB per video.
- The supported file formats for the recording are .flv, .mp4, .avi, .wmv, .mov, .mkv, .m4v, .mpg, .mpeg, .vob, and .webm.

To upload a recording:

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > More actions on sessions > Upload session recording:
1. Click More Options > Upload recording .
2. On the Upload recording for the session panel, drag and drop the recording. Alternatively, click anywhere on the highlighted area to browse. You can choose to upload the file from the available source options. Tip : For the best learner experience, adhere to the recommended file size and types mentioned.
3. While the file is being uploaded, you can choose to set or reset the completion criteria for the session. Click anywhere on the completion criteria or the arrow and select from the available options. The processing time may vary depending on the size of the file being uploaded.
4. Click Save to complete the upload process. Note : You may move away from the page while the video gets uploaded and processed. However, exiting from the ILT discards all the progress and changes made.
5. In the pop-up, click Save . On the displayed pop-up,click Save . You are directed to the Sessions page, and the Recording status is set to Processing . Once the processing is complete:
  1. The icon appears on the session row. Clicking the icon opens the Upload recording for session panel. From this panel, you can:
    1. View the recording. Click the Play button to start viewing.
    2. Rename the recording. Click the Edit icon next to the file name to edit it. This file name is visible to the learners on the learning site.
    3. Replace the recording. Click the Replace button to replace it.
    4. Delete the recording. Click the Delete icon to delete it. Note : Replacing or deleting the recording resets the learners’ progress in the session.
  2. The recording becomes available to learners on the learning site.
  3. Admin and all enrolled learners receive an email with a link to the recording. If the upload operation fails, the admin receives an email notifying them about the same. For more information, see ILT session recording emails.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > More actions on sessions > Upload session recording > ILT session recording emails:
ILT session recording emails are sent to admins, participants or attendees of an ILT session. These emails:

- serve the purpose of providing access to the recorded content of a training session, allowing participants to review or catch up on the material covered during the session.
- offer flexibility and convenience to participants who may have missed the live training or wish to revisit the content for reinforcement or reference purposes.

These emails ensure participants have continued access to valuable training resources, even after the live session has concluded.

The following table lists the types of emails sent, the email recipients, and the trigger points for each email.

Note: The emails listed below are not customizable. To update or customize them, contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).
chunks.body:
ILT session recording emails are sent to admins, participants or attendees of an ILT session. These emails:

- serve the purpose of providing access to the recorded content of a training session, allowing participants to review or catch up on the material covered during the session.
- offer flexibility and convenience to participants who may have missed the live training or wish to revisit the content for reinforcement or reference purposes.

These emails ensure participants have continued access to valuable training resources, even after the live session has concluded.

The following table lists the types of emails sent, the email recipients, and the trigger points for each email.

Note: The emails listed below are not customizable. To update or customize them, contact Mindtickle Support or your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > More actions on sessions > Cancel a session:
You can cancel only published, upcoming sessions. You cannot cancel live and completed sessions. To cancel a session:

1. Click More options > Cancel .
2. In the Cancel Session dialog box that appears, enter the reason for cancellation and then click Yes, Cancel this Session . The instructors are notified by email about the cancellation. By default, Notify Learners about the cancellation checkbox is checked. Keep it checked to automatically sync session events with the instructor's and learner’s calendar. Note : When the session is canceled, the calendar invite is:
  - Deleted from the calendar (Google).
  - Struck out on the calendar (Microsoft Outlook).
3. On the Events and s essions tab, the canceled session shows the status as Canceled .
4. Click Manage to view the session information.
5. On the session page, you can view the list of learners who were enrolled. Hover over the Information icon next to the Canceled status to view the reason for cancellation.
6. To view the Cancelled sessions on the Events and sessions tab,
  - Click the Status filter and select the Cancelled checkbox.
  - Click Apply .

The Cancelled sessions are displayed

Note: When you cancel a session, the enrolled learners are not removed from the module. You can enroll these learners into another session from the Invite and enroll tab page or invite them to enroll themselves.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > More actions on sessions > Filter events and sessions:
You can apply the following filters on the events and sessions to find a specific event or session from the list.

- Type - Click the dropdown and select All types , Independent sessions , Event and sessions within it . Once you apply a type filter, applying all other filters retrieve results based on the option selected in this filter.
- Status - Click the dropdown and select Published , Unpublished , or Cancelled to retrieve the respective type of sessions from the list. By default, Published and Unpublished are selected.
- Time - Click the dropdown and select All , Live , Upcoming , or Past to retrieve the respective type of events/sessions from the list.
- Date - Click the dropdown and select All sessions since beginning , Today’s sessions only , Last 7 days , Next 7 days , or Custom range to retrieve the respective type of events/sessions from the list. If you select Custom range , enter the date range to retrieve the events/sessions from that period.
- Format - Click the dropdown and select All , Classroom , Video conferencing, or Hybrid to retrieve the respective type of events/sessions from the list.

Alternatively, use the Search field to search for a particular session in the list. Click Reset filters to clear and reset the applied filters.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT):
Before you publish an ILT, ensure you have configured all settings. For more information, see Configure ILT Settings.

The process of publishing an ILT is completed in 2 stages:

- Complete all tasks on the To-do list
- Publish the ILT

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Complete all tasks on the To-do list:
The To-do list provides a list of all tasks that must be completed before you publish an ILT. You cannot publish an ILT if there are pending tasks on the To-do list. To access the To-do list:

1. Sign in to the admin site .
2. On the left navigation bar, click Training and select Series.
3. Click the series with the ILT module. For example, Acme Product Training .
4. Click the ILT module. For example, Acme Sales Kick-Off .
5. In the ILT header, click the To-Do icon.

The list of pending tasks (if any) is displayed. Clicking a task displays the page on which it needs to be completed. Complete the task as required.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Publish the ILT:
To publish the ILT:

1. Navigate to the Publish tab. The following screen is displayed if you publish the ILT for the first time. Otherwise, the following screen with the previous publishing history is displayed. Tip : Click a date under the Publish History to view the changes published in that version of the ILT.
2. To publish the ILT module, choose if you want to invite all learners invited to the ILT or if you do not want to invite anyone.
3. By default, the Notify learners about this update via email checkbox is unchecked. Click the checkbox if you wish to notify the invited learners via email.
4. Click Publish changes . Note : The Publish history records are updated every time an ILT is updated and published. Each record also details the changes made to the ILT in that version. You can edit and republish an ILT after publishing it. To edit the ILT after publishing it, make the necessary updates and follow the steps mentioned in Complete all tasks in the To-do list and Publish the ILT . A pop-up is displayed once the ILT is published.
5. Click Go to Invite and enroll.
6. On the Invite and enroll tab, you can view all learners invited to the module, their module relevance and attendance status.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > View ILT analytics:
Analytics for the ILT (Instructor-Led Training) module provides data and insights to admins on learners’ participation (attendance and enrollment) in an ILT. It provides analytics in the form of overview widgets, top stats, and detailed tables.

ILT analytics gives a consolidated view of how learners are doing across events and sessions for an ILT in a particular series. Moreover, if an ILT is present across multiple series, admins can apply filters to view the ILT’s data for all series where it is multi-present.

To view ILT analytics:

1. In the ILT, click View analytics . Note : The View analytics option is enabled once the ILT is published. It is disabled for draft ILT modules. The ILT analytics dashboard opens in a new browser tab.

Alternatively, you can access ILT analytics from the Analytics tab on the admin homepage. For more information, see Module Reports > ILT.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Enroll learners in events or sessions > To enroll or waitlist an individual learner:
1. Sign in to the admin site .
2. On the left navigation bar, click Training and select Series .
3. Click the series with the ILT module. For example, Acme Product Training .
4. Click the ILT module. For example, Acme Sales Kick-Off 2025 .
5. Click Settings to view the ILT module settings.
6. Click on the Invite and enroll tab
7. The list of all learners invited to the module is displayed. The table also displays the number of events or sessions a learner has Attended , Enrolled for, and Waitlisted in. Tip : Click the number under any column to open a page listing all sessions or events the learner is invited to.
8. Click Manage .
9. Alternatively, on the Invite and enroll tab, click anywhere on the learner row. A list of all the sessions and events the learner is invited to is displayed. This page also displays the learner’s enrollment and attendance status across all sessions and events.
10. Click Modify enrollment status . The Manage enrollment for learner page is displayed. Tip : Use the available filters to filter the list of sessions based on the Type, Status , Date , and Format . Alternatively, enter the session name in the Search field to quickly find it.
11. Click Enroll or Waitlist on the event or session. The learner is successfully enrolled or waitlisted for the session or event, and the email is scheduled for the learner. Note : The Notify learners via email toggle is turned on by default. This ensures the learner receives an email every time their enrollment status changes. It also ensures that the learner’s work calendar is automatically synced. Moreover, the learner’s work calendar automatically reflects future session updates. To ensure learners receive automatic updates for the session, turn on the Notify learners via email toggle. Turn the toggle off if you do not wish to apply the ILT-calendar auto-sync and notify learners about the change.
12. To unenroll a learner from a particular session, click Unenroll .

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Enroll learners in events or sessions > To enroll or waitlist multiple learners:
1. Navigate to the Invite and enroll tab in the ILT module. The list of all learners invited to the module is displayed. Select the learners you want to enroll or waitlist and click Manage enrollment in the bulk action tray. The list of sessions is displayed in the Manage enrollment for n learners page. Click Enroll or Waitlist for the particular event or session you want to enroll or waitlist the selected learners. Note :
  1. The bulk actions are performed at the event or session level. If enrollment is set at the event level, clicking Enroll will enroll all the selected learners for all the sessions in the event. If enrollment is set at the individual session level, clicking Enroll will enroll all the selected learners for only the selected session of the event. Clicking Waitlist will waitlist all the selected learners. For example, in the screenshot above, all selected learners are enrolled for all the sessions in the event Company Kick Off Series but are enrolled only for one session from the event SKO Series: Igniting Success in 5 Days and are waitlisted in the session Sales Tech Stack Overview .
    1. If a selected learner is already enrolled for the session, no action is performed.
    2. If the number of selected learners exceeds the number of available seats, the Enroll action is disabled. To continue enrolling the learners, reduce the number of selected learners or increase the maximum seat limit in the event/session.
  2. The Notify learners via email toggle is turned on by default. This ensures the learners receive an email every time their enrollment status changes. It also ensures the learners’ work calendar is automatically synced. Moreover, the learners’ work calendar automatically reflects future session updates. To ensure learners receive automatic updates for the session, ensure the Notify learners via email toggle is turned on. Turn the toggle off if you don’t wish to apply the ILT-calendar auto-sync and notify learners about the change.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Enroll learners in events or sessions > To enroll or waitlist multiple learners:
- The invite is added to the learner’s synced (work) calendar.
- If the event/session details, such as time, type, or location are changed, a new invite with the updated details is created on the calendar, and the old invite is deleted.
- If the event/session is canceled, the invite is deleted from the learner’s calendar. Caution : This update applies only to ILT events and sessions that are scheduled and conducted post the auto-sync feature is enabled on the site. Learners may or may not see conflicting meeting invites on their calendars for events or sessions scheduled before the feature is enabled. For enrollments done before the auto-sync feature is enabled on the site:
- If a learner has downloaded the event/session .ics file and created a calendar invite and the event/session time, type, or location is updated (post feature enablement date), the learner will see a duplicate invite on the calendar for that session.
- If a learner has downloaded the event/session .ics file and created a calendar invite and the event/session is canceled (cancelation done post feature enablement date), the calendar invite will not be automatically deleted. For enrollments done after the auto-sync feature is enabled on the site:
- A calendar invite for that session is automatically created on the learner’s work calendar.
- If the event/session details, such as time, type, or location are changed, a new invite with the updated details is created on the calendar, and the old invite is deleted.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Manage events:
You can manage an event from the Event page. Managing an event involves various tasks, such as editing the event details and managing enrolled learners’ enrollment and attendance. From the event page, you can add sessions to the event, edit event details, and upload learners’ attendance in bulk. You can also perform bulk actions on learners, such as manage enrollment, mark attendance, send emails, and remove from ILT.

To manage an event:

1. On the Events and sessions tab, click Manage . The event page displays the list of invited learners. It also displays the following details:
  - Event details : Displays the date, start time, and duration of the event, the time zone selected by the admin during event creation, the status of the session, the number of learners enrolled, attended, and waitlisted in the event, and the enrollment lock details (if enrollment lock is enabled).
  - Learner : Displays the name of the invited learner.
  - Enrollment/Waitlist status : Displays the learner's enrollment status ( Enrolled or Waiting ).
  - Attendance status : Displays the learner's attendance status.
  - Completion : Displays if the learner has completed the event. This is based on the completion criteria configured in the event settings.
  - Score : Displays the learner's score. The score is allotted to the learner based on the completion criteria.
  - Enrolled / Waitlisted on : Displays the date on which the learner enrolled in the event or joined the waiting list.
  - More Options : Click More Options on the learner row to perform the following actions:
    - View learner profile : View learner’s profile.
    - Email learner : Send an email to the learner.
    - Remove from ILT : Remove the learner from the ILT module.

chunks.text:

1. Navigate to the Events and s essions tab and click Manage against the session you want to manage. Note :
  - The orange lock in the Enrolled column indicates enrollment is locked, and learners cannot enroll or unenroll themselves from the session.
  - The grey lock in the Enrolled column indicates enrollment is open, and learners can enroll or unenroll themselves from the session until the enrollment lock date passes.
2. The session page appears and displays the list of learners invited to the session. It also displays the following details:
  - Session details : Displays the date and time of the session, the time zone selected by the admin during session creation, the duration of the session, the status of the session, the number of learners enrolled, attended, and waitlisted in the session, and the enrollment lock details (if enrollment lock is enabled).
  - Learner : Displays the name of the invited learner.
  - Enrollment / Waitlist status : Displays the learner's enrollment status ( Enrolled or Waiting ).
  - Attendance status : Displays the learner's attendance status.
    - If the completion criteria is set to Learner attends session only , setting it to Attended awards the learner with a full score, and the session completion is marked as Yes .
    - If the completion criteria is set to Learner attends session or watches session recordings , and the learner has viewed the recording, the learner is awarded a full score, and the session completion is marked as Yes even if the attendance is Unmarked or Did not attend . If the session is over, you can mark the attendance of learners on this page. Click a learner’s attendance status and select an option to mark the status as Attended , Did not attend , or Unmarked . Setting it to Attended awards the learner with a full Score. To bulk upload the attendance of learners, click Upload Attendance . For more information, see Upload attendance .
  - Recording viewed : Displays if the learner has watched the session recording. Note : This column is available only if the completion criteria for the session is set to Learner attends session or watches session recordings .
  - Completion : Displays if the learner has completed the session. This is based on the completion criteria configured in the session settings.
    - If the completion criteria is set to Learner attends session only , the session completion is marked as Yes only if the Attendance is marked as Attended .
    - If the completion criteria is set to Learner attends session or watches session recordings , the session completion is marked as Yes if the attendance is Unmarked , Attended , or Did not attend , but the learner has viewed the recording.
    - If the completion criteria is set to Learner attends session or watches session recordings , the session completion is marked as No if the learner has neither attended the session nor watched the session recording.
  - Score : Displays the learner's score. The score is allotted to the learner based on the completion criteria.
  - Enrolled / Waitlisted on : Displays the date on which the learner enrolled in the session or joined the waiting list.
  - More Options : Click the More Options icon on the learner row to perform the following actions:
    - View profile : View learner’s profile.
    - Send email : Send an email to the learner.
    - Remove from ILT : Remove the learner from the ILT module.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Manage sessions > Manage session details for multi-present ILT modules:
Multi-present ILT modules are present in more than one series. Learners enrolled or waitlisted in such modules can be present in multiple series. Apart from providing the details mentioned above, the Session page for multi-present modules provides details specific to other series. This allows admins to track learner enrollment data for multi-present ILT modules across series from a single page.

An admin can access the Session page of a multi-present ILT module from any series the module is present in. It displays:

- The maximum number of seats in the session and the total number of enrolled and waitlisted learners across all series. It also displays a clear distinction between the number of learners enrolled, attended, and waitlisted in the series.
- The number of other series in which enrolled or waitlisted learners are present. Click n other Series to view the list of series.
- Click a series on the list to go to the Session page for the same ILT module in that particular series.
- An accurate representation of enrolled or waitlisted learners present in multiple series. This helps in getting a unique count of enrolled learners for each series.
- Click n other Series to view the list of other series in which the learner is present.
- Click a series in the list to go to the Session page for the same ILT module in that particular series. Note : All admins can view the list of series. However, only series creators or series collaborators can use the series link from the list to access them.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Upload attendance:
You can upload learners’ attendance in bulk. To ensure that you upload the attendance in the correct format, use Mindtickle’s sample file. Follow the steps mentioned below:

1. Click Upload Attendance .
2. On the Upload attendance screen, click Download sample . The sample file is downloaded to your system. Open it using Microsoft Excel. It contains two sheets, Enrollment List and Instructions . Before you start filling in the worksheet, read the instructions carefully. Enter appropriate data in each field in the Enrollment List sheet, save the file, and upload it. Alternatively, upload a Zoom attendance file.
3. Once the file is uploaded successfully, the data is populated on the Upload attendance screen.
4. Click to delete the learner’s attendance record from the list, click Reupload to reupload the list entirely, else click Upload attendance to upload the attendance of the learners. The session page appears with each learner's updated attendance and score details.

chunks.text:
Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Upload attendance > Add notes for learner attendance:
Admins can add and manage notes for learner attendance in individual ILT sessions and sessions that are part of events. These notes help document valid absence reasons, avoid unnecessary penalties, and maintain accurate attendance records.For example, if a learner misses a session due to illness or a company event, admins can add a note and update the absence reason.Note: To disable this feature for your learning site, contact Mindtickle Support.To add a learner note,

1. In the Events and sessions tab of an ILT module, click Manage on a session that is part of an event or click Manage on an individual session. The learners' attendance details for the session are displayed. Click the More options icon, then click Add note . The Attendance Note pop-up is displayed.
2. Enter the note details. You can enter up to 5000 characters. For example, the learner was sick and did not attend this session.
3. Click Save . The system adds the note and displays a Note icon next to the learner’s name. Note: Only admins can see the learner notes.

Help & Support > Help Center Home > Content Development > Instructor-Led Training (ILT) > Manage learners' enrollment across events and sessions:
To track and manage learners’ enrollment across all events and sessions:

1. Navigate to the Invite and enroll tab. All the learners invited to the ILT events and sessions are listed. Use the available filters to quickly find a learner from the list:
  1. Invited : Filter the list based on the time of invite - All invited, Invited this month , or Invited previous month .
  2. Groups : Select a group from the dropdown to display the data of learners of a particular group.
